paper.title: Partition-Aware Unlearning for Removing Spurious Correlations in Large Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) achieve strong performance across many multimodal tasks; however, they often exploit spurious object-background correlations, resulting in predictions driven by contextual shortcuts rather than object-relevant visual evidence. Despite growing interest in hallucination and robustness evaluation, existing benchmarks provide limited control over whether model predictions are grounded in the target object or induced by correlated background cues. In this work, we

summary.core_problem: LVLM在目标-背景存在虚假相关时会走“背景捷径”，导致不基于目标证据的错误预测；需要可控构造与可操作的缓解手段。
summary.importance: 把“虚假相关/捷径学习”从泛泛的鲁棒性讨论，落到可分区的数据构造与可执行的unlearning流程；对多模态预训练的data curation、对齐目标与稳健性评估有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出PURGE框架：用结构化数据构造策略把样本按“目标相关证据 vs 背景诱导线索”分区；在此基础上做partition-aware unlearning以削弱模型对背景线索的依赖，并提供对应benchmark与缓解流程。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体LVLM基座、参数量与训练细节；实验围绕构造的分区数据评测“背景诱导错误”并验证unlearning可降低该类失败，同时尽量保持原能力（具体幅度需看正文表格）。

summary_en.core_problem: LVLMs exploit spurious object-background correlations, producing predictions driven by contextual shortcuts rather than object-grounded evidence.
summary_en.importance: Turns shortcut learning into a controllable, partitioned data construction + actionable unlearning recipe, offering concrete implications for multimodal pretraining data curation, alignment objectives, and robustness evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: PURGE: structured dataset construction that partitions examples by object-relevant evidence vs spurious background cues, then applies partition-aware unlearning to suppress reliance on spurious cues, alongside a benchmark protocol.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract omits base LVLMs, scales, and training details; experiments evaluate spurious-correlation-induced failures on the constructed partitions and show unlearning reduces such errors while aiming to preserve general performance (check tables for deltas).

recommendation.zh: 把“背景捷径”做成可控分区数据+可执行unlearning，适合反哺多模态数据配比与过滤；只看数据构造策略和unlearning消融表就够。
recommendation.en: Makes background shortcuts measurable via partitioned data and actionable via unlearning—useful for multimodal data mixing/filtering; read the dataset construction and the unlearning ablation tables.

paper.title: Learning to Ground Before Reading: Unified PCB Engineering Drawing Parsing with Compact Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: PCB engineering drawings mix sparse graphics, dense tables, and text whose meaning depends on page position. Localizing the regions and sending crops to specialized recognizers are determined as the methods for most parsers, so missed regions cannot be recovered downstream. We train a compact VLM to read the full page and get a sequence of region classes, normalized boxes, and text or HTML content. Bounding boxes are converted to coordinate tokens for supervision. Inference uses no detector or c

summary.core_problem: 解决 PCB 工程图解析中“先检测再裁剪识别”流水线容易漏检且无法回补的问题，尝试用紧凑 VLM 直接从整页图像生成结构化解析结果。
summary.importance: 贡献属于文档/版面理解里的统一建模与训练课程设计。虽然是特定领域应用，但“先学 grounding 再学 content”的训练顺序，对多模态预训练和结构化输出建模有一点可迁移价值。
summary.technical_approach: 训练一个 compact VLM 直接读取整页，输出区域类别、归一化框坐标 token，以及文本或 HTML 内容。为缓解 class/box token 相对内容 token 稀疏、联合目标难优化的问题，提出 localization-first curriculum：先学习 class-box 格式，再加入内容目标，并配合 content-aware resampling。
summary.experiments: 在 Engineering Drawing Dataset 固定验证集上，Localization-First 相比直接 joint training，strict localization F1 提升 0.0955，95% bootstrap 区间为 [0.0350, 0.1572]。摘要未给出模型参数量，只强调模型较小且推理时不需要 detector 或 crop parser。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets PCB engineering drawing parsing, where detector-plus-crop pipelines miss regions that cannot be recovered downstream, and instead uses a compact VLM to parse the full page end-to-end.
summary_en.importance: The contribution sits in document understanding with unified multimodal modeling and curriculum design. It is still domain-specific, but the “ground before reading” training order has some transferable value for multimodal pretraining and structured generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: A compact VLM is trained to read the whole page and emit region classes, normalized box coordinate tokens, and text or HTML content. To address the optimization imbalance where class/box tokens are sparse relative to long content sequences, the paper proposes a localization-first curriculum: learn class-box formatting first, then add content targets with content-aware resampling.
summary_en.experiments: On the fixed validation split of the Engineering Drawing Dataset, Localization-First improves strict localization F1 by 0.0955 over joint training, with a 95% paired image-bootstrap interval of [0.0350, 0.1572]. The abstract does not provide parameter count, only that the model is compact and inference requires no detector or crop parser.

recommendation.zh: 偏应用，但训练信号稀疏失衡这个问题是真实的；只看 curriculum 设计即可，别把领域结果当成通用 VLM 结论。
recommendation.en: Application-heavy, but the sparse-target optimization issue is real; read it for the curriculum idea, not for any broad VLM conclusion.

paper.title: LOCI: A Locator-Critic with Refinement Loop
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) still struggle on tasks requiring complex visual understanding. We argue that the core issue is not high-level reasoning, but instead failing to locate critical details in the image. Due to this shortcoming, VLMs generate often plausible but incorrect reasoning based on flawed perceptual grounding. To address this, we propose Locator-Critic (LOCI), a training-free framework that decouples visual search from evidence verification. LOCI employs a Locator agent to prop

summary.core_problem: VLM 在复杂视觉问答中常因找不到关键视觉证据而推理失真，论文试图用训练外的定位-批判闭环修正这一问题。
summary.importance: 贡献属于 inference-time agentic scaffolding，而不是预训练本身。它有一点启发：复杂多模态错误未必来自高层推理，而可能来自感知 grounding 失败，这对原生多模态预训练目标设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 LOCI 框架，将视觉搜索与证据验证解耦：Locator 负责提出候选视觉证据，Critic 评估其相关性与充分性，两者通过 refinement loop 迭代，直到证据足以支持回答。整体是 training-free 的测试时方法。
summary.experiments: 在多个复杂视觉 benchmark 上评测，报告对开源模型如 Qwen3-VL 在 V*、HR-Bench 等上有明显增益，也对闭源模型如 Gemini 2.5 Pro 有提升。论文强调 gains 来自更好的 evidence grounding，而非额外训练或更强解码器。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Mathilde Caron、Arsha Nagrani、Cordelia Schmid，均与视觉表征和多模态研究相关。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper argues that VLM failures on complex visual tasks often come from missing critical visual evidence rather than weak high-level reasoning, and proposes a test-time loop to fix that.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-time agentic method rather than a pretraining paper. Its main value for pretraining researchers is the diagnosis: many multimodal reasoning errors may actually be grounding failures, which matters for native multimodal objective design.
summary_en.technical_approach: LOCI decouples visual search from evidence verification. A Locator proposes candidate evidence, a Critic checks relevance and sufficiency, and the two interact in an iterative refinement loop until the evidence is adequate for answering. The framework is training-free.
summary_en.experiments: It reports substantial gains on multiple challenging visual benchmarks, including improvements for open models such as Qwen3-VL on V* and HR-Bench, and gains for closed models like Gemini 2.5 Pro. The paper attributes the gains to better perceptual grounding rather than extra training.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Mathilde Caron, Arsha Nagrani, and Cordelia Schmid, all well known in visual representation and multimodal research.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但它把“推理错”拆成“先没看对”，这个诊断值得记；只看方法图和误差分析就够了。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the diagnosis is useful: many VLM reasoning failures are really perception failures; read the method figure and error analysis, then move on.

paper.title: Beyond Atomic Layouts: Compositional Design Understanding with Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Layout understanding, or the interpretation of element organization, is essential for document analysis, user interface (UI) creation, and graphic design. While recent vision-language models (VLMs) excel at interpreting atomic layouts composed of independent elements, they struggle with compositional layouts that require reasoning over visually entangled elements within hierarchical multi-layer structures. In this paper, we introduce a new task, compositional layout understanding, and present Co

summary.core_problem: 研究 VLM 是否能理解多层级、元素相互纠缠的组合式版面，而不只是识别彼此独立的简单布局元素。
summary.importance: 贡献包括一个新的组合式版面理解任务、约 20K 真实多层布局 VQA 数据集 CoDeLayout，以及面向该任务的后训练方案。对 VLM 视觉结构理解和图文对齐有参考意义，但场景偏 UI/设计版面，不是通用基座预训练核心问题。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先构造 CoDeLayout，标注组合元素对和设计意图，用来测试层级结构、元素关系和视觉-文本一致性。随后提出 MASON 后训练范式，结合 multimodal alignment 和 structural perception：前者缓解文本元数据与视觉内容的语义漂移，后者增强层级元素关系和结构歧义的建模。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在 CoDeLayout 上对现有 VLM 做经验分析，发现它们在组合式版面上受语义漂移和结构歧义限制；同时评估 MASON 的改进效果。摘要未给出具体模型规模、训练数据量、baseline 名称或提升数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether VLMs can understand compositional, multi-layer layouts with visually entangled elements, rather than only atomic layouts made of independent elements.
summary_en.importance: It contributes a new compositional layout understanding task, a roughly 20K-example real-world VQA dataset named CoDeLayout, and a post-training method for the task. It is relevant to visual structure understanding and multimodal alignment, but the setting is still specialized around UI and graphic design layouts.
summary_en.technical_approach: CoDeLayout annotates real-world multi-layer layouts with compositional element pairs and design intent. The proposed MASON post-training paradigm combines multimodal alignment, which reduces semantic drift between textual metadata and visual content, with structural perception, which targets ambiguity in hierarchical inter-element relations.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports empirical analysis of existing VLMs on CoDeLayout and identifies semantic drift and structural ambiguity as two key failure modes. MASON is evaluated as a post-training method, but the abstract does not provide concrete model sizes, baseline names, training data details, or numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 看任务定义和 failure taxonomy 就够；MASON 像常规后训练，真正可迁移的是结构歧义的测法。
recommendation.en: Read the task definition and failure taxonomy; MASON looks like routine post-training, while the transferable part is how they measure structural ambiguity.

paper.title: Overview of SHROOM-Visions 2026: A Shared Task on Hallucination Detection in Large Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: In 2026, we held the fourth iteration of the SHROOM Shared Task series: SHROOM-Visions (\textbf{S}hared-task on \textbf{H}allucinations and \textbf{R}elated \textbf{O}bservable \textbf{O}vergeneration \textbf{M}istakes in \textbf{Vision} language model\textbf{s}), which is hosted at the UncertaiNLP Workshop co-located with EMNLP 2026. Following the success of the 2024 and 2025 tasks, this time we aim to tackle hallucinations through a model-agnostic detection task focused on large vision-languag

summary.core_problem: 组织并总结 SHROOM-Visions 2026 共享任务，用于检测大视觉语言模型在图像条件文本生成中的细粒度 hallucination span。
summary.importance: 这是一个 VLM hallucination 评测资产和共享任务报告。贡献在于把幻觉检测从纯文本扩展到图像条件生成，并采用跨语言、细粒度 span 分类设置。
summary.technical_approach: 任务基于 SHEEP 数据集，要求参赛系统对 VQA、图像描述等图像条件生成文本中的 hallucination span 进行检测和分类。评测采用五类幻觉 taxonomy，覆盖中文、英文、法文和意大利文，强调 model-agnostic detection。
summary.experiments: 共享任务有 27 支团队参与。摘要未给出最佳系统、模型配置、数据规模细节或各类错误的定量结果，只说明任务覆盖多语言和多种图像条件文本生成场景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper reports the SHROOM-Visions 2026 shared task for detecting fine-grained hallucination spans in image-conditioned text generated by large vision-language models.
summary_en.importance: This is a VLM hallucination evaluation and shared-task contribution. Its value is extending hallucination detection from text-only settings to image-conditioned generation with multilingual and fine-grained span-level labels.
summary_en.technical_approach: The task builds on the SHEEP dataset and asks systems to detect and classify hallucination spans in outputs from settings such as VQA and image captioning. The evaluation uses a five-class hallucination taxonomy across Chinese, English, French, and Italian, and is designed to be model-agnostic.
summary_en.experiments: The shared task attracted 27 participating teams. The abstract does not provide the leading systems, model configurations, dataset size, or detailed quantitative findings.

recommendation.zh: 知道这个评测存在即可；对 native multimodal pretrain 的信号较弱，除非你在做 VLM hallucination eval。
recommendation.en: Know that the benchmark exists; it gives weak signal for native multimodal pretraining unless you work directly on VLM hallucination evaluation.

paper.title: GGSS: Geodesic-Gated Spherical Steering for Inference-Time Debiasing of Generative Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Generative vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used in human-centered settings, yet they can produce demographically biased outputs even when images differ only in controlled attributes such as perceived race or gender. However, existing inference-time debiasers were largely designed for static embeddings or CLIP-like models rather than generative VLMs. We propose GGSS---Geodesic-Gated Spherical Steering---a norm-preserving intervention that discovers a counterfactual bias subspace on

summary.core_problem: 解决生成式 VLM 在人像相关输入中对感知种族、性别等人口属性产生偏置输出的问题，重点是无需训练的推理时纠偏。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态安全与推理时干预方法。它把原本多用于静态 embedding 或 CLIP 类模型的 debiasing 思路，迁移到生成式 VLM 的视觉 token 空间，对研究 VLM 表征中的 demographic direction 有一定参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 GGSS，即 Geodesic-Gated Spherical Steering。方法先在单位超球面上发现反事实偏置子空间，再沿测地线对视觉 token 做范数保持的 steering，并用自适应 gate 只强化修正携带较强人口属性信号的 token。核心是 inference-time、norm-preserving、token-level intervention。
summary.experiments: 在 4 个生成式 VLM 上评估，与 10 个改造后的推理时 debiasing baseline 和 prompt mitigation 比较。测试覆盖 categorical、pairwise、occupation-gender bias，同时测量一般视觉语言能力。摘要称 GGSS 在 4 个模型上取得最低平均 bias，并保持能力不明显下降，但未给出模型名称和完整数值。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Magellan Technology Research Institute。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses demographic bias in generative VLM outputs under controlled changes in perceived race or gender, using inference-time debiasing rather than retraining.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a multimodal safety and inference-time intervention method. It adapts debiasing ideas that were mostly designed for static embeddings or CLIP-like models to token-level generative VLMs, which is mildly useful for understanding demographic directions in VLM representations.
summary_en.technical_approach: GGSS discovers a counterfactual bias subspace on the unit hypersphere, steers visual tokens along geodesic arcs while preserving norm, and applies an adaptive gate to focus the correction on tokens with stronger demographic signal. The method is training-free and operates directly on visual tokens.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates four generative VLMs against ten adapted inference-time debiasing baselines and prompt-based mitigation. It reports categorical, pairwise, and occupation-gender bias tests while also measuring general VLM capability. The abstract claims the lowest average bias across all four models, but does not provide model names or exact numbers.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Magellan Technology Research Institute.

recommendation.zh: 作为 VLM 表征 steering 的备查即可；setup 偏公平性评测，不会改变预训练侧判断。
recommendation.en: Useful as a reference for VLM representation steering; the setup is fairness-centric and unlikely to change pretraining priors.

paper.title: HAP: Head-Adaptive Visual Token Pruning via Cross-Modal Alignment
paper.abstract: Recent Vision-Language Models encode high-resolution images into long visual token sequences, incurring prohibitive prefill costs. To compress them, existing methods score each visual token by averaging text-to-visual attention uniformly across all heads, which assumes every head matches the query. However, our empirical analysis shows that misaligned heads dominate the average, amplifying background tokens and drowning out fine-grained cues.   To address this, we propose PAQ (Prompt-Grounded At

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 高分辨率图像带来的长视觉 token 序列 prefill 成本过高问题，重点是更稳健地做视觉 token pruning。
summary.importance: 这是推理效率工作。对基座研究员的价值不在方法本身，而在一个具体观察：跨模态注意力头并不都对 prompt 对齐，简单平均会把错头的噪声放大。这个观察对后续视觉 token 压缩和 head-level routing 有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 HAP，核心指标是 PAQ（Prompt-Grounded Attention Quality），用于衡量每个注意力头把文本 prompt 对齐到图像区域的质量。方法分三步：先按 FLOPs 预算给不同层组分配视觉 token 预算；再在组内用 PAQ 加权 softmax 聚合各头注意力；最后按聚合矩阵幅值给 token 打分并裁剪。关键改动是从“所有头等权平均”改为“按 head 对齐质量加权”。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出具体模型、分辨率、压缩率和精度损失，只能确认其目标是降低 VLM prefill 成本，并与基于平均 text-to-visual attention 的 pruning 方法比较。若实验完整，最值得看的应是 head misalignment 分析和不同预算下的精度-延迟曲线。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the high prefill cost of long visual token sequences in VLMs, focusing on more reliable visual token pruning.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper. Its main value for foundation-model researchers is not the pruning recipe itself, but the observation that cross-modal attention heads are not equally aligned with the prompt, so naive averaging amplifies noisy heads. That is mildly useful for future visual compression and head-level routing work.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes HAP with a key metric called PAQ (Prompt-Grounded Attention Quality), which measures how well each attention head aligns the text prompt to image regions. The method first allocates token budgets across layer groups under a FLOPs target, then aggregates per-head attention maps using PAQ-weighted softmax, and finally scores and prunes visual tokens based on the resulting group-level matrix. The core change is replacing uniform head averaging with alignment-aware weighting.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model names, resolutions, compression ratios, or accuracy drops. It is clear, however, that the paper compares against prior pruning methods based on averaged text-to-visual attention and targets lower VLM prefill cost. If the paper is solid, the most useful parts are the head-misalignment analysis and the accuracy-latency tradeoff under different budgets.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但“错头平均会害死 token pruning”这个观察值得记一下；只看 head analysis 和 budget allocation，方法细节可略。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the 'misaligned heads break token pruning' observation is worth keeping; read the head analysis and budget allocation, skip the rest.

paper.title: Taming Visual Neglect: A Variational Information Bottleneck Framework for Adaptive Attention in Multimodal In-Context Learning
paper.abstract: Large vision-language models exhibit strong in-context learning (ICL) capabilities, yet when and why visual context helps multimodal ICL remains poorly understood. Empirical studies show a puzzling dichotomy: models sometimes effectively leverage visual demonstrations, yet often neglect them entirely. We propose VIB-ICL, an information-theoretic framework that resolves this dichotomy through the Information Bottleneck principle. We introduce the Cross-Modal Information Gain (CMIG), which quantif

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是解释多模态 in-context learning 中的视觉上下文何时有用、何时会被模型忽略。该工作把“visual neglect”从单纯的模型缺陷重新表述为一个条件信息量问题：如果图像相对于文本和示例集不能提供额外标签信息，忽略视觉输入可能是合理的。
summary.importance: 对多模态预训练和 VLM 行为分析的启发在于，它给视觉 token 利用率提供了一个可检验的判据，而不是只看 attention heatmap 或任务准确率。对基座研究更直接的价值是：多模态数据并不因为包含图像就一定增加有效监督，关键是图像相对于文本的条件增益。这个视角可用于解释图文冗余数据、caption 过强数据、视觉示例选择，以及多模态 ICL 中的 modality collapse。贡献偏理论框架和诊断方法，离直接改变预训练 recipe 还有距离。
summary.technical_approach: 方法基于 Information Bottleneck。作者定义 Cross-Modal Information Gain，记为 ΔI = I(V; Y | T, D) - I(V; Y | T)，用来度量在给定文本 T 和 demonstration set D 后，视觉信息 V 对目标标签 Y 还能提供多少额外信息。理论部分给出一个泛化界：多模态 ICL 相对 text-only ICL 的 excess risk 由 -ΔI/(2σ_y²) 加上样本复杂度项控制，因此当 ΔI 为正且样本量足够时，视觉上下文应当带来收益。另一个结果说明，当 ΔI 小于 IB 正则强度 λ_IB 时，视觉忽略是 IB 最优解。作者进一步导出自适应视觉注意力权重 α_v* = max(0, 1 - λ_IB / I(V; Y | T))。算法层面，VIB-ICL 先用变分下界估计 CMIG，再按理论公式重分配视觉注意力，并选择 CMIG 较高的 demonstrations。相比直接增加视觉示例或手工调 attention，它的区别是把示例选择和注意力分配绑定到条件互信息估计上。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 5 个多模态 ICL benchmark。作者报告 VIB-ICL 相比已有方法有稳定提升，最高 accuracy gain 为 4.7%，并可减少约 35% 所需 demonstrations。实验主线包括三类验证：CMIG 是否能预测视觉上下文收益；自适应视觉注意力是否优于固定使用图像；按 CMIG 选择 demonstrations 是否优于普通检索或随机选择。由于可见全文片段没有给出完整表格，需要精读实验部分确认不同 benchmark、不同 LVLM 架构和不同 shot 数下的增益是否均匀，以及变分互信息估计是否稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25 分钟。优先看 Definition 1、Theorem 7、Theorem 9 和 Corollary 10，理解 CMIG、泛化界和视觉忽略条件。Figure 1 可以快速把理论变量和算法流程对上。实验部分重点看 CMIG 与性能提升的相关性、attention reallocation 的消融、demonstration selection 的消融。如果只关心预训练启发，可以重点看“文本已足够强时视觉 token 为什么失效”这一点，而不是细读所有证明。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies when visual demonstrations actually help multimodal in-context learning, and when large vision-language models rationally ignore them. It frames visual neglect as a conditional information problem rather than treating it only as an attention failure.
summary_en.importance: The useful signal for pretraining research is the separation between multimodal input volume and effective cross-modal supervision. Images do not necessarily add training or inference signal if the text already explains the label. This matters for multimodal data mixture design, caption-heavy datasets, visual token utilization analysis, and demonstration retrieval for LVLMs. The contribution is mainly a theoretical and diagnostic framework, not a direct pretraining recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method builds on the Information Bottleneck principle. It defines Cross-Modal Information Gain as ΔI = I(V; Y | T, D) - I(V; Y | T), measuring the extra label information carried by visual context beyond text and demonstrations. The main bound states that the excess risk of multimodal ICL over text-only ICL is controlled by a negative CMIG term, -ΔI/(2σ_y²), plus a sample complexity term. Positive CMIG therefore predicts a benefit from visual context. A second result shows that visual neglect is IB-optimal when ΔI is below the bottleneck penalty λ_IB. The derived attention rule sets the visual attention weight to α_v* = max(0, 1 - λ_IB / I(V; Y | T)). The instantiated VIB-ICL algorithm estimates CMIG through a variational lower bound, reallocates visual attention, and selects demonstrations with high cross-modal information gain.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports experiments on five multimodal ICL benchmarks. VIB-ICL achieves consistent gains, with up to 4.7% accuracy improvement and a 35% reduction in the number of demonstrations needed. The relevant experimental checks are whether CMIG predicts when visual context helps, whether adaptive visual attention beats fixed use of images, and whether CMIG-based demonstration selection improves over standard selection strategies. The available text does not expose all tables, so the robustness across tasks, model families, and shot counts should be verified from the full experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 25 minutes. Focus on Definition 1, Theorem 7, Theorem 9, Corollary 10, and Figure 1. These parts contain the main conceptual contribution. Then check the ablations for CMIG estimation, attention reallocation, and demonstration selection. For pretraining-oriented readers, the most useful angle is the explanation of why visually grounded data can still yield weak visual usage when text is already sufficiently informative.

recommendation.zh: 可读 §理论部分：它把视觉忽略解释成最优压缩，不一定对训练 recipe 有用，但能修正 VLM ICL 的直觉。
recommendation.en: Read the theory sections: treating visual neglect as optimal compression is a useful prior correction, even if it is not a training recipe.

paper.title: Rubrics as Visual-Repair Context for Self-Evolving UI-to-Code Generation
paper.abstract: Large vision-language models have shown strong progress in UI-to-code generation, yet their test-time self-evolution remains unstable. We first identify a fundamental obstacle, termed visual repair coupling: a local code edit may propagate through layout, style, and component dependencies, correcting one visual mismatch while degrading regions that were previously faithful. To address this issue, we present RubSE, a Rubric-guided Self-Evolution framework that uses rubrics to represent visual fee

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 做 UI-to-code 生成时，测试时自我迭代修复不稳定的问题：一次局部代码修改可能修好一处视觉差异，同时破坏原本正确的区域。
summary.importance: 贡献是方法改进和现象归纳：提出 visual repair coupling 作为 UI-to-code 自我修复失败的主要原因，并用结构化 rubrics 约束每轮修复目标。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RubSE，即 Rubric-guided Self-Evolution。每轮 refinement 先生成带类型的候选 rubric，再选择一个优先修复目标，并把历史 rubric 作为上下文，避免重复修改或过宽修改。方法属于测试时迭代修复框架，不是预训练或模型架构改动。
summary.experiments: 在 6 个 VLM 和 3 个 UI-to-code benchmark 上评估；相比 naïve self-evolution，在 final-round 和 best-round 指标上都有明显提升。摘要未给出具体模型名、benchmark 名称和提升数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses unstable test-time self-evolution for VLM-based UI-to-code generation, where a local code edit may fix one visual mismatch while damaging previously correct regions.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a method-level improvement and a useful failure-mode analysis: it names visual repair coupling as a key obstacle and uses structured rubrics to constrain each repair step.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes RubSE, a rubric-guided self-evolution framework. At each refinement round, it generates typed candidate rubrics, selects one prioritized repair target, and stores prior rubrics as history to prevent repeated or overly broad edits. This is a test-time refinement framework rather than a pretraining or architecture change.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on six VLMs and three UI-to-code benchmarks, outperforming naïve self-evolution in both final-round and best-round settings. The abstract does not include model names, benchmark names, or exact numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 只看 visual repair coupling 的定义和 ablation；这是好用的测试时反馈设计，不是基座训练信号。
recommendation.en: Read only the visual-repair-coupling definition and ablations; this is a useful test-time feedback design, not a base-model training signal.

paper.title: E2S-Pruner: Progressive Two-Stage Evidence Fusion for Visual Token Pruning in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-language models typically encode an image into hundreds of visual tokens, incurring substantial inference latency and GPU memory overhead. Existing pruning methods largely rely on attention scores and directly aggregate outputs across attention heads and network layers, making it difficult to characterize evidential uncertainty and conflict. We propose E2S-Pruner, a progressive two-stage evidence-fusion framework for visual token pruning that requires no auxiliary model, trainable paramet

summary.core_problem: VLM 推理时视觉 token 数量过多导致延迟与显存开销大，如何在不训练/不微调的前提下做稳健 token pruning。
summary.importance: 贡献点在推理侧的无训练剪枝策略；对预训练本身不直接，但对“视觉 tokenizer 粒度/冗余”与推理预算分配有间接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 两阶段证据融合：阶段1把每个 attention head 视为独立证据源，基于证据清晰度与 head 间一致性估计可靠性，并把 token 表示为 important/unimportant/uncertain 三态；阶段2用 Dempster–Shafer 证据理论量化跨层冲突并融合多层证据；再加空间新颖性约束避免过度丢弃局部新信息。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 VLM、剪枝比例-精度曲线、与 attention-score pruning 等基线的定量差距；宣称无需辅助模型/参数/微调，主要收益是降低延迟与显存同时保持性能。

summary_en.core_problem: VLMs use hundreds of visual tokens, causing high latency and memory; how to prune tokens robustly without training or fine-tuning.
summary_en.importance: Inference-time, training-free pruning; not a pretraining contribution, but relevant to understanding visual-token redundancy and budget allocation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Progressive two-stage evidence fusion: (1) treat each attention head as an evidence source, estimate head reliability via evidence clarity and inter-head consistency, and assign each token a 3-state belief (important/unimportant/uncertain); (2) use Dempster–Shafer theory to quantify inter-layer conflict and fuse evidence across layers; add a spatial novelty constraint to preserve locally novel regions.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract lacks concrete model names, pruning-vs-accuracy curves, and strong baselines; claims latency/memory reduction while maintaining performance, with zero extra parameters and no fine-tuning.

recommendation.zh: 当作“无训练 VLM token 剪枝”的一个可复现思路看：只需看它的剪枝率-精度曲线和消融；证据理论包装可能大于实质。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a training-free VLM token pruning recipe—check pruning-rate vs accuracy and ablations; the Dempster–Shafer framing may be more packaging than substance.

paper.title: Training-Free VLM Personalization via Calibrated Residual Decoding
paper.abstract: Vision-language models can be personalized in a training-free manner by directly providing user profiles, preferences, or visual references at inference time, without updating model parameters. However, direct personalized prompting does not guarantee that the model will reliably exploit such evidence. The predictive distribution under the positive user profile often mixes two sources: personalized signals genuinely supported by the current profile, and the model's generic visual or linguistic p

summary.core_problem: 解决免训练的 VLM 个性化生成中，模型可能依赖通用先验而非用户提供的个性化证据（profile）的问题。
summary.importance: 提出了一种基于对比解码（Contrastive Decoding）变体的推理期干预方法，用于提升 VLM 对上下文（个性化信息）的忠诚度。
summary.technical_approach: 提出校准残差解码（Calibrated Residual Decoding）框架。构建正向 profile、反事实 profile 和空 profile。通过计算正向与空 profile 的残差，并减去反事实与空 profile 的残差，来隔离真正由个性化信号驱动的预测分布。
summary.experiments: 在多个 VLM 上验证，提升了个性化生成的准确性和对 profile 的忠诚度。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the issue in training-free VLM personalization where models may rely on generic priors rather than the provided user profiles.
summary_en.importance: Proposes an inference-time intervention method based on a variant of Contrastive Decoding to improve VLM faithfulness to context (personalized information).
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces Calibrated Residual Decoding. It constructs positive, counterfactual, and empty profiles, and isolates the prediction distribution genuinely driven by personalized signals by calculating the residual between positive and empty profiles, and subtracting the residual between counterfactual and empty profiles.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on multiple VLMs, improving the accuracy and faithfulness of personalized generation.

recommendation.zh: 一种基于对比解码的 VLM 推理期干预方法，用于提升对上下文的忠诚度，作为 inference-time 技巧备查。
recommendation.en: An inference-time intervention method for VLMs based on contrastive decoding to improve context faithfulness; keep as a reference for inference tricks.

paper.title: Knowing Isn't Always Saying: When Do Spatial Encodings Reach Answers in Vision-Language Models?
paper.abstract: Vision-language models are known to encode spatial information in their hidden states, yet often fail to use it when answering. However, it remains unclear when and where this encoded information reaches the answer. We address this with direction patching, a class-conditioned causal intervention applied across layers, token positions, and prompt formats. Using spatial-ID directions constructed following prior encoding evidence, we find that causal influence on answer logits emerges only at mid-t

summary.core_problem: 研究 VLM 虽然在隐藏状态中编码了空间信息，却常常答不出来时，这些空间表征究竟在何时何层真正影响答案。
summary.importance: 这是机制分析工作。对做原生多模态预训练的人有一定参考价值，因为它把“模型知道但说不出”拆成可干预的传输路径问题，而不是泛泛谈幻觉或 grounding 失败。
summary.technical_approach: 作者使用 direction patching，在不同层、token 位置和 prompt 格式上做类条件因果干预。基于已有工作构造 spatial-ID directions，观察这些方向何时会影响 answer logits。结果显示，空间信息的因果影响主要在中后层出现；文本 CoT 往往抑制对象词的即时传输，而视觉 grounding 更容易保持这条通路开放；有时 target logit 虽上升但不足以越过 argmax 阈值，信息会在更深层或最终前缀 token/答案步重新出现。
summary.experiments: 覆盖 10 个 VLM，并比较不同数据集、属性和编码方式下的 transport pattern。摘要没有给出具体模型名和量化幅度，但实验设计看起来偏系统性机制扫描，而非单模型 anecdote。对预训练研究员而言，价值主要在于层级传输模式和 prompt 形式对信息使用的抑制/释放效应。

summary_en.core_problem: It studies when and where spatial information encoded in VLM hidden states actually reaches the final answer, given that models often 'know' spatial facts but fail to say them.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic analysis paper. It is moderately useful for native multimodal pretraining because it reframes the issue as an information-transport problem rather than generic hallucination or grounding failure.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper uses direction patching, a class-conditioned causal intervention across layers, token positions, and prompt formats. Using spatial-ID directions built from prior encoding evidence, it tracks when these directions affect answer logits. The findings suggest that causal influence emerges mainly in mid-to-deep layers; text CoT often suppresses immediate object-word transport, while visually grounded prompts keep the path open; and positive target-logit gains may remain sub-argmax until deeper layers or the answer step.
summary_en.experiments: It studies 10 VLMs and examines how transport patterns vary across datasets, attributes, and encoding schemes. The abstract does not provide model names or effect sizes, but the setup appears to be a systematic mechanistic sweep rather than a single-model anecdote. For pretraining researchers, the main value is the layerwise transport pattern and the prompt-dependent suppression/release of encoded information.

recommendation.zh: 不是方法论文，但做 VLM 预训练的人可看：它提醒你“编码了”不等于“能被解码头用到”；读因果干预结果和 CoT 抑制现象就够了。
recommendation.en: Not a methods paper, but useful for VLM pretraining: ‘encoded’ does not mean ‘reachable by the answer head’; the causal intervention results and the CoT suppression effect are the parts to read.

paper.title: Grounding Isn't Knowing: Do VLMs Need Object Localization for Spatial Reasoning?
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can answer spatial questions, yet the mechanisms connecting object grounding to spatial reasoning remain poorly understood. It is underexplored whether spatial reasoning internally requires precise objects localization, or can bypass explicit localization through global layout cues. In this work, we investigate two representative model families, LLaVA-1.5 and Qwen2.5-VL, using a suite of mechanistic interpretability tools, including token ablation, layer-wise probin

summary.core_problem: VLM 做空间推理时，是否真的依赖精确目标定位，还是可以绕过显式 localization 直接用全局布局线索。
summary.importance: 这是机制分析工作。价值不在提出新模型，而在把“grounding 与 reasoning 的接口”拆开看，对多模态预训练里表示形成和中间监督设计有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 选取 LLaVA-1.5 和 Qwen2.5-VL 两类 VLM，用 token ablation、layer-wise probing、attention knockout、causal mediation analysis 等工具分析空间关系预测的内部过程，追踪定位信息、关系决策和关键注意力头的因果作用。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示两类模型都呈现 staged grounding-to-reasoning：先形成粗粒度 target-reference anchor，再做关系判断；精确 bounding box 边界并非必要。位置编码信息先于关系决策变得可解码，少量注意力头承担 localization 与 reasoning 的因果中介。未见新的大规模训练实验。

summary_en.core_problem: It asks whether VLM spatial reasoning truly requires precise object localization, or whether models can bypass explicit localization using global layout cues.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic analysis paper. Its value is not a new model, but a cleaner decomposition of the grounding–reasoning interface, which is mildly useful for thinking about representation formation and intermediate supervision in multimodal pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using LLaVA-1.5 and Qwen2.5-VL, it applies token ablation, layer-wise probing, attention knockout, and causal mediation analysis to trace how positional information, relation decisions, and a small set of attention heads contribute to spatial reasoning.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports a staged grounding-to-reasoning process in both model families: coarse target-reference anchoring emerges first, then relation prediction; precise bounding-box boundaries are not necessary. Positional information becomes decodable before relation decisions, and a few heads mediate both localization and reasoning. No new large-scale training study is involved.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 主线，但它把“定位监督是否必要”这个 prior 拆得比较干净；只看因果分析和关键头定位那几节就够。
recommendation.en: Not core pretraining, but it cleanly probes whether explicit localization supervision is actually needed; read only the causal analysis and key-head sections.

paper.title: Investigating Relational Reasoning in VLMs
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) achieve strong performance in visual reasoning tasks, but it remains unclear whether they understand visual relations, or simply employ shortcuts such as language cues or priors. To investigate this, we use the Qwen3-VL-4B (Bai et al., 2025), a modern VLM, to decode how visual information is encoded across depths. For this, we propose a synthetic dataset of simple geometric shapes for controlled analysis, along with queries crafted to precisely test language cues. F

summary.core_problem: 检验现代 VLM 在关系推理任务上到底是在使用真实视觉关系信息，还是主要依赖语言线索和先验捷径。
summary.importance: 这是一篇机制分析工作。价值不在提出新模型，而在用受控合成数据拆开视觉证据与语言偏置，对理解 VLM 表征形成和 shortcut 依赖有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者围绕 Qwen3-VL-4B 构造简单几何图形的合成数据集，并设计精确控制语言提示的查询；再通过修改数据以测试模型对真实视觉证据的因果依赖，同时分析不同层深的视觉信息编码情况。
summary.experiments: 核心实验对象是 Qwen3-VL-4B。摘要未给出更多模型对比、数据规模或具体数值，但主要发现是：当前 VLM 同时存在一定真实视觉关系推理能力，以及显著依赖语言线索的 shortcut 行为。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether modern VLMs truly reason over visual relations or mostly exploit language cues and priors as shortcuts.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic analysis paper rather than a new model. Its value lies in using controlled synthetic data to separate visual evidence from linguistic bias, which is useful for understanding VLM representations and shortcut behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using Qwen3-VL-4B, the authors build a synthetic geometric-shape dataset with carefully designed prompts that isolate language cues, then intervene on the visual evidence to test causal reliance and inspect how information is encoded across depth.
summary_en.experiments: The main subject is Qwen3-VL-4B. The abstract does not provide broader model comparisons, dataset size, or exact numbers, but the headline result is that current VLMs mix genuine visual relational reasoning with shortcut strategies driven largely by language cues.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做 native multimodal pretrain，只看它如何用受控合成数据拆 shortcut 与真视觉证据；结论不新，但 setup 还算干净。
recommendation.en: If you work on native multimodal pretraining, read it for the controlled setup that separates shortcuts from genuine visual evidence; the conclusion is not new, but the measurement is reasonably clean.

paper.title: Llama-Mobile: Efficient 2.7-Bit Quantization of VLMs
paper.abstract: Deploying vision-language models (VLMs) on mobile devices is challenging due to their significant memory and compute requirements. We present a framework for quantizing VLMs for efficient inference on resource-constrained hardware. Our approach combines a quantization pipeline that uses the model itself to generate training data and does not require access to the training setup, with a novel 2.7-bit-per-parameter format supporting efficient execution on Arm CPUs. We validate our approach by comp

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 在移动端部署时参数存储和计算开销过高的问题，目标是在 Arm CPU 等资源受限硬件上运行 11B 级视觉语言模型。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理压缩和部署工程。它不直接推进预训练方法，但对多模态基座模型的端侧落地有参考价值，尤其是低比特权重量化、激活精度和校准数据获取之间的取舍。
summary.technical_approach: 提出一套 VLM 量化流程：不依赖原始训练配置或训练数据，而是利用模型自身生成量化所需的数据；同时设计 2.7 bit/parameter 的权重格式，并配合 8-bit activation，使格式能在 Arm CPU 上高效执行。
summary.experiments: 主要验证对象是 Llama 3.2 11B Vision Instruct。论文将模型压缩到 3.7 GB，并在一组标准视觉问答任务上测试，声称在强压缩下仍保持较好的性能。摘要未给出具体 baseline、任务列表和逐项提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: Graphcore Research 的工作，关注低比特 VLM 量化和移动端推理部署。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the memory and compute cost of deploying VLMs on mobile devices, with the goal of running an 11B-class vision-language model on constrained Arm CPU hardware.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly inference compression and deployment engineering. It does not directly affect pretraining methodology, but it is relevant for understanding the deployment constraints of multimodal foundation models, especially the trade-off between low-bit weights, activation precision, and calibration data.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose a VLM quantization pipeline that does not require access to the original training setup or data. The model itself is used to generate data for quantization, and the paper introduces a 2.7-bit-per-parameter weight format paired with 8-bit activations for efficient Arm CPU execution.
summary_en.experiments: The main experiment compresses Llama 3.2 11B Vision Instruct to 3.7 GB and evaluates it on standard visual question answering tasks. The abstract reports that performance remains strong under this compression level, but does not provide detailed baselines, task-level numbers, or improvement margins.
summary_en.authors_note: Work from Graphcore Research, focused on low-bit VLM quantization and mobile inference deployment.

recommendation.zh: 低比特 VLM 上机有工程信号，但离预训练问题较远；看量化格式和自生成校准数据即可。
recommendation.en: Useful as an engineering signal for low-bit VLM deployment, but far from pretraining; read only the quantization format and self-generated calibration setup.

paper.title: DARS: Dual-Level Credit Assignment RL with Structured Reasoning for Instruction-Based Image Editing
paper.abstract: Instruction-based image editing uses a planner-renderer pipeline: a vision-language model (VLM) first converts the instruction into an edit plan, and a diffusion model then executes that plan. Training such systems with only final-image rewards is inefficient because a poor edit does not reveal whether additional optimization should place more emphasis on the planner or the renderer, and even planner-dominant cases remain difficult to localize within a free-form reasoning trace. We present DARS,

summary.core_problem: 在“VLM 规划 + diffusion 渲染”的指令图像编辑流水线中，用仅有的最终图像奖励做 RL 时，如何把 credit assignment 分到模块级与 token 级。
summary.importance: 属于后训练/RL 信号工程：把 outcome-level reward 变成更可学习的局部监督；对“如何给推理/规划链条做可控训练信号”有可迁移价值，但不直接触及基座预训练。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DARS：跨模块用 multi-plan/multi-render rollout 估计奖励方差以做软路由（更该优化 planner 还是 renderer），并用 rollout 均值做难度估计实现自适应 curriculum；在 planner 内把自由文本推理改成四字段结构化输出，配合 prefix-gated reward 与 token-level advantage reweighting，把最终奖励定位到推理前缀与 token。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 VLM/扩散模型规模与数据集名称；宣称在两阶段设置下训练效率与效果提升，关键对比是“仅最终奖励 RL”与其 credit assignment 方案。

summary_en.core_problem: How to perform effective credit assignment for RL in instruction-based image editing pipelines with a VLM planner and a diffusion renderer when only final-image rewards are available.
summary_en.importance: Post-training/RL signal shaping: turns outcome-level rewards into localized supervision; potentially transferable to training structured reasoning/planning, but not directly about base pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: DARS uses multi-plan/multi-render rollouts to estimate reward variability for soft module routing (planner vs renderer), uses rollout mean as a hardness signal for adaptive curriculum, and enforces a four-field structured reasoning format in the planner with prefix-gated rewards and token-level advantage reweighting.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete model sizes or dataset names; compares against RL with only final rewards, claiming better training efficiency and performance in the two-stage setting.

recommendation.zh: 把“最终奖励”拆成模块路由+token 级优势重加权这点可借鉴；只需看结构化推理输出与 prefix-gated reward 的设计，别指望有干净的预训练结论。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming for the structured-reasoning + prefix-gated reward and token-level advantage reweighting; don’t expect clean pretraining takeaways.

paper.title: MAVEN: A Macro-Societal Value Evaluation Framework of Multimodal Content with Compact Aligned Evaluators
paper.abstract: Assessing whether multimodal content aligns with macro-societal values, such as peace, justice, and freedom, has become an increasingly urgent challenge. Existing frameworks are largely confined to safety-oriented taxonomies, text-only psychometric probes, or single-label classification. Therefore, we propose MAVEN, a hierarchical framework for macro-societal value evaluation of multimodal content, grounded in international human-rights instruments and cultural value theory. MAVEN organizes valu

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是：如何系统评估多模态内容是否符合宏观社会价值，而不是只做狭义安全分类或单标签判断。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评测框架与 benchmark。对 LLM 基座预训练不是核心，但如果你关心多模态 evaluator、judge distillation、价值对齐评测资产，这篇算可备查材料。它更偏应用化评测框架，而不是通用预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 MAVEN 分层框架，把价值评估组织为 6 个一级维度和 72 个二级指标；构建了人工验证的多模态 benchmark，并设计 soft-match metric 来评估 VLM 在不同价值维度上的判断。为训练 evaluator，作者提出 span-adaptive 的 multi-level preference optimization 做 evaluator distillation；推理时再加一个 training-free 的 multi-role consensus 策略。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明评测对象覆盖开源和闭源系统，但没有给出模型规模、数据规模和关键数值结果。就定位看，重点在 benchmark + evaluator pipeline，而不是提出新的多模态基座模型。对预训练研究员而言，主要价值在于看其标签体系、metric 设计和 evaluator 压缩思路。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括中国科学技术大学、State Key Laboratory of Communication Content Cognition、人民网。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how to systematically evaluate whether multimodal content aligns with macro-societal values, rather than only performing narrow safety classification or single-label judgments.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a benchmark and evaluation-framework contribution. It is not central to LLM pretraining, but it can be a reference if you care about multimodal evaluators, judge distillation, or value-alignment evaluation assets. The work is more application-facing evaluation than general pretraining methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach: MAVEN is a hierarchical framework with 6 primary dimensions and 72 secondary indicators. The authors build a human-verified multimodal benchmark and introduce a soft-match metric for evaluating VLM assessments across value dimensions. For evaluator optimization, they propose a span-adaptive variant of multi-level preference optimization for evaluator distillation, plus a training-free multi-role consensus strategy at inference time.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract says both open- and closed-source systems are evaluated, but it does not provide model scales, dataset sizes, or key quantitative results. By design, the contribution is benchmark plus evaluator pipeline rather than a new multimodal foundation model. For pretraining researchers, the main value is in the taxonomy, metric design, and evaluator compression recipe.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include the University of Science and Technology of China, the State Key Laboratory of Communication Content Cognition, and People’s Daily Online.

recommendation.zh: 更像价值对齐评测资产，不是 pretrain 方法；若你做 multimodal judge 或 evaluator distillation，可只看 taxonomy、metric 和蒸馏目标定义。
recommendation.en: This is mostly a value-alignment evaluation asset, not a pretraining paper; if you work on multimodal judges or evaluator distillation, read the taxonomy, metric, and distillation objective only.

institutions: University of Science and Technology of China
State Key Laboratory of Communication Content Cognition
State Key Laboratory of Communication Content Cognition, People’s Daily Online

paper.title: ReWEIGH the Evidence: Calibrating Token-Level Ordinal Visual Evidence to Mitigate Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) often hallucinate, generating content that the input image does not support. Preventing such content during decoding calls for a candidate-specific measure of how strongly the image supports the token under consideration. The model's visual-token states offer a natural source of this evidence because projecting each state through the output head reveals which vocabulary items that position favors. These position-wise readouts cannot be pooled directly because

summary.core_problem: 解决 LVLM 解码时如何判断候选 token 是否被图像证据支持，从而减少图像无依据幻觉的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是训练免费解码干预。它关注的是 VLM 内部视觉 token 状态能否被当作 token-level visual evidence 使用，对多模态对齐、视觉证据校准和 hallucination 抑制有一定参考价值，但离基座预训练方法较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ReWEIGH。方法把每个视觉位置的 hidden state 经过输出头投影，观察该位置偏好的词表项；由于不同视觉位置的概率幅度不可直接比较，改用 vocabulary rank 作为尺度不变信号；再用无标注图像估计每个候选 token 的参考分布，进行 token-specific calibration。推理时在 prefill 阶段缓存图像证据，并在解码中施加有界调整。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供具体模型、数据集、baseline 和数值提升。可以确认的是方法不需要训练，主要比较对象应是常规 LVLM 解码和未校准的视觉证据聚合方式；完整有效性需要看实验表格确认。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 Pohang University of Science and Technology。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how to estimate whether a candidate token is visually supported during LVLM decoding, with the goal of reducing image-unsupported hallucinations.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training-free decoding intervention. It is relevant to multimodal alignment and hallucination control because it turns visual-token states into candidate-specific evidence, although it is less central to base-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: ReWEIGH projects visual-token hidden states through the output head to read out vocabulary preferences at each visual position. Since raw probability magnitudes are not comparable across positions, it pools rank-based evidence instead. It then compares each candidate token against a token-specific reference estimated from unlabeled images and applies a bounded correction during decoding, caching image evidence at prefill.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not specify model families, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains. The relevant comparisons are likely standard LVLM decoding and uncalibrated visual-evidence aggregation, but the quantitative strength has to be checked in the main results.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institution is Pohang University of Science and Technology.

recommendation.zh: 作为 VLM 幻觉解码技巧备查即可；核心看 rank calibration，别把它当预训练对齐结论。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a VLM decoding reference; the only part to inspect is the rank calibration, not as evidence about pretraining alignment.

institutions: Pohang University of Science and Technology
Affiliation:Pohang University of Science and Technology (POSTECH)

paper.title: Vision-Language Models for Egocentric Video: From Hand-Object Interaction to Embodied AI
paper.abstract: Egocentric video captures activities from the wearer's perspective, providing a direct view of human attention, hand--object interaction, and goal-directed behavior. This perspective is increasingly important for wearable intelligence, assistive systems, human--robot interaction, and embodied AI, yet it introduces challenges including ego-motion, occlusion, small active objects, viewpoint-dependent appearance, and long-range temporal dependencies. Vision--language models (VLMs) offer a promising

summary.core_problem: 梳理第一视角视频中的视觉语言模型研究，重点覆盖手-物交互、长时序理解、具身智能和可穿戴场景。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是综述。它把 egocentric video 从传统识别模型整理到多模态基础模型和具身系统，对理解 VLM 在真实交互数据上的限制有参考价值，但不是新的预训练方法或数据配比工作。
summary.technical_approach: 论文按任务、数据集、手-物交互、时间推理、帧/片段选择、多模态表示等主题组织已有工作，讨论 ego-motion、遮挡、小目标、视角依赖外观和长程依赖带来的建模难点。
summary.experiments: 作为综述，摘要未显示新的模型训练或统一实验；主要价值在文献分类、任务脉络和问题归纳，而不是可复现实验结果。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Tehran。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper surveys vision-language models for egocentric video, with emphasis on hand-object interaction, long-range temporal understanding, and embodied AI.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a survey. It organizes the transition from conventional recognition pipelines to multimodal foundation models for egocentric video, which is useful context for VLM researchers but not a new pretraining recipe or modeling objective.
summary_en.technical_approach: The survey structures prior work around tasks, datasets, hand-object interaction, temporal reasoning, frame and clip selection, and multimodal representation, while highlighting ego-motion, occlusion, small active objects, viewpoint-specific appearance, and long temporal dependencies.
summary_en.experiments: No new training run or controlled benchmark is indicated in the abstract; the value is in taxonomy and problem framing rather than empirical model results.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Tehran.

recommendation.zh: 作为 egocentric VLM 文献地图可留档；预训练研究员扫任务和数据集部分即可，不必细读方法表。
recommendation.en: Useful as a map of egocentric VLM tasks and datasets; for pretraining work, skim the taxonomy rather than the full survey.

paper.title: When Safety Overrides Vision: Exploring Dynamics between Vision Influence and Safety Alignment in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Aligned vision-language models (VLMs) are designed to balance grounded visual reasoning with safe generation behavior. However, we observe a striking phenomenon: under safety-constrained instruction, models frequently abstain from answering questions that remain correctly answerable under default instruction despite receiving identical image-question inputs. This raises a fundamental question: does safety alignment suppress perceptual grounding itself, or does visual evidence remain internally a

summary.core_problem: 安全对齐后的 VLM 在安全约束指令下会拒答原本可由图像正确回答的问题，需要区分是视觉 grounding 被抑制，还是生成策略被导向拒答。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM 对齐机制分析。它把安全拒答拆成感知表征、解码动态和输出策略之间的关系，对理解多模态模型的安全训练副作用有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 在相同图像-问题输入下比较 default instruction 与 safety-constrained instruction 的生成行为，分析解码过程中的视觉影响是否持续存在，并观察拒答表示组织和生成路径的变化。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在多个架构和多模态 benchmark 上验证：即使模型最终拒答，生成过程仍持续受视觉证据影响，说明 perceptual grounding 大体保留；但拒答相关表征组织和生成行为会被安全指令重新定向。摘要未给出具体模型、数据集和数值。
summary.authors_note: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi, Yardi School of Artificial Intelligence。

summary_en.core_problem: Aligned VLMs may refuse answerable visual questions under safety-constrained instructions, raising the question of whether safety suppresses visual grounding or merely redirects generation.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism analysis of multimodal alignment. It separates perceptual grounding from refusal behavior, which matters for diagnosing safety-training side effects in VLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study compares default and safety-constrained instructions over identical image-question inputs, then analyzes decoding dynamics to test whether visual evidence continues to influence abstained generations.
summary_en.experiments: Across multiple architectures and multimodal benchmarks, the abstract reports that abstained generations remain consistently influenced by visual evidence, suggesting that grounding is largely preserved while generation is redirected toward refusal. Specific models, datasets, and numerical results are not provided in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Yardi School of Artificial Intelligence, Indian Institute of Technology Delhi.

recommendation.zh: VLM safety 机制的弱相关读物；若有 logit/attention 证据可扫图，否则只是拒答现象再描述。
recommendation.en: A weakly relevant VLM safety-mechanism read; skim only if the paper has logit or attention evidence beyond refusal examples.

institutions: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi, New Delhi

paper.title: MemCatalyst: Amplifying Data Auditing on Vision-Language Models via Data Poisoning
paper.abstract: Vision-Language models (VLMs) achieve outstanding performance largely due to the amount of training data available on the internet. At the same time, data holders (e.g., artists) urgently need to determine whether their data has been used for model training without authorization, which concerns both intellectual property rights and personal privacy. Data auditing, particularly through membership inference (MI), has attracted attention as a direct tool. This work proposes MemCatalyst, a set of da

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究如何让数据持有者在发布图文数据前主动植入少量“可审计”样本，使后续 VLM 若使用这些数据训练，membership inference 能得到更强的成员信号。
summary.importance: 它和预训练数据研究的关系主要在数据治理、成员推断和训练数据可追溯性。论文不是在提高 VLM 预训练效果，而是在说明：数据分布中很小比例的精心构造样本，可能显著改变训练后模型对这些样本的记忆信号。这个结果对大规模多模态数据清洗、版权审计和数据污染风险都有参考意义。它也提醒预训练团队，数据审计和数据投毒不是两个完全分离的问题；审计增强本身也可以通过投毒实现。
summary.technical_approach: MemCatalyst 把目标写成一个受约束优化问题：最大化成员样本和非成员样本在审计打分函数上的间隔，同时限制正常模型行为的偏移。方法包含两条路径。MemCatalyst-PT 操作文本侧，借助参考模型生成看起来合理的文本扰动，使训练中的 VLM 过度学习某些图像特征与文本语义之间的特定不一致，从而改变文本特征空间中的成员信号。论文设置中参考模型使用 Qwen2-VL-72B，黑盒审计者不需要知道目标 VLM 的结构和参数。MemCatalyst-PI 操作图像侧，通过人眼不易察觉的扰动诱导视觉特征空间发生偏移；灰盒设定下审计者可访问视觉编码器 logits，这比完整白盒弱，但能生成更隐蔽的 poisoned images。两类方法都强调低预算、可转移和对正常任务性能影响有限。
summary.experiments: 论文在两个代表性 VLM 和五种 membership inference/数据审计方法上做评估，报告称极小比例的 poisoned samples 就能提升审计成功率，同时对整体模型性能影响较小。给定内容没有包含完整实验表格，因此不宜写具体提升数字。实验部分最需要关注三类结果：PT 与 PI 分别对不同 MI 打分方法的增益；黑盒、灰盒以及跨模型迁移下的稳定性；utility 约束是否真实成立，即图文任务性能是否只出现有限下降。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。重点看 Section III 的威胁模型和优化目标，确认 auditor 的知识、能力和约束是否符合真实数据发布场景。然后看 PT 和 PI 的构造细节：文本扰动如何保持人类可接受的图文对齐，图像扰动如何在不可感知和特征偏移之间取平衡。实验部分优先看 poisoned budget 曲线、MI 方法对比、迁移实验和 utility 表。若只关心预训练数据安全，可跳过一般 VQA/caption 任务描述，集中看成员信号如何被放大。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether data owners can proactively insert a small number of crafted image-text samples before releasing a dataset, so that a later VLM trained on that dataset exposes a stronger membership-inference signal for auditing.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to foundation-model research is data governance rather than model improvement. The paper shows that a tiny amount of carefully designed multimodal data can amplify memorization-based auditing signals after training. This matters for large-scale VLM pretraining pipelines because copyright auditing, membership inference, and data poisoning interact in practice. A mechanism intended to improve auditability can also become a distributional intervention that changes what the model memorizes.
summary_en.technical_approach: MemCatalyst formulates the auditor’s objective as increasing the gap between member and non-member membership scores while constraining normal model behavior. It provides two poisoning tools. MemCatalyst-PT works on the text side: using a reference model, the auditor generates plausible textual perturbations that induce the target VLM to over-learn controlled mismatches between visual features and textual semantics. The paper uses Qwen2-VL-72B as the reference model in the black-box setup. MemCatalyst-PI works on the image side: it adds human-imperceptible perturbations that shift the visual feature space and strengthen audit signals. In the gray-box setup, the auditor can access vision-encoder logits, which is weaker than full white-box access but helps produce stealthier poisoned samples. The design goal is low poison budget, transferability, and limited degradation of regular VLM utility.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers two representative VLMs and five membership-inference or data-auditing methods. The reported outcome is that a very small number of poisoned samples can substantially increase auditability while keeping overall model performance largely intact. The provided text does not include the numerical tables, so exact gains should be checked in the experimental section. The most informative results are likely the poison-budget curves, PT-versus-PI comparisons, black-box and gray-box differences, transferability across target models, and utility measurements on standard VLM tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough for most pretraining researchers. Read the threat model and optimization objective in Section III first, because the assumptions determine how practical the method is. Then inspect how PT preserves plausible image-text alignment and how PI balances imperceptibility against feature-space shift. In the experiments, prioritize membership-score separation, poison-budget sensitivity, transfer tests, and utility degradation. The general VLM task descriptions can be skimmed unless the utility metrics look suspiciously narrow.

recommendation.zh: 把投毒当“水印式审计放大器”这个角度值得看：重点核查黑盒迁移是否真干净、以及对模型性能/鲁棒性的副作用，别只看 MI 提升。
recommendation.en: Worth reading for the “poisoning as an audit amplifier” angle; verify whether black-box transfer is actually clean and what it does to utility/robustness, not just MI lift.

paper.title: Which Source Wins? Task-Dependent Reliance in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) combine images and text, but when the two conflict and one becomes harder to read, it is unclear how a model shifts its reliance between them. We study this modality reallocation with a controlled setup: we degrade either the image or the text across four levels of legibility while keeping the other clean, and track how the model's preference changes. We build conflicts from GSM8K and SVAMP by pairing the rendered image of one arithmetic problem with the text of ano

summary.core_problem: 当图像与文本冲突且其中一方可读性下降时，VLM会如何在两种模态之间重新分配依赖。
summary.importance: 属于VLM行为分析+小型benchmark（冲突构造与likelihood margin指标）；对多模态预训练的“模态权重/对齐信号”有间接启发，但规模不大。
summary.technical_approach: 构造冲突样本：把一道算术题的图像渲染与另一道题的文本配对；分别对图像或文本做四档可读性退化，观察模型答案与length-normalized条件对数似然margin如何变化；并提出ChartQA-Conflict（229条人工复核的chart-report冲突，含chart与table-image匹配表示）。
summary.experiments: 评测6个开源权重VLM；在GSM8K/SVAMP冲突设置下，5/6模型对文本退化更敏感（更快从文本转向图像）；在ChartQA-Conflict上，所有用likelihood评分的模型出现相应偏移趋势。摘要未给出具体模型名单与显著性分析。

summary_en.core_problem: How VLMs reallocate reliance between image and text when the two conflict and one modality becomes less legible.
summary_en.importance: Behavioral analysis plus a small conflict benchmark and a likelihood-margin metric; indirectly informative for multimodal pretraining/alignment, but limited in scale.
summary_en.technical_approach: Create conflicts by pairing the rendered image of one math problem with the text of another; degrade either image or text across four legibility levels; track answer changes and a length-normalized conditional log-likelihood margin; introduce ChartQA-Conflict (229 manually reviewed chart-report conflicts with matched chart and table-image representations).
summary_en.experiments: Evaluates six open-weight VLMs; on GSM8K/SVAMP conflicts, 5/6 shift away from degraded text more than from degraded images; on ChartQA-Conflict, all likelihood-scored models show the corresponding shift. Specific model list and significance details are not in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 作为“模态冲突+可读性退化”的探针还算干净；只看likelihood margin定义和ChartQA-Conflict构造，别指望给出训练层面的因果解释。
recommendation.en: A reasonably clean probe via modality conflict + legibility degradation; read the likelihood-margin metric and ChartQA-Conflict construction, but don’t expect causal training takeaways.

paper.title: Data-DPO: Direct Preference Optimization for Target Model Data Selection in LLM Post-Training
paper.abstract: Data selection in supervised fine-tuning aims to select a small set of effective samples from large-scale candidate data, reducing training cost while preserving model performance. However, existing methods usually treat data value as a relatively static property, and pay limited attention to the compatibility between data and the capability distribution of the target model. To address this issue, we propose Data-DPO, a target model-oriented SFT data selection method. Data-DPO observes the local

summary.core_problem: 为 LLM/VLM 后训练选择更适配目标模型能力分布的 SFT 数据，而不是只按静态质量分数筛样本。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练数据选择方法。它强调数据价值不是固定属性，而取决于目标模型当前能力和样本之间的匹配关系；这对 pretrain-to-posttrain 接口、数据 curriculum 和能力定向补齐有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Data-DPO。先对目标模型做 one-step probing，观察不同样本带来的局部训练反馈；再把样本间 activation differences 转成 pairwise data preferences，并训练轻量 reward model 学习 target-model-aware 数据偏好。最终选择阶段同时结合目标模型偏好、外部质量分数和边际多样性，得到更稳定的训练子集。
summary.experiments: 实验在 Vision-Flan 和 LLaVA-CoT 上进行，面向 VLM 指令/推理后训练数据选择。摘要声称 Data-DPO 相比现有选择方法更有效，但给定摘要被截断，未提供具体模型参数量、候选数据规模、baseline 名单或提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper selects SFT data that better matches the capability distribution of a specific target LLM/VLM, instead of relying only on static data-quality scores.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training data selection method. It treats data value as target-model-dependent, which is relevant to the interface between pretraining, SFT, curriculum design, and capability-specific data allocation.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes Data-DPO. The method performs one-step probing on the target model to observe local training feedback for candidate samples, converts activation differences into pairwise data preferences, and trains a lightweight reward model to learn target-model-aware preferences. Final selection combines target-model preference, external quality scores, and marginal diversity.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are reported on Vision-Flan and LLaVA-CoT for VLM instruction or reasoning post-training data selection. The abstract claims Data-DPO improves selection effectiveness, but the provided text is truncated and does not include model sizes, candidate pool sizes, baseline details, or numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 读 one-step probing 到 pairwise preference 的构造即可；VLM 结果先当弱证据，但这个 data-model fit 信号值得复现。
recommendation.en: Read the one-step probing to pairwise preference construction; the VLM evidence is limited, but the data-model fit signal is worth reproducing.

paper.title: Diagnosing Dense Same-Class Attribute Misbinding in Large Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Large vision-language models can recognize the objects and attributes in a crowded scene yet assign an attribute to the wrong same-class instance. Generic visual-question-answering accuracy marks the response as wrong, while object-hallucination metrics may regard both the object and attribute as image-supported; neither reveals the transfer. This study formalizes this blind spot as Dense Same-Class Attribute Misbinding (DSCAM) and presents InstaBind-Lite, a controlled benchmark that makes it di

summary.core_problem: 大型 VLM 能识别拥挤场景中的物体和属性，却会把属性错误绑定到同类的另一个实例上；现有 VQA 准确率和物体幻觉指标都无法揭示这种属性迁移。
summary.importance: 形式化定义 Dense Same-Class Attribute Misbinding (DSCAM) 这一盲区，并构建可控 benchmark InstaBind-Lite 使其可测量。对多模态预训练中视觉-语言绑定机制有诊断价值。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 524 张图像、529 组 3–6 个同类实体、1773 个带框实例，设计有序邻居和可区分颜色类属性，以及四个互补问题层级，共 9580 个确定性评测问题；引入源实例标注以区分无依据生成、识别失败与从可见实体复制的属性迁移。
summary.experiments: 524 图 / 529 组 / 1773 框实例 / 9580 问题；提出绑定专用指标量化迁移频率、邻接关系等；摘要未给出具体模型得分。

summary_en.core_problem: Large VLMs can recognize objects and attributes in crowded scenes yet bind an attribute to the wrong same-class instance; generic VQA accuracy and object-hallucination metrics both fail to reveal this transfer.
summary_en.importance: Formalizes Dense Same-Class Attribute Misbinding (DSCAM) as a blind spot and builds InstaBind-Lite, a controlled benchmark to measure it. Diagnostic value for vision-language binding in multimodal pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: 524 images with 529 groups of 3–6 same-class entities, 1,773 boxed instances, ordered neighbors, distinguishable color-like attributes, and four question levels yielding 9,580 deterministically evaluated questions; source-instance annotations separate unsupported generation and recognition failure from attribute copied from another visible entity.
summary_en.experiments: 524 images / 529 groups / 1,773 boxed instances / 9,580 questions; binding-specific metrics quantify transfer frequency and adjacency; no model scores in abstract.

recommendation.zh: 把 VLM 同类属性错绑从泛化幻觉里拆出来单独测量，思路干净；作为多模态对齐诊断参考，看 benchmark 设计即可。
recommendation.en: Cleanly separates same-class attribute misbinding from generic hallucination in VLMs; worth a look at the benchmark design as a multimodal-alignment diagnostic.

paper.title: UniFed-VLM: Federated Instruction Tuning for Vision-Language Models with Multiple Heterogeneity
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in multimodal understanding and generation. However, fine-tuning of VLMs typically relies on centralized data, which raises privacy concerns in certain domains (e.g. healthcare). Federated Learning (FL) provides a natural solution by enabling model training without sharing raw data. However, applying FL to VLM instruction tuning is highly challenging. VLMs have substantial parameter scales, and in real-world scenarios, clients ex

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 联邦指令微调中的多重异质性：不同客户端可能有不同任务、不同模态和不同模型架构，同时又不能共享原始数据。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态后训练/联邦训练框架。它把 VLM 指令微调从简化联邦设定推进到更接近真实部署的异质场景，但对基座预训练研究的直接影响有限。
summary.technical_approach: UniFed-VLM 是统一的联邦 VLM 指令微调框架，摘要提到包含两个关键组件，用于处理任务异质、模态异质和架构异质。由于摘要截断，具体聚合策略、参数共享粒度和跨架构对齐机制无法确认。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出使用的 VLM、客户端数量、数据集、异质性构造方式或效果提升。应重点检查实验是否真的覆盖跨任务、跨模态、跨架构三种异质性，而不是只做局部 ablation。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses federated instruction tuning for VLMs under multiple forms of heterogeneity: clients may differ in tasks, modalities, and model architectures while keeping raw data private.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a multimodal post-training/federated learning framework. It moves VLM instruction tuning beyond simplified federated settings toward more realistic deployment heterogeneity, but its direct value for foundation pretraining is limited.
summary_en.technical_approach: UniFed-VLM is presented as a unified framework for federated VLM instruction tuning with two key components that handle task, modality, and architecture heterogeneity. The provided abstract is truncated, so the exact aggregation rule, parameter-sharing granularity, and cross-architecture alignment mechanism are unclear.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report VLM backbones, number of clients, datasets, heterogeneity construction, or quantitative gains. The critical check is whether the experiments truly cover joint task, modality, and architecture heterogeneity rather than isolated ablations.

recommendation.zh: 作为联邦 VLM 微调备查即可；若实验没有真实跨架构客户端，结论对基座训练几乎不可迁移。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a federated VLM tuning reference; if the setup lacks real cross-architecture clients, the conclusions barely transfer to foundation training.

paper.title: Neurosymbolic Embodied Agents
paper.abstract: Language and vision-language models generate plausible embodied plans but do not guarantee executability, as their outputs can violate environment dynamics or act on incorrectly grounded entities. We present a neurosymbolic agent that factors long-horizon household tasks into task-directed visual exploration and constrained symbolic planning. In the first phase, a vision-language model and exploration harness acquire goal-relevant predicates and instance bindings from egocentric observations and

summary.core_problem: 解决 embodied agent 生成的长程计划看起来合理但不可执行的问题，尤其是环境动力学约束和视觉实体 grounding 出错导致的失败。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent 方法改进。它把 VLM 的开放世界感知能力和符号规划的可执行性约束结合起来，对通用 agent 的 planning/grounding 接口有参考价值，但不是 LLM 预训练或通用模型训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分两阶段：先用 VLM 和视觉探索执行脚手架从第一视角观测与交互中抽取目标相关 predicates、对象实例绑定和 symbolic initial state；再用 PDDL transition model 约束 action token 解码，只允许生成适用动作，并用 Monte Carlo Tree Search 结合领域无关 planning heuristic 评估可执行续写。
summary.experiments: 在 VirtualHome 和 ALFWorld 上评估，使用 4B 到 27B 的开源模型。摘要称在两个环境中成功率超过 90%，并强调生成计划在给定 transition model 下 by construction 可执行，实际迁移仍依赖视觉 grounding 的正确性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the gap between plausible embodied plans produced by LMs/VLMs and plans that are actually executable under environment dynamics and grounded entities.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-method contribution. It is useful for thinking about the interface between open-ended VLM perception and constrained planning, but it is not a pretraining or general model-training paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: The system has two stages. A VLM-driven exploration harness extracts goal-relevant predicates, instance bindings, and a symbolic initial state from egocentric observations and interactions. A PDDL transition model then constrains decoding to applicable action tokens, while Monte Carlo tree search scores executable continuations using a domain-independent planning heuristic.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates on VirtualHome and ALFWorld with open 4B–27B models. The abstract reports over 90% success in both environments, with executability guaranteed under the transition model and transfer conditioned on correct visual grounding.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和 PDDL 约束解码部分即可；对 pretrain 没有直接动作，但能提醒 agent 失败常在 grounding/可执行性接口。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and PDDL-constrained decoding; no direct pretraining action, but it is a useful reminder that agent failures often sit at the grounding/executability boundary.

paper.title: Rollplex: Cross-Phase GPU Spatial Sharing for Vision Language Model Post-Training
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) enable embodied agents to reason and act from visual observations and language instructions. Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training enhances these capabilities using task feedback, but current on-policy RL runtimes execute rollout, reference scoring, and actor training in strict serial phases. While effective for text-only RL, this phase-granular execution is wasteful for VLMs, where processing dense video inputs and prompt prefixes occupies a large fraction of e

summary.core_problem: 解决VLM基于on-policy RL的后训练阶段，rollout、参考打分、actor训练严格串行导致GPU算力利用率低的问题，尤其是密集视频输入与prompt前缀处理带来的资源浪费。
summary.importance: 工程/系统创新，提出跨阶段GPU空间共享的runtime方案，提升大规模VLM RL后训练的资源效率。
summary.technical_approach: 原创性分解参考打分与训练阶段，将独立于生成响应的前缀计算迁移到rollout解码窗口执行，实现跨阶段GPU空间共享且不破坏on-policy同步语义；针对朴素colocating带来的高显存开销（Qwen2.5-VL-32B需约165GiB）做适配优化。
summary.experiments: 测试对象为Qwen2.5-VL-32B，对比基线为现有串行on-policy RL runtime；摘要仅提及朴素colocating方案需约165GiB显存，具体效率提升数据见正文。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses low GPU utilization in on-policy RL post-training of Vision-Language Models (VLMs), caused by strict serial execution of rollout, reference scoring, and actor training phases, especially with dense video inputs and prompt prefix processing overhead.
summary_en.importance: Engineering/system innovation proposing a cross-phase GPU spatial sharing runtime to improve resource efficiency for large-scale VLM RL post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Decomposes reference scoring and training phases, offloads prefix computation (independent of response generation) into the rollout decoding window to enable cross-phase GPU spatial sharing without violating synchronous on-policy semantics; mitigates VRAM overhead from naive colocation (165GiB for Qwen2.5-VL-32B).
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Qwen2.5-VL-32B with standard serial on-policy RL runtime as baseline; abstract only notes naive colocation requires ~165GiB VRAM, full efficiency gains are reported in main paper.

recommendation.zh: 针对VLM RL后训练的GPU调度优化，无方法论创新，做大规模后训练系统的团队可参考§3的阶段拆分逻辑。
recommendation.en: GPU scheduling optimization for VLM RL post-training with no methodological novelty; teams building large-scale post-training systems can reference §3 for phase splitting logic.

paper.title: MAG: MAnifold Guided Semi-Supervised Multi-modal In-Context Learning
paper.abstract: Few-shot in-context learning (ICL) with multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) enables task adaptation without parameter updates, but its performance is highly sensitive to the quality and coverage of the selected demonstrations. While unlabeled multi-modal data is abundant, it remains elusive how to exploit them for ICL. We propose MAG (MAnifold-Guided semi-supervised in-context demonstra- tion selection), an efficient framework that leverages unlabeled data to improve multi-modal ICL. MAG f

summary.core_problem: 解决多模态大模型 few-shot ICL 对 demonstration 选择高度敏感、但未标注多模态数据难以利用的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态 ICL 的样本选择方法。它不直接推进预训练，但对理解 VLM 表示、示例选择和未标注数据在上下文学习中的作用有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MAG，将 demonstration selection 建模为多模态图上的半监督传播问题。第一阶段用 relevance score propagation 找到少量高影响未标注样本进行伪标注，降低 MLLM 调用成本；第二阶段结合多模态相关性选择最终 demonstrations。论文还观察到文本表示更适合传播，视觉和文本都影响最终选择质量。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体模型参数量、数据集名称、baseline 列表和提升幅度。实验主张是 MAG 能更高效地利用未标注多模态样本，并改善 few-shot multimodal ICL 的 demonstration 质量。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to exploit unlabeled multimodal data for few-shot in-context learning, where MLLM performance is highly sensitive to the chosen demonstrations.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a demonstration-selection method for multimodal ICL. It is not a pretraining paper, but it offers a small signal about representation choice and unlabeled-data use in VLM prompting.
summary_en.technical_approach: MAG formulates demonstration selection as semi-supervised propagation on a multimodal graph. It first propagates relevance scores to identify a compact set of influential unlabeled samples for pseudo-labeling, then uses multimodal relevance to select the final demonstrations. The reported design separates propagation representations from final selection features.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, dataset names, baselines, or numerical gains. The main empirical claim is that MAG improves multimodal few-shot ICL while reducing MLLM inference cost for pseudo-labeling.

recommendation.zh: 作为 VLM ICL 备查即可；看文本传播优于多模态传播的消融，方法本身偏样本选择增量。
recommendation.en: Keep it as VLM-ICL background; the only useful part is the ablation where text features beat multimodal features for propagation.

paper.title: SCOUT: Unlocking Enhanced Spatial Reasoning via Structured Chain-of-Thought and Multi-Objective Process Reward
paper.abstract: Existing Vision-Language Models (VLMs) exhibits a critical bottleneck in robust spatial reasoning. Recent reinforcement learning (RL) methods aim to close this gap with verifiable outcomes, yet they suffer from poor credit assignment across intermediate reasoning steps. Concurrently, structured reasoning approaches overlook the critical depth perception necessary for comprehensive 3D understanding. To address these challenges, we propose SCOUT (Structured Chain-Of-Thought Utilizing Process-Super

summary.core_problem: VLM 在空间推理中不稳定，只有最终答案可验证的 RL 训练难以给中间推理步骤分配信用，尤其缺少显式深度和 3D 环境感知。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM 后训练方法和训练数据：结构化 CoT、过程奖励、多目标 RL，以及 SCOUT-24k 空间推理数据。它不是基座预训练方法，但对 RLVR 如何处理可分解推理轨迹有参考。
summary.technical_approach: SCOUT 设计显式建模 3D 环境感知的结构化 Chain-of-Thought，将空间推理轨迹拆成更可监督的片段；训练侧引入多目标 process rewards 和定制 advantage estimation，以便对不同推理段落进行细粒度 credit assignment。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出底座 VLM、参数量、训练轮数、baseline 或提升幅度；实验应比较 outcome-only RL、普通 CoT、过程监督 RL 在空间推理任务上的表现，并使用 SCOUT-24k 作为训练数据。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets weak spatial reasoning in VLMs, where outcome-verifiable RL provides poor credit assignment over intermediate reasoning steps and often lacks explicit depth or 3D scene modeling.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a VLM post-training recipe and dataset: structured CoT, multi-objective process rewards, tailored RL credit assignment, and SCOUT-24k. It is not a foundation pretraining method, but it is relevant to how RLVR might supervise decomposed reasoning trajectories.
summary_en.technical_approach: SCOUT defines a structured Chain-of-Thought format that explicitly models 3D environmental perception, then trains with multi-objective process rewards and a tailored advantage estimator to assign credit across different segments of the reasoning trajectory.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify the base VLM, parameter count, training schedule, baselines, or quantitative gains. The expected comparison is against outcome-only RL, standard CoT, and process-supervised variants on spatial reasoning tasks using SCOUT-24k.

recommendation.zh: 作为 RLVR 信号设计备查即可；若没有严谨 ablation，结构化 CoT 很容易只是格式工程。
recommendation.en: Keep it as RLVR signal-design background; without tight ablations, the structured CoT part may just be format engineering.

paper.title: CoAdapt-GUI: Joint Workflow Context and Policy Adaptation for Unseen GUI Applications
paper.abstract: Mobile GUI agents remain brittle when deployed to applications absent from source training.
