We study novel-app generalization under a limited target interaction budget and without target demonstrations. We introduce CoAdapt-GUI, a test-time adaptation (TTA) framework that jointly adapts structured workflow context and policy from the agent's own target-app rollouts and rewards. The workflow context retains transferable procedures, failure modes, and verification rules while excluding app-bound s

summary.core_problem: 移动GUI agent在未见过的应用上泛化能力差，测试时适应缺乏目标应用演示且交互预算有限
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出工作流上下文与策略联合适应的测试时适应（TTA）框架，无需目标应用演示
summary.technical_approach: 将工作流上下文分离为可迁移的过程/失败模式/验证规则与应用绑定细节；用task-context-matched group-relative优化更新冻结VLM上的LoRA
summary.experiments: AndroidWorld-Generalization达45.0%（Policy-Only TTA baseline 37.5%）；AndroidWorld Plus从38.6%提升至52.9%

summary_en.core_problem: Mobile GUI agents are brittle on unseen apps; test-time adaptation lacks target demonstrations and has limited interaction budget
summary_en.importance: Method innovation: joint workflow-context and policy adaptation TTA framework requiring no target-app demonstrations
summary_en.technical_approach: Separates transferable workflow knowledge (procedures, failure modes, verification rules) from app-bound source details; updates LoRA on frozen VLM via task-context-matched group-relative optimization
summary_en.experiments: 45.0% on AndroidWorld-Generalization (vs 37.5% Policy-Only TTA baseline); AndroidWorld Plus improved from 38.6% to 52.9%

recommendation.zh: GUI agent的TTA方法，工作流与策略解耦的思路对agent泛化有启发，但与pretrain无直接关系，作为agent方法备查
recommendation.en: GUI agent TTA with workflow-policy decoupling is interesting for agent generalization but has no direct pretrain relevance—keep as reference.

paper.title: When Vision Becomes Text: Visual Token Pruning via Cross-Modal Residual Guidance in VLMs
paper.abstract: Abundant visual information strengthens vision-language model (VLM) perception, yet massive visual tokens raise inference costs. Existing visual token pruning methods rely on similarity-based guidance, which exploits pairwise text-vision and vision-vision token correlations for compression. However, such methods only capture local layer-level signals and overlook the whole inference process in VLM. In this paper, we revisit VLM inference and present a new efficient guidance scheme that complemen

summary.core_problem: 这项工作要解决的是 VLM 推理中的视觉 token 冗余问题：现有剪枝方法多依赖单层 attention 或相似度，缺少对文本 token 在深层逐步吸收视觉信息这一过程的刻画。
summary.importance: 它对预训练研究的直接贡献不在训练目标，而在多模态表示动态分析和推理效率。论文给出一个清晰观察：随着 LLM 层数加深，一部分视觉 token 信息会被文本表示吸收，因此继续保留所有视觉 token 的边际收益下降。这对 native multimodal pretrain、视觉 token budget、跨模态 token routing 都有启发。训练阶段可以考虑让视觉信息在合适层被压缩到文本或共享 latent 中；推理阶段则可以用残差信息而不是原始相似度判断哪些视觉 token 仍有保留价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分两步。第一步是分析指标 Cross Modal Absorption，简称 CMA。它在每一层把中心化后的视觉 token 矩阵投影到文本 token 张成的子空间中，用投影可解释的 Frobenius norm 比例衡量视觉信息被文本子空间吸收的程度。CMA 是层级指标，用来描述随层深变化的整体趋势。第二步是 token 级剪枝指标 Cross Modal Residual，简称 CMR。对每个视觉 token，用 Tikhonov regularization 做正则化最小二乘投影，计算它在文本子空间之外的残差；残差越大，说明该 token 仍包含文本表示尚未解释的视觉信息。最终方法 SIEVE 把三类信号结合起来：CMR 衡量视觉独特性，text-to-visual attention 衡量任务相关性，残差空间中的 diversity selection 去除冗余。与只看原特征相似度的剪枝相比，残差空间先剥离了已被文本解释的成分，因此更适合找互补视觉信息。方法不训练模型，可插入已有 VLM。
summary.experiments: 分析部分在 LLaVA-1.5-7B 的 32 层上进行，覆盖 TextVQA、POPE、MME 三个 benchmark，共 16,284 个样本。CMA 随层数单调增加：POPE 从 0.008 到 0.209，MME 从 0.009 到 0.217，TextVQA 从 0.017 到 0.396；三者与层深的 Spearman 相关系数均为 +0.99。这说明视觉表征确实逐层变得更容易由文本子空间解释。方法实验覆盖三种 VLM 架构和八个 benchmark，报告在降低计算和显存开销的同时保持任务表现，并带来实际推理加速。给定正文没有完整提供各压缩率、延迟、显存和精度表，因此具体收益需要读实验表。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。先看 Analysis 中 CMA 的定义和 Figure 2，因为这是方法成立的核心证据。再看 Method 中 CMR 的正则化投影公式、SIEVE 如何融合 CMR、attention relevance 和 residual-space diversity。实验部分重点看不同保留率下的 accuracy-latency 曲线、跨 LLaVA / InternVL / Qwen-VL 等架构的稳定性，以及 OCR、幻觉检测、多图或高分辨率场景是否掉点。消融部分要确认 CMR 单独使用、attention 单独使用、diversity 单独使用的贡献，避免把收益误认为只是常规 attention pruning 的变体。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets visual-token redundancy in VLM inference. Existing pruning methods mostly use single-layer attention or feature similarity, while this work models a process that happens across depth: text tokens gradually absorb part of the visual information.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model research is in multimodal representation dynamics and efficient inference, rather than pretraining objectives. The key observation is that visual information does not remain fully isolated in visual tokens; deeper text states can explain an increasing portion of it. This has implications for native multimodal pretraining, visual token budgets, and cross-modal routing. During training, one may encourage visual information to move into shared or textual latent states at the right depth. During inference, pruning can focus on visual residuals that have not yet been explained by text.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis first defines Cross Modal Absorption, or CMA. At each layer, centered visual-token representations are projected onto the subspace spanned by text-token representations, and the explainable Frobenius-norm ratio measures how much visual information has been absorbed by the text subspace. CMA is a layer-level diagnostic. For pruning, the paper introduces Cross Modal Residual, or CMR, at the token level. Each visual token is projected onto the text subspace using Tikhonov-regularized least squares, and the residual measures the visual information not explained by text. A larger residual means the token still carries complementary visual content. The final method, SIEVE, combines CMR for visual distinctiveness, text-to-visual attention for task relevance, and diversity selection in the residual space to reduce redundancy. It is training-free and can be applied to existing VLMs.
summary_en.experiments: The representation analysis uses all 32 layers of LLaVA-1.5-7B on TextVQA, POPE, and MME, with 16,284 samples in total. CMA increases monotonically with depth: from 0.008 to 0.209 on POPE, from 0.009 to 0.217 on MME, and from 0.017 to 0.396 on TextVQA. The Spearman correlation with layer depth is +0.99 for all three benchmarks. This provides direct evidence that deeper text representations explain more visual-token content. The pruning experiments cover three VLM architectures and eight benchmarks, reporting reduced compute and memory with practical inference acceleration while maintaining task performance. The provided text does not include the full accuracy, latency, memory, or pruning-ratio tables, so those numbers should be checked in the experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Start with the CMA definition and Figure 2, since they motivate the whole method. Then read the CMR derivation, especially the regularized projection onto the text subspace, and how SIEVE combines CMR, attention relevance, and residual-space diversity. In the experiments, focus on accuracy-latency trade-off curves, robustness across different VLM backbones, and behavior on OCR-heavy, hallucination-sensitive, high-resolution, or multi-image inputs. The ablations should be checked carefully: CMR alone, attention alone, diversity alone, and their combinations determine whether the method is more than a variant of standard attention-based pruning.

recommendation.zh: CMA 这个度量可借鉴到 VLM KV-cache 压缩，看方法和图即可，不必复现。
recommendation.en: The CMA metric is a useful angle for VLM KV-cache compression; read the method and figures, no need to reproduce.

paper.title: Chain of Spatial Thoughts: Modality-Agnostic Spatial Grounding for Vision Language Models
paper.abstract: Spatial understanding is fundamental to embodied intelligence, underpinning applications such as robotic manipulation, embodied navigation, and autonomous driving. Although recent vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved impressive performance on spatial reasoning benchmarks, state-of-the-art approaches typically rely on additional spatial encoders or architectural modifications during inference, increasing computational cost. We introduce Space Tokens, a lightweight, architecture-agnostic fr

summary.core_problem: 这项工作要解决的是 VLM 空间推理能力的注入方式：如何让模型获得显式 3D 几何和物体级空间属性，同时不在推理时外挂 3D 重建编码器、几何连接器或额外空间模块。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的启发主要在统一表示和 latent token 监督。它不是单纯做空间 benchmark，而是把 3D 几何知识压到 VLM 的生成序列中，用保留词表位置对应的 hidden states 承载连续空间表示。这个思路和视觉 tokenizer、latent knowledge token、native multimodal mid-train 接口关系较近：外部专家模型只在训练阶段提供监督，推理阶段由原 VLM 内部表示承接知识。贡献量级偏方法型，不是大规模预训练 recipe，但对“如何把不可文本化的结构知识并入 LM token 流”有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Space Tokens。核心做法是预留一组特殊 token，但不使用它们的离散 token id 表达空间信息，而是取这些 token 生成位置的最后层 hidden states 作为连续空间向量。模型仍按自回归方式生成文本和空间 token，因此不需要改 Transformer 结构，也不需要在推理时调用额外 3D 模块。训练时，空间 token 接受两类监督：一类是 scene-level 3D geometry，把大型 3D reconstruction 模型产生的场景几何知识蒸馏进 VLM latent space；另一类是 object-centric spatial attributes，把 3D bounding box 的位置、朝向和尺寸编码进专用 latent token。与直接拼接深度图、点云 encoder 或几何 adapter 相比，这种方案把几何监督放在训练期，把推理期接口保持为普通 VLM token 流。代价是空间 token 的语义依赖监督质量，且连续表示需要额外 decoder 或 probe 才能被显式验证。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖空间推理、视觉问答和通用 VQA。文中报告 Space Tokens 在 VSI-Bench 上使 Qwen3-VL-8B 提升 4.3 分，使 SenseNova1.3 提升 1.3 分；在 object size 和 room size estimation 上也取得较强结果。更有信息量的部分不是单个分数，而是两个现象：第一，外部 3D 教师模型可以在训练后被移除，说明几何信号部分进入了 VLM 内部状态；第二，空间 token 可被解码回可解释 3D 模态，用于检查模型学到的是否是几何结构，而不只是 benchmark shortcut。摘要和给定正文没有完整列出各 benchmark 的绝对分数、训练数据规模和消融数值，因此这些部分需要读表确认。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Methodology 中空间 token 的定义、hidden state 抽取位置、scene-level 和 object-level 两类监督的具体 loss，以及是否在训练和推理阶段引入不同组件。实验部分优先看 VSI-Bench 的主表、object size / room size 估计表、空间 token 可视化或可解码验证图。消融需要关注三点：只用场景几何、只用物体 3D box、两者同时使用的差异；空间 token 数量和插入位置；通用 VQA 是否退化。这些决定它更像一个稳健的 latent token 接口，还是主要依赖特定空间 benchmark 的监督适配。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to inject explicit 3D geometry and object-level spatial attributes into VLMs without adding reconstruction encoders, geometry adapters, or other inference-time spatial modules.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to foundation-model pretraining is the representation interface. Space Tokens treat reserved token positions as carriers of continuous latent states, supervised by external geometric signals during training and used as native tokens at inference. This connects to visual tokenization, latent knowledge tokens, and multimodal mid-training: a teacher model supplies structured non-text information, while the deployed VLM keeps the same autoregressive interface. The contribution is methodological rather than a large-scale pretraining recipe, but it is useful for thinking about how non-linguistic structure can be folded into an LM token stream.
summary_en.technical_approach: Space Tokens reserve a subset of the vocabulary and let the VLM generate these tokens just like normal autoregressive tokens. Their discrete identities are not the main representation; the final-layer hidden states at these positions are used as continuous spatial embeddings. The training supervision has two branches. One distills scene-level 3D geometry from large 3D reconstruction models into the VLM latent space. The other encodes object-centric 3D bounding-box attributes, including position, orientation, and size, into dedicated spatial tokens. Compared with attaching depth, point-cloud, or geometry encoders, the heavy geometry model is only used during training. The trade-off is that the learned latent tokens depend on teacher quality and need decoders or probes for explicit verification.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers spatial reasoning, visual QA, and general VQA. The reported gains include +4.3 points on VSI-Bench for Qwen3-VL-8B and +1.3 points for SenseNova1.3. The method also reports strong results on object-size and room-size estimation. The more useful evidence is qualitative and diagnostic: the 3D teacher can be removed at inference, and the learned spatial states remain decodable into interpretable 3D modalities. The provided text does not expose the full score tables, data scale, or all ablation numbers, so those details should be checked directly in the experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the Methodology section: how spatial tokens are inserted, which hidden states are supervised, what losses are used for scene-level geometry and object-level boxes, and whether the training and inference graphs differ. In the experiments, read the VSI-Bench table, the object-size and room-size estimation results, and any visualization or decoding analysis of Space Tokens. The most important ablations are scene geometry only versus object boxes only, the number and placement of spatial tokens, and whether general VQA performance is preserved.

recommendation.zh: 做多模态预训练的空间能力注入可参考其蒸馏思路，重点看§3的Space Tokens设计和消融实验
recommendation.en: Reference for spatial ability injection in multimodal pretraining; focus on §3 Space Tokens design and ablation studies.

paper.title: UniProbe: A Learnable Token-Level Hallucination Detector for Large VLMs using Multi-Structural Internal Representations
paper.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) achieve impressive visual reasoning and dialogue capabilities, yet frequently hallucinate content unsupported by the visual input. Effective mitigation requires token-level localization, enabling targeted intervention without discarding the entire response. Existing detectors require expensive full-model fine-tuning, rely on external verifiers that ignore the model's generation process, or reduce internal signals to isolated features and hand-crafted statisti

summary.core_problem: 在不微调大型 VLM 的情况下，利用单次前向传播的内部表示，在生成 token 级别定位视觉幻觉。
summary.importance: 贡献是 VLM 幻觉检测方法，重点不在 benchmark，而在把模型内部计算轨迹结构化为可学习信号；对预训练研究员的价值主要是观察 LVLM 内部表征中哪些结构信号能预测 grounding 失败。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 UniProbe：冻结 LVLM，从一次前向传播中构建包含图像 patch、query token 和生成 token 的有向图，用 attention 权重表示关系；再交替使用 GNN 建模关系证据、ViT 建模二维视觉几何、序列模块建模生成 token 上下文，从多结构内部表示预测 token 级幻觉。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 LVLM、参数量、数据集、baseline 或提升幅度；能确认的是方法声称比全模型微调、外部 verifier 或手工统计特征更轻量，并支持 token-level localization。
summary.authors_note: Gal Chechik 和 Haggai Maron 参与；两人在视觉表示学习、几何深度学习和结构化表示方向有代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper detects token-level hallucinations in large VLM outputs using internal representations from a single forward pass, without fine-tuning the full model.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a VLM hallucination detector whose main value is not a benchmark but a structured use of internal computational traces. For pretraining researchers, it is mainly useful as evidence about which internal LVLM signals correlate with grounding failures.
summary_en.technical_approach: UniProbe freezes the LVLM and builds a directed graph over image patches, query tokens, and generated tokens, with attention weights encoding their relations. It alternates structure-aware modules: a GNN for relational evidence, a ViT for 2-D visual geometry, and sequence modeling over generated tokens to predict token-level hallucination.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not disclose concrete LVLMs, parameter counts, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains. It positions the method as lighter than full-model fine-tuning, more process-aware than external verifiers, and richer than hand-crafted internal statistics.
summary_en.authors_note: Gal Chechik and Haggai Maron are among the authors; they are known for work in visual representation learning, geometric deep learning, and structured representations.

recommendation.zh: 看方法图和内部 trace 构造即可；它不是预训练方法，但能提示 VLM grounding 失败的可探测信号。
recommendation.en: Read the method diagram and trace construction; it is not pretraining, but it exposes useful signals for VLM grounding failures.

paper.title: Multi-View Relational Distillation for Spatial Reasoning with Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved strong image and video understanding, yet their visual-spatial representations remain geometrically fragile, leading to failures in spatial reasoning needed for embodied AI, robotics, and autonomous driving. Prior approaches to geometry grounding either fine-tune VLMs on spatial question answering, which can perpetuate spurious visual representations, or fuse features from large geometry-grounded vision models, which substantially increases model size

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 在空间推理中几何表征脆弱的问题，尤其是多视角场景下对象关系和空间对应不稳定。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM 表征蒸馏方法改进。它关注一个真实问题：直接引入几何模型特征会增加推理成本，直接特征蒸馏又可能破坏原有图文语义对齐。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Multi-View Relational Distillation，不直接匹配几何教师模型的特征，而是蒸馏跨视角 patch-wise cosine similarity。这样保留几何对应关系，同时减少对 VLM 原有视觉-文本对齐空间的扰动。
summary.experiments: 摘要称方法面向图像和视频理解中的空间推理，并与空间问答微调、几何特征融合、直接特征蒸馏等思路对比；未提供模型规模、数据规模和具体提升数字。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses fragile geometric representations in VLMs, especially unstable multi-view spatial correspondences needed for visual-spatial reasoning.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a representation distillation method for VLMs. The useful point is the trade-off: geometry-grounded teachers can help, but feature fusion increases inference cost and direct feature matching may damage vision-language alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes Multi-View Relational Distillation, which distills patch-wise cosine similarity relations across views rather than matching teacher features directly. The goal is to transfer geometric correspondence while preserving the pretrained semantic alignment of the VLM.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports evaluations on image and video spatial reasoning, comparing against spatial QA fine-tuning, geometry-feature fusion, and direct feature distillation style baselines; exact model sizes, data scale, and numerical gains are not given.

recommendation.zh: 可略读方法图；关系蒸馏比特征蒸馏更稳这个点，对 VLM 预训练对齐有一点可迁移价值。
recommendation.en: Skim the method figure; relational distillation being safer than feature matching is mildly useful for VLM alignment work.

paper.title: Wiener Representation Filtering for VLM Hallucination Suppression
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) excel at open-ended captioning and visual QA but often describe objects, attributes, or relations absent from the image, a phenomenon known as object hallucination. We propose a {training-free, post-hoc representation editing technique} that operates in the representation space of the language backbone. The method performs a lightweight, one-time offline calibration on a modest paired dataset to estimate the required covariance structures, using only forward passes

summary.core_problem: VLM在开放域描述和视觉问答中频繁产生图像中不存在的物体、属性或关系（物体幻觉）。
summary.importance: 提出一种训练自由、事后的表示编辑方法，无需梯度更新或微调即可抑制幻觉，属于方法创新。
summary.technical_approach: 将语言骨干隐藏状态建模为真实成分和幻觉相关成分的叠加；在小规模配对数据集上仅通过前向传播估计协方差结构；推导出Wiener型估计器，最优增益由真实和幻觉表示的协方差闭式给出；特征分解得到逐模式衰减并满足稳定性准则；校正直接吸收到模型现有权重中。
summary.experiments: 在VLM物体幻觉基准上测试，训练自由、一次性校准，显著降低幻觉率同时保持描述质量。
summary.authors_note: Lior Wolf（Tel Aviv University），在多模态和生成模型领域有较多代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: VLMs frequently describe objects, attributes, or relations absent from the image (object hallucination) in open-ended captioning and VQA.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a training-free, post-hoc representation editing method that suppresses hallucination without gradient updates or fine-tuning; method innovation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Models hidden states of the language backbone as a superposition of truthful and hallucination-associated components; estimates covariance structures on a small paired dataset via forward passes only; derives a Wiener-type estimator whose optimal gains are given in closed form from covariances of truthful and hallucinated representations; eigendecomposition yields mode-wise attenuation satisfying a stability criterion; correction is absorbed directly into existing model weights.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on VLM object hallucination benchmarks; training-free with one-time calibration, significantly reduces hallucination rate while preserving caption quality.
summary_en.authors_note: Lior Wolf (Tel Aviv University), known for work in multimodal and generative models.

recommendation.zh: 看§3的Wiener滤波推导和协方差估计部分，判断幻觉是否真在表示空间线性可分；若成立，对幻觉干预手段的认知会改变。
recommendation.en: Read §3 for the Wiener filter derivation and covariance estimation; if hallucination is truly linearly separable in representation space, it changes how we think about hallucination interventions.

paper.title: Locating Failure in Multi-Page Visually Rich Document Understanding: An Empirical Attribution
paper.abstract: Multi-page visually-rich document understanding (MP-VRDU) requires managing evidence that is sparse, spread across pages, and often exceeds a model's context window. Prior work has produced competing, largely untested claims about how these systems should be built. We attribute incorrect answers to three failure modes, representation, selection, and reasoning, and isolate each over a multi-page document understanding dataset by intervening on one while holding the others fixed. We find that visi

summary.core_problem: 定位多页、视觉丰富文档理解系统的错误来源：到底是页面表示、证据选择，还是跨页推理失败。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是经验归因分析。它不提出新的基座模型或预训练方法，但把 MP-VRDU 中常被混在一起讨论的三个瓶颈拆开测量，对 VLM 长文档训练和系统设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把错误归因到 representation、selection、reasoning 三类，并通过干预实验固定其中若干环节、单独改变一个环节来隔离因果影响。例如分别控制文本抽取、页面选择、完整证据供给和提示方式，观察最终回答变化。
summary.experiments: 实验基于一个多页文档理解数据集，评估视觉输入、文本抽取、缺页、干扰页和提示策略对准确率的影响。主要发现包括：视觉信息必要但不能替代文本抽取；缺失相关页面会直接限制准确率；额外干扰页代价较小；即使完整证据已提供，模型仍会在跨页证据整合上失败。摘要未给出模型规模和具体提升数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks where multi-page visually rich document understanding systems fail: page representation, evidence selection, or cross-page reasoning.
summary_en.importance: This is an empirical attribution study rather than a new foundation-model training method. Its value is in separating three failure sources that are often conflated in MP-VRDU systems, which is useful for VLM long-document training and system design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors decompose errors into representation, selection, and reasoning failures, then use intervention-style experiments that hold some components fixed while varying one component at a time. They control text extraction, page selection, full-evidence supply, and prompting behavior to isolate causal effects.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on a multi-page document understanding dataset. The main findings are that vision remains necessary but does not replace text extraction, missing relevant pages upper-bound accuracy, distractor pages are relatively cheap, and reasoners still fail to integrate cross-page evidence even when all evidence is supplied. The abstract does not report model sizes or exact numeric gains.

recommendation.zh: 只看错误归因结果即可；对 native VLM 预训练不直接给 recipe，但会校准文档任务里“加长上下文就够了”的直觉。
recommendation.en: Read the attribution results only; it does not give a VLM pretraining recipe, but it usefully checks the prior that longer context alone solves document QA.

paper.title: Listen, See and Track: Spatio-Temporal Audio-Visual Sound Event Reasoning for Omni-Modal Language Models
paper.abstract: Understanding dynamic sound sources requires jointly determining what produces a sound, where the source is located, and how it moves over time. Yet existing audio-language models often represent clips as global acoustic events, while vision-language models lack the spatial audio cues needed to localize and track individual sources. To evaluate this missing capability, we introduce ST-OmniQA, a spatio-temporal audio-visual question-answering benchmark built from panoramic videos paired with sync

summary.core_problem: 现有音频-语言模型和视觉-语言模型缺乏对动态声源的时空定位与跟踪能力的问题
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献+方法创新，提出首个时空音视频问答基准ST-OmniQA，并构建了对应的多模态模型ST-Omni-R1
summary.technical_approach: 基于全景视频和同步一阶Ambisonics（FOA）音频构建数据集，包含40K视频和400K问答对，覆盖声音事件识别、到达方向、声源距离、运动轨迹、时序 grounded 音视频推理4个能力层级；ST-Omni-R1整合FOA衍生的语义和轨迹表示与全景视觉上下文，通过渐进式课程学习训练
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体基线对比和量化结果，仅说明数据集规模和模型设计思路

summary_en.core_problem: Existing audio-language and vision-language models lack the ability to localize and track dynamic sound sources in space and time
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution + methodological innovation: proposes ST-OmniQA, the first spatio-temporal audio-visual QA benchmark, and the corresponding ST-Omni-R1 multimodal model
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs dataset from panoramic videos paired with synchronized first-order Ambisonics (FOA) audio of moving sound sources, containing 40K videos and 400K QA pairs across 4 capability levels; ST-Omni-R1 integrates FOA-derived semantic and trajectory representations with panoramic visual context, trained via progressive curriculum learning
summary_en.experiments: No specific baseline comparisons or quantitative results are provided in the abstract, only dataset scale and model design are described

recommendation.zh: 音视频时空推理的新benchmark，做多模态预训练的可以了解下数据集构造思路，无需深读
recommendation.en: A new benchmark for audio-visual spatio-temporal reasoning; multimodal pretraining researchers can note the dataset construction approach, no deep read needed

paper.title: Thinking With Tools, Not With Pixels: Tool Calls as Text Scaffolds for Visual Reasoning
paper.abstract: Tool-augmented vision-language models increasingly "think with images": they call crop, zoom, or code tools and reason over the returned pixels. However, recent work using blind tests, gain decompositions, and attention analyses has shown that returned images contribute little, raising the question: if pixels do not carry the gain, what does? We hypothesize that the load-bearing signal is the structured text emitted before any returned pixel arrives: tool name, coordinates, target description, a

summary.core_problem: 工具增强VLM在“看图思考”时，性能增益到底来自返回的像素，还是来自工具调用前生成的结构化文本脚手架？
summary.importance: 机制/归因分析：把一类常见的tool-use视觉推理增益拆解为“文本结构信号”，对多模态预训练与agent式交互数据的建模目标有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出TextCall（call-but-no-return）对照：保留工具名/坐标/意图等调用文本，但将返回图像替换为占位符[Image output skipped]；在LoRA、全参微调与RL设置下比较“有无返回像素”的差异，并结合blind tests、gain decomposition、attention分析支撑归因。
summary.experiments: 在多种训练范式（LoRA/全参/RL）下，TextCall可匹配或超过完整“thinking-with-images”；并报告RL下保留工具使用行为、避免某些训练失败模式（摘要提到但未给具体数值/基准名）。

summary_en.core_problem: In tool-augmented VLM visual reasoning, does the gain come from returned pixels or from the structured textual scaffold emitted before any pixels arrive?
summary_en.importance: A mechanistic attribution result: it reframes a common 'think-with-images' tool-use gain as largely a text-structure effect, which matters for multimodal pretraining objectives and agent-style interaction data.
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose TextCall (call-but-no-return): keep tool name/coordinates/intent text but replace returned images with a placeholder. Validate via controlled comparisons across LoRA, full finetuning, and RL, plus blind tests, gain decomposition, and attention analyses.
summary_en.experiments: Across multiple training regimes, TextCall matches or exceeds full tool-return pipelines; under RL it preserves tool-use behavior at the reported checkpoint and avoids a cited failure mode (details/benchmarks not in the abstract).

recommendation.zh: 把“工具返回像素”拆成“调用文本脚手架”后仍不掉点，这会直接影响你怎么做tool-use数据与多模态对齐；只看TextCall设定与RL那组对照就够。
recommendation.en: If performance holds with pixels removed but the call text kept, your tool-use/multimodal training signal is misattributed; read the TextCall control and the RL ablation.

paper.title: RIG-RoPE: Relation- and Instance-Gated Rotary Positional Encoding with Duration-Aware Temporal Coordinates
paper.abstract: Rotary positional encoding (RoPE) is a core component of modern language models and has been extended to multimodal LLMs through multidimensional variants such as multimodal RoPE (M-RoPE), which split positional channels into temporal, height, and width subspaces. This report identifies two limitations of static multidimensional position assignment in interleaved multimodal contexts. First, height/width rotations may be applied to token pairs whose spatial displacement is not a well-defined geom

summary.core_problem: 解决多模态交错上下文中静态 M-RoPE 位置分配导致的跨模态、跨实例空间干扰，以及时间坐标不能反映不同 token 信息密度的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是 VLM 位置编码方法改进，和统一多模态预训练的 token 坐标设计直接相关；它关心的是模型如何在同一序列里同时处理文本、图像块和视频片段的位置关系。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RIG-RoPE，在 RoPE 上加入 relation gate 和 instance gate，并引入 duration-aware temporal coordinates。每个 token 额外带有 modality indicator、visual instance identifier 和时间尺度信息，使空间旋转只在几何关系明确的视觉实例内生效，时间相位按内容时长或信息密度推进。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据、baseline 和具体指标；目前只能确认论文针对 M-RoPE 的两个机制性缺陷提出改法，实验可信度需要看正文中的 ablation 和长视频/多图交错任务结果。
summary.authors_note: Sichuan University；未见可确认的知名作者背景信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses cross-modal and cross-instance spatial interference in static M-RoPE assignments, as well as temporal coordinates that fail to reflect different information densities across text, image, and video tokens.
summary_en.importance: This is a VLM positional-encoding contribution with direct relevance to unified multimodal pretraining, especially for interleaved sequences containing text, image blocks, and video segments.
summary_en.technical_approach: RIG-RoPE adds relation and instance gates to RoPE and uses duration-aware temporal coordinates. Tokens carry modality indicators, visual instance identifiers, and temporal scale information, so spatial rotations are applied only where geometric displacement is meaningful and temporal phase advances according to duration or information density.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, training data, baselines, or numerical results. The key thing to verify in the full paper is whether ablations isolate the gates and duration-aware coordinates on long-video and multi-image interleaved tasks.
summary_en.authors_note: Sichuan University; no clearly identifiable widely known authors from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 这是 VLM pretrain 里容易被低估的坐标问题；只读方法图和 ablation，确认 gate 是否真消掉跨实例干扰。
recommendation.en: This targets an under-discussed coordinate issue in VLM pretraining; read the method diagram and ablations to see whether the gates really remove cross-instance interference.

paper.title: Not All Redundant Tokens Are Alike: Analyzing Visual Token Pruning through Token Roles
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) process an image as a sequence of visual tokens, which creates a substantial computational bottleneck during inference. Recent visual token pruning methods address this issue by removing seemingly redundant tokens, yet it remains unclear how these pruning decisions relate to the functional roles of visual tokens. In this work, we analyze visual token pruning through the lens of token roles identified by EmbedLens. We first show that representative pruning methods ex

summary.core_problem: 分析 VLM 中视觉 token 剪枝决策与 token 功能角色之间的关系，解释为何看似冗余的 token 被剪去后会影响性能。
summary.importance: 属于视觉 token 剪枝的机制分析工作；主要贡献是用 EmbedLens 定义的 token role 审视现有剪枝方法的偏差，并发现弱语义 token 不一定可安全删除。
summary.technical_approach: 先用 EmbedLens 识别视觉 token 角色，比较多种代表性剪枝方法的角色偏好；再改进 token-role 分配流程，设计 role-protected pruning 变体，观察保留不同角色 token 对下游性能的影响。
summary.experiments: 在多种视觉 token 剪枝方法上做角色偏差分析和受控剪枝实验；结果显示保留 non-alive tokens 有时能维持或提升性能。摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集或数值提升。

summary_en.core_problem: Analyze how visual token pruning decisions in VLMs relate to the functional roles of visual tokens, and why pruning seemingly redundant tokens can hurt behavior.
summary_en.importance: A mechanistic analysis of visual token pruning; its main contribution is using EmbedLens-derived token roles to reveal biases in existing pruners and show that weakly semantic tokens are not always safe to remove.
summary_en.technical_approach: It identifies token roles with EmbedLens, compares role biases across representative pruning methods, refines the role-assignment procedure, and evaluates role-protected pruning variants that preserve specific token groups.
summary_en.experiments: It analyzes role biases and runs controlled pruning experiments across several pruning methods; preserving non-alive tokens sometimes maintains or improves performance. The abstract does not specify model sizes, datasets, or numeric gains.

recommendation.zh: 视觉 token 剪枝的小分析，结论对 VLM 推理优化有边际参考；只看 role-protected pruning 的对照实验即可。
recommendation.en: A small analysis of visual token pruning; marginally useful for VLM inference work. Read only the role-protected pruning comparisons.

paper.title: DIVE: Dynamic Iterative Visual Evidence Construction for Efficient Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Visual inputs in vision-language models (VLMs) are often encoded into substantially longer token sequences than text, making visual tokens a major bottleneck for efficient inference. Abundant recent methods address this bottleneck by scoring token importance and pruning low-scoring tokens in a single pass. However, one-shot scoring is insufficient because a token's prompt-relevant usefulness depends on the evidence already retained. Motivated by this insight, we introduce DIVE (Dynamic Iterative

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 中一次性视觉 token 评分无法考虑已保留证据、导致剪枝 token 与 prompt 需求不互补的问题。
summary.importance: 方法型工作，把视觉 token 剪枝重新表述为动态证据构建；对 VLM 推理加速有参考，但属于训练-free 的增量式剪枝改进。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DIVE，一个 training-free 框架：迭代选择当前 residual-conditioned score 最高的 token，更新视觉和 prompt residual 以折扣已解释证据，再重新评估剩余 token，形成互补的保留集合。
summary.experiments: 在 8 个图像理解 benchmark 上评估；摘要未给出具体模型、baseline 或数值结果，仅说明该 select-update-re-evaluate 流程用于构建 prompt-relevant visual evidence。

summary_en.core_problem: One-shot visual token scoring in VLMs ignores which evidence has already been retained, so pruned tokens may fail to complement the prompt-relevant evidence set.
summary_en.importance: A methods paper that recasts visual token pruning as dynamic evidence construction; relevant to VLM inference acceleration, but it is an incremental training-free pruning improvement.
summary_en.technical_approach: DIVE repeatedly selects the token with the highest residual-conditioned score, updates visual and prompt residuals to discount explained evidence, and re-evaluates remaining tokens to build a complementary retained set.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on eight image-understanding benchmarks. The abstract does not report model names, baselines, or numeric results, only describing the select-update-re-evaluate procedure.

recommendation.zh: 训练-free 的迭代剪枝技巧，思路清楚但更像 VLM 推理工程改进；看 residual 更新公式和主表即可。
recommendation.en: A training-free iterative pruning trick with a clear idea, but mostly VLM inference engineering. Read the residual update and main table.

paper.title: Perception Before Reasoning: Dynamic Latent Reasoning for Video Understanding and Question Answering
paper.abstract: Video question answering requires models to ground language queries in visual evidence and, when necessary, reason over that evidence across time. Existing methods typically rely on long textual chain-of-thought rationales, even though many questions can be answered as soon as the relevant object, action, or frame is localized. We propose Dynamic Latent Reasoning (DyLaR), which first grounds a question in a short block of perception latents (continuous hidden states that encode query-relevant vi

summary.core_problem: 现有视频QA方法过度依赖长文本CoT推理，而很多问题在定位到相关视觉证据后即可直接回答，存在推理冗余和效率低下的问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出“先感知后推理”的动态潜在推理框架，减少不必要的文本CoT推理，兼顾准确率和效率。
summary.technical_approach: 提出DyLaR框架：1）将查询ground到短感知潜在块（连续隐状态，编码查询相关视觉证据）；2）自适应决定是否追加推理潜在（在隐空间对证据进行推理）；3）训练流程：用验证的视觉证据ground感知潜在，蒸馏验证的推理链到推理潜在，再用RL优化推理时机的决策。
summary.experiments: 在9个视频benchmark、4个多模态LLM骨干上进行实验，平均准确率优于基线（摘要截断，具体提升幅度未披露）。
summary.authors_note: 作者含Vicente Ordonez（多模态领域知名研究者），所属机构含莱斯大学。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing video QA methods over-rely on long textual Chain-of-Thought reasoning, while many questions can be answered immediately after localizing relevant visual evidence, leading to redundant reasoning and low efficiency.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: a dynamic latent reasoning framework following the 'perception before reasoning' paradigm, reducing unnecessary textual CoT while balancing accuracy and efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes DyLaR: 1) grounds queries into short perception latent blocks (continuous hidden states encoding query-relevant visual evidence); 2) adaptively decides whether to append reasoning latents for latent-space evidence reasoning; 3) training pipeline: grounds perception latents with verified visual evidence, distills verified rationales into reasoning latents, then refines reasoning timing via RL.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 9 video benchmarks with 4 multimodal LLM backbones, achieving higher average accuracy than baselines (abstract truncated, exact improvement margins not disclosed).
summary_en.authors_note: Includes Vicente Ordonez, a well-known researcher in multimodal learning, affiliated with Rice University.

recommendation.zh: 多模态中动态切换感知/推理阶段的思路对统一预训练的潜在推理设计有参考，仅看方法框架即可。
recommendation.en: Dynamic perception-reasoning switching in multimodal models informs latent reasoning design for unified pretraining; only review the method framework.

paper.title: DocTrace: Towards Traceable Long Document VQA via Hierarchical Evidence Graph Reasoning
paper.abstract: Long Document Visual Question Answering (LongDocVQA) requires Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to locate, integrate, and reason over heterogeneous document elements distributed across multiple pages. Existing approaches, including end-to-end MLLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and document agents, often lack explicit mechanisms to represent and verify how grounded evidence is progressively composed during reasoning, limiting both answer accuracy and traceability. In th

summary.core_problem: 现有长文档VQA方法缺乏显式的证据组合表示与验证机制，导致答案准确率低、推理过程不可追溯
summary.importance: 将长文档VQA建模为显式证据图推理问题（范式创新），同时给出可训练的分层框架与配套两阶段训练方案
summary.technical_approach: 提出DocTrace分层框架，依次执行证据定位、结构化文档解析、证据图推理，实现证据来源可追溯；采用两阶段训练：联合SFT初始化证据定位与图推理能力，第二阶段优化推理一致性
summary.experiments: 未披露具体模型规模与训练数据量，核心实验验证了显式证据图建模可同时提升长文档VQA的答案准确率与推理可追溯性

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LongDocVQA methods lack explicit mechanisms to represent and verify grounded evidence composition, leading to low answer accuracy and untraceable reasoning processes
summary_en.importance: Formulates LongDocVQA as explicit evidence graph reasoning (paradigm innovation) and proposes a trainable hierarchical framework with a matching two-stage training pipeline
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes DocTrace, a hierarchical framework that sequentially performs evidence localization, structured document parsing, and evidence graph reasoning for traceable evidence provenance; uses two-stage training: joint SFT initializes evidence localization and graph reasoning, followed by consistency optimization in the second stage
summary_en.experiments: No specific model scale or training data size disclosed; core experiments validate that explicit evidence graph modeling improves both answer accuracy and reasoning traceability for LongDocVQA

recommendation.zh: 显式证据图建模的思路可用于多模态后训练的推理监督设计，仅需关注§3的训练目标定义部分
recommendation.en: Explicit evidence graph modeling can inform multi-modal post-training reasoning supervision; only check §3 for training objective definition

paper.title: Failure-Informed Image Self-Augmentation for Multimodal Large Language Model Self-Improvement
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable performance across vision-language tasks, but their progress depends heavily on large-scale, high-quality multimodal data that are costly to annotate. Self-augmentation offers a promising alternative by enabling models to expand their own training data without external supervision. However, existing MLLM self-augmentation methods are largely text-centric, while image augmentation remains underexplored and typically relies on gener

summary.core_problem: 解决 MLLM 自我改进时图像侧数据增强不足的问题：现有方法多在文本上自增强，图像增强通常与模型真实失败模式不匹配。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态自训练数据构造方法。它不是基座预训练核心 recipe，但对多模态后训练、数据闭环和 failure-driven data generation 有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Failure-informed Image Self-Augmentation，先从模型自身失败样本中生成视觉上更难但答案不变的图像扰动，再通过 self-examination 验证样本效用，并用 dual fidelity filtering 降低语义扭曲风险。方法重点不是通用随机增强，而是让增强方向对齐模型暴露出的 incapability。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明在视觉问答类任务上实验，比较了 failure-informed 图像增强与既有 MLLM 自增强或通用图像变换方案；具体模型规模、训练数据量、baseline 名称和提升幅度未在给定摘要中披露。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the lack of image-side self-augmentation for MLLM self-improvement, where existing methods are mostly text-centric and generic image transforms are poorly aligned with model failures.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a multimodal self-training data construction method. It is not a core base-pretraining recipe, but it is relevant to multimodal post-training, data feedback loops, and failure-driven data generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Failure-informed Image Self-Augmentation starts from the model's own failure cases, generates visually challenging but answer-preserving image complications, validates their usefulness through self-examination, and applies dual fidelity filtering to avoid semantic drift. The key design is to align augmentation with observed incapabilities rather than handcrafted generic transforms.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports experiments on visual question answering-style tasks and compares failure-informed image augmentation against prior MLLM self-augmentation or generic image transforms. The provided abstract does not specify model sizes, training data volume, baseline list, or exact gains.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和过滤策略即可；思路像 data engine 的小闭环，效果若无干净消融别过度外推。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and filtering rules; it is a small data-engine loop, but do not extrapolate without clean ablations.

paper.title: Enhancing VLM Reward Models Through Structure-Aware Fine-Tuning
paper.abstract: Designing effective reward functions remains a major bottleneck in Reinforcement Learning (RL). Recent work uses large foundation Vision-Language Models (VLMs) as reward models, computing text-observation similarity to bypass manual reward engineering. Although promising, these rewards are often noisy and unreliable, limiting their direct utility during deployment. We present Structure-Aware Fine-Tuning (SAFT), a simple, self-supervised method that refines these imperfect reward signals online w

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 VLM 作为视觉奖励模型时奖励信号不稳定的问题。现有方法常用图像-文本 embedding 的余弦相似度作为 dense reward，但这类 reward 容易受视觉扰动、状态别名和细粒度场景理解不足影响，导致 RL 训练中的奖励地形噪声较大。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的直接贡献有限，更接近 post-train / RL reward modeling 的方法论文。它的启发点在于：不一定要依赖人工偏好或真实奖励标签来修正 reward model，可以把任务结构作为训练信号，在线约束 VLM 表征空间。这对研究多模态 reward model、RLHF 信号质量、以及 VLM 作为环境反馈接口有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Structure-Aware Fine-Tuning，核心是在在线 RL 过程中用 LoRA 适配器微调 VLM reward model，而不是全量更新基础 VLM。原始 reward 来自视觉观察 embedding 与文本目标 embedding 的余弦相似度。SAFT 在此基础上加入任务内在结构约束，用 augmentation 和辅助损失正则化 VLM latent space，使相似状态、等价变换后的状态、以及符合任务进展关系的状态在 reward 表征上更一致。论文提到两个实例化机制 CAL 和 RLR，重点不是引入新的监督标签，而是用环境结构本身去降低 VLM reward 的噪声。相比 preference-based RL，它减少了人工比较标注；相比直接使用 frozen VLM，它能在任务分布上修正 reward landscape。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖两个标准控制 benchmark 和两个高维机器人操作任务，并测试不同能力级别的基础 VLM。结果显示，SAFT 相比未微调的 VLM reward 能提升 policy sample efficiency，加快收敛，并让部分较小 VLM 在原本无法解决的任务上取得有效学习。论文还用 preference-based learning 设定评估人工标注需求，显示结构约束可以减少对 human labeling 的依赖。另一个关键结果是 SAFT 后的 reward prediction 与 ground-truth reward 更一致，说明收益不只是 policy optimization 的偶然改善，也来自 reward model 本身的去噪。提供的内容未包含具体分数、环境名称、模型参数量和提升百分比，精读时需要回到实验表格确认这些数字。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 15 分钟。重点看三个部分：第一，SAFT 的 loss 定义和 CAL / RLR 的具体构造，判断结构先验是否依赖任务手工设计；第二，online fine-tuning 的训练流程，尤其是 LoRA 更新频率、是否会引入 reward hacking、是否冻结 text encoder；第三，reward-ground truth alignment 的实验，比单纯 policy return 更能说明 reward model 是否真的变好。若只关心 LLM 预训练，可以跳过多数 RL benchmark 细节，保留它关于“弱监督 reward 信号如何被结构先验修正”的思路。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the instability of VLM-derived rewards in reinforcement learning. A common setup uses the cosine similarity between an observation embedding and a text-goal embedding as a dense reward, but this signal is often noisy, brittle under visual changes, and poorly aligned with fine-grained task progress.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining paper. Its relevance is mainly through the pretrain-posttrain interface: it studies how a pretrained multimodal model can be adapted into a usable reward model without dense human labels. The useful idea is that reward-model correction does not have to come only from preferences or ground-truth rewards; task structure can also provide a training signal for denoising latent representations.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method, Structure-Aware Fine-Tuning, adapts the VLM reward model online using LoRA adapters. The base reward is the image-text cosine similarity between the current observation and the goal description. SAFT adds auxiliary structure-aware objectives, implemented through augmentations and losses such as CAL and RLR, to regularize the VLM latent space. The goal is to make reward predictions consistent under task-preserving transformations and more faithful to the environment’s structural relations. Compared with frozen VLM rewards, it adapts the embedding space to the task distribution. Compared with preference-based RL, it reduces the need for human comparison labels.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans two standard control benchmarks and two high-dimensional robotic manipulation tasks, with several base VLM capability levels. SAFT improves sample efficiency, speeds up policy convergence, and enables smaller VLMs to solve tasks that were difficult for frozen baselines. The paper also evaluates a preference-learning setting and reports reduced human labeling needs. A separate reward-alignment analysis shows that the fine-tuned rewards become closer to ground-truth rewards, suggesting that the gains are not only due to downstream policy optimization. The provided text does not expose the exact scores, model sizes, or percentage gains, so those numbers should be checked in the experimental tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 15 minutes. Focus on the SAFT objective, especially how CAL and RLR encode task structure and whether these priors are generic or task-specific. Then inspect the online fine-tuning loop: LoRA placement, update frequency, frozen versus trainable encoders, and safeguards against reward drift. The reward-ground-truth alignment results are more informative than policy return alone. Readers focused on foundation-model training can skip most environment-specific RL details and keep the method as an example of structure-supervised reward-model adaptation.

recommendation.zh: 重点看§3的SAFT潜空间正则设计，思路可迁移到多模态对齐预训练的稳定正则项设计中。
recommendation.en: Focus on the SAFT latent space regularization design in §3 — the idea is transferable to stabilizing regularizers for multimodal alignment pretraining.

paper.title: In-Context Collapse in Vision-Language Models and How to Mitigate it?
paper.abstract: Many-shot in-context learning (ICL) lets vision-language models (VLMs) adapt from image--label demonstrations without weight updates, and is widely assumed to improve as more demonstrations are supplied. We show the opposite: as demonstrations accumulate, a subset of VLMs undergo an \emph{in-context collapse}, a sharp, sometimes catastrophic accuracy drop spanning synthetic classification, natural-image classification, and VQA benchmarks, in some models falling below chance while outputs remain

summary.core_problem: 视觉语言模型在多示例上下文学习时，示例数量增加并不会带来性能单调提升，反而会出现准确率骤降甚至低于随机猜测的上下文崩溃现象，现有研究未定位其底层机制，也未提出通用修复方案。
summary.importance: 揭示了VLM多模态ICL的一个关键失效模式，通过因果实验将问题锁定在视觉-语言连接通路而非语言模型深层，给出的轻量化、可迁移修复方案对多模态预训练阶段的视觉-语言连接器设计、训练目标设计有明确启发，解释了长期以来VLM长上下文多示例适配效果远差于纯文本LLM的原因。
summary.technical_approach: 首先通过无预训练污染的合成概念任务（答案无法从预训练记忆中检索，必须从上下文学习），将VLM的ICL能力拆分为两个可分离的维度：对示例数量增加的鲁棒性、从上下文中学习新规则的能力。之后通过参数匹配的损伤-救援实验，因果定位崩溃来源为视觉-语言集成通路（连接器和语言模型早中层），而非后期读出层。最后提出CircA方法，仅需在一个合成任务上一次性训练一个小型适配模块，即可将崩溃抗性迁移到未见的任务族，无需针对下游任务微调。
summary.experiments: 在0.5B到11B参数规模的多个开源VLM（覆盖不同连接器设计）以及闭源前沿模型Claude Sonnet上均观测到上下文崩溃现象：例如Qwen2-VL-2B在CIFAR四分类任务上0样本准确率为94%，64个示例时准确率降至38%；LLaVA-OneVision-0.5B在相同设置下准确率降至低于25%的随机猜测水平。提出的CircA适配模块可以消除崩溃现象，同时恢复模型从上下文学习新规则的能力，效果可跨任务族迁移。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注上下文崩溃的现象刻画、因果定位的损伤-救援实验逻辑，无需细读修复方法的实现细节。预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Unlike text LLMs where in-context learning (ICL) performance generally improves with more demonstrations, vision-language models often suffer sharp, sometimes catastrophic accuracy drops as in-context examples accumulate, even falling below random chance. Prior work has not localized the underlying mechanism or proposed a general mitigation for this phenomenon, termed in-context collapse.
summary_en.importance: This work identifies a critical failure mode of multimodal ICL in VLMs, and causally localizes the issue to the vision-language integration pathway rather than deep language model layers. The proposed lightweight, transferable mitigation provides clear insights for VLM pretraining, particularly for vision-language connector design and training objective design, and explains the persistent performance gap between VLMs and pure text LLMs on many-shot in-context adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach: First, the authors decompose VLM ICL capability into two separable axes using contamination-free synthetic concept tasks (where answers cannot be retrieved from pretraining memory and must be learned from context): robustness to increasing demonstration count, and ability to learn novel rules from in-context examples. Second, parameter-matched lesion-and-rescue experiments causally locate in-context collapse to the vision-language integration pathway (the connector and early/mid layers of the language model), rather than late readout layers. Third, they propose CircA, a method that trains a small adapter once on a single synthetic task that transfers collapse resistance to unseen task families without downstream fine-tuning.
summary_en.experiments: In-context collapse is observed across open VLMs ranging from 0.5B to 11B parameters with varying connector designs, as well as the frontier closed model Claude Sonnet. For example, Qwen2-VL-2B achieves 94% accuracy on 4-way CIFAR classification with zero demonstrations, but accuracy drops to 38% at 64 shots; LLaVA-OneVision-0.5B drops below the 25% random chance baseline under the same setting. The CircA adapter eliminates collapse and restores in-context novel rule learning, with benefits transferring across unseen task families.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the paper, focusing on the behavioral characterization of in-context collapse and the causal lesion-and-rescue experimental design for failure localization. There is no need to dive into implementation details of the mitigation. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看崩溃曲线和 lesion-rescue 实验；它提醒 connector 不是小头，many-shot VLM ICL 不能按文本 ICL 直觉外推。
recommendation.en: Read the collapse curves and lesion-rescue setup; it is a useful warning that VLM connectors are not a minor detail and text-ICL priors do not transfer cleanly.

paper.title: Attention is Case-Sensitive
paper.abstract: In human visual perception, uppercase lettering serves as a natural salience cue that captures attention within lowercase text. In this paper, we present a systematic empirical characterization study revealing that Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit an analogous property: letter casing modulates internal attention allocation. Through analysis across 13 models, nine LLMs and four Vision-Language Models (VLMs), with diverse tokenization schemes, we show that formatting target information in alte

summary.core_problem: 字母大小写差异通常被视为tokenizer的被动附带产物，此前没有系统研究预训练Transformer（包括LLM和VLM）中是否存在类似人类视觉感知的、由大小写调节内部注意力分配的效应，以及该效应的边界条件。
summary.importance: 揭示了预训练过程中Transformer会将排版大小写内隐学习为一种潜在的注意力优先级信号，而非无关紧要的tokenization细节。这一发现有助于理解预训练数据中的表层排版特征如何塑造模型内部行为，为注意力操控、模型可解释性研究提供了新的切入角度。推理模型与非推理模型的效应差异也为理解推理过程的语义重对齐功能提供了实证依据。
summary.technical_approach: 研究采用完全训练无关的实验范式，仅在tokenization之前修改输入文本的大小写，严格保持词序和语义不变。实验设计将目标span（标注的正确答案span或对应图像区域的文本描述）设置为大写或交替大小写、周围上下文保持小写，同时设置反向干预（上下文大写、目标小写）用于因果验证。评估覆盖13个模型：9个LLM（7个非推理、2个推理）和4个VLM（2个非推理、2个推理），涵盖不同规模和tokenizer类型。测量指标包括目标span上的跨层注意力集中度变化，以及下游任务性能的变化。核心贡献是系统刻画了此前未被充分研究的“大小写显著性”效应，以及发现推理模型的审慎推理过程会过滤这类表层排版信号。
summary.experiments: 大小写显著性效应在所有被测非推理LLM中普遍存在：格式化为大写或交替大小写的目标span，跨层注意力集中度显著提升。该效应延伸到VLM场景：将文本描述中的目标词改为大写，会使图像注意力向对应视觉区域偏移。反向干预实验中，大写上下文中的小写目标注意力下降，验证了大小写变化的因果作用。注意力集中度提升并不总能改善下游性能，根据任务上下文不同可能带来提升也可能造成下降。推理模型在文本任务中的大小写效应明显减弱，因为其审慎推理过程会进行语义重对齐，优先保证逻辑一致性而非遵循表层排版信号。所有实验仅通过prompt层面的大小写修改实现，未进行微调、添加适配器或运行时模型内部探测。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读引言中的问题提出、方法论部分的控制变量设计（如何排除语义混淆因素），以及推理模型与非推理模型的对比结果。无需深挖数学细节，预计阅读时间20-30分钟。从事可解释性或注意力操控研究的读者可额外关注因果分析的实验设计。

summary_en.core_problem: Letter case variation is conventionally treated as a passive artifact of tokenization. There is no systematic characterization of whether typographic case modulates internal attention allocation in pretrained LLMs and VLMs — analogous to the case-based salience effect observed in human visual perception — nor of the boundary conditions of such an effect.
summary_en.importance: The findings demonstrate that pretrained transformers implicitly internalize typographic case as a latent attention priority signal during pretraining, rather than it being a trivial tokenization quirk. This informs understanding of how surface-level formatting features in pretraining data shape model internal behavior, and provides a new angle for attention steering and interpretability research. The observed difference between reasoning and non-reasoning models also offers empirical evidence for the semantic realignment function of deliberative reasoning processes.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study uses an entirely training-free experimental paradigm: it modifies only the letter case of input text before tokenization, while strictly preserving word order and semantic content. The experimental design formats target spans (ground-truth answer spans or text descriptions corresponding to image regions) in uppercase or alternating case against a lowercase context, and runs reverse interventions (uppercase context, lowercase targets) for causal validation. The evaluation covers 13 models: 9 LLMs (7 non-reasoning, 2 reasoning) and 4 VLMs (2 non-reasoning, 2 reasoning) across different scales and tokenizer types. Measured outcomes include changes in cross-layer attention concentration on target spans, as well as downstream task performance shifts. Core contributions include systematic characterization of the under-explored "casing-salience" effect, and the finding that deliberative reasoning processes in reasoning models filter out such surface-level typographic cues.
summary_en.experiments: The casing-salience effect is universal across all evaluated non-reasoning LLMs: target spans formatted in uppercase or alternating case show significantly higher cross-layer attention concentration. The effect extends to VLMs: uppercasing target words in text descriptions shifts image attention toward corresponding visual regions. Reverse intervention experiments reduce attention on lowercase targets embedded in uppercase context, confirming the causal role of case variation. Increased attention concentration does not consistently improve downstream performance — it can lead to both gains and degradations depending on task context. Reasoning models show weakened casing effects in text tasks, as their deliberative reasoning process performs semantic realignment that prioritizes logical coherence over surface typographic signals. All experiments use only prompt-level case modification, with no fine-tuning, adapters, or runtime model introspection.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the problem framing in the introduction, the controlled variable design in the methodology (how semantic confounders are excluded), and the comparison results between reasoning and non-reasoning models. No deep dive into mathematical details is needed; estimated reading time is 20–30 minutes. Researchers working on interpretability or attention steering may pay extra attention to the causal analysis experiment design.

recommendation.zh: 这篇改变的是对“格式噪声无害”的默认假设；先看 attention-performance divergence 的图。
recommendation.en: This weakens the default assumption that casing is harmless formatting noise; start with the attention-performance divergence plots.

paper.title: GUI-Lens: Coarse-to-Fine Cropping for GUI Grounding with General-Purpose VLMs
paper.abstract: GUI grounding maps natural-language instructions to click locations and is essential for reliable GUI agents. The task remains difficult on high-resolution, densely populated interfaces because a vision-language model (VLM) may recognize a requested control without locating it precisely enough for interaction. Most existing methods provide various forms of localization assistance, but still rely on a direct click prediction, allowing visual ambiguity or an inaccurate initial estimate to propagat

summary.core_problem: 解决通用 VLM 在高分辨率、密集 GUI 界面上能看懂控件但点不准的问题。
summary.importance: 这属于 GUI agent 感知-定位链路的方法改进，不是预训练工作，但对“主动视觉观察 + 多步决策”式 agent 设计有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 GUI-Lens 的 coarse-to-fine grounding 框架：先抽取 OCR 文本和 UI 组件及其坐标作为参考，再让通用 VLM 迭代选择下一步裁剪区域与缩放尺度，通过多轮局部放大逐步逼近最终点击位置，而不是一次性直接回归坐标。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模，但核心实验应是在 GUI grounding 基准上，对比直接点击预测和带定位辅助的方法，验证多步裁剪观察能提升高分辨率界面的定位精度与鲁棒性。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles the failure mode where general-purpose VLMs can recognize a GUI target but cannot localize it precisely enough to click on dense high-resolution interfaces.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-side perception/localization improvement rather than a pretraining paper, but it is still relevant for active visual observation and iterative decision-making in GUI agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: GUI-Lens introduces a coarse-to-fine grounding loop: OCR text and detected UI elements are exposed as coordinate references, and the VLM repeatedly chooses the next crop region and zoom level, refining the view before making the final click instead of predicting coordinates in one shot.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, but the key evaluation is likely on GUI grounding benchmarks against direct-click baselines and localization-assisted methods, showing gains from iterative crop-and-zoom reasoning.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但把“先找区域再精定位”做成了可执行闭环；只看方法图和主表，判断这类主动观察是否该进 GUI agent 基座。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the coarse-to-fine observation loop is a clean design pattern; read the method figure and main table to decide whether active zooming belongs in your GUI-agent stack.

paper.title: It's the Decoding Format, Not the Perturbation: Auditing Consistency-Based Selection for Vision-Language Test-Time Scaling
paper.abstract: Test-time scaling lifts large language model reasoning by sampling many candidate solutions and selecting among them, yet the same recipe transfers poorly to vision-language models (VLMs): recent work shows that simple majority voting beats selection methods built on the model's own self-verification, apparently because at the selection layer an image-grounded answer and a confident guess from the language prior look the same. A natural fix is to make the selection signal one that cannot be comp

summary.core_problem: 研究 VLM test-time scaling 中，基于一致性的候选答案选择到底受益于图像扰动，还是受益于解码格式本身的改变。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是方法审计和负结果分析。它针对 VLM 上“采样多个候选再选择”的迁移失败问题，检查 perturbation-grounded selection 这类无训练选择规则是否真正提供了图像依赖信号。
summary.technical_approach: 论文考察 Perturbation Grounded Selection：对输入图像做保持标签不变的裁剪、背景遮罩、轻微光照或几何扰动，让模型在扰动图像上重新推导候选答案，并用重现一致性打分；同时控制 decoding format，区分扰动项和输出格式带来的收益。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、数据集、提升幅度。实验重点应是比较 chain-of-thought majority voting、自验证选择、空扰动退化到多数投票的 PGS，以及加入扰动后的 PGS，在不同解码格式下的表现差异。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether consistency-based selection for VLM test-time scaling gains from image perturbations, or merely from changes in the decoding format.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an audit-style analysis rather than a new training method. It probes why sample-and-select recipes that work for LLM reasoning transfer poorly to VLMs, especially when self-verification cannot distinguish grounded answers from confident language-prior guesses.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study evaluates Perturbation Grounded Selection, a training-free rule that perturbs the input image with label-preserving crops, masks, and mild photometric or geometric jitter, then scores candidates by whether the model re-derives them. The key control is to isolate the perturbation term from the decoding-format effect.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, datasets, or numerical gains. The relevant comparisons are expected to include chain-of-thought majority voting, self-verification selection, PGS with an empty perturbation set, and PGS with actual image perturbations under controlled decoding formats.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验控制部分即可；若结论成立，VLM TTS 里不少“grounding trick”可能只是格式偏置。
recommendation.en: Read only the controlled ablations; if the claim holds, several VLM grounding tricks may just be decoding-format bias.

paper.title: Recompute or Reuse? Diagnosing and Mitigating Textual Shortcuts in VLM Self-Reflection
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are expected to revise their reasoning when visual evidence changes. Failures to do so are often attributed to insufficient visual attention or contextual inertia, leaving unclear what models reuse instead of recomputing from the current image. We show that evidence-bearing reasoning in a prior chain of thought (CoT) can form a textual shortcut that competes behaviorally with visual recomputation. Across 16 VLMs, a matched counterfactual analysis identifies evidence

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究 VLM 在视觉状态改变后的自我反思失败：模型没有重新读取当前图像时，究竟复用了什么信息。核心结论是，旧 CoT 中承载视觉证据的文本片段会形成“textual shortcut”，与当前图像的重新计算竞争。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在 multimodal reasoning 的训练信号质量。论文说明，CoT 不只是推理轨迹，也可能把旧视觉状态离散化成可复用文本证据。只用最终答案是否修正来评估视觉更新是不够的，因为模型可能仍保留旧证据的分数偏置。对 VLM 预训练、SFT、反思式数据构造都有提醒：如果训练中大量暴露带证据描述的历史 CoT，模型可能学会优先走文本捷径，而不是重新绑定当前视觉输入。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是一个 matched counterfactual 框架。每个样本包含当前图像 I、问题 Q、正确答案 y，以及结构相近但关键视觉证据不同的反事实图像 I- 和答案 y-。先让被测模型在 I- 上生成一个支持 y- 的旧 CoT R-，再把当前图像 I、同一问题 Q 和旧 CoT 放入反思上下文，观察模型是否被旧推理牵引。论文进一步做受控删除：删除旧 CoT 中 evidence-bearing content、删除等长非证据文本、删除最终答案 span，并比较答案偏移。这样可以区分三类影响：上下文长度、答案锚定、以及旧视觉证据文本本身。还测试了 evidence 顺序打乱，说明文本证据的组织结构也会影响捷径被复用的程度。干预方法 FSAF 不是 prompt 提醒，而是在注意力层面阻断新一轮计算访问旧 CoT，使当前计算不能直接 attend 到旧推理轨迹。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 16 个 VLM。数据使用 800 个经人工检查的 VS-Bench paired counterfactual 样本，来源包括 MathVista-MINI、MathVerse-MINI、MathVision 和 MMMU-Pro。样本筛选要求模型在反事实图像上能得到 y-，且在无历史条件下对当前图像能得到 y，因此测到的是旧 CoT 的干扰，而不是任务本身不可解。主要发现是：删除旧 CoT 中承载证据的内容，比删除等长非证据文本或最终答案片段更能改变答案偏好；这种 content-specific effect 在 16 个模型上均为正，并且随着删除更多旧证据而增强。即使模型给出了当前正确答案，在后续 matched support withdrawal 下仍比 history-free control 更容易回到旧答案，说明答案修正不等于证据状态更新。FSAF 在 5 个 Qwen VLM 上将 visual update rate 从 35.28% 提升到 53.61%，将 prior-answer rate 从 39.22% 降到 3.67%。prompt-only 版本没有稳定提升，支持“控制旧推理访问”比“要求模型重新看图”更关键。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。重点看 Controlled Evaluation of Prior-CoT Influence 中的任务构造、eligibility 条件和 deletion controls，这部分决定实验是否真的隔离了文本捷径。结果部分优先看 evidence removal、final-answer removal、order disruption 的对比图表。FSAF 部分适合关注 attention mask 具体怎么施加，以及是否影响正常上下文利用。对做 VLM pretrain 或 multimodal CoT 数据的人，最值得深挖的是“evidence-bearing CoT 会不会成为训练时的错误归因路径”：模型可能学到从文本证据恢复答案，而不是从图像重新抽取证据。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks what a VLM reuses when it fails to update its reasoning after the visual evidence changes. The central finding is that evidence-bearing spans in a previous CoT can act as a textual shortcut, competing with recomputation from the current image.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to foundation-model research is in multimodal reasoning supervision. CoT traces are not neutral explanations; they can serialize visual observations into text and make stale evidence easier to reuse than fresh visual evidence. This matters for VLM pretraining and post-training pipelines that rely on reflective reasoning, self-correction, or multimodal CoT data. A corrected final answer is not a reliable certificate that the model has refreshed its visual state.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study uses a matched counterfactual setup. Each example contains a current image-question-answer triple and a structurally similar counterfactual image with a different answer. The model first produces a coherent prior CoT on the counterfactual image. The same model is then asked to reflect under the current image while the stale CoT remains in context. The analysis compares this prior-conditioned path with a history-free direct path. Controlled removals separate three effects: removing evidence-bearing spans, removing length-matched non-evidence spans, and removing the final-answer span. The paper also perturbs evidence order to test whether the organization of the stale reasoning path affects reuse. The proposed intervention, Fresh-State Attention Firewall, blocks fresh computation from attending to the prior CoT instead of merely prompting the model to inspect the image again.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers 16 VLMs and 800 human-checked VS-Bench counterfactual pairs drawn from MathVista-MINI, MathVerse-MINI, MathVision, and MMMU-Pro. Eligibility requires the model to answer the counterfactual image correctly and to answer the current image correctly without history, so the measured effect is prior-CoT interference rather than base task failure. Removing evidence-bearing content shifts answer preference more than removing length-matched non-evidence context or the final-answer span. The content-specific effect is positive for all 16 models and grows as more stale evidence is removed. Even when a model recovers the current answer, matched support withdrawal reveals residual dependence on the old reasoning path. On five Qwen VLMs, FSAF improves visual update rate from 35.28% to 53.61% and reduces prior-answer rate from 39.22% to 3.67%. A prompt-only variant does not provide a reliable update gain.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 25–35 minutes. Focus on the matched counterfactual construction, the eligibility filter, and the deletion controls, since these determine whether the shortcut effect is well isolated. The most useful result tables or figures are those comparing evidence removal, non-evidence removal, final-answer removal, and evidence-order disruption. The FSAF section is worth checking for the exact attention restriction and whether it sacrifices useful context. For VLM pretraining work, the key question to carry forward is whether multimodal CoT supervision encourages models to recover answers from textualized evidence rather than bind reasoning to the current visual input.

recommendation.zh: 这不是预训练论文，但把“反思失败”从注意力问题改写成文本捷径竞争问题，值得看干预设计；只读 counterfactual setup 和证据删除结果就够了。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it reframes reflection failure from weak visual attention to textual-shortcut competition; read the counterfactual setup and evidence-ablation results, not the whole story.

paper.title: Distill What the Student Can See: Fisher-Projected On-Policy Distillation for Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) samples trajectories from the current student policy and minimizes token-level divergence between student and teacher next-token distributions at prefixes along those trajectories. This aligns the distillation states with the student's own generation distribution. However, it still assumes that the complete teacher distribution is an appropriate target across student capacities. In vision--language reasoning, teacher corrections can depend on visual distinctions that

summary.core_problem: FP-OPD 解决的是 VLM on-policy distillation 中“状态对齐了，但目标不一定适合学生模型”的问题。OPD 用学生自己生成的轨迹做蒸馏，缓解了训练前缀与推理前缀不一致。但在视觉语言推理中，大教师的 token 分布可能依赖学生无法表征的视觉证据。直接让小学生匹配完整教师分布，可能要求它学习超出自身视觉表示能力的修正。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练和中后期训练的启发在于：教师信号不是越完整越好，训练目标需要匹配学生模型当前可表达的局部几何。这个结论适用于 VLM 蒸馏，也可能影响小模型继续预训练、multimodal mid-training、以及用强模型生成监督信号的流程。它提供了一个比简单调低 KL 权重更细的方案：不是整体削弱教师，而是保留学生能通过自身视觉通路表达的那部分修正。
summary.technical_approach: 方法沿用 OPD 的 on-policy 轨迹：学生先生成回答轨迹，教师和学生都在这些学生访问过的 prefix 上输出 full-vocabulary 分布。标准 OPD 直接最小化学生分布到教师分布的 token-level reverse KL。FP-OPD 改动的是 target，而不是训练轨迹或损失形式。它先把教师监督表示为相对于学生 log-probability 的 correction，然后用 detached perturbation probes 估计学生当前的局部视觉响应空间。KL 在局部诱导 Fisher metric，因此方法在 Fisher 几何下把教师 correction 投影到学生可表达的视觉响应空间中，得到 reachable target q^R。训练时仍使用标准 full-vocabulary reverse KL，只是把完整教师分布替换成 q^R。与简单温度、label smoothing 或统一缩放 teacher target 不同，FP-OPD 会按学生局部表示能力选择性保留教师修正。
summary.experiments: 论文先做 target-scaling 诊断实验。对于 8B 教师到 2B 学生的设置，当插值强度 α=0.5 时，学生一个 epoch 后能消除 56.3% 的指定 KL gap；使用完整教师目标 α=1 时只消除 46.6%。同一中间目标还将 MathVista Geometry 从 55.29 提升到 57.03，说明完整教师分布更难拟合，并且未必带来更好的下游推理。主实验显示，在 8B-to-2B 蒸馏中，FP-OPD 在 7 个 benchmark 上均有提升，平均分相比 base student 提高 2.77 分，相比标准 OPD 提高 1.60 分。论文还报告了不同教师规模和教师变体下的稳定收益。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读约 25 到 35 分钟。先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，重点是 target interpolation 实验，它是整篇工作的动机支点。然后看 Method 和 Figure 2，理解 Fisher projection 如何从教师分布构造 q^R。公式部分不需要逐行推导，但要看清楚 correction、visual response space、Fisher metric 三者的关系。实验部分重点看 8B-to-2B 主结果、target scaling、projection ablation，以及不同教师变体的结果。

summary_en.core_problem: FP-OPD addresses a target mismatch in on-policy distillation for vision-language models. OPD samples trajectories from the current student, so supervision is applied at prefixes the student actually visits. However, sharing the same prefix does not guarantee that the complete teacher distribution is a suitable target. In VLM reasoning, teacher corrections may rely on visual evidence that a compact student cannot represent.
summary_en.importance: The main training lesson is that stronger teacher targets are not always better for smaller multimodal students. The useful signal is the part of the teacher correction that lies within the student’s current response geometry. This matters for VLM distillation, multimodal mid-training, and synthetic supervision pipelines where large models provide dense token-level targets. The paper offers a more structured alternative to simply reducing the KL weight or interpolating the teacher distribution uniformly.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method keeps the OPD protocol: the student rolls out an on-policy trajectory, and both student and teacher are evaluated on the resulting prefixes. Standard OPD minimizes a full-vocabulary token-level reverse KL to the complete teacher distribution. FP-OPD changes only the target. It represents the teacher signal as a correction to the student log-probabilities, estimates the student’s local visual response space using detached perturbation probes, and projects the teacher correction onto that space under the Fisher metric induced locally by KL. The projected correction defines a reachable target q^R, which replaces the full teacher distribution in the same reverse-KL loss. Unlike temperature scaling or uniform target weakening, the projection selectively keeps corrections that the student can express through its current visual pathway.
summary_en.experiments: A diagnostic target-scaling study shows the mismatch clearly. In an 8B-to-2B setting, a target interpolation strength of α=0.5 lets the student remove 56.3% of the prescribed KL gap after one epoch, while the complete teacher target at α=1 removes only 46.6%. The intermediate target also improves MathVista Geometry from 55.29 to 57.03. In the main experiments, FP-OPD improves all seven reported benchmarks for 8B-to-2B distillation, with an average gain of 2.77 points over the base student and 1.60 points over standard OPD. The paper also reports consistent gains across teacher scales and teacher variants.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 25 to 35 minutes. Read the introduction and Figure 1 first; the target interpolation experiment is the clearest evidence for the capacity-target mismatch. Then read the method figure and the projection derivation to understand how the reachable target q^R is constructed. The most informative experiments are the 8B-to-2B comparison, the target-scaling analysis, the projection ablations, and the teacher-variant results.

recommendation.zh: 这个 prior 值得改：蒸馏不该总追完整 teacher 分布；看 target-scaling 实验和投影定义。
recommendation.en: This changes a useful prior: distillation should not always chase the full teacher distribution; read the target-scaling study and projection definition.

paper.title: TRAM: Enhancing Multimodal Reasoning with Trajectory-Derived Auxiliary Memory
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Reasoning Models (MLRMs) have achieved strong performance on tasks requiring visual understanding and multi-step inference. However, as reasoning trajectories grow, models may become less effective at using information established earlier in the context, increasing the risk of reasoning errors. Existing approaches primarily address this problem by sustaining visual grounding throughout reasoning. However, reasoning also transforms visual observations into task-specific relations

summary.core_problem: 多模态大推理模型在长推理轨迹中，早期推导的任务特定关系、约束、中间结论的影响力会随轨迹长度增加而衰减；现有方法仅关注维持原始图像的视觉接地，未覆盖推理衍生信息的保留问题，且图像归因强度本身无法稳定区分正确与错误推理轨迹。
summary.importance: 明确了推理衍生信息整合不足（而非视觉接地减弱）是长程多模态推理错误的关键驱动因素，为多模态预训练的推理能力优化提供了新的靶点；提出的无训练记忆机制为推理时增强提供了轻量方案，也为预训练阶段引入推理记忆模块的架构设计提供了参考。
summary.technical_approach: TRAM（Trajectory-derived Auxiliary Memory）是一种无需训练的解码增强方法。推理过程中，已完成的推理步骤被在线压缩为紧凑的潜在记忆状态；记忆通过双时间尺度循环流更新：快流响应近期推理内容，慢流保留长程信息，平衡近期敏感度与长程保留能力；记忆通过轻量残差路径注入选定的解码器层，无需修改注意力机制、额外训练或外部验证器。
summary.experiments: 在4个多模态大推理模型变体（含Qwen3-VL-4B、InternVL3.5-4B）、8个覆盖数学、科学、通用视觉推理的基准上测试，TRAM的平均准确率优于原生解码。归因分析验证：正确轨迹对多阶段推理信息的整合范围更广，错误轨迹对累积推理信息的利用更有限，两类轨迹的图像归因强度无稳定差异。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注推理轨迹分析章节的归因实验设计与核心结论，以及方法章节的双时间尺度记忆更新机制，还有实验章节的跨模型泛化结果。预计阅读时间25-30分钟，核心是理解推理衍生信息衰减这一独立于视觉接地损失的问题定位。

summary_en.core_problem: As reasoning trajectories grow longer, multimodal large reasoning models (MLRMs) lose access to task-specific relations, constraints, and intermediate conclusions derived early in the reasoning process. Existing methods focus exclusively on sustaining grounding to the original input image, but image attribution strength does not consistently distinguish correct from incorrect reasoning trajectories.
summary_en.importance: Insufficient integration of reasoning-derived information, not weakened visual grounding, is identified as a key driver of long-horizon multimodal reasoning errors. This reframes the target for optimizing reasoning capabilities in multimodal pretraining, and the training-free memory mechanism informs architecture design of reasoning memory modules in pretrained models.
summary_en.technical_approach: TRAM (Trajectory-derived Auxiliary Memory) is a training-free decoding enhancement method. During reasoning, completed reasoning steps are consolidated online into a compact latent memory state. The memory is updated via two recurrent streams with different timescales: a fast stream responsive to recent reasoning, and a slow stream that retains information over longer horizons, balancing recent sensitivity and long-range retention. The memory is fed into selected decoder layers via a lightweight residual pathway, requiring no attention mechanism modifications, additional training, parameter updates, or external verifiers.
summary_en.experiments: Tested across four MLRM variants (including Qwen3-VL-4B and InternVL3.5-4B) and eight visual reasoning benchmarks covering mathematical, scientific, and general reasoning tasks, TRAM achieves higher average accuracy than vanilla decoding. Attribution analysis confirms that correct trajectories show broader integration of information across multiple reasoning stages, while incorrect trajectories have limited use of accumulated reasoning information, with no consistent difference in image attribution between the two groups.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the reasoning trajectory analysis section for attribution experiment design and core findings, the methods section for the dual-timescale memory update mechanism, and the experiments section for cross-model generalization results. Estimated reading time: 25-30 minutes. The core insight is the framing of reasoning-derived information decay as a distinct problem from visual grounding loss.

recommendation.zh: 多模态长推理的记忆设计有参考价值，重点看归因分析部分和辅助记忆通路的实现逻辑，无需复现
recommendation.en: The memory design for long multimodal reasoning is referenceable; focus on the attribution analysis and auxiliary memory pathway implementation, no reproduction required

paper.title: SpatioLM: Towards General Physical Spatial Intelligence in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) perform well on commonsense reasoning tasks but struggle with visual spatial reasoning. Most existing solutions introduce extra 3D prior inputs or external spatial encoders, which increase complexity and degrade the underlying VLMs' general-purpose capabilities after spatial fine-tuning. To this end, we propose a parameter-efficient \textit{\textbf{Spatio}-vision \textbf{L}anguage \textbf{M}odels (SpatioLM)}, that enhances spatial intelligence without extra 3D prior

summary.core_problem: 提升 VLM 的物理空间理解能力，同时避免引入额外 3D 输入、外部空间编码器，或破坏原模型的通用能力。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态模型适配方法。它关注 VLM 预训练模型中潜在空间知识能否被轻量模块激发，对 native multimodal pretraining 的空间表征缺口有参考意义，但不是基座预训练 recipe。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SpatioLM：一个 plug-and-play、non-invasive 的 spatio-vision module，用于从已有 VLM 中 elicitation 空间知识。训练信号使用 pseudo depth 和 camera information 作为监督，引导模型学习更符合物理约束的空间表征，而不是直接接入第三方 3D encoder。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在多类 spatial perception 和 spatial understanding 任务上有明显提升，并且限制了对原有通用 VLM 能力的退化。未给出模型参数、训练数据、baseline 名称或提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to improve physical spatial reasoning in VLMs without adding explicit 3D inputs, external spatial encoders, or degrading the base model’s general capabilities.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal adaptation method. It is relevant because it probes whether spatial knowledge already exists in VLMs and can be elicited with light supervision, but it is not a foundation pretraining recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: SpatioLM adds a plug-and-play, non-invasive spatio-vision module to an existing VLM. It uses pseudo depth and camera information as supervision to encourage physically coherent spatial representations, avoiding a separate 3D encoder.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports significant improvements across spatial perception and understanding tasks while limiting degradation of general-purpose VLM abilities. It does not provide model size, data scale, baseline names, or numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 只看伪深度/相机监督怎么不伤通用能力；这是 VLM 空间微调经验，不是预训练新信号。
recommendation.en: Read only how pseudo-depth and camera supervision avoid hurting general ability; this is VLM spatial tuning evidence, not a new pretraining signal.

paper.title: HAFI-VLM: A Frequency Perspective for Diagnosing and Enhancing Visual Perception in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) remain unreliable when predictions require fine-grained visual evidence. We identify a previously overlooked cause: spectral response rigidity. Despite substantial frequency variation across images and tasks, pretrained vision encoders exhibit persistent, encoder-specific layerwise spectral profiles that change only marginally under downstream fine-tuning.
