Existing methods create this asymmetry either through privileged answers or visual evidence. We ask whether both can be removed, yielding a simpler form of OPSD driven purely by input conditioning. For this purpose, we

summary.core_problem: 解决视觉自蒸馏中对外部教师、特权答案或额外视觉证据的依赖，尝试只靠输入条件差异构造有效的 on-policy 蒸馏信号。
summary.importance: 这是 VLM 训练信号设计上的方法创新。它不直接推进 LLM 预训练，但对“如何从同一模型内部构造更干净的学习信号”有一定启发，尤其适合关注自训练、自蒸馏和多模态对齐损失的人。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Visual Contrastive Self-Distillation（VCSD）。在每个 student 已生成前缀处，EMA teacher 在相同文本 prompt 和前缀下分别看到原图与内容擦除图，得到两个 next-token 分布；两者的 token 级 log-prob 差值被当作 instance-specific 的视觉贡献信号，用来指导 student 学习真正由图像内容支持的 token，而不是语言先验带来的 token。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据规模和数值结果。可确认的 baseline 包括现有 on-policy distillation / self-distillation 方法，以及依赖 privileged answers 或 visual evidence 的不对称设计。论文主张在不依赖这些额外信息的情况下仍能形成有效蒸馏信号，但需要正文结果来判断增益幅度和 setup 是否干净。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether visual self-distillation can work without an external teacher, privileged answers, or extra visual evidence, using only input-conditioned asymmetry.
summary_en.importance: This is a training-signal design contribution for VLMs. It is not central to LLM pretraining, but it is mildly relevant if you care about self-training, self-distillation, and cleaner multimodal supervision.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes Visual Contrastive Self-Distillation (VCSD). At each student-generated prefix, an EMA teacher produces two next-token distributions under the same prompt and prefix: one conditioned on the original image and one on a content-erased control image. The token-wise log-probability difference is used as a visual-content-specific learning signal, highlighting tokens whose likelihood is truly increased by the image rather than by language priors.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, dataset sizes, or concrete gains. The relevant baselines are prior on-policy distillation and self-distillation methods that rely on privileged answers or explicit visual evidence. The claimed benefit is that useful distillation remains possible without those extra asymmetries, but the magnitude and cleanliness of the setup need to be checked in the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 点子比结果更值得看：把“原图-擦除图”差分当蒸馏信号很干净，但离基座预训练较远，读方法和消融就够了。
recommendation.en: The idea is cleaner than the likely headline numbers: image-vs-erased-image contrast as a distillation signal is worth noting, but it's peripheral to core pretraining.

paper.title: 3D-Aware VLMs with Implicit and Explicit Geometries
paper.abstract: Despite rapid progress, most existing vision-language models (VLMs) built from 2D visual inputs often struggle when handling various 3D tasks that require fine-grained spatial understanding and reasoning. To bridge this gap, we present VLM-IE3D, a unified framework that enhances the 3D spatial awareness of VLMs by equipping them with both implicit and explicit 3D geometries learned from RGB videos. Our VLM-IE3D introduces Implicit Geometry Tokens (IGTs) that capture high-level geometric priors f

summary.core_problem: 解决 2D 输入 VLM 在需要精细空间理解和 3D 推理任务上表现不足的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是 VLM 视觉表示增强方法：在不额外输入真实 3D 数据的前提下，把从 RGB 视频学习到的隐式和显式几何信息注入 VLM；对视觉 tokenizer、几何先验和多模态对齐有间接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 VLM-IE3D，包含 Implicit Geometry Tokens 捕获高层几何先验，Explicit Geometry Tokens 编码由重建得到的细粒度 3D 属性，再用 3D-aware adapter 将两类几何表示与 2D visual cues 融合。方法更像 VLM adapter/representation augmentation，而不是端到端 native multimodal pretraining。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在多种 3D 空间理解与推理任务上取得优于现有方法的结果；未给出具体 VLM backbone、参数规模、训练数据量、benchmark 名称或提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the weakness of 2D-input VLMs on tasks requiring fine-grained spatial understanding and 3D reasoning.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a VLM representation enhancement method: injecting implicit and explicit geometry learned from RGB videos without requiring additional 3D inputs. It is indirectly relevant to visual tokenization, geometric priors, and multimodal alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: VLM-IE3D introduces Implicit Geometry Tokens for high-level geometric priors and Explicit Geometry Tokens for detailed reconstructed 3D attributes, then fuses them with 2D visual cues through a 3D-aware adapter. This is closer to adapter-based VLM augmentation than native multimodal pretraining.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims superior results across 3D spatial understanding and reasoning tasks, but does not provide the exact VLM backbone, parameter scale, training data size, benchmark names, or improvement margins.

recommendation.zh: 看 token 设计即可；这是 VLM 几何 adapter 增强，不会改变预训练范式，但能提醒视觉表示别只靠 2D patch。
recommendation.en: Skim the token design only; this is geometry-adapter augmentation, not a pretraining shift, but it usefully warns against relying only on 2D patches.

paper.title: Trace: A Taxonomy-Guided Environment for Multidomain Visual Reasoning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has substantially improved language-model reasoning, yet its extension to vision-language models remains constrained by the lack of training data that are simultaneously broad, exactly verifiable, and reproducible. We introduce Trace, a taxonomy-guided environment for multidomain visual reasoning. Trace factorizes task construction into a scene grammar and an executable task program, separating visual realization from answer computation. A sh

summary.core_problem: VLM的RLVR训练缺乏覆盖范围广、标注精确可验证、可复现的视觉推理训练数据，限制了可验证奖励强化学习在VLM推理能力提升上的落地效果。
summary.importance: 提出了面向多域视觉推理的过程化任务生成框架，通过解耦视觉渲染和答案计算逻辑，自动生成带精确验证器的大规模视觉推理样本，为VLM的RLVR训练提供了可复现的开源环境。
summary.technical_approach: 将视觉推理任务构建分解为场景语法和可执行任务程序两部分，分离视觉渲染过程与答案计算逻辑；通过共享语义状态同步生成渲染图像、文本提示、标准答案、验证器状态与可复现的实例轨迹；支持跨11个视觉域、277种场景语法的可控生成，可系统性调节语义和视觉变化幅度。
summary.experiments: 在6.4万条Trace生成的样本上对Qwen2.5-VL-3B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B进行RLVR训练，模型在24个外部视觉推理benchmark上的宏平均准确率分别提升3.51、4.06个百分点，验证了广覆盖过程化训练的跨环境迁移能力。

summary_en.core_problem: Extending reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) to vision-language models is bottlenecked by the lack of training data that is broad in coverage, exactly verifiable, and fully reproducible.
summary_en.importance: This work introduces a procedural multi-domain visual reasoning environment that decouples visual rendering from answer computation, enabling automatic generation of large-scale visual reasoning samples with precise verifiers, and provides a reproducible setup for VLM RLVR training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Task construction is factorized into a scene grammar module and an executable task program, separating visual realization from answer computation. A shared semantic state is used to jointly produce rendered images, text prompts, ground-truth answers, verifier states, and replayable instance traces. The environment spans 11 visual domains, 277 scene grammars, and 1000 tasks with controlled semantic and visual variation.
summary_en.experiments: RLVR training on 64,000 Trace instances improves macro-average accuracy across 24 external visual reasoning benchmarks by 3.51 points for Qwen2.5-VL-3B and 4.06 points for Qwen2.5-VL-7B, demonstrating transfer from procedurally generated broad-coverage visual tasks to out-of-domain benchmarks.

recommendation.zh: 将文本RLVR的程序化可验证数据生成思路迁移到视觉推理，无本质方法创新，了解迁移效果即可，无需深读。
recommendation.en: Transfers procedural verifiable data generation from textual RLVR to visual reasoning without fundamental novelty; knowing the transfer result is sufficient, no deep read needed.

paper.title: HPD-Parsing: Hierarchical Parallel Document Parsing
paper.abstract: Efficient teamwork typically combines global coordination with parallel execution, a principle not yet fully reflected in unified Vision-Language Model (VLM)-based document parsers. Existing unified parsers process an entire page jointly but generate its output through a single token-by-token autoregressive trajectory, creating a sequential bottleneck that grows with document length. Such full-page sequential generation overlooks a key property of document parsing: layout must be analyzed global

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 文档解析中的长序列自回归瓶颈：整页文档需要全局理解，但逐 token 生成所有内容会随文档长度线性拖慢。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理结构与解码效率改进。它不是基座预训练工作，但提出的“全局布局协调 + 块级并行生成”对长输出、多分支生成和文档 VLM serving 有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 HPD-Parsing，用 Hierarchical Parallel Decoding 替代整页单轨自回归生成。主 layout branch 负责组织页面结构，并动态派发 block-level content decoding 到多个并发分支；同时使用 progressive multi-token prediction 减少每个分支内部的解码步数。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在公开文档解析 benchmark 上验证，HPD-Parsing 相比 full-page autoregressive parser 能降低解码步数并提升解析效率，同时保持或改善解析效果；未给出具体数据集名称、模型规模和速度提升倍数。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the sequential decoding bottleneck in VLM-based document parsing: a page requires global layout understanding, but emitting all content through one token-by-token trajectory scales poorly with document length.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference and decoding-structure improvement. It is not a base pretraining paper, but the split between global layout coordination and parallel block-level generation is relevant to long-output VLM serving and structured generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: HPD-Parsing replaces full-page autoregressive generation with Hierarchical Parallel Decoding. A main layout branch organizes the page structure and dynamically dispatches block-level content decoding to concurrent branches; progressive multi-token prediction further reduces the number of decoding steps inside each branch.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports experiments on public document parsing benchmarks, showing improved parsing efficiency and reduced decoding steps relative to full-page autoregressive parsers, while maintaining or improving parsing quality. It does not provide dataset names, model sizes, or exact speedups.

recommendation.zh: 看图即可；它是文档解析工程，但 layout/blocks 解耦对长输出并行解码有一点可借鉴。
recommendation.en: A figure-level read is enough; it is document parsing engineering, but the layout/block split is a useful cue for parallel long-output decoding.

paper.title: LookME: Lookup-Based Multimodal Embeddings for Layer Injection in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved strong progress in multimodal understanding. However, scaling dense or sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models to improve performance limits deployment in resource-constrained environments due to the trade-off between high memory usage from full loading and increased latency from on-demand loading. Recently, the Per-Layer Embedding (PLE) architecture addresses this by scaling models with large external embedding tables stored in ROM and performing light

summary.core_problem: 把 Per-Layer Embedding（PLE）的查表式参数扩展从纯文本推广到多模态 VLM，缓解 MoE 扩容带来的显存/延迟矛盾。
summary.importance: 工程型架构扩展：用 ROM 存储大 embedding 表 + 按需查表替代全量加载 MoE，思路对边缘部署有参考。
summary.technical_approach: LookME：为 VLM 设计多模态 lookup-based embedding，支持分区存储和按需加载，在层注入时用查表增强 token 表示，适配视觉 token 而非仅文本 ID。
summary.experiments: 在 VLM 上对比 dense/sparse MoE 与 PLE 基线，报告显存、延迟与视觉任务精度权衡。

summary_en.core_problem: Extend Per-Layer Embedding (PLE) lookup-based parameter scaling from text-only to multimodal VLMs, mitigating the memory/latency trade-off of MoE scaling.
summary_en.importance: Engineering-oriented architecture extension: large ROM-resident embedding tables with on-demand lookup replace full MoE loading, relevant to edge deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: LookME: multimodal lookup-based embeddings for VLMs with partitioned storage and on-demand loading, injecting retrieved embeddings per layer to enhance token representations beyond text IDs.
summary_en.experiments: Compared against dense/sparse MoE and PLE baselines on VLMs, reporting memory, latency, and vision-task accuracy trade-offs.

recommendation.zh: 把 PLE 查表扩容搬到多模态，属部署侧工程增量；作为 ROM-based 参数化思路备查，不读正文。
recommendation.en: Extends PLE lookup-scaling to multimodal; an engineering-side deployment variant—file it as literature, skip the body.

paper.title: Seeing What Is Actually There: PriVE-Bench and PriVE-Tools for Counterfactual Evaluation of Agentic Visual Evidence in VLMs
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) often answer visual questions using learned language and category priors rather than grounding their predictions in the image itself. Counterfactual images provide a natural diagnostic setting for this failure mode: when visible evidence contradicts what is usually true, a grounded model should answer from the pixels, while a prior-following model will produce a canonical but visually incorrect response. However, existing counterfactual benchmarks mainly ask whether

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作关注的是 VLM 在“视觉证据”和“语言/类别先验”冲突时到底看不看图，进一步问的是：如果给模型更多 agentic 风格的视觉证据视角，比如框选、裁剪、放大、轮廓叠加，它会不会更愿意根据像素修正原本的先验性回答。核心问题不是再证明一次 VLM 有 prior-following，而是把这种失败模式放到一个可控的 counterfactual setting 里，检验额外证据视图是否真的能改善 grounding。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接相关性有限，因为它主要是评测资产而不是训练方法。但它对多模态预训练和 native VLM 研究仍有启发。第一，它把“看起来会答”与“是否真正依赖视觉证据”分开了，适合诊断图文对齐训练是否过度借助语言先验。第二，它提醒一个常见误区：给模型更多视觉工具或更多局部视图，不等于模型会使用这些证据。若预训练或指令微调阶段没有学会在先验冲突时重加权视觉信号，工具增强可能只增加输入复杂度。第三，PriVE-Tools 这种受控证据条件设计，对后续做多视图训练、视觉 verifier、或 tool-augmented VLM 的数据构造有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分两层。第一层是 PriVE-Bench，本质上是一个 prior-vs-evidence 的 counterfactual benchmark。每个样本由 original/counterfactual 图像对组成：原图符合常见视觉预期，反事实图则通过定向修改打破某个典型先验。作者覆盖五个域：object existence、counting、fashion attributes、industry/common-object attributes、medical modality consistency。每个样本都定义 visually correct answer 和 prior-consistent biased answer，因此模型输出可以被归类为 correct、biased、other，而不是只看对错。

第二层是 PriVE-Tools。它不是做一个自由工具调用 agent，而是把常见视觉操作转成受控 evidence condition：bounding-box overlays、crops、zoom panels、contour overlays。关键设计是固定底层图像、问题、正确答案、偏置答案和评分规则，只改变证据呈现方式。这样能把“工具是否帮助模型利用视觉证据”从“agent 规划是否成功”“工具调用链是否稳定”等因素里剥离出来。

评测协议上，作者同时测试 original-only、counterfactual-only、paired-image 三种输入模式，并覆盖 yes/no、multiple-choice、open-ended 问题形式。指标除了 accuracy，还单独统计 prior-following error rate 和 other-response rate。这个拆分很重要，因为在 counterfactual 场景里，单纯准确率下降并不能区分模型是看错了、跟随了先验，还是输出了别的无关答案。整体方法的价值在于评测控制做得比较干净。
summary.experiments:
从全文给出的结论看，实验主要得到三点。第一，counterfactual 输入会系统性诱发 prior-following，而不只是让模型更不确定。也就是说，很多错误答案不是随机噪声，而是稳定落在“类别上通常正确、但对当前图像错误”的那个 biased answer 上。第二，paired-image 输入有时有帮助，因为原图和反事实图并排时，某些差异更容易被比较出来，但这种帮助并不稳定，也不能消除 prior-following。第三，PriVE-Tools 中的工具化证据视图效果高度依赖模型：作者评测的 closed-source VLM 在 crop 和 zoom panel 等条件下整体 grounding 有改善，而若干 open-source 模型的 aggregate 效果较弱，甚至为负。

从研究解读上，这说明失败点不只是“看不到关键区域”，还包括“即便关键区域被显式暴露，模型也未必重写原有先验”。如果一个模型在 raw image 上错、在 crop/zoom 后仍错，而且错误继续落在 biased answer 上，那更像是视觉证据在决策层权重不足，而不是视觉编码器单纯分辨率不够。摘要截断没有给出完整数字，因此不宜编造具体百分点；但从作者的结论表述看，prior-following error rate 是这篇论文最该看的主指标，而不是总准确率。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读。先看 benchmark construction，确认五个 domain 的 counterfactual 是怎么做的，以及 correct / biased / other 三分类规则是否足够严格。然后看 evaluation protocol，特别是 original-only、counterfactual-only、paired-image、tool-conditioned 这几种设置如何保持其余变量不变。结果部分建议优先看不同模型在 prior-following error rate 上的变化，而不是只看 accuracy 排名；再看哪些工具条件对 closed-source 有帮助、对 open-source 无帮助，这里最能反映“证据可见 ≠ 证据被使用”。如果只想抓主线，20–30 分钟足够。更值得深挖的是数据构造细节：反事实修改是否引入低层视觉伪迹，paired-image 是否给了额外比较捷径，以及 medical modality consistency 这类域是否会把任务难度和先验强度混在一起。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a specific failure mode in VLMs: when visual evidence conflicts with learned language or category priors, do models answer from the pixels or from what is usually true? It then asks a more current question motivated by tool-augmented vision systems: if we provide extra evidence views such as crops, zooms, boxes, or contours, will the model actually revise a prior-driven answer? The contribution is not just to show that prior-following exists, but to test whether additional visual evidence helps under controlled counterfactual conditions.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to pretraining is limited because this is mainly an evaluation asset, not a new training recipe. Still, it is useful for multimodal pretraining and native VLM work. First, it cleanly separates apparent task competence from genuine visual grounding. That matters when image-text pretraining may let the model rely too heavily on language-mediated priors. Second, it highlights a practical lesson: exposing more visual evidence does not guarantee that the model will use it. If pretraining or instruction tuning does not teach the model to upweight visual signals under prior conflict, tool augmentation may add complexity without fixing the decision rule. Third, the controlled evidence-view setup is a good template for future work on multi-view training, visual verifiers, or tool-conditioned multimodal data generation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has two layers. The first is PriVE-Bench, a counterfactual benchmark built around prior-versus-evidence conflicts. Each example contains an original image and a counterfactual image. The original conforms to common expectations, while the counterfactual violates a canonical attribute, count, part, or modality expectation. The benchmark spans five domains: object existence, counting, fashion attributes, industry/common-object attributes, and medical modality consistency. Each item defines both a visually correct answer and a prior-consistent biased answer, so model outputs can be categorized as correct, biased, or other rather than only correct or incorrect.

The second layer is PriVE-Tools. Instead of evaluating a free-form visual agent, the paper converts common visual operations into controlled evidence conditions: bounding-box overlays, crops, zoom panels, and contour overlays. The key design choice is to keep the underlying image, question, correct answer, biased answer, and scoring rubric fixed while changing only the evidence presentation. That isolates whether the evidence view itself helps the model use visual information.

The evaluation protocol includes original-only, counterfactual-only, and paired-image inputs, and supports yes/no, multiple-choice, and open-ended questions. Metrics include accuracy, prior-following error rate, and other-response rate. That metric split is important because a drop in accuracy alone cannot tell whether the model is following a prior, becoming uncertain, or producing unrelated outputs.
summary_en.experiments:
The main findings are clear even from the available full text. First, counterfactual inputs induce systematic prior-following errors rather than merely generic confusion. Many wrong answers land specifically on the prior-consistent biased option. Second, paired-image inputs sometimes help because they make the visual discrepancy easier to compare, but they do not reliably remove prior-following. Third, tool-derived evidence views are model-dependent: in the reported evaluations, closed-source VLMs benefit more consistently from crops and zoom panels, while several open-source models show weak or even negative aggregate effects.

The important interpretation is that the bottleneck is not only visual access. In many cases, the relevant evidence is made more explicit, yet the model still does not revise its answer. That suggests a failure in evidence weighting or decision integration, not just a failure of raw perception. The provided text does not include the full numeric tables, so it is better to avoid inventing exact percentages. The metric to watch is prior-following error rate, not just overall accuracy.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper. Start with the benchmark construction and verify how the five domains are built, especially how the correct, biased, and other labels are defined. Then read the evaluation protocol to see how original-only, counterfactual-only, paired-image, and tool-conditioned settings are controlled. In the results, focus on changes in prior-following error rate rather than headline accuracy. Also pay attention to the asymmetry between closed-source and open-source models under crop and zoom conditions; that is where the paper most clearly shows that visible evidence is not the same as used evidence. A 20–30 minute read is enough for the main idea. The deeper questions are whether the counterfactual edits introduce low-level artifacts, whether paired-image inputs create comparison shortcuts, and whether some domains mix prior strength with task difficulty.

recommendation.zh: 反事实 grounding 诊断思路干净，对 VLM 对齐/幻觉评测有参考；只看 benchmark 构造与错误分类表即可。
recommendation.en: Clean counterfactual grounding diagnostic for VLM hallucination evaluation; read the benchmark construction and error taxonomy, skip the rest.

paper.title: OrientSAM: Mitigating Camera-Centric Shortcut in Multimodal Spatial Reasoning via Orientation-Aware Spatial Alignment
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) still struggle with spatial reasoning that requires perspective transformation. In particular, they often rely on camera-centric cues rather than reasoning from the reference object's viewpoint, leading to systematic errors in non-camera reference settings. In this paper, we first analyze this failure mode and show that object orientation is a key factor underlying such camera-centric shortcut behavior. To address this issue, we propose OrientSAM, an orie

summary.core_problem: 多模态大模型在空间推理任务中依赖相机视角的捷径线索，而非从参考物体视角进行推理，导致非相机参考设置下出现系统性错误。
summary.importance: 方法创新与数据贡献：首次系统分析相机中心捷径的失效模式，提出方向感知的空间对齐框架，并构建大规模方向感知空间监督数据生成管线。
summary.technical_approach: 提出OrientSAM，通过方向感知token与傅里叶角度编码将显式朝向信息注入多模态表示，同时采用课程学习逐步提升视角感知推理能力；配套空间数据构造管线从大规模图像生成方向感知监督。
summary.experiments: 在Spatial-MM、ViewSpatial、3DS等空间推理基准上验证方法有效性，对比基线模型在非相机参考视角任务上的错误率下降与推理准确率提升（摘要未给出具体数值）。

summary_en.core_problem: Multimodal LLMs rely on camera-centric shortcut cues during spatial reasoning instead of reasoning from the reference object's perspective, causing systematic failures under non-camera reference settings.
summary_en.importance: Methodological and data contribution: it first systematically analyzes the camera-centric shortcut failure mode, proposes an orientation-aware spatial alignment framework, and builds a pipeline to generate large-scale orientation-aware spatial supervision.
summary_en.technical_approach: OrientSAM injects explicit orientation information into multimodal representations via orientation-aware tokens and Fourier-based angle encoding, adopts curriculum learning to progressively improve perspective-aware reasoning, and uses a spatial data pipeline to generate orientation supervision from large-scale images.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Spatial-MM, ViewSpatial and 3DS benchmarks, demonstrating reduced error rates and improved accuracy on non-camera perspective spatial reasoning tasks compared with baseline models (specific metrics not fully provided in the abstract).

recommendation.zh: 属于VLM空间推理的细分改进，对预训练研究员仅作弱信号参考，关注其方向编码设计即可，无需深入正文。
recommendation.en: A niche improvement for VLM spatial reasoning; only the orientation encoding design is worth noting as a weak signal, no need to read the full paper.

paper.title: Learning to Detect Cross-Modal Negation: An Analysis of Latent Representations and an Attention-Based Solution
paper.abstract: Detecting high-level semantic concepts like negation across modalities remains a challenge for current multimodal systems. We analyze this as a fundamental representation learning problem, providing the first evidence that negation does not form a linearly or non-linearly separable class in the latent spaces of standard vision-language models (VLMs). We demonstrate that pretrained embeddings primarily encode modality-specific features, lacking a generalizable negation signal. To overcome this, w

summary.core_problem: 分析并提升 VLM 对跨模态否定语义的检测能力，特别是图像/视频与文本组合中“否定”是否被表示为可泛化 latent signal。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM 表征分析加小型方法改进。否定是高层语义和组合泛化的典型失败点；如果标准 VLM latent space 中否定不可分，说明当前图文对齐预训练更偏向实体、场景和模态特征，而不是逻辑关系。
summary.technical_approach: 先对标准 VLM 的 latent representations 做线性和非线性可分性分析，发现否定类别不形成稳定可分结构；再提出 cross-modal attention 架构，显式建模文本和视觉之间的依赖。数据侧使用 Qwen2.5-VL 自动标注 3,222 条政治 video-text pairs，并进行统计分析。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告 cross-modal attention 方法相对 unimodal baselines 最高提升 +7.03% F1。实验数据为 3,222 个政治视频-文本配对；未给出被分析 VLM 名称、参数规模、完整 baseline 列表或统计置信区间。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper analyzes and improves VLM detection of cross-modal negation, asking whether negation is represented as a generalizable latent signal across image/video and text.
summary_en.importance: This is a VLM representation-analysis contribution with a modest method component. Negation is a useful stress case for high-level semantics and compositional generalization; if it is not separable in standard VLM latent spaces, current image-text pretraining may be encoding entities, scenes, and modality-specific cues more strongly than logical relations.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors first test whether negation forms a linearly or non-linearly separable class in standard VLM latent representations, then introduce a cross-modal attention architecture to explicitly model dependencies between language and vision. The study uses 3,222 political video-text pairs automatically annotated with Qwen2.5-VL and includes statistical analysis of textual versus visual negation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports up to +7.03% F1 over unimodal baselines using the proposed cross-modal attention solution. The dataset contains 3,222 political video-text pairs. It does not specify the analyzed VLMs, parameter sizes, full baseline set, or confidence intervals.

recommendation.zh: 看 latent separability 结果即可；数据域偏政治视频，结论别直接推广到通用 VLM 预训练。
recommendation.en: Read the latent-separability analysis; the political-video domain makes broad VLM-pretraining conclusions fragile.

paper.title: How Do VLMs Fail? Vision-Operation Misalignment in Compositional VQA
paper.abstract: Compositional visual question answering requires Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to execute multiple reasoning operations like object selection, spatial relation resolution, and attribute verification. Despite strong aggregate performance, the mechanistic basis of VLM failures on this task remains underexplored. To address this gap, we analyze vision-operation misalignment in VLMs by examining how failures relate to specific reasoning operations and the internal computational pathways through whic

summary.core_problem: 现有VLM在组合式视觉问答任务上的错误来源与内部传播机制缺乏系统性拆解，无法针对性指导模型改进。
summary.importance: 提出以推理操作为核心的VLM失败分析框架，首次按错误起源与传播路径区分了四类机制不同的错误模式，为VLM能力优化提供错误归因依据。
summary.technical_approach: 构建Operation-centric分析框架，将VLM组合推理拆解为目标选择、空间关系解析、属性验证等原子操作，从错误起源的操作类型、内部计算传播路径两个维度拆解失败，结合视觉grounding强度与答案正确性的关联对错误分类。
summary.experiments: 在组合VQA数据集上对主流VLM开展分析，识别出grounding失败、推理失败、属性提取失败、语言先验主导失败四类错误，每类对应视觉grounding强度与答案正确率的独特关联模式，在不同规模模型上均普遍存在。
summary.authors_note: 新加坡理工大学、NVIDIA新加坡团队出品。

summary_en.core_problem: The mechanistic origin and propagation pathways of VLM failures on compositional VQA remain under-explored, preventing targeted model improvements.
summary_en.importance: Proposes an operation-centric mechanistic analysis framework for VLM failures, identifying four distinct failure modes categorized by their origin operation and propagation pathway to inform VLM capability optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: Decomposes VLM compositional reasoning into atomic operations including object selection, spatial relation resolution and attribute verification; categorizes failures by their origin operation and internal propagation path, using the correlation between visual grounding strength and answer correctness for classification.
summary_en.experiments: Tests mainstream VLMs on compositional VQA benchmarks, identifying four failure modes (grounding, reasoning, attribute extraction, language prior dominance) each with a unique correlation pattern between grounding strength and answer accuracy, observed across model scales.
summary_en.authors_note: Work from Singapore Institute of Technology and NVIDIA Singapore.

recommendation.zh: VLM错误归因的常规分析工作，无预训练层面新洞见，只看四类失败模式总结即可，不必读全文。
recommendation.en: A routine VLM error analysis with no pretraining-level insights; only read the four failure mode summary, skip the full text.

paper.title: HyMobileAgent: Data-Environment Co-Scaling for Efficient GUI Agents
paper.abstract: As large multimodal models move from understanding content to operating on digital environments, mobile GUI has emerged as a challenging and consequential testbed for digital embodied intelligence. Mobile agents operate under three coupled constraints: precise perception of complex interfaces, scalable acquisition of high-quality interaction data, and robust long-horizon decision making under compounding execution errors. This report presents HyMobileAgent, a mobile GUI agent built on Hy3.0-VL-A

summary.core_problem: 移动 GUI agent 受限于复杂界面精确感知、高质量交互数据的可扩展获取、以及长程决策中累积执行误差三个耦合约束。
summary.importance: 提出数据-环境协同 scaling 框架，而非单纯依赖模型 scaling，来解决移动 GUI 交互的关键瓶颈。
summary.technical_approach: 基于 Hy3.0-VL-A3B（原生任意分辨率输入、A3B 规模部署、32K 上下文窗口）构建 HyMobileAgent，集成 GUI 感知飞轮（mock 界面合成、拒绝采样、图标特定增强）和知识流水线。
summary.experiments: 在移动 GUI 交互场景中验证，报告了感知、数据获取和长程决策三方面的改进。
summary.authors_note: 来自 Hy Vision Team，基于自研 Hy3.0-VL-A3B 视觉原生基座模型。

summary_en.core_problem: Mobile GUI agents face three coupled constraints: precise perception of complex interfaces, scalable acquisition of high-quality interaction data, and robust long-horizon decision making under compounding execution errors.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a joint data-environment co-scaling framework rather than relying solely on model scaling to address key mobile interaction bottlenecks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds HyMobileAgent on Hy3.0-VL-A3B (native any-resolution input, A3B-scale deployment budget, 32K context window), integrating a GUI perception flywheel (mock-interface synthesis, rejection sampling, icon-specific augmentation) and a knowledge pipeline.
summary_en.experiments: Validated in mobile GUI interaction scenarios, reporting improvements across perception, data acquisition, and long-horizon decision making.
summary_en.authors_note: From the Hy Vision Team, built on the in-house Hy3.0-VL-A3B vision-native foundation model.

recommendation.zh: GUI agent 的数据-环境协同 scaling 思路对 VLM 预训练数据合成有参考，但属应用系统报告，看数据飞轮部分即可。
recommendation.en: The data-environment co-scaling idea for GUI agents is relevant to VLM pretraining data synthesis, but this is an application system report—just read the data flywheel section.

paper.title: Attention-Free and Lightweight Token Reduction for Efficient Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance in multimodal understanding, yet remain challenging to deploy on resource-constrained edge devices due to the substantial computational overhead of processing numerous visual tokens. Token reduction is a promising direction for accelerating VLMs inference, but existing approaches either rely on attention maps that are incompatible with modern acceleration frameworks or depend on computationally intensive pairwise similarity compariso

summary.core_problem: 现有VLM视觉token缩减方法要么依赖attention map难以适配现代推理加速框架，要么pairwise相似度计算开销过大，无法兼顾部署效率与性能。
summary.importance: 提出无注意力依赖的轻量token缩减即插即用模块，降低VLM端侧部署的视觉token计算开销，属于工程效率改进。
summary.technical_approach: 从信息论视角出发，设计基于熵的token重要性评估准则，无需attention权重即可筛选信息量大且具备多样性的视觉token，生成紧凑视觉表示，可作为插件接入现有VLM。
summary.experiments: 摘要内容截断，未披露具体模型参数量、测试数据集与量化性能提升，仅声明方法兼容主流加速框架、计算开销低。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing VLM token reduction methods either rely on attention maps incompatible with modern acceleration frameworks or require expensive pairwise similarity computation, failing to balance deployment efficiency and performance.
summary_en.importance: Proposes an attention-free, lightweight plug-and-play token reduction module to cut VLM edge deployment overhead, representing an engineering efficiency improvement.
summary_en.technical_approach: Adopts an information-theoretic perspective, designs an entropy-based token importance criterion to select informative and diverse visual tokens without attention weights, producing compact visual representations compatible with off-the-shelf VLMs as a plug-in.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract is truncated; no specific model sizes, test datasets, or quantitative performance gains are disclosed, only claims of compatibility with mainstream acceleration frameworks and low overhead.

recommendation.zh: VLM端侧部署的token剪枝实用方案，无注意力依赖适配加速库，只看熵准则的token打分设计即可。
recommendation.en: Practical VLM token pruning for edge deployment without attention map dependency; only review the entropy-based token scoring design.

paper.title: SIVA-RL: Sensitivity-Invariance Visual Alignment for Multimodal Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) drives multimodal reasoning, but answer-level correctness does not guarantee that a vision-language model grounds its predictions in visual evidence. Existing visual-intervention methods contrast policy behavior on original and modified images, yet assign supervision by the type of intervention rather than its observed effect. This assumption fails: identical operators produce heterogeneous outcomes across samples. We propose SIVA-RL, a Sensi

summary.core_problem: 多模态强化学习（RLVR）中答案级正确无法保证VLM的预测真正基于视觉证据，现有视觉干预方法按干预类型分配监督而非实际效果，同操作在不同样本上效果差异大。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出基于干预实际效果的样本级视觉对齐框架，改进多模态RL模型的视觉grounded性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出SIVA-RL框架，用样本级结果条件监督替代操作条件正则；通过token对齐、距离约束的PatchSwap构造局部图像干预；用冻结审计策略打分干净-干预对的奖励下降幅度作为软路由权重，分别驱动敏感性对齐（大降样本）和不变性对齐（低降样本）。
summary.experiments: 摘要未明确给出模型参数量、训练数据规模及具体基线对比数值，仅披露框架设计思路。

summary_en.core_problem: In multimodal reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), answer-level correctness does not guarantee VLM predictions are grounded in visual evidence; existing visual intervention methods assign supervision by intervention type rather than actual effect, leading to inconsistent outcomes across samples.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation proposing a sample-wise outcome-conditioned visual alignment framework to improve visual grounding in multimodal RL.
summary_en.technical_approach: SIVA-RL replaces operator-conditioned regularization with sample-wise outcome-conditioned supervision; constructs localized interventions via token-aligned, distance-constrained PatchSwap; uses a frozen audit policy to score reward drops on clean-intervention pairs as soft routing weights, driving sensitivity alignment for high-drop pairs and invariance alignment for low-drop pairs.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract does not specify model size, training data scale, or quantitative baseline comparisons, only discloses framework design.

recommendation.zh: 多模态RL视觉对齐的增量工作，干预效果驱动监督的思路可作设计参考，无需深读正文。
recommendation.en: Incremental work on multimodal RL visual alignment; the outcome-conditioned supervision idea is useful as design reference, no need for deep reading.

paper.title: Self-Improving is Often Sudden: Enlightenment-style Finetuning for Large-Scale Models
paper.abstract: The pursuit of autonomously self-improving models has attracted growing interest in the era of large-scale foundation models. Drawing inspiration from the concept of "enlightenment" or "aha moment" in human brain, we hypothesize that large models exhibit an analogous enlightenment phenomenon-a latent capacity for sudden capability boost. Then, we propose Enlightenment, a novel training-free post-tuning paradigm for large-scale models. Our approach modifies shortcuts for key modules/layers withou

summary.core_problem: 现有免训练后调方法主要通过操纵注意力权重提升模型能力，缺乏对模块/层快捷连接的直接修改方式。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出一种无需权重更新的后调范式，通过修改关键模块的快捷连接实现能力提升。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Enlightenment范式，对LLM引入注意力头混合快捷连接（将初始注意力头输出连接到所有其他目标头，由自适应缩放因子调制），对VLM在残差连接上施加轻量标量调制因子。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供具体模型规模、基准测试及量化提升数据。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing training-free post-tuning methods primarily manipulate attention weights to improve model capability, lacking approaches that directly modify shortcut connections of modules/layers.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: proposes a weight-update-free post-tuning paradigm that improves capability by modifying shortcut connections of key modules.
summary_en.technical_approach: The Enlightenment paradigm introduces attention head-mixing shortcuts for LLMs (linking initial attention head outputs to all other target heads, modulated by adaptive scaling factors) and lightweight scalar-modulated factors on residual connections for VLMs.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract does not provide specific model scale, benchmarks, or quantitative improvement data.

recommendation.zh: 免训练后调的一个新思路，但概念包装大于实质，看方法部分了解快捷连接设计即可，效果可信度待验证。
recommendation.en: A new idea in training-free post-tuning, but concept packaging outweighs substance; read the method section for shortcut connection design, effectiveness remains to be verified.

paper.title: VisCo: Leveraging Large Language Models as Intrinsic Encoders for Visual Token Compression
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) process large numbers of visual tokens, resulting in substantial inference latency and memory overhead. This has motivated extensive research on visual token compression. While training-free strategies rely on heuristic metrics and suffer significant performance degradation under high compression ratios, many training-based methods introduce external compression modules that force the VLM backbone to adapt, incurring substantial retraining cost and compromising VLMs

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 推理中视觉 token 数量过多导致的延迟和显存开销问题，尤其关注高压缩率下性能退化和重训练成本。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM 推理效率方法。它的价值不在预训练 recipe，而在提出一种利用已训练 VLM 内部表征做视觉 token 压缩的思路，避免额外压缩模块破坏 backbone 先验。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 VisCo，一个训练高效的自压缩框架。方法把预训练 VLM 作为内在编码器，使用参数共享的 autoencoder 结构，用少量 memory tokens 承载视觉信息，并把编码阶段的层级信息传递到解码阶段。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型参数量、训练数据、具体 VLM backbone、压缩率、基线和提升幅度。能确认的是它对比了 training-free 启发式压缩和引入外部模块的 training-based 压缩路线。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the latency and memory cost caused by excessive visual tokens in VLM inference, especially under aggressive compression where existing methods often lose accuracy or require costly retraining.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency contribution for VLMs. Its useful angle is to reuse the pretrained VLM’s own representational capacity for compression instead of adding an external compressor that may disturb the backbone’s priors.
summary_en.technical_approach: VisCo is a training-efficient self-compression framework. It treats the pretrained VLM as an intrinsic encoder, builds a parameter-sharing autoencoder, stores compressed visual information in a small set of memory tokens, and transfers hierarchical information from encoding to decoding.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, training data, exact VLM backbone, compression ratios, baselines, or numerical gains. It positions the method against training-free heuristic token pruning and training-based methods with external compression modules.

recommendation.zh: 作为 VLM token 压缩路线备查即可；重点看 memory token 自编码设计，别把它当预训练方法论。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a VLM token-compression reference; inspect the memory-token autoencoder design, but do not treat it as a pretraining result.

paper.title: CoRe: A Comprehensive Framework for Cross-Image Comparative Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Cross-image comparative reasoning remains challenging for vision-language models (VLMs), especially when correct prediction requires fine-grained attribute grounding and globally consistent reasoning. We present CoRe, a unified framework for this problem. CoRe includes: (i) CoRe-20K, a large-scale triplet-based training set automatically constructed from structured visual metadata through a multi-expert collaborative pipeline, covering counting, depth, distance, and spatial relations; (ii) TriSR

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 在多图比较推理中难以同时完成细粒度属性定位、跨图判断和全局一致性的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是多模态推理数据、训练框架和评测资产的组合。它把 cross-image comparative reasoning 单独拎出来，覆盖计数、深度、距离、空间关系等需要比较而非单图识别的能力，对 VLM 后训练和评测有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CoRe 框架，包括从结构化视觉元数据自动构造的 CoRe-20K 三元组训练集，以及 TriSR 结构化奖励。TriSR 在 GRPO 优化中同时约束属性 grounding、判断对齐和 triplet consistency，避免只用最终答案奖励导致模型学到表面比较模式。
summary.experiments: 在 CoRe-Bench 上评测多图细粒度比较推理能力。摘要报告 CoRe 相比最强 baseline 的 partial accuracy 提升 28.2 个百分点，同时在常规多模态 benchmark 上保持竞争力。未给出模型规模、训练 token 或具体 baseline 名称。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets VLM failures in cross-image comparative reasoning, where models must ground fine-grained attributes and maintain consistent judgments across multiple images.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a combined data, reward, and benchmark package for multi-image VLM reasoning. The task isolates comparative capabilities such as counting, depth, distance, and spatial relations, which are not well captured by standard single-image VQA setups.
summary_en.technical_approach: CoRe builds a triplet-based training set, CoRe-20K, from structured visual metadata through a multi-expert construction pipeline. It also introduces TriSR, a structured reward scheme for GRPO that supervises attribute grounding, judgment alignment, and triplet-level consistency instead of relying only on final-answer reward.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are centered on CoRe-Bench. The abstract reports a 28.2-point gain in partial accuracy over the strongest baseline while remaining competitive on standard multimodal benchmarks. Model scale, training size beyond CoRe-20K, and detailed baselines are not specified in the provided abstract.

recommendation.zh: 可扫数据构造和 TriSR 奖励设计；它更像 VLM 后训练 recipe，不会改变基座预训练判断。
recommendation.en: Skim the data construction and TriSR reward design; this is more a VLM post-training recipe than a base-pretraining signal.

paper.title: TIGER: Text-Conditioned Visual Gated Routing with Acceptance Alignment for Multimodal Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by letting a lightweight drafter propose multiple tokens that are verified by a larger target model. Although effective for text-only LLMs, speculative decoding yields limited gains in VLMs because drafters often diverge on vision-critical content, while existing multimodal acceleration methods do not directly address irrelevant visual evidence or optimize the verifier-accepted prefix length that governs speedup. We propose TIGER, a Text

summary.core_problem: 多模态（尤其含高分辨率视觉 token）的 speculative decoding 很难获得文本 LLM 那样的加速：小 drafter 在“视觉关键 token”（OCR 字符串、计数/数值、指代与关系、 grounded 描述等）上更容易早早偏离大 verifier，导致 verifier 接受的前缀很短，速度收益被抵消。论文要解决的是：在不改变 verifier 分布（保持 lossless 验证）的前提下，如何让 drafter 在多模态场景生成更长的可接受块（accepted prefix），从而真正提升端到端吞吐。
summary.importance:
对基座预训练的直接影响有限，更偏推理侧系统与训练目标设计；但它给了两个对“训练—推理闭环”有用的启发：
1) 把训练目标从“拟合分布/蒸馏”转到“直接优化推理时的关键运行量”（accepted prefix length），属于典型的 post-train 信号反哺推理效率；这类思路可迁移到长上下文、工具调用、结构化输出等场景。
2) 多模态小模型的失败往往不是容量不足这么简单，而是“给了不该看的视觉证据”导致噪声与分歧；用文本状态条件化的视觉证据路由，提供了一种比固定压缩接口更细粒度的视觉 token 预算分配方式。
整体贡献量级：属于把 speculative decoding 真正落到 VLM 的工程化方法论文，价值在于目标函数与路由接口的组合，而不是提出新的预训练范式。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由两块组成，分别对应“看什么”和“怎么训”。

(1) Text-conditioned Visual Gated Routing（看什么）：
- 设 vision encoder 产生视觉 token bank V（r 个 token）。传统做法要么把全量 V 给 drafter（贵且噪声大），要么用固定压缩/适配器给一个静态接口（对不同解码阶段不够自适应）。
- TIGER 在每个 speculative round j，用 drafter 当前的文本状态（prefix embedding / decoder state）作为条件，对视觉 token 做稀疏选择，得到 V_j^{route} 作为 drafter 的视觉接口。直觉是：下一段要生成的 token 只需要与当前语义相关的一小部分视觉证据（例如当前在读图表某个区域、或 OCR 某行），其余 token 只会增加 drafter 的不确定性与与 verifier 的分歧。
- 这种“按解码阶段动态路由视觉 token”的设计，和固定的视觉压缩（例如固定数量的视觉 query）相比，核心差异是：预算分配随文本状态变化，且目标是减少 drafter/verifier 的分歧而非仅压缩计算。

(2) Acceptance Alignment（怎么训）：
- 论文指出：多模态 speculative decoding 的速度主要由 verifier 接受的前缀长度决定，但常规蒸馏/模仿学习优化的是 token-level 似然或 KL，对 accepted prefix 这个离散运行量并不敏感。
- 训练流程：先用知识蒸馏 warm-start drafter，保证基本行为稳定；再进入 acceptance-aligned 阶段：对同一输入采样多个 draft continuations，运行标准 speculative decoding 的 verifier acceptance test（保持“lossless”验证逻辑），把“被接受的前缀长度”作为奖励信号，做 group-based policy optimization（类似用 verifier 作为可计算的监督/奖励源，而非人类偏好或 learned RM）。
- 为了稳定：加入 KL anchoring 防止策略漂移（drafter 过度追求某些模式导致整体分布偏离，反而降低可接受性或质量）。

关键取舍：
- 不去改 verifier，也不牺牲正确性（仍用标准 acceptance test），把所有可控变量放在 drafter 的可见视觉证据与训练目标上。
- 相比“让 drafter 更大/更强”这种线性堆算力的方案，TIGER 试图用更好的信息接口 + 更贴近推理指标的训练信号来换 accepted prefix。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文片段只能确认实验覆盖“多类多模态基准（OCR-heavy、counting、grounded reasoning 等）”，并且报告了三类指标：
1) verifier-accepted prefix length 变长；
2) target-model decoding work 减少；
3) 端到端 speculative decoding speedup 提升，同时保持任务准确率。

但当前提供的内容未包含具体表格/数字（例如：drafter/verifier 参数规模、视觉 token 路由的稀疏率、平均接受长度提升多少、吞吐提升多少、各基准上的准确率差异与方差）。因此无法在不臆测的情况下给出精确提升幅度。

建议在精读时重点核对：
- speedup 的定义（是否包含路由开销、是否计入 vision encoder、是否按 wall-clock 还是按 verifier step）；
- acceptance length 的统计方式（平均/分位数、按 block γ 的归一化）；
- 与强基线的对比（全视觉 token drafter、固定压缩接口、仅蒸馏不做 acceptance alignment 等）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction 里对“VLM speculative decoding 为何不加速”的诊断：它把问题落在 vision-critical token 与 accepted prefix 上，这个 framing 决定了后续设计。
- Method 重点抓两处：
  1) 路由模块如何用文本状态选择视觉 token（选择机制、稀疏度/预算、是否可微、是否引入额外注意力层）。
  2) acceptance-aligned 训练的具体优化形式：奖励如何定义、group-based 更新怎么做、KL anchoring 的实现细节、采样与验证的计算开销。
- 实验部分优先看：accepted prefix length 与端到端吞吐的对应关系图/表；以及消融（仅路由/仅 alignment/两者叠加）。

如果你的关注点是 pretrain：把它当作“用可计算 verifier 信号做训练目标”的案例，思考能否把类似信号迁移到预训练/中期训练的课程或数据选择上；但不要期待它提供新的 scaling law 或数据配比结论。

summary_en.core_problem: Multimodal speculative decoding often fails to deliver meaningful speedups because a small drafter diverges early on vision-critical tokens (OCR strings, numbers, counting, grounded attributes/relations). Early divergence shortens the verifier-accepted prefix, which is the actual runtime driver of speculative decoding gains. The paper targets a lossless setup (standard verifier acceptance test) and asks how to make the drafter produce longer accepted blocks in VLM decoding.
summary_en.importance:
This is primarily an inference-time acceleration + training-objective paper rather than a pretraining contribution. Still, it offers two reusable ideas for foundation-model researchers:
1) Replace “distill to match logits” with an objective that directly optimizes the runtime quantity that matters (accepted prefix length). This is a concrete example of closing the train–inference loop using a computable verifier signal.
2) In VLMs, drafter/verifier mismatch is often driven by exposing the drafter to irrelevant/noisy visual evidence. Text-state-conditioned routing is a more adaptive alternative to fixed visual compression interfaces.
Overall impact is practical: making speculative decoding more viable for VLM serving without modifying the verifier distribution.
summary_en.technical_approach:
TIGER combines (a) an adaptive visual interface for the drafter and (b) acceptance-aligned drafter training.

(a) Text-conditioned Visual Gated Routing:
- A vision encoder produces a visual token bank V (r tokens). Instead of feeding the full V to the drafter or using a fixed compressed adapter, TIGER selects a sparse subset V_j^{route} at each speculative round j.
- The selection is conditioned on the drafter’s current textual state (prefix embedding/decoder state), aiming to expose only the visual evidence needed for the next speculative block. The goal is not just compute reduction, but reducing drafter/verifier divergence on the upcoming tokens.

(b) Acceptance Alignment training:
- The paper argues that standard distillation optimizes imitation quality, while speculative decoding efficiency is governed by the verifier-accepted prefix length.
- Training pipeline: warm-start the drafter via knowledge distillation; then sample multiple draft continuations, run the standard verifier acceptance test, and use accepted prefix length as a reward signal for group-based policy optimization.
- KL anchoring is used to prevent policy drift and stabilize optimization.

Key design choice: keep the verifier and acceptance test unchanged (lossless), and move all adaptation into the drafter’s visual evidence budget and objective.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full-text excerpt, the evaluation spans diverse multimodal benchmarks (OCR-heavy, counting/numerical, grounded reasoning) and reports: longer accepted prefixes, reduced verifier decoding work, and higher end-to-end speedup while preserving task accuracy.

However, the excerpt does not include the concrete numbers/tables (model sizes, routed token budget, acceptance-length deltas, wall-clock speedups, accuracy changes). Without those sections, it’s not possible to quote exact gains reliably.

When checking the paper, validate: (i) how speedup is measured (wall-clock vs verifier steps; whether routing/vision encoding is included), (ii) acceptance-length statistics (mean vs tail), and (iii) ablations separating routing vs acceptance alignment.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Read the Introduction for the failure analysis: “vision-critical tokens” + “accepted prefix length” as the bottleneck.
- In Method, focus on (1) how routing selects visual tokens conditioned on text state (budget, sparsity, overhead), and (2) the exact acceptance-aligned optimization (reward definition, group-based update, KL anchoring, sampling/verification cost).
- In Experiments, prioritize the plots/tables linking accepted prefix length to end-to-end throughput, plus ablations (routing only vs alignment only vs both).

If your main interest is pretraining, treat this as a case study of using a verifier-derived, fully automatic signal to optimize a deployment metric, rather than as a new pretraining recipe.

recommendation.zh: 多模态 spec decode 一直缺干净做法，这篇把瓶颈明确落在 accepted prefix 和视觉 token 暴露方式上；先看路由设计和 acceptance reward，别急着信总加速数字。
recommendation.en: Multimodal speculative decoding has lacked a clean formulation; this paper usefully pins the bottleneck on accepted-prefix length and visual-token exposure. Read the routing design and acceptance reward first, but do not over-trust the headline speedups.

paper.title: Spectral Heat Flow for Conservative Token Condensation in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are costly at inference time because they must process long sequences of visual tokens. Existing token pruning methods often degrade under high compression by blindly discarding information, breaking spatial structure or collapsing diversity. We propose SpecFlow, a training-free framework that shifts the paradigm from destructive pruning to conservative condensation, strictly enforcing spatial coverage and statistical conservation to ensure stability. Treating visua

summary.core_problem: VLM推理时视觉token序列过长导致计算开销大，现有token剪枝在高压缩率下信息损失严重。
summary.importance: 推理效率方向的方法改进，提出训练无关的保守token凝聚范式，属于增量型创新。
summary.technical_approach: 提出SpecFlow，将视觉token视为kNN图节点，通过谱热流计算重要性场、自适应空间划分保证覆盖、信息聚合到coreset sink保持统计守恒，无需微调。
summary.experiments: 在多个VLM架构和任务上与现有SOTA token剪枝方法对比，高压缩率下性能更优，兼容FlashAttention，即插即用。

summary_en.core_problem: Long visual token sequences make VLM inference expensive; existing token pruning methods degrade severely under high compression ratios.
summary_en.importance: Incremental improvement in inference efficiency; proposes a training-free conservative token condensation paradigm as an alternative to destructive pruning.
summary_en.technical_approach: SpecFlow treats visual tokens as nodes in a kNN graph, computes importance via spectral heat flow, allocates budgets through adaptive spatial partitioning, and aggregates discarded information into coreset sinks to preserve statistical conservation, requiring no fine-tuning.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across multiple VLM architectures and tasks, outperforming state-of-the-art token pruning methods especially at high compression rates; plug-and-play and FlashAttention-compatible.

recommendation.zh: VLM视觉token压缩的工程改进，训练无关思路有参考价值但非范式突破，看方法节即可。
recommendation.en: Engineering improvement for VLM visual token compression; training-free design is worth noting but not paradigm-shifting—skim the method section only.

paper.title: MM-ToolSandBox: A Unified Framework for Evaluating Visual Tool-Calling Agents
paper.abstract: We introduce MM-ToolSandBox, a benchmark and evaluation framework for visually grounded tool-calling agents. The framework provides a stateful execution environment spanning 500+ tools across 16 application domains, supporting multi-image, multi-turn tasks where agents must ground progressively arriving visual inputs into executable tool calls while handling realistic conversational phenomena (goal revisions, error corrections, state mutations). An automated scenario generation pipeline produces

summary.core_problem: 现有工具调用Agent评测框架以文本为核心，大多仅支持静态单轮、小规模工具集的视觉输入场景，缺少在动态多轮交互、多图像输入、大规模工具库条件下，对多模态Agent视觉工具调用能力的标准化统一评测体系。
summary.importance: 作为多模态工具调用方向的专项评测框架，填补了动态视觉工具调用场景的评测空白，其多维度任务设计和自动化场景生成流程，为多模态模型的工具调用能力迭代、预训练-后训练全流程的多模态Agent能力验证提供了可直接复用的测试基准。
summary.technical_approach: 在文本工具调用评测框架ToolSandbox基础上扩展，新增原生图像处理能力、视觉专属工具集，同时支持结构化工具调用、代码执行两种交互范式。构建的评测基准覆盖511个工具、16个应用领域，沿信息流类型、对话挑战类型、图像到达模式三个正交维度设计任务，包含258个人工校验的场景、1284张专属图像，支持多轮、多图像交互。配套自动化场景生成管线，通过信息流引导的任务规划、环境状态实例化、多阶段质量过滤，将人工成本从全量标注降低为定向审核。评测环节结合确定性状态校验与LLM裁判，从任务完成度、工具使用有效性、指令遵循、无副作用等多个维度完成打分。
summary.experiments: 对主流闭源、开源前沿模型的系统评测显示，现有模型在视觉工具调用任务上仍存在明显短板：多图像工作记忆是核心瓶颈，不同参数量模型呈现差异化的失败模式，在视觉grounding推理、多步交互、状态化工具使用环节均存在显著提升空间。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注框架设计部分的三维任务划分逻辑、实验部分的模型失败模式分析，可直接复用该基准评估自有多模态模型的视觉工具调用能力，预计阅读时间12分钟。
summary.authors_note: Apple机器学习团队

summary_en.core_problem: Existing tool-calling agent evaluation frameworks are text-centric, mostly limited to static single-turn scenarios with small tool sets, and lack a standardized, unified evaluation system for multimodal agents' visual tool-calling capabilities under dynamic multi-turn interaction, multi-image input, and large tool library settings.
summary_en.importance: This dedicated visual tool-calling evaluation framework fills the gap in benchmarking for dynamic visual tool use scenarios. Its multi-dimensional task design and automated scenario generation pipeline provide a directly reusable testbed for iterating multimodal model tool-calling capabilities and validating multimodal agent performance across the full pretraining and post-training pipeline.
summary_en.technical_approach: Built as an extension of the text-centric ToolSandbox evaluation framework, the system adds native image processing support and vision-specific tools, supporting both structured tool calling and code execution interfaces. The benchmark covers 511 tools across 16 application domains, with tasks designed along three orthogonal axes: information flow type, conversational challenge type, and image arrival pattern. It includes 258 human-verified scenarios with 1284 curated images, supporting multi-turn, multi-image interactions. An automated scenario generation pipeline uses information-flow-guided planning, environment state instantiation, and multi-stage quality filtering to reduce manual effort from full annotation to targeted review. Evaluation combines deterministic state verification and LLM-based judges, scoring across dimensions including task completion, tool use validity, instruction following, and absence of unintended side effects.
summary_en.experiments: Systematic evaluation of leading proprietary and open-weight models shows existing models still exhibit clear weaknesses on visual tool-calling tasks: multi-image working memory stands out as a core bottleneck, models of different parameter scales show distinct failure patterns, and significant gaps remain in visual grounding reasoning, multi-step interaction, and stateful tool use.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the paper, focusing on the three-dimensional task taxonomy in the framework design section and the model failure mode analysis in the experiment section. The benchmark can be directly adopted to evaluate visual tool-calling capabilities of in-house multimodal models. Estimated reading time: 12 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Apple Machine Learning team

recommendation.zh: 值得扫 §benchmark 和 failure analysis；低于 50% 的结果说明 VLM-agent 短板仍在视觉接地精度，不只是规划。
recommendation.en: Skim the benchmark design and failure analysis; the sub-50% result points to visual grounding precision, not just planning, as the VLM-agent bottleneck.

paper.title: Mixture of Cognitive Experts in Large Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs) require strong reasoning over both visual and textual input. Recent work suggests that cognitive elements, especially diverse representations and metacognition, correlate with better performance. Many of the needed perceptual functions are already provided by specialized domain-specific computer vision models, which act as the perceptual subsystem for detecting objects, localizing them, inferring states, recovering spatial layout, and reading text. The key ch

summary.core_problem: 现有大视觉语言模型（LVLM）对不同认知层次的视觉问答采用统一的感知-推理路由，无法充分利用专业化CV模型的能力，存在幻觉和可验证性差的问题
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出证据驱动的多模态推理框架，将Bloom认知分类法与混合专家范式结合，提升LVLM的推理可解释性和准确性
summary.technical_approach: Mixture of Cognitive Experts框架：基于Bloom分类法构建分层推理协议，根据查询的认知需求动态路由到不同的专业化CV专家（检测、定位、状态推断、空间布局恢复、OCR等），整合多源证据生成连贯可验证的输出
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体模型参数量、数据集及量化实验结果

summary_en.core_problem: Existing Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) apply a uniform perception-reasoning routing to visual queries of all cognitive levels, failing to fully leverage specialized CV models and suffering from hallucinations and poor verifiability
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposing an evidence-driven multimodal reasoning framework that combines Bloom's cognitive taxonomy with the mixture-of-experts paradigm to improve the interpretability and accuracy of LVLM reasoning
summary_en.technical_approach: Mixture of Cognitive Experts framework: builds a hierarchical reasoning protocol based on Bloom's taxonomy, dynamically routes queries to specialized CV experts (detection, localization, state inference, spatial layout recovery, OCR, etc.) according to their cognitive demands, and integrates multi-source evidence to generate coherent, verifiable outputs
summary_en.experiments: No specific model size, dataset, or quantitative results are disclosed in the abstract

recommendation.zh: VLM领域的认知混合专家路由设计，对多模态MoE架构有微弱参考，仅看路由机制部分即可
recommendation.en: Cognitive mixture-of-experts routing design for VLM, offers marginal reference for multimodal MoE architectures; only the routing mechanism section is worth a look

paper.title: When Depth Is Better Told Than Shown: Depth-Ordinal Prompting for Vision-Language Spatial Reasoning
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are expected to reason about physical space -- which object is closer, what lies behind what, and how objects are arranged in 3D -- yet they still struggle with such spatial judgments. A natural remedy is to show the model a depth map, but we find that this can make performance worse. We show that depth is not absent: it reaches the language model, but becomes difficult to access for downstream reasoning, while rendered pseudo-depth maps act as noisy auxiliary image

summary.core_problem: VLM在3D空间关系推理（如物体远近、前后遮挡判断）上表现不佳，直接输入伪深度图作为辅助模态反而会进一步降低性能。
summary.importance: 首次明确发现深度信号的呈现形式（图像vs文本）对冻结VLM空间推理能力的反向影响，提出免训练、无标注的提示方法，属于方法创新+反常识发现。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Depth-Ordinal Prompting（DOP），先通过单目深度估计器得到深度信息，再针对查询问题中的目标对象，将深度关系转换为有序文本提示注入输入，无需训练模型、修改架构或注入视觉特征。
summary.experiments: 跨多个空间推理benchmark、不同VLM模型和不同深度估计器测试，DOP均能稳定提升空间推理准确率，且显著优于直接输入深度图的方案。

summary_en.core_problem: VLMs underperform on 3D spatial relation reasoning (e.g., object proximity, occlusion order judgment), and directly inputting pseudo-depth maps as auxiliary modality further degrades performance.
summary_en.importance: First explicitly identifies the reverse impact of depth signal presentation format (image vs text) on frozen VLMs' spatial reasoning, proposes a training-free, annotation-free prompting method, belonging to methodological innovation + counterintuitive finding.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Depth-Ordinal Prompting (DOP), which first obtains depth information via monocular depth estimators, then converts depth relations into ordinal text prompts for query-targeted objects and injects them into the input, without model training, architecture modification or visual feature injection.
summary_en.experiments: Tested across multiple spatial reasoning benchmarks, various VLMs and different depth estimators; DOP consistently improves spatial reasoning accuracy and significantly outperforms the direct depth map input scheme.

recommendation.zh: 反常识发现值得参考，深度信号以文本而非图像形式注入冻结VLM更有效，仅看摘要和§3核心实验即可。
recommendation.en: Counterintuitive finding worth noting; injecting depth as text rather than image works better for frozen VLMs, read abstract and §3 core experiments only.

paper.title: MOSAIC: Adaptive Inter-layer Composition for Efficient Heterogeneous Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved success using homogeneous Transformers to process multimedia data. Recent studies show that heterogeneous structures interleaving efficient mechanisms, like linear attention, improve both performance and inference latency over homogeneous designs. However, these efforts rely on handcrafted static mixing patterns, which are sub-optimal and difficult to adapt to specific hardware. To bridge this gap, we propose Multi-Objective Search for Adaptive Inter-l

summary.core_problem: 异构 VLM 结构常靠人工指定不同层使用何种高效算子，难以同时适配任务性能与具体硬件延迟约束。
summary.importance: 这是一个效率与架构搜索工作。对基座预训练研究员的价值有限，但如果你关心 heterogeneous attention、硬件感知模型设计或 serving 侧结构改写，它提供了一个自动化搜索思路。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 MOSAIC，把 homogeneous VLM 自动转换为 heterogeneous 架构，在统一搜索空间中混合 linear attention、sparse operator、low-rank operator 等机制，并用多目标混合整数规划在性能和延迟约束下搜索最优层间组合。为降低搜索成本，还设计了相应的近似或代理评估流程。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调在严格硬件延迟约束下，相比手工设计的静态混合模式能取得更优的性能-延迟折中，但未给出具体模型规模、硬件平台和提升幅度。更像工程优化论文，而不是会改变预训练方法论的工作。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 LiAuto Inc。未见可确认的知名基座模型作者。

summary_en.core_problem: Heterogeneous VLM architectures often rely on manually chosen layer-wise mixes of efficient operators, which are hard to optimize jointly for task quality and hardware latency.
summary_en.importance: This is an efficiency and architecture-search paper. Its relevance to base-model pretraining is limited, but it may be useful if you care about heterogeneous attention, hardware-aware model design, or serving-time architectural adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach: MOSAIC automatically transforms a homogeneous VLM into a heterogeneous one. It defines a unified search space over linear attention, sparse operators, low-rank operators, and related mechanisms, then solves a multi-objective mixed-integer program to maximize downstream performance under latency constraints. The method also includes cost-reduction machinery for search.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims better performance-latency trade-offs than handcrafted static mixing patterns under strict hardware constraints, but does not provide model sizes, hardware details, or exact gains. This reads more like an engineering optimization paper than a pretraining-method paper.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from LiAuto Inc. No clearly identifiable foundation-model researchers can be confirmed from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在做 heterogeneous attention 或部署侧结构改写，可只看搜索空间和 latency 约束建模；否则和基座预训练主线关系不大。
recommendation.en: Only read the search-space design and latency formulation if you work on heterogeneous attention or deployment-side architecture adaptation; otherwise it is peripheral to core pretraining.

paper.title: Seeing is Free, Speaking is Not: Uncovering the True Energy Bottleneck in Edge VLM Inference
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are the perceptual backbone of embodied AI, but their energy footprint on edge hardware remains poorly understood. Existing efficiency efforts focus predominantly on reducing visual tokens, implicitly treating visual processing as the dominant energy cost. We overturn this implicit assumption through the first systematic energy profiling of on-device VLM inference, spanning five models across three architecture families, four input resolutions, and two hardware plat

summary.core_problem: 澄清端侧VLM推理的真实能耗分布，纠正此前默认视觉处理是主要能耗瓶颈的认知偏差
summary.importance: 系统分析贡献，首次完成跨模型、跨硬件、跨输入设置的端侧VLM能耗profiling，为端侧VLM推理优化方向提供实测依据
summary.technical_approach: 选取3个架构族共5个VLM模型、4种输入分辨率，在NVIDIA RTX 3070和Jetson Orin NX两个硬件平台上，系统测量推理功率、时延、token级计算开销分布
summary.experiments: 得到三个核心结论：1. 模型平均推理功率为固有常数，随输入分辨率、图像复杂度、提示类型的波动小于5%，能耗差异全部来自推理时延；2. 每个输出token的时延是输入视觉token的11-39倍，自回归解码是核心能耗瓶颈；3. 视觉token压缩的能耗收益被显著高估

summary_en.core_problem: Clarify the real energy consumption distribution of on-device VLM inference, correcting the prior misperception that visual processing is the dominant energy bottleneck
summary_en.importance: System analysis contribution that presents the first cross-model, cross-hardware, cross-setting energy profiling for on-device VLMs, providing empirical evidence for on-device VLM inference optimization directions
summary_en.technical_approach: Selects 5 VLM models from 3 architecture families and 4 input resolutions, systematically measures inference power, latency and per-token compute overhead on NVIDIA RTX 3070 and Jetson Orin NX platforms
summary_en.experiments: Three core findings: 1. Average inference power is a model-intrinsic constant with <5% variation across inputs, all energy difference comes from latency; 2. Each output token costs 11-39x more latency than each input visual token, autoregressive decoding is the core energy bottleneck; 3. Energy gains from visual token reduction are significantly overestimated

recommendation.zh: 端侧VLM能耗的实测分析，核心结论符合直觉——自回归解码才是真瓶颈，看摘要三个结论即可，无需读全文
recommendation.en: Empirical energy profiling for on-device VLMs, the core finding that autoregressive decoding is the real bottleneck is intuitive; reading the three abstract findings is sufficient

paper.title: MultiView-Bench: A Diagnostic Benchmark for World-Centric Multi-View Integration in VLMs
paper.abstract: Recent benchmarks for VLMs largely assess single- or limited-view perception, leaving untested the core cognitive ability to integrate observations across viewpoints into a coherent, world-centric (allocentric) 3D mental model. We introduce MultiView-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark expressly designed to evaluate multi-view integration for holistic 3D scene comprehension. Unlike existing datasets that focus on pixel-level mapping or camera-relative navigation, MultiView-Bench requires models to dec

summary.core_problem: 现有 VLM 评测大多停留在单视角或弱多视角感知，缺少对模型是否能把多视角观察整合成统一、世界坐标系下 3D 场景表征的诊断。
summary.importance: 这是一篇评测工作，贡献在于把“world-centric multi-view integration”单独拎出来测。对做原生多模态预训练的人有价值，因为它测的不是普通图文对齐，而是更接近具身和 3D 理解所需的跨视角一致性能力。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 MultiView-Bench，专门构造需要跨视角聚合信息、并在固定全局坐标系中判断物体关系的任务。设计上刻意区分：单图 2D 关系、3D 空间关系、以及多视角整合，借此定位 VLM 是卡在几何理解本身，还是卡在跨视角记忆与整合。
summary.experiments: 作者系统评测了前沿 VLM，结论是：模型在单图 2D 平面关系上通常表现较强，但在 3D 空间关系和多视角信息整合上明显失效；同时还分析了视觉语言数据中的偏置会如何掩盖真实的空间推理缺陷。摘要未给出具体模型规模和提升幅度，因此更适合作为诊断基准而非性能论文来读。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Yale University 和 University of Edinburgh。未见可确认的一线基座模型作者信息。

summary_en.core_problem: Current VLM evaluations mostly test single-view or weak multi-view perception, but do not directly probe whether models can integrate multiple viewpoints into a coherent world-centric 3D representation.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation contribution. Its value is in isolating world-centric multi-view integration as a distinct capability. For multimodal pretraining researchers, this matters because it targets cross-view consistency rather than generic image-text alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces MultiView-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark built around tasks that require aggregating observations across viewpoints and reasoning in a fixed global coordinate frame. The setup separates single-image 2D relations, 3D spatial relations, and true multi-view integration, making failure modes easier to localize.
summary_en.experiments: The authors evaluate frontier VLMs and find a consistent pattern: strong performance on 2D planar relations from a single image, but clear weakness on 3D spatial reasoning and cross-view aggregation. They also analyze dataset and prompt biases that can mask genuine spatial reasoning deficits. The abstract does not provide model sizes or exact margins, so this is best read as a diagnostic benchmark rather than a performance paper.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Yale University and the University of Edinburgh. No clearly identifiable foundation-model lab authors can be confirmed from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 做多模态预训练可以记住这个 benchmark，但不必细读正文；价值在于它把“跨视角整合失败”从泛泛空间推理里单独剥出来了。
recommendation.en: Worth bookmarking if you work on multimodal pretraining; the main value is that it cleanly isolates cross-view integration failure from generic spatial reasoning.

paper.title: SigLIP-HD by Fine-to-Coarse Supervision
paper.abstract: High-quality visual representation is a long-standing pursuit in computer vision. In the context of multimodal LLMs (MLLMs), feeding higher-resolution images can produce more fine-grained visual tokens. However, it introduces additional computational and design complexity, due to multiple forward passes and post-processing of increased tokens. Before simply adopting a higher resolution, have we truly unlocked the model's full perception capability at a standard resolution? Therefore, we study an

summary.core_problem: 如何在不提升输入图像分辨率、不增加推理开销的前提下，提升MLLM视觉编码器的细粒度感知能力
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出轻量的细到粗监督训练方案，解决高分辨率视觉输入带来的token爆炸、多轮前向计算复杂度高的问题，为VLM视觉侧效率优化提供了可落地的训练技巧
summary.technical_approach: 基于SigLIP 2模型，训练时以同图高分辨率版本输出的细粒度特征为监督，引导中分辨率输入的粗粒度特征对齐；推理时完全移除高分辨率分支，无额外计算开销
summary.experiments: 在多个MLLM基准上验证，相同推理预算下，模型输出的视觉特征质量优于基线SigLIP 2，可支撑更细粒度的多模态理解
summary.authors_note: 核心作者Hengshuang Zhao为计算机视觉领域知名研究者，长期从事视觉表征学习、多模态感知相关研究

summary_en.core_problem: How to improve fine-grained perception of MLLM visual encoders without increasing input resolution or inference overhead
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation that proposes a lightweight fine-to-coarse supervision scheme to address token explosion and compute overhead from high-resolution visual inputs, providing a practical training trick for VLM vision-side efficiency optimization
summary_en.technical_approach: Built on SigLIP 2, during training coarse features from mid-resolution inputs are aligned to fine-grained features from the high-resolution version of the same image as supervision; the high-resolution branch is fully removed at inference with zero extra cost
summary_en.experiments: Validated on multiple MLLM benchmarks, under identical inference budget the model produces better visual features than baseline SigLIP 2, supporting finer-grained multimodal understanding
summary_en.authors_note: Corresponding author Hengshuang Zhao is a well-known computer vision researcher focusing on visual representation learning and multimodal perception

recommendation.zh: 视觉编码器特征蒸馏的增量改进，无范式创新，结论符合直觉，作为VLM视觉侧训练素材备查即可，无需读全文
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement on vision encoder distillation with no paradigm innovation, conclusions are intuitive; keep as reference for VLM vision training, no need to read the full paper

paper.title: The Count Is There, but Misaligned: Understanding and Correcting Counting Failures in VLMs
paper.abstract: Despite strong performance on many multimodal tasks, vision-language models (VLMs) still struggle with basic object counting. We investigate whether this reflects missing internal knowledge or a gap between internal representations and verbalized outputs. Training simple probes on activations from four VLMs across five counting datasets reveals that nonlinear probes can reliably detect counting errors, suggesting that VLMs often encode the correct count even when they output the wrong answer. SV

summary.core_problem: VLM在基础目标计数任务上频繁出错，其成因是模型未习得计数能力，还是内部正确表征与语言输出间存在对齐错位。
summary.importance: 通过探针和因果干预明确VLM计数错误的核心机制是表征读出方向错位而非知识缺失，为理解多模态模型的幻觉来源、表征对齐缺口提供了任务级实证。
summary.technical_approach: 在4个VLM、5个计数数据集上训练线性/非线性探针检测计数错误；用SVCCA分析真实计数探针与模型输出探针的表征子空间重叠关系；通过因果激活steering验证正确计数方向的因果效用；提出探针引导的选择性重提示自校正方法。
summary.experiments: 覆盖4个公开VLM、5个计数数据集，非线性探针检测计数错误的可靠性显著高于线性探针；因果steering沿计数方向干预激活可稳定提升计数准确率；自校正方法通过选择性重提示修正错误，摘要未披露完整量化结果。

summary_en.core_problem: Whether VLM counting failures arise from a lack of internal counting capability, or from misalignment between correctly encoded internal representations and final verbalized outputs.
summary_en.importance: Provides causal evidence that VLM counting errors stem primarily from readout misalignment rather than missing knowledge, offering empirical support for representation-output gaps as a source of hallucination in multimodal models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Trains linear and nonlinear probes on activations from 4 VLMs across 5 counting datasets to detect errors; applies SVCCA to measure subspace overlap between ground-truth count probes and model output probes; conducts causal activation steering to validate the functional role of count-aligned directions; proposes probe-guided selective re-prompting for self-correction.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across 4 public VLMs and 5 counting benchmarks; nonlinear probes reliably detect counting errors where linear probes fail; causal steering along count directions consistently improves counting accuracy; the self-correction method uses selective re-prompting, with full quantitative results not included in the available abstract.

recommendation.zh: VLM计数场景下验证了「知识已编码但读出错位」的现象，与LLM幻觉的相关观察呼应，仅看探针和因果干预结果即可，自校正方法工程价值有限。
recommendation.en: Replicates the encoded-knowledge misaligned-readout finding in VLM counting, echoing LLM hallucination observations; skip the self-correction method, focus on probe and intervention results.

paper.title: Scalable Visual Pretraining for Language Intelligence
paper.abstract: The rapid progress of large foundation models has been driven predominantly by pretraining on large-scale text corpora. However, many forms of knowledge are conveyed through visual representations, where figures, typeset equations, and page layouts carry rich information that cannot be faithfully or completely captured by text alone. Yet current pretraining approaches discard these visual cues by converting visually rich sources, such as documents and web pages, into plain text for learning lang

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的核心问题是：科学文档被转成纯文本后，会丢掉版面、公式结构、图表关系和空间拓扑等信息；这些信息是否可以通过直接在视觉形态的文档上做预训练，转化为更强的语言推理能力。它把问题设得很干净：同一批科学 PDF，TP 路径用解析文本继续预训练，VP 路径用渲染页面图像继续预训练，后续 SFT 保持一致，用这种匹配设置隔离文档表示形式带来的差异。
summary.importance: 这篇值得精读，因为它把视觉文档预训练从多模态条件输入问题，推进到基座训练目标问题。常见做法是先 OCR 或解析 PDF，再让 LM 学文本；另一类做法是把图像作为上下文，让模型预测文本。VP 的不同点在于，视觉 latent 自身进入自回归预测目标，模型必须从页面图像序列中学习可预测结构。对预训练研究的影响有三点。第一，token budget 不能只按文本 token 理解，视觉 patch latent 可能在科学语料上承载更高的信息密度。第二，文档预训练的数据清洗目标不一定是把 PDF 最大程度文本化，也可以保留原始视觉结构。第三，语言能力和视觉能力的边界在基座阶段更早地耦合，尤其是科学推理、公式和图表这类文本化损失较大的数据域。
summary.technical_approach: Visual Pretraining 将科学 PDF 页面直接渲染为图像，过滤出前景视觉 patch，再把这些 patch 表示为冻结视觉特征空间中的 latent 序列。训练目标是 next visual latent prediction，即沿页面视觉 token 序列做自回归预测，而不是把图像只当作条件上下文去预测文字。对照组 Text Pretraining 使用同一 PDF 语料经 MinerU2.5 解析得到的文本，并进行常规 text-token prediction。VP 和 TP 使用相同起始 checkpoint、相同底层文档来源、相同继续预训练阶段和相同 SFT 阶段。这个设计的关键不是换了更多数据，而是把文档的表示形式从解析文本换成原始页面视觉 latent。它避免了 OCR、LaTeX 解析和版面线性化中的结构丢失，也不依赖显式图文配对监督。论文还报告 VP 会拉近匹配视觉文档和文本嵌入在共享表示空间中的距离，说明它不仅学习视觉感知，也改善跨模态对齐。
summary.experiments: 核心实验覆盖 Qwen 3.5、Qwen 3、Llama 3.2 Vision 和 Llama 3.1，评测包含 MMLU-Pro、GPQA Diamond、AIME 2025 和 HLE。GPQA 使用 average pass@8，AIME 2025 使用 32 次运行平均分，MMLU-Pro 和 HLE 使用 pass@1。Qwen 3.5 多模态模型上，TP 为 83.91/76.24/89.58/15.70，VP 提升到 85.09/79.29/90.21/16.67，分别对应 MMLU-Pro、GPQA、AIME、HLE。Qwen 3 语言模型上，TP 为 81.52/74.94/74.99/11.39，VP 为 81.94/77.08/76.98/11.77。Llama 3.2 Vision 上，TP 为 50.60/30.24/13.75/6.08，VP 为 51.52/33.08/18.54/7.00，其中 AIME 提升较明显。Llama 3.1 上，TP 为 60.64/43.88/23.65/6.79，VP 为 62.77/47.10/24.27/7.17。论文还强调 VP 在相同底层文档语料上只消耗 25% token budget 就超过 TP，这一点比单个 benchmark 增益更重要，因为它指向视觉文档 token 的数据效率。消融和对齐结果显示，收益不依赖单一 backbone，也不只是 SFT 格式带来的表面增益。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 45 到 60 分钟。先看 Figure 1，确认 TP 与 VP 的 matched-corpus 设计，尤其是同一 PDF 在文本解析和页面渲染两条路径上的差别。然后读 Method，重点关注视觉 patch 的筛选、冻结视觉 latent 的构造、序列顺序、next visual latent prediction loss，以及它如何接到原有 LLM backbone。再看 Table 1，逐行比较 Base、TP、VP，注意 Qwen 和 Llama、multimodal 和 language-only 两类 backbone 上是否一致。继续看 scaling 和 token budget 相关实验，重点确认 25% token budget 的定义和计算方式。最后看表示对齐结果，例如 t-SNE 和 Table 2，判断 VP 改善的是科学推理相关结构，还是更宽泛的视觉-文本嵌入接近。值得深挖的问题包括：视觉 tokenizer 或视觉 encoder 的选择是否限制 scaling；页面 patch 顺序是否引入归纳偏置；复杂公式和表格的收益是否来自保留布局，还是来自绕开解析错误；在更嘈杂网页截图或非科学文档上是否仍成立。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether scientific documents should be pretrained as rendered visual objects rather than converted into plain text. The core issue is information loss: equations, diagrams, tables, spatial layout, and symbolic topology are weakened or distorted by OCR, LaTeX parsing, and linear text extraction. The experimental setup is deliberately controlled: the same scientific PDFs are used for continued pretraining, either as parsed text for TP or as rendered page images for VP, followed by the same SFT stage.
summary_en.importance: This is a strong pretraining paper because it reframes visual documents as a primary training signal, not merely as multimodal conditioning context. Standard pipelines extract text from PDFs and train on text tokens. Many multimodal systems consume images as inputs but still optimize text-token prediction. VP instead places visual latents inside the autoregressive prediction objective. That changes the pretraining problem: the model learns predictable structure from page images directly. The implication is concrete for foundation-model training. Token budgets should be compared by information carrier, not only by text-token count. Scientific PDFs may be more data-efficient when their visual structure is preserved. The result also weakens the boundary between language pretraining and visual pretraining, especially for domains where reasoning depends on notation, layout, and diagrams.
summary_en.technical_approach: Visual Pretraining renders scientific PDF pages as images, filters foreground visual patches, represents them as latent tokens in a frozen visual-feature space, and trains the model with next visual latent prediction. The visual sequence is therefore part of the predictive target, rather than an auxiliary condition for text generation. The matched Text Pretraining baseline uses MinerU2.5-parsed text from the same PDFs and applies standard text-token prediction. VP and TP share the same starting checkpoint, the same underlying document corpus, the same continued-pretraining stage, and the same supervised fine-tuning stage. This design isolates the document representation variable. The main technical contribution is the autoregressive visual-latent objective for document pages, together with a controlled comparison showing that preserving layout and visual structure can improve downstream text-only reasoning. The paper also reports stronger cross-modal alignment: matched visual and textual document embeddings move closer in the shared representation space, without explicit image-text pair supervision.
summary_en.experiments: The main results cover Qwen 3.5, Qwen 3, Llama 3.2 Vision, and Llama 3.1, evaluated on MMLU-Pro, GPQA Diamond, AIME 2025, and HLE. GPQA is reported as average pass@8, AIME 2025 as the average over 32 runs, and MMLU-Pro and HLE as pass@1. On Qwen 3.5, TP scores 83.91/76.24/89.58/15.70 on MMLU-Pro, GPQA, AIME, and HLE, while VP reaches 85.09/79.29/90.21/16.67. On Qwen 3, TP scores 81.52/74.94/74.99/11.39, while VP reaches 81.94/77.08/76.98/11.77.
