On Llama 3.2 Vision, TP scores 50.60/30.24/13.75/6.08, while VP reaches 51.52/33.08/18.54/7.00, with a clear AIME gain. On Llama 3.1, TP scores 60.64/43.88/23.65/6.79, while VP reaches 62.77/47.10/24.27/7.17. The paper also reports that VP surpasses TP while using only 25% of the token budget on the same underlying document corpus. That efficiency claim is more important than any single benchmark delta, because it suggests that visual document latents can carry reasoning-relevant information more compactly than extracted text in this domain.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read it closely in about 45 to 60 minutes. Start with Figure 1 to understand the matched TP versus VP design: the same PDFs are either parsed into text or rendered into page images. Then study the method details: foreground patch filtering, frozen visual-latent construction, sequence ordering, and the next visual latent prediction loss. Table 1 is the key empirical anchor; compare Base, TP, and VP row by row, and check whether gains hold for both multimodal and language-only backbones. The scaling and token-budget experiments deserve careful attention, especially the definition of the 25% token budget. Finally, inspect the representation-alignment analysis, including the t-SNE visualization and Table 2. The main questions worth probing are whether the choice of visual encoder limits scaling, whether patch order injects useful or harmful bias, whether gains come from preserving layout versus avoiding parser errors, and whether the result transfers beyond clean scientific PDFs.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改变“先 OCR 成文本再预训练”的默认动作；优先看同语料视觉/文本对照实验和失败案例。
recommendation.en: This directly challenges the OCR-then-pretrain default; read the matched-corpus visual-vs-text ablations and the failure cases first.

institutions: University of Science and Technology of China
Scalable Visual Pretraining for Language Intelligence

paper.title: Infinity-Parser2 Technical Report
paper.abstract: We present Infinity-Parser2, a large multimodal model that couples a controllable data-synthesis pipeline with multi-task reinforcement learning for end-to-end document parsing, addressing the persistent scarcity of faithfully annotated parsing corpora. Our contributions are threefold. First, we build a scalable synthesis engine, pairing a controllable rendering framework with an iterative refinement loop, and use it to construct and open-source Infinity-Doc2-5M: a 5-million-sample bilingual (Ch

summary.core_problem: 解决端到端文档解析缺少高保真标注语料的问题，覆盖版面、表格、公式、图表、化学式和阅读顺序等复杂结构。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态文档理解系统报告，核心亮点是 500 万规模中英双语合成语料 Infinity-Doc2-5M，以及可验证多任务 reward 支撑的联合强化学习；对多模态预训练的数据合成和 reward 设计有间接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法包括可控渲染框架、迭代式数据精修循环、全页元素框和规范内容形式标注，并将 Markdown、HTML、LaTeX、SMILES、结构化图表和阅读顺序统一到文档解析训练中；训练侧提出跨八个目标的 verifiable reward，并进行 Joint Reinforcement Learning。
summary.experiments: 语料规模为 500 万样本，覆盖中英文和多类文档；八个联合目标包括文档解析、布局分析、表格解析、数学公式解析、图表解析、化学公式解析、文档 VQA 和通用多模态理解。摘要未提供模型参数量、基线、具体指标或提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The report tackles the shortage of faithfully annotated corpora for end-to-end document parsing across layout, tables, formulas, charts, chemical structures, and reading order.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a multimodal document-understanding system report, highlighted by the 5M-sample bilingual Infinity-Doc2-5M synthetic corpus and a verifiable multi-task reward setup for joint reinforcement learning. It is indirectly useful for multimodal data synthesis and reward design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The system combines controllable rendering, iterative data refinement, full-page element boxes, canonical content annotations, and unified targets such as Markdown, HTML, LaTeX, SMILES, structured charts, and reading order. It then trains with verifiable rewards across eight co-trained objectives.
summary_en.experiments: The corpus contains 5 million Chinese-English samples across diverse document types. The eight objectives include document parsing, layout analysis, table parsing, math formula parsing, chart parsing, chemical formula parsing, document VQA, and general multimodal understanding. The supplied abstract does not include parameter counts, baselines, metrics, or quantitative gains.

recommendation.zh: 只看数据合成闭环和可验证 reward 设计；任务偏文档解析，别把结论外推到通用 VLM pretrain。
recommendation.en: Read only the synthesis loop and verifiable-reward design; the task is document parsing, so avoid overextending it to general VLM pretraining.

paper.title: When Thinking Hurts: Epistemic Signals in the Reasoning Chains of Visual Language Models
paper.abstract: Uncertainty quantification for visual language models (VLMs) conventionally targets the answer token distribution. We provide the first three-family empirical characterisation of answer entropy behaviour in thinking-mode VLMs. Running four models on identical POPE adversarial samples, we find three qualitatively distinct patterns: Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking shows complete collapse (ans H AUROC = 0.492); GLM-4.1V-9B-Thinking shows no collapse (0.716); and InternVL3-8B shows selective thinking (chains o

summary.core_problem: 带显式<think>推理链的思考模式视觉语言模型（VLM）上，传统依赖答案token分布熵的不确定性量化方法会失效——推理链作为强条件先验会坍缩答案分布，破坏原有方法依赖的认知信号。目前缺少对不同思考模式VLM该类失效模式的系统性实证刻画，也没有适配这类模型的低成本可靠幻觉检测方案。
summary.importance: 研究证实答案分布坍缩是训练配方导致的现象，而非思考模式解码的必然属性，为推理模型的RL/后训练配方设计提供了可落地的观测依据：训练阶段可以通过目标设计保留答案分布的置信度信号。同时提出的零额外推理成本的幻觉检测与拒识方案，可直接迁移到所有部署态的推理式VLM，甚至纯文本o1风格模型上。
summary.technical_approach: 首先设计控制变量实验，对比同视觉编码器、同底座的Qwen3-VL-8B思考版与非思考版在完全相同的POPE对抗样本上的表现，分离思考模式本身对答案熵信号的影响。随后在POPE、HallusionBench两个基准上，对三款主流思考模式VLM（Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking、GLM-4.1V-9B-Thinking、InternVL3-8B）开展跨家族对比，评估两类不确定性信号的幻觉检测性能：一类是传统的答案token平均熵，另一类是贪婪解码的免费副产品——从思考链提取的信号，包括思考链token平均熵、思考链长度、是否生成思考链的二元标记。最终基于这些信号构建无额外计算开销的拒识门控策略。
summary.experiments: 核心结果包括：1）控制变量实验中，非思考版Qwen3-VL的答案熵检测幻觉AUROC达0.899，思考版直接跌至0.492（接近随机猜测水平），确认坍缩由思考模式本身导致；2）跨模型观测到三类 qualitatively 不同的行为模式：Qwen为完全坍缩，GLM未发生完全坍缩（答案熵AUROC 0.716），InternVL为选择性思考（仅50%样本生成思考链），证明坍缩不是思考模式的固有属性；3）在生成思考链的样本上，思考链熵的检测性能一致优于答案熵：Qwen上0.647 vs 0.492，GLM上0.759 vs 0.716；对InternVL而言，是否生成思考链本身就是强信号——跳过思考的样本误检率是生成思考样本的2倍以上；4）基于拒识策略（拒绝低置信度、思考链过长的样本），POPE数据集上准确率从71.0%提升至93.8%，对应覆盖率62.7%；5）识别出两类不同的失效机制：POPE上为过度推理导致错误，HallusionBench上为思考链即时坍缩导致错误。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注引言中的控制变量实验结果、结果部分的三类模型行为模式划分、拒识门控的设计逻辑，无需深究熵计算的公式细节，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Conventional uncertainty quantification methods for vision language models (VLMs), which rely on entropy of the answer token distribution, break down for thinking-mode VLMs that generate explicit <think> chains before producing answers. The reasoning chain acts as a strong conditioning prior that collapses the answer distribution and erases the epistemic signals traditional methods depend on. No systematic empirical characterization of this failure exists across model families, nor are there low-cost, reliable hallucination detection signals tailored for thinking-mode VLMs.
summary_en.importance: The finding that answer distribution collapse is tied to training recipes rather than being an inherent property of thinking-mode decoding provides actionable feedback for post-training and RL pipeline design for reasoning models, showing it is possible to preserve usable confidence signals in answer distributions even with explicit chain-of-thought generation. The zero-overhead hallucination detection and abstention gate proposed can be directly applied to deployed reasoning VLMs, with relevance to both multimodal and text-only o1-style models.
summary_en.technical_approach: First run a controlled ablation comparing Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking against non-thinking Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct (identical vision encoder and base model, differing only in thinking chain generation) on matched POPE adversarial samples to isolate the causal effect of thinking mode on answer entropy signals. Then compare uncertainty signal performance across three mainstream thinking VLMs on POPE and HallusionBench: conventional answer token entropy, and free byproducts of greedy decoding extracted from thinking chains, including mean per-token entropy over think tokens, chain length, and a binary indicator of whether a chain is generated at all. Use these signals to build a practical abstention gate with no additional inference cost.
summary_en.experiments: Key results include: 1) Controlled ablation: answer entropy achieves 0.899 AUROC for hallucination detection on non-thinking Qwen3-VL, dropping to 0.492 (near random) on the thinking variant, confirming collapse is caused by thinking mode itself; 2) Three distinct behavioral patterns across models: complete collapse for Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking, no collapse for GLM-4.1V-9B-Thinking (0.716 answer entropy AUROC), and selective thinking for InternVL3-8B (chains generated on only 50% of samples), proving collapse is not a universal property of thinking decoding; 3) On samples with chains, thinking chain entropy consistently outperforms answer entropy: 0.647 vs 0.492 on Qwen, 0.759 vs 0.716 on GLM; for InternVL, chain presence is a strong signal, with false positive rate more than twice as high on samples where the model skips thinking; 4) The abstention gate (rejecting low-confidence samples and samples with overly long chains) raises POPE accuracy from 71.0% to 93.8% at 62.7% coverage; 5) Two distinct failure modes are identified: over-deliberation on POPE, and immediate chain collapse on HallusionBench.
summary_en.reading_guide: This empirical characterization requires no deep technical background to absorb. Focus on the controlled ablation result in the introduction, the three-way behavioral classification across model families in the results section, and the abstention gate design. There is no need to work through mathematical definitions in detail; expected reading time is 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: thinking VLM不确定性的实证分析，跨模型熵坍塌差异对推理预训练有参考价值，读摘要和实验部分即可。
recommendation.en: Empirical analysis of uncertainty in thinking VLMs; cross-model entropy collapse differences are informative for reasoning pretraining, read abstract and experiments only.

paper.title: When Structured Sparse Autoencoders Learn Consistent Concepts Across Modalities
paper.abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have emerged as a promising technique for mechanistic interpretability by learning a set of sparse latent features in large models, each of which encodes a distinct concept. However, in vision-language models (VLMs), vanilla SAEs struggle to learn modality-consistent concepts, with concepts often exhibiting fragmented coverage (i.e., disjoint regions) in the visual modality. To address this challenge, we propose a Structured Sparse AutoEncoder ($S^2AE$) that enforces c

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 中 vanilla SAE 学到的稀疏概念在视觉模态上不连续、不一致，难以形成跨模态可解释概念的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制解释方法改进。它不是预训练方法，但触及 VLM 表征是否能被稳定分解为跨模态概念，对分析视觉 token、patch attention 与语言概念对齐有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Structured Sparse AutoEncoder，即 S²AE。在训练 SAE 时，先根据 Transformer attention 相似度和空间邻近性对图像 patch 分组，再加入结构化稀疏正则：组间使用 exclusive sparsity 促进概念解耦，组内使用 group sparsity 促进同一语义区域内概念一致激活。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 VLM、参数规模、数据规模和数值结果。实验重点应是比较 vanilla SAE 与 S²AE 在视觉区域覆盖、跨模态概念一致性和概念碎片化程度上的差异。

summary_en.core_problem: The work targets the failure of vanilla SAEs to learn modality-consistent concepts in VLMs, especially fragmented visual coverage across image regions.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic interpretability method contribution. It does not directly improve pretraining, but it is useful for studying how VLM representations bind visual patches to language-level concepts.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed S²AE groups image patches using Transformer attention similarity and spatial proximity. It then trains an SAE with structured sparsity: exclusive sparsity encourages inter-group disentanglement, while group sparsity encourages intra-group consistency of concept activations.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model scale, data scale, or quantitative gains. The expected comparison is against vanilla SAE on concept consistency, visual coverage, and fragmentation metrics in VLM representations.

recommendation.zh: 可扫 regularizer 设计；它给 VLM SAE 一个更干净的空间先验，但离 pretrain recipe 还远。
recommendation.en: Skim the regularizer; it adds a useful spatial prior for VLM SAEs, but it is far from a pretraining recipe.

paper.title: HIVE: Understanding Post-Hallucination Reasoning in Vision Language Models
paper.abstract: Hallucinations in vision language models (VLMs) are commonly treated as semantic errors, yet they often arise from partial or ambiguous visual evidence. Prior work mainly focuses on detecting or suppressing hallucinations at generation time, leaving the subsequent reasoning stage largely unexplored. In this work, we study Post Hallucination Reasoning (PHR), the stage in which hallucinated semantics enter the model's inference context and influence downstream predictions. To systematically invest

summary.core_problem: 研究 VLM 在生成幻觉内容之后，幻觉语义进入推理上下文并影响后续预测的过程。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评测与机制分析。它把幻觉从“生成时错误”扩展到“后续推理变量”，并提出 HIVE 来控制比较忠实 caption 与幻觉 caption 对不同任务的影响。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Hallucination Inference and Verification Engine，通过构造或选择 faithful 与 hallucinated captions，在相同下游输入条件下观察模型推理变化。方法重点不是抑制幻觉，而是隔离幻觉线索进入上下文后的因果影响。
summary.experiments: 在九类任务和九个 VLM 上做对照实验。摘要称 hallucinated captions 在视觉-语言任务上经常提升准确率，而在纯文本任务上效果有限或不稳定；进一步分析显示幻觉线索会扩展语义覆盖并改变推理动态。具体模型规模、数据量和提升幅度未在摘要中给出。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies what happens after a VLM has produced a hallucinated semantic cue and that cue becomes part of the reasoning context.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an evaluation and analysis setup. It reframes hallucination not only as a generation-time error, but also as a downstream reasoning variable that can alter predictions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce HIVE, the Hallucination Inference and Verification Engine, to run controlled comparisons between faithful and hallucinated captions. The setup isolates how hallucinated cues affect later inference rather than trying to suppress them during decoding.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers nine tasks and nine models. The abstract reports that hallucinated captions often improve accuracy on vision-language tasks, while text-only tasks show limited or unstable effects. Model sizes, datasets, and exact gains are not specified in the provided abstract.

recommendation.zh: 结论有点反直觉：幻觉不总是坏信号；只看实验设置和按任务拆分的结果即可。
recommendation.en: The useful bit is the counter-prior result: hallucinations are not uniformly harmful; read the setup and task-wise breakdown.

paper.title: BUS: Brain-Inspired Unsupervised Self-Reflection for Advanced Multimodal Reasoning
paper.abstract: Current Vision-Language Models (VLMs) often struggle to handle complex visual tasks that require consistent and fine-grained reasoning. Recent methods aim to train models to facilitate self-reflective reasoning, i.e., reviewing and improving the generated reasoning. However, they require large volumes of annotated data and lack explicit reflective behavior during test time. This work aims to bridge this gap through inspiration from neuroscience. The human brain exhibits efficient backward predic

summary.core_problem: 现有VLM自反思推理方法依赖大量标注数据，且测试时无显式反思行为，难以处理复杂细粒度视觉推理任务。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出无监督的脑启发自反思训练框架，无需真值标签即可增强VLM的反思推理能力。
summary.technical_approach: 受神经科学反向预测机制启发，先验证主流VLM具备从未来状态反向预测前置状态的能力；再提出BUS框架，让VLM通过反向预测生成无监督学习信号，训练反思推理能力，测试时显式执行反思迭代步骤。
summary.experiments: 在多个复杂图像分析推理任务上开展验证，对比现有有监督自反思方法，无监督训练的BUS可取得相当甚至更优的性能，未披露具体模型参数量与训练数据规模。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing VLM self-reflective reasoning methods rely on large amounts of annotated data and lack explicit reflective behavior during test time, failing to handle complex fine-grained visual reasoning tasks.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: a brain-inspired unsupervised self-reflection training framework that enhances VLM reflective reasoning capability without ground-truth labels.
summary_en.technical_approach: Inspired by the backward prediction mechanism in neuroscience, first verifies mainstream VLMs have the ability to predict preceding states from future states; then proposes the BUS framework, which uses backward prediction to generate unsupervised learning signals for training reflective reasoning, with explicit iterative reflection steps at test time.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on multiple complex image analysis and reasoning tasks; compared with existing supervised self-reflection methods, unsupervised-trained BUS achieves comparable or even better performance; no specific model parameter count or training data scale disclosed.

recommendation.zh: VLM自反思训练的增量探索，无监督反向预测信号设计有微弱启发，仅看摘要与§3方法部分即可。
recommendation.en: Incremental exploration of VLM self-reflection training; weak insights on unsupervised backward prediction signal design, only check abstract and §3 Method section.

paper.title: Bridging Physical Reasoning and Task Generalization via Visual Action Outcome Reasoning Alignment
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) struggle to generalize in interactive physical reasoning, particularly under unseen tasks and environments. Two key failure modes are prominent: hallucinated chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning that contradicts physical reality, and misalignment between the model's reasoning and actions. We present VAORA (Visual Action Outcome Reasoning Alignment), a novel reward design that directly addresses both issues. VAORA introduces two complementary rewards: Visual Alignment Re

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 在交互式物理推理中面对未见任务和环境时，推理内容脱离视觉现实、且 reasoning 与 action 不一致的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个 VLM 后训练/对齐方向的工作，关注 reasoning-action alignment 与物理一致性。对预训练研究员的价值主要在于：它暴露了视觉推理模型在交互环境中的失配模式，以及奖励设计如何约束语言推理贴近环境反馈。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 VAORA 奖励设计，包含两部分：Visual Alignment Reward，用于约束推理与当前视觉上下文一致；Visual-Action Alignment Reward，用于约束推理与模型动作导致的视觉结果一致。为提升训练稳定性，作者还利用预训练领域内 expert agent 估计成功概率，构造更平滑、更稠密的奖励信号。
summary.experiments: 在 PHYRE 和 Virtual Tool 等交互式物理推理环境上实验，目标是提升未见任务和环境下的泛化。摘要强调其能减少 hallucinated CoT 并缩小 reasoning-behavior gap，但未给出模型规模、训练数据量和具体提升幅度。实验更偏任务对齐而非基座模型训练。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Ming-Hsuan Yang、Yu-Chiang Frank Wang。仅从摘要无法确认完整机构信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a failure mode of VLMs in interactive physical reasoning: under unseen tasks and environments, their chain-of-thought can contradict visual reality and become misaligned with the actions they take.
summary_en.importance: This is a VLM post-training/alignment paper focused on reasoning-action alignment and physical consistency. Its value to pretraining researchers is mostly diagnostic: it exposes where visually grounded reasoning breaks in interactive settings and how reward design can tether language reasoning to environmental feedback.
summary_en.technical_approach: VAORA introduces two rewards: a Visual Alignment Reward that anchors reasoning to the current visual context, and a Visual-Action Alignment Reward that anchors reasoning to the visual outcome induced by the model's action. To stabilize training, the method uses a pretrained in-domain expert agent to estimate success probabilities and provide smoother, denser rewards.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted on interactive physical reasoning environments such as PHYRE and Virtual Tool, with a focus on generalization to unseen tasks and environments. The abstract claims reduced hallucinated CoT and a smaller reasoning-behavior gap, but does not report model sizes, data scale, or exact gains. The setup is more task-alignment oriented than foundation-model training oriented.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Ming-Hsuan Yang and Yu-Chiang Frank Wang. Full institutional affiliation cannot be confirmed from the abstract alone.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练论文，但它把“reasoning 看起来对”和“action 真能落地”拆成两个奖励，诊断味道比方法味道更重；只看奖励定义和失败案例就够了。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the split between visually grounded reasoning and action-outcome alignment is a useful diagnostic lens; reading the reward design and failure cases is enough.

paper.title: Analysis-by-Proxy: Localization Signals in VLMs Operating as Condition Encoders
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly utilized as the conditioning backbone for diffusion-based image editing due to their remarkable multimodal reasoning capabilities. While standalone VLMs demonstrate strong localization capabilities, editing pipelines frequently struggle to maintain this accuracy, particularly in complex, multi-entity scenes. In this work, we investigate this performance gap, hypothesizing that it stems from treating the VLM as a condition encoder. In this role, the

summary.core_problem: 解释为什么 VLM 单独使用时具备较强定位能力，但作为扩散图像编辑管线的条件编码器时，复杂多实体场景中的空间定位会明显退化。
summary.importance: 贡献是机制分析方法：它关注 VLM 表征在跨模态生成系统中的使用方式，而不是单纯改图像编辑指标；对理解 VLM encoder-only 调用和 AR 生成式调用的能力差异有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Analysis-by-Proxy：冻结或读取 VLM 中间表征，训练轻量、可解释的 proxy model 执行辅助定位任务，用 proxy 的表现来判断空间信息是否仍存在于 VLM hidden states 中。
summary.experiments: 实验围绕扩散式图像编辑中的 VLM 条件编码场景展开，对比 standalone VLM 的定位能力与作为单次 forward condition encoder 时的信号可用性；摘要未给出具体 VLM、扩散模型、数据规模或数值结果。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Daniel Cohen-Or 和 Or Patashnik，相关团队长期做视觉生成、图像编辑与表示分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why VLMs can localize objects well as standalone models but lose localization fidelity when used as condition encoders inside diffusion-based image editing pipelines.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a mechanism-analysis tool rather than a new editing model; it is relevant for understanding how VLM representations change when used through a single encoder pass instead of their native autoregressive generation mode.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes Analysis-by-Proxy: train a lightweight interpretable proxy on intermediate VLM representations with an auxiliary localization objective, then use the proxy to inspect whether spatial information is still present in hidden states.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments target VLM-conditioned diffusion editing, contrasting standalone localization behavior with the information exposed under condition-encoder usage; the abstract does not provide exact model names, data scale, or quantitative results.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Daniel Cohen-Or and Or Patashnik, whose groups are known for work on visual generation, image editing, and representation analysis.

recommendation.zh: 只看 proxy 设计和定位信号分析即可；它提醒别把 VLM 单次 encoder 表征等同于完整 AR 能力。
recommendation.en: Skim the proxy design and localization analysis; it is a useful warning against equating one-pass VLM embeddings with full AR capability.

paper.title: Do GUI Agents Believe Their Eyes? Diagnosing State-Belief Reliance on Pixels versus Structure
paper.abstract: Multimodal GUI agents read an interface through two redundant channels: the rendered pixels of a screenshot and a serialized structure such as a DOM or accessibility tree. Before acting, an agent forms a belief about the current interface state, but existing benchmarks score task success, element grounding, or attack resistance and do not ask whether that belief is drawn from the pixels. We formalize visual state reliance, the attribution of a state belief to pixels, structure, or priors, and me

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文评测 GUI 多模态 Agent 的状态信念来源：模型在同时看到截图和 DOM/accessibility tree 等结构化输入时，是否真的依据像素形成对界面状态的判断，还是直接跟随结构化文本。
summary.importance: 这是一篇偏评测和诊断的工作，对 VLM/GUI Agent 预训练与 post-train 都有启发。它指出一个常被任务成功率掩盖的问题：模型可以在 image-only 条件下正确读屏，但在图像和结构冲突时仍采用结构中的值。对原生多模态预训练来说，这说明“能看懂图像”和“融合时优先相信图像”不是同一个能力。对 Agent 训练来说，它提示 action interface 会改变模型依赖哪个通道，结构化动作空间可能放大对 DOM 或 accessibility tree 的依赖。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 visual state reliance，并用配对 single-channel intervention 测量信念归因。每个 probe 包含真实截图、结构化表示、目标区域、离散状态变量和像素定义的 gold value。核心对照是让截图保持真实值 a，同时把结构化输入中的对应值改成冲突值 b；如果模型回答 b，就说明融合后的状态信念跟随结构。Perception-Fusion Gap 条件化在模型 image-only 感知正确的样本上，衡量模型从“看得对”到“融合时信错通道”的差距。数据由规则编辑构造，不用模型生成 item，也不用模型 judge，评分采用 deterministic forced choice。论文还做了白盒 ablation：删除冲突结构值比删除等长随机片段更容易让答案回到像素，说明结构中的冲突值有因果作用。最后通过 live environment 和 action-output format 对照，验证这种信念来源会影响实际点击行为。
summary.experiments: 数据集包含 310 个真实 web、mobile、desktop probe，冲突由规则化编辑生成，两名标注者验证，一致性 κ=0.83。评测包括两个本地运行的开源 VLM，以及三个 OpenAI 模型。主要结果是：在 textual web state 上，所有五个模型即使 image-only 准确率接近上限，也会在融合输入中转向冲突的结构化值，因此 PFG 为正；在 non-text identity，如图标、控件类型等状态上，能力较强的模型更多保持 pixel-bound，说明问题不能简单归因于 OCR 不足。live task 中，冲突会让 Agent 点击结构中命名的元素并导致任务失败。保持模型不变，只改变动作输出格式时，结构命名式 action 会提高 structure-following，坐标式 action 会显著降低该倾向。一个无需训练的 consistency gate 在检测冲突后重新 grounding，能降低 web hijack，同时基本不损害通道一致时的行为，但它仍是启发式自检，不是完整防御。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Problem Formulation 中 probe 的定义、Table 1 的干预条件，以及 Perception-Fusion Gap 的计算方式。实验部分优先看 textual state 与 non-text identity 的分组结果，因为这能区分“视觉能力不足”和“融合时通道偏置”。如果关注 GUI Agent 训练，应看 action-output format 的对照实验，它直接说明接口设计会改变模型信念来源。consistency gate 可以快速浏览，更多是工程缓解方案，不是核心科学结论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether multimodal GUI agents base their state beliefs on pixels when screenshots and structured inputs, such as DOMs or accessibility trees, are both available. The target failure mode is not inability to read the screen, but deferring to structure even when the pixels are read correctly.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation and diagnostic paper, but it has clear implications for VLM pretraining and GUI-agent post-training. It separates visual perception from multimodal fusion. A model can succeed in an image-only setting and still choose the wrong source when pixels and structure disagree. For native multimodal training, this suggests that grounding should be evaluated under controlled channel conflict, not only under aligned inputs. For agent training, the paper also shows that the action interface can bias the model toward structural strings rather than screen evidence.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper formalizes visual state reliance through paired single-channel interventions. Each probe contains a real screenshot, a serialized structure, a target region, a discrete state variable, and a gold value defined by what is visible in the pixels. The main contrast keeps the screenshot at the true value a while editing the corresponding structural value to a conflicting value b. If the model answers b under the fused input, its belief is attributed to structure. The Perception-Fusion Gap is computed on probes where the model is correct in the image-only condition, so it measures a failure of fusion rather than a failure of perception. The benchmark avoids model-generated items and model judges: conflicts are rule-based edits and answers are deterministic forced choices. The paper further uses white-box ablations to show that removing the conflicting structural value restores pixel-following more often than removing a random span, which gives causal evidence for structural copying.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 310 probes from real web, mobile, and desktop interfaces. Conflicts are generated by controlled edits and validated by two annotators with κ = 0.83. The evaluation covers two locally run open-weight VLMs and three OpenAI models. On textual web states, all five models defer to the conflicting structural value despite near-ceiling image-only accuracy, yielding a positive Perception-Fusion Gap. On non-text identity states such as icons and widget types, stronger models remain more pixel-bound, which rules out a simple OCR-only explanation. In live environments, the mis-sourced belief changes behavior: agents tap the structure-named element and fail the task. A within-model control shows that structured action outputs increase structure-following, while coordinate outputs reduce it. A training-free consistency gate that re-grounds when conflict is detected reduces the web hijack without a clear degradation on aligned cases, though it remains a heuristic check.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 to 30 minutes. Start with the probe definition and intervention table, since the contribution depends on clean channel isolation. Then read the Perception-Fusion Gap metric carefully; the conditioning on correct image-only perception is the key design choice. In the results, focus on the split between textual states and non-text identity, and on the action-output-format control. The consistency gate is useful as an engineering mitigation, but the more important result is the diagnosis of channel reliance under conflict.

recommendation.zh: 非常干净的诊断性评测，揭示了多模态模型在处理冗余输入（像素 vs 结构）时的偏好（更依赖文本结构），对 VLM 预训练中图文对齐和多模态融合策略有直接启发。
recommendation.en: A very clean diagnostic evaluation revealing VLM preference (structure over pixels) when handling redundant inputs. Highly relevant for multimodal fusion and alignment strategies in VLM pretraining.

paper.title: RL Forgets! Towards Continual Policy Optimization
paper.abstract: Continual post-training is becoming a central paradigm for adapting vision-language models to evolving tasks. Recent work has increasingly favored reinforcement learning over supervised fine-tuning, driven by the belief that reinforcement learning is inherently less prone to forgetting. However, the belief remains insufficiently validated, as existing evidence is largely drawn from outdated or homogeneous benchmarks. To revisit this assumption, we introduce MRCL, a Multimodal Reasoning Continual

summary.core_problem: 验证了「RL天然比SFT更抗遗忘」的现有结论存在偏差，在多模态持续后训练场景下，现有RL算法（如GRPO）仍会出现严重灾难性遗忘，同时需要在不存储旧任务数据（无回放）的前提下解决RL持续学习的遗忘问题。
summary.importance: 修正了领域对RL抗遗忘特性的普遍误解，提出的无回放持续RL框架可直接复用在LLM/VLM的持续预训练/后训练流程中，对需要持续迭代的基座模型训练有实际工程价值；构建的MRCL基准解决了旧基准与预训练语料重叠导致的评估失真问题。
summary.technical_approach: 首先构建MRCL基准，全部采用2025年下半年之后发布的多模态推理数据集，避免预训练数据污染；理论分析指出GRPO的当前任务KL约束无法约束旧任务上的行为漂移，因为KL计算基于新任务分布；提出CPO（持续策略优化）：在旧任务训练阶段累计记录高参数移动量的权重子集，新任务训练时对这部分受保护参数施加稀疏移动正则，用参数空间的移动量近似替代无法计算的旧任务分布KL约束，全程不需要存储旧数据。
summary.experiments: 在MRCL基准上测试，GRPO等现有RL算法的遗忘程度与SFT相当，推翻了RL天然抗遗忘的结论；在Qwen3-VL-8B上，CPO相比基线将遗忘率降低13.7%，同时预训练基础能力提升7.0%；多模型规模的实验均验证了CPO的有效性。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注第3章的理论分析（为什么GRPO的KL不能抗遗忘）和第4章CPO的核心设计；MRCL基准的构建细节可按需参考，预计阅读时间25-35分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Validates that the prevailing belief of "RL is inherently more forgetting-resistant than SFT" is biased. Existing RL algorithms (e.g., GRPO) still suffer from severe catastrophic forgetting in multimodal continual post-training, and the work addresses this issue under a replay-free setting where no historical task data is stored.
summary_en.importance: Corrects a widespread misconception about RL's forgetting resistance in the community. The proposed replay-free continual RL framework can be directly integrated into continual pretraining/post-training pipelines for LLMs and VLMs, delivering practical engineering value for iteratively updated base models. The MRCL benchmark also eliminates evaluation distortion caused by overlap between legacy benchmarks and pretraining corpora.
summary_en.technical_approach: First constructs the MRCL benchmark, consisting exclusively of multimodal reasoning datasets released after H2 2025 to avoid pretraining data contamination. Theoretical analysis shows GRPO's on-policy KL constraint (computed on new task distribution) fails to restrict behavioral drift on old tasks. Proposes Continual Policy Optimization (CPO): during training on historical tasks, it accumulates a subset of parameters with high movement magnitudes; during training on new tasks, it applies sparse movement regularization to this protected subset, using parameter-space movement as a surrogate for the intractable old-task distribution KL constraint, without storing any historical data.
summary_en.experiments: Tests on MRCL show existing RL algorithms like GRPO exhibit forgetting levels comparable to SFT, disproving the claim of inherent RL forgetting resistance. On Qwen3-VL-8B, CPO reduces forgetting rate by 13.7% over baselines while improving pretrained base capability by 7.0%. Consistent gains are observed across multiple model scales.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 (theoretical analysis of why GRPO's KL fails to prevent forgetting) and Section 4 (core design of CPO). Skim MRCL construction details as needed. Estimated reading time: 25-35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验设定和遗忘曲线；它会削弱“RL 天然保能力”的 prior，但需确认 MRCL 任务序列是否干净。
recommendation.en: Read the setup and forgetting curves; it weakens the prior that RL naturally preserves skills, but MRCL’s task ordering needs scrutiny.

paper.title: Is the Geometry Doing the Work? An Operating-Point Audit of Hierarchy in Hyperbolic Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Whether a hyperbolic representation model uses its geometry cannot be read off its curvature parameter: what matters is the dimensionless operating point $\sqrt{c}ρ$ and whether the radial and cone machinery is active there. We develop a battery of necessary-condition diagnostics and audit three published hyperbolic vision-language families -- MERU, HyCoCLIP, and PHyCLIP -- across released checkpoints and controlled interventions on a fixed GRIT snapshot, identifying three failure modes. First,

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文审计了一个具体问题：现有 hyperbolic VLM 是否真的使用了负曲率几何来编码层级关系，还是只是在近似欧氏空间里获得了普通对比学习收益。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于评估表征机制时不能只看最终 benchmark，也不能只看曲率参数是否非零。论文提出了 operating point 的概念，即嵌入实际落在双曲空间的什么半径和曲率组合上。若无量纲量 sqrt(c)ρ 很小，模型虽然形式上在双曲空间里，实际计算仍接近欧氏。这个结论对多模态表征学习、层级语义建模和非欧几何预训练都有警示意义：结构先验只有在训练动态把模型推到相应工作区间时才会生效，否则会退化成参数化装饰。
summary.technical_approach: 论文不是提出新模型，而是提出一组必要条件诊断，并用它审计 MERU、HyCoCLIP、PHyCLIP 三类 hyperbolic vision-language model。核心指标是无量纲 operating point sqrt(c)ρ，其中 c 是曲率，ρ 是 embedding 半径尺度。作者检查模型是否进入非欧几何显著的区域，而不是只检查可学习曲率的数值。诊断还包括：双曲度量相对欧氏度量的放大因子 H(u) 是否显著偏离 1；entailment cone 的孔径是否饱和或与语义方向错位；径向深度是否能区分 parent-child 关系；taxonomy-distance correlation 是否由角度相似性而非径向层级贡献；norm-ordering 分数是否经得起 shuffle-null control。机制分析部分进一步做 per-loss gradient decomposition，显示 entailment objective 存在 low-curvature shortcut：降低曲率会放宽 cone aperture，从而减少 violation，但并不需要学到真实的有向层级。
summary.experiments: 论文覆盖三类模型家族：MERU、HyCoCLIP、PHyCLIP，包括 7 个公开 checkpoint，并在固定的 current-GRIT snapshot 上训练匹配 baseline 和干预模型。主要发现包括：公开和重训模型的 operating point 都接近欧氏区间，sqrt(c)ρ 约为 0.2 到 0.3，未观察到收敛 checkpoint 达到 sqrt(c)ρ > 1；释放 curvature floor 会改变参数化中的 c 和 norm，但不会把模型带入有效双曲工作区间，下游 retrieval、compositionality、zero-shot 等指标也没有明显退化。cone 相关机制被测为不活跃：孔径饱和或方向不匹配，controlled readout 下 graded traversal 失败。外部 parent-child 径向排序在 shuffle-null control 之上没有可靠信号。梯度审计显示，在被探测的两个模型家族、三个随机种子上，collapse 阶段 entailment loss 对曲率的梯度持续向下，强于 contrastive loss 和附加 depth signal；去掉 entailment term 后，contrastive/alignment 训练本身也不能维持曲率，因此 entailment shortcut 是加速坍缩的重要因素，但不是唯一原因。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30 到 40 分钟。优先读 Section 4 的 operating-point 分析，确认 sqrt(c)ρ、H(u) 等指标如何定义，以及为什么曲率参数本身不足以说明模型在使用双曲几何。然后看 Section 5 的 cone、traversal、radial-depth 诊断，重点关注 shuffle-null control，因为它区分了真实有向层级和 prompt/norm 边际统计。Section 7 的梯度分解值得细读，它解释了为什么增加 entailment loss 反而可能让模型通过降低曲率来逃避约束。若时间有限，可跳过常规下游结果表，把注意力放在机制诊断图、curvature floor intervention、entailment-off ablation 和 taxonomy correlation 的角度/径向分解上。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper audits whether current hyperbolic vision-language models actually use negative curvature to encode hierarchy, or whether they operate in an almost Euclidean regime while gaining performance from ordinary contrastive alignment and regularization.
summary_en.importance: The useful lesson for pretraining research is methodological. A nonzero curvature parameter does not imply that the model is using hyperbolic geometry. What matters is the operating point, especially the dimensionless quantity sqrt(c)ρ. If embeddings stay at small effective radius, the geometry is locally Euclidean and the intended hierarchy mechanism is inactive. This matters for multimodal representation learning and structured inductive biases more generally: adding a geometric prior is not enough unless the optimization dynamics place representations in the regime where the prior has operational effect.
summary_en.technical_approach: The contribution is a diagnostic framework rather than a new model. The authors audit MERU, HyCoCLIP, and PHyCLIP using released checkpoints and matched interventions trained on a fixed current-GRIT snapshot. The central diagnostic is the operating point sqrt(c)ρ, where c is curvature and ρ is the embedding radius scale. They also measure whether the hyperbolic metric amplification H(u) departs from 1, whether entailment cones have meaningful apertures and orientations, whether radial depth orders external parent-child pairs, and whether taxonomy-distance correlations come from angular similarity rather than radial hierarchy. Shuffle-null controls are used to avoid mistaking marginal prompt statistics for directed hierarchy. The mechanistic part decomposes gradients by loss term and shows a low-curvature shortcut in the entailment objective: reducing curvature widens cone apertures and suppresses violations without learning semantic order.
summary_en.experiments: The audit covers three model families, seven released checkpoints, and controlled current-GRIT retraining/intervention runs. The main empirical finding is that all audited configurations remain near Euclidean, with sqrt(c)ρ around 0.2 to 0.3 and no converged evaluated checkpoint reaching sqrt(c)ρ > 1. Releasing the curvature floor changes the parameterization, including c and norms, but does not move the model into an active hyperbolic regime; downstream retrieval, compositionality, and zero-shot metrics remain broadly comparable. Cone mechanisms are measured as inactive: apertures saturate or misalign, and graded traversal fails under controlled readouts. Directed radial depth shows no reliable parent-child ordering above shuffle-null controls. Gradient probes on two families across three seeds show that, during the collapse phase, the entailment loss consistently pushes curvature downward more strongly than contrastive loss or added depth signals can counteract. Removing the entailment term does not restore curvature, so the shortcut accelerates collapse but is not the only cause.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30- to 40-minute skim is recommended. Start with the operating-point analysis in Section 4, especially the definitions of sqrt(c)ρ and H(u), because this is the core audit lens. Then read the cone, traversal, and radial-depth diagnostics in Section 5, paying attention to the shuffle-null controls. Section 7 is the most useful mechanistic part: the per-loss gradient decomposition explains why an entailment objective can reduce violations by lowering curvature rather than by learning hierarchy. If short on time, de-emphasize the standard downstream benchmark tables and focus on the diagnostic plots, curvature-floor interventions, entailment-off ablations, and the angular-versus-radial decomposition of taxonomy correlations.

recommendation.zh: 提出的√cρ工作点诊断法可直接复用，提醒双曲VLM/LLM改进需先验证几何是否真被激活，仅看§3和§4即可。
recommendation.en: The √cρ operating point diagnostic is directly reusable; hyperbolic VLM/LLM improvements must verify geometric activation first; only read §3 and §4.

paper.title: Pathways of Visual Information Flow in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: We study how visual information is routed in vision-language models (VLMs). Using causal patching on controlled synthetic and natural datasets, we find that models rely on two distinct pathways to solve visual tasks: A direct pathway, where visual information is retained in image token representations and read out by the final token at later layers, and a text-mediated pathway, where visual information is first transferred to the query tokens and then read out by the final token. Across three vi

summary.core_problem: 视觉语言模型中视觉信息如何从图像token传递到最终生成token的机制尚不明确，过往基于注意力干预的研究得出了相互矛盾的结论，且干预手段本身可能触发模型的备用通路，导致观测到的机制偏离模型实际使用的通路。
summary.importance: 系统揭示了VLM中存在两条独立的视觉信息流通路，统一了此前研究的分歧；发现通路选择的任务依赖性与灵活切换特性，为VLM的可解释性研究、架构设计优化以及测试时干预方法提供了机制层面的参考，也为多模态预训练的机制理解提供了新的视角。
summary.technical_approach: 采用因果修补（causal patching）方法结合反事实样本，从因果层面识别模型实际使用的信息通路，而非仅判断某通路是否可用。设计三类覆盖不同视觉理解层次的任务：物体识别、空间关系预测、物体定位。同时使用合成数据集（可控变量）和自然数据集（验证泛化性），结合注意力敲除、损坏输入修补等干预手段，研究通路的灵活性。实验覆盖Qwen3、InternVL3.5、LLaVA-1.5三个模型家族，验证结论的普适性。
summary.experiments: 1. 确认VLM通过两条不同通路传导视觉信息：直接通路（最终token直接从图像token读取视觉信息）、文本介导通路（视觉信息先转移到查询token的表示中，再被最终token读取）。2. 通路选择具有任务依赖性：空间关系推理任务依赖文本介导通路，物体识别任务主要使用直接通路。3. 数据分布与提示设计会调制通路选择：例如定位任务在合成数据上使用直接通路，在自然数据集上切换为文本介导通路。4. 通路具有灵活备份特性：当直接通路被注意力敲除或输入损坏阻断时，模型可切换到文本介导通路并维持任务性能，这种补偿效应强于纯文本大模型中的备用电路表现。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点为引言部分的研究背景与过往分歧、第2节的因果修补实验设计逻辑，以及核心发现部分的通路分类与任务依赖性结论。重点关注通路示意图与不同任务下的通路选择统计结果，可跳过详细的实验设置细节。预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The mechanism by which visual information flows from image tokens to the final generation token in vision-language models (VLMs) remains poorly understood. Prior studies based on attention interventions have yielded conflicting conclusions, and interventions themselves may trigger fallback pathways in models, leading to observations that reflect alternative rather than normally used mechanisms.
summary_en.importance: This work systematically identifies two distinct visual information flow pathways in VLMs, reconciling discrepancies in previous research. The findings of task-dependent pathway selection and flexible switching provide mechanistic references for VLM interpretability research, architecture optimization, and test-time intervention design, and offer a new perspective for understanding multimodal pretraining mechanisms.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method uses causal patching with counterfactual examples to causally identify information pathways the model actually uses, rather than merely assessing whether a pathway is available. Three tasks covering different levels of visual understanding are designed: object recognition, spatial relation prediction, and object localization. Both synthetic datasets (for controlled variables) and natural datasets (for generalization testing) are used, combined with interventions like attention knockouts and corrupted-input patching to study pathway flexibility. Experiments are conducted across three model families — Qwen3, InternVL3.5, and LLaVA-1.5 — to verify generalizability.
summary_en.experiments: 1. VLMs channel visual information through two distinct pathways: a direct pathway where the final token reads visual information directly from image tokens, and a text-mediated pathway where visual information is first transferred to query token representations and then read by the final token. 2. Pathway selection is task-dependent: spatial relation reasoning relies on the text-mediated pathway, while object recognition primarily uses the direct pathway. 3. Data distribution and prompt design modulate pathway choice: for example, localization tasks use the direct pathway on synthetic data but switch to text-mediation on natural datasets. 4. Pathways function as flexible backups: when the direct pathway is disrupted by attention knockouts or corrupted inputs, models can reroute through the text-mediated pathway and maintain task performance. This compensation effect is stronger than backup circuit behavior observed in text-only LLMs.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the research background and prior disagreements in the introduction, the causal patching experimental design in Section 2, and the core findings of pathway classification and task dependency. Prioritize the pathway schematic and pathway selection statistics across tasks; detailed experimental setup specifics can be skipped. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读 causal patching 结果即可；它提醒 VLM ablation 不是单路径诊断，prompt 改动会换掉内部计算图。
recommendation.en: Read the causal-patching sections; the useful lesson is that VLM ablations may probe a switched computation graph, not a fixed visual pathway.

paper.title: Brand-as-Memory: Vision-Language Models Encode Causal, Mechanistically Localizable Credibility Priors for News Sources
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly read news and web content as images, where the publisher's identity is visually present. We show that VLMs carry a strong source-credibility prior keyed on outlet identity, and study it along three axes. (i) Cross-model benchmark. We introduce CueTrust, a cross-model diagnostic that measures which surface source cue overrides an article's content evidence via a Source-Override Index (SOI). Across seven VLMs and five cues, the vulnerability profile is mo

summary.core_problem: VLM处理新闻类图文内容时是否以及如何编码新闻来源的可信度先验，缺乏跨模型的因果性机制验证
summary.importance: 首次系统验证VLM中存在独立于内容的来源可信度先验，明确了该先验的跨模态触发条件与可定位性
summary.technical_approach: 构建跨模型诊断工具CueTrust，通过Source-Override Index测量不同来源线索对内容证据的覆盖效应；通过仅替换报头等因果干预定位先验编码，分析其与人类媒体可信度评分的相关性
summary.experiments: 在7个VLM上测试5类来源线索，发现仅媒体身份线索（报头、logo、裸域名）可触发可信度偏移，作者名、文中权威、页面布局无显著效应；仅替换报头可导致约11个log-odds的可信度变动，与Media Bias/Fact Check专业评分相关系数rho=0.88（摘要截断）

summary_en.core_problem: Whether and how VLMs encode source credibility priors for news outlets when processing multimodal news content lacks cross-model causal mechanistic validation.
summary_en.importance: Provides the first systematic evidence that VLMs encode content-independent source credibility priors, along with their cross-modal triggering conditions and localizability.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces CueTrust, a cross-model diagnostic that measures how source cues override content evidence via the Source-Override Index; uses causal interventions (swapping only mastheads) to localize prior encoding and correlates outputs with human-rated media credibility scores.
summary_en.experiments: Tests 5 cue types across 7 VLMs, finding that only outlet identity cues (masthead, logo, bare domain) trigger credibility shifts, with no significant effect from author names, in-text authority, or page layout; masthead swaps alone shift credibility by ~11 log-odds, correlating at rho=0.88 with Media Bias/Fact Check ratings (abstract truncated).

recommendation.zh: VLM品牌偏见的个例机制研究，未触及预训练数据或建模的通用规律，作为文献备查即可，不读正文
recommendation.en: A case study of VLM brand credibility bias with no generalizable findings for pretraining data or modeling; keep as reference, skip the main text.

paper.title: MultAttnAttrib: Training-Free Multimodal Attribution in Long Document Question Answering
paper.abstract: As grounded QA systems are increasingly deployed in AI assistants, accurately attributing generated answers to evidence is critical for user trust and model safety. While unimodal attributions have been explored in depth, the multimodal setting remains relatively under-researched. As a result, we introduce MultAttnAttrib, a training-free attribution-generation method that leverages a model's prefill pass, selected attention heads, and calibrated thresholds to locate source evidence within a docu

summary.core_problem: 解决多模态长文档 QA 中答案片段如何自动归因到原始证据位置的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献包括一个 training-free 多模态归因方法和一个细粒度归因评测集。它与 VLM 可靠性、长上下文证据定位和 grounded generation 有关，但不是预训练方法论文。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MultAttnAttrib，利用模型 prefill pass 中的注意力信息，选择特定 attention heads，并通过校准阈值定位文档中的证据区域。方法不训练额外模型，依赖已有多模态模型内部注意力作为归因信号。同时提出 MultAttrEval，用于评估答案组件到多模态源文档证据的细粒度映射。
summary.experiments: 摘要称 MultAttnAttrib 在 MultAttrEval 上稳定优于多种 attribution-generation baseline，包括若干强基线；未给出具体 VLM、文档长度、数据规模、指标和提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how to attribute answer components in multimodal long-document QA back to their supporting evidence in the source document.
summary_en.importance: The contribution combines a training-free multimodal attribution method with a fine-grained attribution evaluation dataset. It is relevant to VLM reliability, long-context grounding, and evidence localization, but it is not a pretraining-method paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: MultAttnAttrib uses attention signals from the model's prefill pass, selects specific attention heads, and applies calibrated thresholds to locate evidence regions in multimodal documents. It requires no additional training. The paper also introduces MultAttrEval, a dataset with ground-truth fine-grained attributions from answer components to multimodal source evidence.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that MultAttnAttrib consistently outperforms several attribution-generation baselines on MultAttrEval, including strong baselines. It does not specify the VLMs, document lengths, dataset size, metrics, or effect sizes.

recommendation.zh: 长文档 VLM grounding 的工具性工作；只看 attention-head 选择和阈值校准细节，不必追实验排名。
recommendation.en: A tooling paper for long-document VLM grounding; skim the head-selection and threshold-calibration details, not the leaderboard claims.

paper.title: FlowCIR: Semantic Transport via Flow Matching for Zero-Shot Composed Image Retrieval
paper.abstract: Zero-shot composed image retrieval (ZS-CIR) aims to retrieve a target image by editing a reference image with a natural-language instruction, without relying on domain-specific annotated triplets. Most existing ZS-CIR methods rely on textual inversion to translate the reference image into pseudo-text tokens and then compose them with the instruction via simple concatenation in the text space, which can be lossy and brittle for fine-grained semantics. In this work, we propose a new paradigm, name

summary.core_problem: 现有零样本组合图像检索方法依赖文本反转将参考图转为伪文本token再与指令拼接，存在细粒度语义损失大、鲁棒性差的问题。
summary.importance: 提出一种新的零样本组合图像检索范式，将任务建模为条件语义传输，首次将flow matching引入多模态嵌入空间的语义组合任务。
summary.technical_approach: 提出FlowCIR，利用条件flow matching学习轻量传输场，以参考图像为条件将指令表示映射为目标对齐的查询嵌入，仅训练小模块，不更新预训练VLM的图像/文本编码器。
summary.experiments: 在预提取的VLM嵌入上训练，计算效率高；摘要未披露具体模型参数量、baseline与量化提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing zero-shot composed image retrieval (ZS-CIR) methods rely on textual inversion to convert reference images into pseudo-text tokens, leading to large fine-grained semantic loss and poor robustness.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a new ZS-CIR paradigm that frames the task as conditional semantic transport, introducing flow matching to semantic composition in multimodal embedding spaces.
summary_en.technical_approach: FlowCIR uses conditional flow matching to learn a lightweight transport field that maps instruction representations to target-aligned query embeddings conditioned on the reference image, training only a small module without updating pretrained VLM encoders.
summary_en.experiments: Trains on pre-extracted VLM embeddings with high computational efficiency; specific model parameters, baselines, and quantitative improvements are not provided in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 多模态检索领域的增量方法，将flow matching用于嵌入空间语义组合，对多模态预训练仅有微弱启发，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Incremental multimodal retrieval method applying flow matching to embedding-space semantic composition, with weak inspiration for multimodal pretraining; read abstract only.

paper.title: Towards Robustness against Typographic Attack with Training-free Concept Localization
paper.abstract: Models trained via Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining (CLIP) serve as the foundational vision encoders for most modern Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs). Despite their widespread adoption, CLIP models exhibit a critical yet underexplored failure mode: irrelevant text appearing within images confounds visual representations, biasing them toward lexical meaning rather than true visual semantics. This robustness issue, commonly described as a Typographic Attack (TA), exposes a vulnerability

summary.core_problem: CLIP/ViT 视觉编码器在“图中叠字”(typographic attack) 场景下会被无关文字强烈牵引，导致表征从视觉语义偏向“词形/词义”线索；论文要解决的问题是：在不训练、不改权重的前提下，能否定位出导致这种词汇聚焦(lexical focus)的具体注意力电路/模块，并用可解释的方式在测试时干预，从而提升 TA 鲁棒性。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接贡献不大（更偏 CLIP 机制分析与测试时防御），但对“预训练表征里概念纠缠如何在注意力头中出现、如何用电路级定位做可解释干预”有参考价值。对做 VLM/CLIP 预训练的人，启发点在于：TA 不是简单的对抗样本问题，而是视觉 token 对“文字形状→语言概念”的捷径耦合；论文提供了一套训练外的诊断与快速修补流程，可作为预训练阶段数据/目标改造前的定位工具。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是一个训练外的“概念采样 + 归因排序 + 电路干预”流程。
1) 概念采样(Concept Mining)：基于 Linear Representation Hypothesis，把残差流表示看作多个概念方向的线性叠加。作者不训练 SAE/字典，而是随机采样“伪概念向量”(pseudo-concept vectors) 去做命中测试；关键技巧是利用 MHSA 的天然分解：每个 head 把 d_model 投到更低维 d_head 子空间，在这些投影空间里采样/搜索概念方向，命中概率更高、纠缠更少。
2) 词汇聚焦概念与模块定位：提出一个梯度归因分数，把“注意力头是否把注意力集中到文字 patch”(focus) 与“概念方向是否与词汇语义相关”(direction) 结合，得到归一化 attribution score，用于无标签地排序出最 TA 脆弱的概念样本与其宿主模块/注意力头。
3) 测试时干预：对识别出的有害电路做 attention reweighting 或 head/通路消融(ablation)，在不训练的情况下抑制文字相关通路对全局表征的支配，从而恢复对真实视觉语义的依赖。
与已有工作差异：相较残差流宏观分解或 SDL/SAE 字典学习，这里更强调“在注意力头投影空间做概念采样”和“把路由(QK)与特征(OV)视角结合的归因”，并把解释直接闭环到可执行的测试时电路干预。
summary.experiments:
全文给出的信息点主要是：
- 任务：CLIP 的对象分类在 TA 数据集上易被叠字误导；以及下游 LVLM 的 VQA 在 TA 场景下也会受影响。
- 结果形态：通过定位并干预“词汇聚焦”电路，CLIP 分类准确率与 LVLM 的 VQA 准确率在 typographic attack 数据集上显著提升；作者声称优于既有 SOTA 防御且成本很低（测试时简单重加权/消融）。
- 机制侧消融：强调在 MHSA 低维 head 子空间采样能提高 concept hit 概率，并通过降维减少搜索空间与概念纠缠。
由于你提供的全文片段未包含具体表格/数值（参数规模、数据集名称、提升百分点等），这里无法可靠复述精确数字；建议以论文实验章节的主表与消融表为准。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
- 先看方法总览图（文中 Fig.1 的 a/b/c 流程）：概念采样→归因排序→电路干预，理解闭环。
- 重点读 Method 里对 MHSA 分解（QK 路由与 OV 特征）以及为何在 d_head 子空间采样更有效的论证；这是与常见 SAE/SDL 路线的关键区别。
- 实验部分优先看：1) TA 场景下的分类/VQA 主结果表；2) 归因分数的稳定性与 head 定位一致性；3) 干预方式（reweight vs ablate）的代价与副作用（干净样本性能是否下降）。
- 如果你关心预训练改进：把作者定位出的“文字 patch→语义概念”捷径当作诊断信号，思考是否能在预训练数据增强（带字图像比例/合成 TA）、目标函数（去文字捷径的对比学习变体）或 tokenizer/patching（文字区域处理）上做更根治的改动。

summary_en.core_problem: CLIP-style ViT vision encoders can be hijacked by irrelevant overlaid text (typographic attacks), shifting representations from visual semantics to lexical cues. The paper asks whether we can (i) localize the specific attention circuits responsible for this “lexical focus” without any training, and (ii) apply lightweight test-time interventions to improve robustness while keeping model weights frozen.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining recipe paper; it is closer to mechanistic interpretability plus a deployment-time defense for CLIP/VLM backbones. The value for foundation-model pretraining researchers is diagnostic: it frames TA as a shortcut coupling between visual tokens and language semantics, and provides a practical circuit-level localization workflow that can guide upstream fixes (data mixture, augmentation with text-in-image, objective tweaks) before committing to expensive retraining.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method is a training-free loop: stochastic concept mining → attribution-based ranking → circuit intervention.
1) Stochastic concept mining: under the linear representation hypothesis, hidden states are treated as linear mixtures of concept directions. Instead of learning a dictionary/SAE, the authors sample pseudo-concept vectors. A key design choice is to sample/search in the per-head low-dimensional subspaces induced by MHSA projections (d_head), which empirically increases “concept hit” probability and reduces entanglement.
2) Vulnerability explanation via attribution: they propose a gradient-based attribution score that combines (a) whether an attention head focuses on text patches (focus) and (b) whether the sampled concept direction aligns with lexical semantics (direction). This yields a normalized score to identify TA-vulnerable concepts and the hosting heads/modules.
3) Mechanistic intervention: once harmful circuits are identified, they apply attention reweighting or ablation of selected heads/paths at test time to suppress lexical-dominated routes and recover visual-semantic behavior.
Compared to residual-stream-only analyses or SDL/SAE-based disentanglement, the emphasis here is head-subspace concept sampling plus an attribution metric that directly maps to actionable attention-level interventions.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper reports improved robustness on typographic-attack benchmarks for (i) CLIP object classification and (ii) downstream LVLM VQA, using only test-time reweighting/ablation (no finetuning). It also includes analyses suggesting that concept sampling in MHSA head subspaces improves concept-hit rates and reduces search complexity.
The provided full-text excerpt does not include the key numeric tables (model variants, dataset names, exact accuracy deltas), so exact figures cannot be stated reliably here; consult the main results and ablation tables in the experiments section for precise gains and any clean-accuracy trade-offs.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Start with the pipeline figure (their Fig.1) to understand the end-to-end loop from localization to intervention.
- Read the Method section focusing on the MHSA decomposition (QK routing vs OV feature circuits) and why sampling in d_head subspaces is central.
- In Experiments, prioritize: (1) main TA robustness tables for CLIP classification and LVLM VQA, (2) stability/consistency of head localization, and (3) intervention ablations (reweight vs ablate) including any degradation on clean inputs.
- If your goal is pretraining improvements, treat the localized “text-patch → lexical concept” circuits as a measurable failure mode and consider how to prevent them via data curation/augmentation or objective modifications rather than relying on post-hoc interventions.

recommendation.zh: 看 head attribution 和 circuit mining 部分；若结论稳，会影响 CLIP encoder 在 LVLM 预训练中的筛选标准。
recommendation.en: Read the head-attribution and circuit-mining parts; if stable, they affect how CLIP encoders should be screened for LVLM pretraining.

paper.title: SpaceEra++: A Unified Framework Towards 3D Spatial Reasoning in Video
paper.abstract: Visual-spatial understanding, defined as the ability to infer object relationships and scene layouts from visual inputs, is fundamental to downstream tasks such as robotic navigation and embodied interaction. However, pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs) remain constrained by spatial uncertainty stemming from inherently 2D observations and by the scarcity of data for 3D spatial understanding. To address these limitations, we proposed a novel framework, SpaceEra, in the NeurIPS 2025 Spotligh

summary.core_problem: 提升 VLM 从视频中进行 3D 空间关系和场景布局推理的能力，缓解 2D 视觉输入带来的空间不确定性和 3D 空间数据稀缺问题。
summary.importance: 这是 VLM 空间推理方向的系统型扩展，覆盖数据构建、模型设计、训练优化和推理提示。对 native multimodal pretraining 有间接参考价值，尤其是视频采样和空间约束数据如何进入训练闭环。
summary.technical_approach: 在原 SpaceEra 基础上提出 SpaceEra++。摘要中明确提到 ScenePick，用于从扫描视频中选择更有用的帧，缓解输入不足；同时加入更强的推理约束，并把数据构造、模型结构、训练优化和 prompting inference 组合成统一框架。方法更像面向空间推理的 VLM pipeline 强化，而不是新的基础建模范式。
summary.experiments: 摘要称原 SpaceEra 为 NeurIPS 2025 Spotlight 并已有显著提升，但当前给定摘要被截断，未提供 SpaceEra++ 的模型规模、训练数据量、基线、评测集和具体增益。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to improve VLMs' ability to infer 3D spatial relations and scene layouts from video, addressing spatial uncertainty from 2D observations and limited 3D spatial training data.
summary_en.importance: This is a system-level extension for video-based spatial reasoning, spanning data construction, model design, training optimization, and prompting. It is indirectly relevant to native multimodal pretraining, especially for how video sampling and spatial constraints can be integrated into a training pipeline.
summary_en.technical_approach: SpaceEra++ extends the earlier SpaceEra framework. The abstract highlights ScenePick, a frame-sampling strategy for scanning videos, and stronger reasoning constraints. The framework combines data construction, model design, training optimization, and prompting inference. It is closer to a VLM spatial-reasoning pipeline than to a new base modeling paradigm.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that the original SpaceEra was a NeurIPS 2025 Spotlight with significant gains, but the provided text is truncated and does not report SpaceEra++ model size, data scale, baselines, benchmarks, or numerical improvements.

recommendation.zh: 只看数据构造和 ScenePick 相关部分；它对视频空间预训练有旁路信号，但不像基座范式变化。
recommendation.en: Read only the data-construction and ScenePick parts; it offers side signals for video-spatial pretraining but not a base-modeling shift.

paper.title: AnyGroundBench: A Specialized-Domain Benchmark for Video Grounding in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated immense promise in Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding (STVG). However, current evaluation protocols are largely confined to zero-shot assessments on general, daily-life benchmarks. This creates a critical disconnect from real-world applications in specialized fields, where models inevitably encounter rare visual concepts and complex spatio-temporal dynamics. Since exhaustive pre-training across infinite data distributions is infeasible, the ability to

summary.core_problem: 构建面向专业领域的视频时空定位基准，评估 VLM 在少见视觉概念和复杂时序动态中的领域适应能力。
summary.importance: 贡献是 VLM 视频 grounding 评测资产，重点从通用日常场景 zero-shot 测试转向专业领域 domain adaptation；对多模态预训练研究员有弱相关价值，主要用于观察现有 VLM 的分布外视频理解短板。
summary.technical_approach: AnyGroundBench 覆盖动物、工业、体育、手术、公共安全五类专业领域，将新采集视频与已有数据集统一到密集、高质量的时空标注格式。评测目标是 Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding，即根据语言描述在视频中定位目标对象及其时间范围。
summary.experiments: 摘要未列出参与评测的 VLM 名单、模型规模或具体分数。基准包含新采集视频，例如专家标注的小鼠行为视频，并与既有数据集整合，形成跨五个专业领域的 domain-adaptation 测试集。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper introduces a specialized-domain benchmark for spatio-temporal video grounding in VLMs, focusing on rare visual concepts and complex temporal dynamics.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an evaluation asset for video-language models, shifting from zero-shot testing on everyday videos to domain-adaptation evaluation in specialized settings. For LLM pretraining researchers, its value is mainly diagnostic: it exposes distribution-shift issues in multimodal video understanding.
summary_en.technical_approach: AnyGroundBench covers five domains: animals, industry, sports, surgery, and public security. It combines newly captured videos with existing datasets under dense, high-fidelity spatio-temporal annotations, so models must localize described entities and events in both space and time.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not list evaluated VLMs, parameter scales, or numerical results. It states that the benchmark includes newly captured videos, such as expert-annotated mouse behaviors, and unifies them with established datasets across five specialized domains.

recommendation.zh: 作为 VLM 视频分布外评测备查即可；对预训练动作没有直接指令，先看任务定义和数据域。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a VLM out-of-domain video eval reference; read the task and domain definitions, not the full paper.

paper.title: Safe Alone, Unsafe Together: Safeguarding Against Implicit Toxicity When Benign Images Combine
paper.abstract: Multi-image content has become an increasingly prevalent form of visual communication in social media, giving rise to a new safety issue, multi-image implicit toxicity (MIIT), where each image appears benign in isolation, but harmful semantics emerge when the images are interpreted jointly. MIIT is particularly challenging for existing commercial moderation APIs and models due to the lack of explicit risky cues in each image. This paper aims to study how to identify MIIT. We first provide a form

summary.core_problem: 研究多张单独看无害的图片组合后产生隐式有害语义的问题，并尝试让多模态模型识别这种组合式安全风险。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是多模态安全数据与评测问题定义，而不是基座预训练方法。它提醒 VLM 安全不能只做单图或显式风险词检测，组合语义会绕过现有审核系统。
summary.technical_approach: 论文形式化定义 multi-image implicit toxicity，分析检测难点；构建覆盖七类风险的 MIIT-dataset，并用自动生成流程缓解数据稀缺；训练 MiShield，通过渐进蒸馏的 reasoning supervision，让模型输出安全判断和导致风险的实体关联解释。
summary.experiments: 实验比较 MiShield 与现有商业审核 API 和多模态模型在 MIIT-dataset 上的检测能力。摘要显示现有系统在缺少显式风险线索时表现不足，MiShield 通过关联实体分析提升了识别效果；具体模型规模、数据量和提升幅度未在给定摘要中完整披露。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自清华大学 DCST Conversational AI Group，团队长期做对话系统、LLM 对齐与安全相关研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies multi-image implicit toxicity, where each image is benign in isolation but harmful meaning emerges when the images are interpreted jointly.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a multimodal safety problem formulation and dataset rather than a pretraining method. It is relevant because VLM safety pipelines that only inspect single images or explicit harmful cues can miss compositional risks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors formalize MIIT, analyze its detection challenges, build MIIT-dataset with seven representative risk categories through an automatic generation pipeline, and train MiShield with progressively distilled reasoning supervision so that it produces both safety decisions and explicit analyses of correlated risky entities.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments evaluate MiShield against commercial moderation APIs and existing multimodal models on MIIT-dataset. The abstract reports that current systems struggle under implicit multi-image hazards and that MiShield improves detection through entity-correlation reasoning; exact model sizes, dataset scale, and margins are not fully available in the provided abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the Conversational AI Group, DCST, Tsinghua University, a group known for work on dialogue systems, LLM alignment, and safety.

recommendation.zh: 作为 VLM safety 数据问题看一眼即可；对预训练没直接动作，但组合语义风险会影响多模态数据过滤设计。
recommendation.en: Worth a glance as a VLM safety data problem; it does not change pretraining practice directly, but compositional risk matters for multimodal data filtering.

institutions: The Conversational AI (CoAI) Group, DCST, Tsinghua University

paper.title: StochasT: Learning with Stochastic Turn Depth for Visual Instruction Tuning
paper.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) rely extensively on Visual Instruction Tuning (VIT) to elicit their multimodal reasoning capabilities. However, we find a discrepancy: VIT often packs multiple language tasks about the same image for conversational, multi-turn training, whereas existing benchmarks evaluate LVLMs in isolated, single-turn scenarios. The models can suffer from visual attention decay and contextual overfitting during multi-turn training, making it hard for them to realize their f

summary.core_problem: 视觉指令微调中多轮训练与单轮评测的分布不匹配，导致模型出现视觉注意力衰减和上下文过拟合，无法充分发挥推理能力。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出随机轮次深度的训练策略，在不丢弃训练数据的前提下缓解训练-测试分布偏移问题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 StochasT 方法：将同一张图像的多个语言任务按有机顺序随机分组为不同大小的簇（即轮次深度），不丢弃任何数据以最大化数据利用率；思想借鉴自 ResNet 的 Dropout 和随机深度，但无实际的单元或数据丢弃。
summary.experiments: 在多个 VLM 基准上验证了方法有效性，同时提升了单轮和多轮场景下的推理性能，缓解了视觉注意力衰减和上下文过拟合问题。
summary.authors_note: 波士顿大学、罗格斯大学合作完成。

summary_en.core_problem: The distribution mismatch between multi-turn training and single-turn evaluation in visual instruction tuning leads to visual attention decay and contextual overfitting, preventing VLMs from reaching their full potential.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: proposes a stochastic turn depth training strategy that mitigates train-test distribution shift without dropping any training data.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes StochasT, which stochastically groups language tasks of the same image into clusters of varying sizes (turn depth) while preserving their organic order, without dropping any data to maximize training utility; inspired by Dropout and stochastic depth for ResNets but with no actual unit or data dropout.
summary_en.experiments: Validates effectiveness on multiple VLM benchmarks, improves performance on both single-turn and multi-turn scenarios, and mitigates visual attention decay and contextual overfitting.
summary_en.authors_note: A collaboration between Boston University and Rutgers University, New Brunswick.

recommendation.zh: VLM指令微调的训练-测试分布偏移解决思路可迁移到文本多轮指令微调，看§3方法部分即可
recommendation.en: The approach to addressing train-test distribution shift in VLM instruction tuning is transferable to text multi-turn SFT; read §3 only.

paper.title: MindEdit-Bench: Benchmarking Object-Level Counterfactual Spatial Reasoning in VLMs from In-the-Wild Photos
paper.abstract: Benchmarks for vision-language models (VLMs) mostly test observational spatial reasoning: models describe relations already visible in the input. Existing what-if tasks typically vary the observer while keeping the scene fixed. Can VLMs instead predict the consequences of hypothetically moving or rotating an object? We introduce MindEdit-Bench, a benchmark of six spatial reasoning tasks built from three-photo smartphone triplets of newly captured indoor scenes via an automatic in-the-wild 3D sce

summary.core_problem: 现有 VLM 基准主要测试观测性空间推理，缺乏对物体级反事实空间推理能力（预测物体移动/旋转后的结果，答案不在输入图像中）的系统评测。
summary.importance: Benchmark 贡献，首次构建基于真实野外室内场景的物体级反事实空间推理评测基准，包含 2 个全新的反事实推理任务。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MindEdit-Bench，通过自动的野外 3D 场景图提取管线，从新拍摄的室内场景三联智能手机照片中构建 6 个空间推理任务：4 个感知与视角变换任务，2 个新的反事实任务（空间编辑、跨视角可见性编辑），每个问题提供 8-24 个结构化选项，支持错误模式诊断。
summary.experiments: 覆盖 120 个私有室内场景，未使用公开数据集以减少数据泄露风险；在多个主流 VLM 上的评测显示，现有模型在反事实空间推理任务上表现显著差于观测性任务。
summary.authors_note: 浙江大学、同济大学、东京大学合作完成。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing VLM benchmarks mostly test observational spatial reasoning, lacking systematic evaluation of object-level counterfactual spatial reasoning (predicting consequences of moving/rotating objects, with correct answers absent from input images).
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution: first object-level counterfactual spatial reasoning benchmark built on real-world in-the-wild indoor scenes, including 2 novel counterfactual reasoning tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes MindEdit-Bench, built via an automatic in-the-wild 3D scene-graph extraction pipeline from newly captured three-photo smartphone triplets of indoor scenes, with 6 spatial reasoning tasks: 4 on perception and perspective transformation, 2 novel counterfactual tasks (spatial editing, cross-view visibility editing); each question has 8-24 structured options for error diagnosis.
summary_en.experiments: Covers 120 private indoor scenes not drawn from public datasets to reduce data leakage risk; evaluation on multiple mainstream VLMs shows models perform significantly worse on counterfactual spatial reasoning than on observational tasks.
summary_en.authors_note: A collaboration between Zhejiang University, Tongji University, and The University of Tokyo.

recommendation.zh: VLM反事实空间推理新基准，可用于多模态预训练的能力诊断，看任务定义部分即可
recommendation.en: A new benchmark for VLM counterfactual spatial reasoning, useful for multimodal pretraining capability diagnosis; read task definition only.

paper.title: Information-Regularized Attention for Visual-Centric Reasoning
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have become a paradigm for multimodal learning, yet remain unstable due to object hallucination, weak visual grounding, and catastrophic forgetting after full-parameter instruction tuning. We claim these failures result from a lack of explicit control over visual representation learning during the standard next-token prediction objective. As a result, visual embeddings thus become passively optimized and prone to injecting redundant or spurious signals. To counter t

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 在视觉中心推理中容易出现物体幻觉、视觉 grounding 不稳、全参指令微调后遗忘的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态训练机制改进。它把问题归因于标准 next-token objective 对视觉表征缺少显式控制，关注点接近 native multimodal pretraining 中“视觉信息如何进入语言层”的训练动态。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Information-Regularized Attention，一种随机注意力机制，在 Transformer 中间层显式调节注入 hidden states 的视觉信息量。方法通过局部重参数化把视觉表征不确定性转化为样本独立的局部噪声，从而压制冗余或虚假视觉信号。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示除任务性能外，还量化 embedding 属性；IRA 产生更平滑的曲率轨迹，并抑制部分异常表征行为。未给出模型规模、训练数据、baseline 数量或具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses object hallucination, unstable visual grounding, and forgetting after full-parameter instruction tuning in visual-centric VLM reasoning.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a multimodal training-mechanism modification. It frames the failure as insufficient control over visual representations under the standard next-token objective, which is relevant to how visual signals are injected into language backbones.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes Information-Regularized Attention, a stochastic attention mechanism that explicitly controls the amount of visual information entering intermediate Transformer hidden states. A local reparameterization turns uncertainty in visual representations into data-point-independent local noise.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports both downstream performance evaluation and embedding diagnostics. IRA is claimed to yield smoother curvature trajectories and suppress spurious representation behavior, but model size, data scale, baselines, and numerical gains are not specified.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和 embedding 诊断即可；把视觉注入当随机信息瓶颈有意思，但摘要里的因果链还不够干净。
recommendation.en: Skim the method figure and embedding diagnostics; treating visual injection as a stochastic information bottleneck is interesting, but the causal story is not yet clean.

paper.title: Perceive-to-Reason: Decoupling Perception and Reasoning for Fine-Grained Visual Reasoning
paper.abstract: Fine-grained visual reasoning remains challenging for vision-language models, especially when small but critical visual cues are buried in high-resolution images. Existing approaches rely on repeated cropping or test-time visual search to introduce local evidence, but they typically do not explicitly distinguish perception from reasoning. In this paper, we propose Perceive-to-Reason (P2R), a unified framework that formulates fine-grained visual reasoning as a two-stage process: the model first l

summary.core_problem: 细粒度视觉推理任务中，视觉语言模型难以定位高分辨率图像中微小但关键的视觉线索，现有方法未明确区分感知与推理过程，导致细粒度推理能力不足。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出感知-推理解耦的细粒度视觉推理框架，以及角色感知的交替强化学习策略，为VLM细粒度能力提升提供了新的优化思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Perceive-to-Reason（P2R）两阶段框架：先由感知器模块定位与问题相关的视觉证据区域，再由推理器模块基于标注图像和裁剪区域回答问题；配套提出PRA-GRPO强化学习策略，仅用最终答案监督交替进行感知方向和推理方向的模型更新。
summary.experiments: 基于Qwen3-VL-Instruct的2B/4B/8B三个参数规模的模型进行实验，在细粒度视觉推理任务上取得一致的性能提升。

summary_en.core_problem: Fine-grained visual reasoning is challenging for vision-language models, as small but critical visual cues in high-resolution images are hard to locate, and existing methods do not explicitly separate perception from reasoning processes.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation proposing a decoupled perception-reasoning framework for fine-grained visual reasoning and a role-aware alternating reinforcement learning strategy, offering new optimization ideas for improving VLM fine-grained capabilities.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Perceive-to-Reason (P2R), a two-stage framework where a perceiver module first localizes question-relevant visual evidence regions, then a reasoner module answers questions based on the annotated image and cropped regions; introduces PRA-GRPO, an alternating RL strategy that updates perception and reasoning modules separately using only final-answer supervision.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Qwen3-VL-Instruct models with 2B, 4B, and 8B parameters, achieving consistent performance improvements on fine-grained visual reasoning tasks.

recommendation.zh: 细粒度VLM的解耦训练思路可参考，PRA-GRPO的交替优化设计有一定启发，看摘要和方法部分即可。
recommendation.en: The decoupled training idea for fine-grained VLM is worth noting, and the alternating optimization design of PRA-GRPO provides some inspiration; read abstract and method section only.

paper.title: Visual Semantic Entropy: Do Vision Language Models Recognize Visual Ambiguity?
paper.abstract: Vision-language models can produce confident answers on visually ambiguous inputs, resulting in biased predictions. Common entropy-based methods, such as Semantic Entropy (SE), rely on output diversity. Yet our analysis shows that overconfident visual embeddings suppress output diversity under stochastic decoding, causing SE to underestimate uncertainty in such cases. Recent methods instead probe output diversity through input perturbations, including textual paraphrasing or joint text-image per

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文关注 VLM 在视觉问答中的不确定性估计：当图像证据存在歧义时，模型是否能表现出相应的不确定性。核心发现是，常用的 Semantic Entropy 依赖采样输出多样性，但 VLM 的视觉表征可能已经把模型推向一个过度自信的答案，导致多次采样仍然高度一致，从而低估视觉歧义。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在训练 recipe，而在 VLM 的视觉 grounding 与校准诊断。它提醒一个常被忽略的问题：输出分布的不确定性不一定能反映输入模态的不确定性。对于 native multimodal pretraining、视觉 tokenizer、图文对齐损失的研究，这类现象可以作为诊断信号，帮助区分“语言端稳定”与“视觉证据充分”这两件事。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 Visual Semantic Entropy。方法只扰动图像，不改写文本问题，用图像扰动诱导模型在视觉证据附近产生不同回答。随后把语义相近的回答聚成原型，避免同义改写被误判为真正分歧。最终不确定性用原型之间的频率加权成对距离来度量。它和 Semantic Entropy 的区别是，不只依赖解码随机性；和 SNNE 的区别是，先做语义聚类再计算原型距离，降低措辞差异的影响；和文本 paraphrase 或图文联合扰动方法的区别是，避免把 prompt sensitivity 当成视觉歧义。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 5 个 VLM 和 5 个数据集，并比较了采样熵、语义距离、文本扰动、图文联合扰动等不确定性估计方法。关键经验结果是：在视觉对抗或视觉歧义更强的数据集上，VSE 比依赖文本扰动或联合扰动的方法更稳定；论文还展示了三个诊断现象：过度自信的视觉 embedding 会压制采样输出多样性，直接在文本 embedding 上算距离会放大措辞差异，文本 paraphrase 往往比图像扰动带来更大的非局部语义漂移。提供内容中没有完整 AUROC、AUPR 或校准误差表格数值，精确数字需要看实验表。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。重点看问题分析部分的三个 failure modes，尤其是 Sec. 3.2、3.3、3.4，以及 Fig. 3 和 Fig. 5。方法部分主要看 VSE 的三步：image-only perturbation、answer prototype clustering、frequency-weighted pairwise distance。实验部分优先看视觉对抗数据集上的结果，因为那里最能说明 VSE 相比文本扰动方法的差异。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies uncertainty estimation for VLMs in VQA, with a focus on whether models recognize ambiguity in the visual evidence. Its main diagnosis is that Semantic Entropy can fail when visual embeddings drive the model toward an overconfident answer: stochastic decoding then produces nearly identical outputs, so output diversity no longer reflects visual ambiguity.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to pretraining research is diagnostic rather than algorithmic. It separates language-side answer stability from visual-evidence reliability, which matters for native multimodal pretraining, visual grounding, and calibration analysis. A VLM can look confident at the output level while its visual input remains ambiguous, so output entropy alone is a weak proxy for multimodal uncertainty.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method, Visual Semantic Entropy, perturbs only the image while keeping the text query fixed. It then collects generated answers, clusters semantically equivalent variants into prototypes, and computes uncertainty as a frequency-weighted pairwise distance among prototype embeddings. Compared with Semantic Entropy, it probes instability through visual perturbations rather than decoding noise alone. Compared with SNNE-style text-distance aggregation, it reduces the effect of wording variation through prototype clustering. Compared with paraphrase-based or joint image-text perturbation methods, it avoids conflating prompt sensitivity with visual ambiguity.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers 5 VLMs and 5 datasets, with comparisons against sampling-based entropy, semantic-distance methods, text perturbation, and joint image-text perturbation baselines. The main empirical result is that VSE is stronger on visually adversarial or visually ambiguous datasets. The diagnostic analyses also support three claims: overconfident visual embeddings suppress output diversity, raw text-embedding distances can overestimate disagreement due to wording changes, and paraphrased prompts often dominate the variability induced by perturbation methods. Exact AUROC, AUPR, or calibration numbers are not available in the provided content and should be checked in the result tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough. Focus on the failure-mode analysis in Sec. 3.2–3.4 and the figures showing overconfident visual embeddings and text-driven clustering. Then read the method description to understand the image-only perturbation, prototype clustering, and weighted pairwise-distance score. In the experiments, prioritize the visually adversarial settings, where the method’s design choices are most visible.

recommendation.zh: 指出VLM不确定性估计中视觉/文本扰动的核心混淆问题，§3的分析对VLM预训练目标和校准设计有直接参考，读方法和分析部分
recommendation.en: Identifies core confound between visual/textual perturbations in VLM uncertainty estimation; §3 analysis directly informs VLM pretraining objective and calibration design, read method and analysis sections

institutions: Australian Institute for Machine Learning, Adelaide University
new state-of-the-art for VLM uncertainty estimation. Code is available:
