paper.title: Seeing Is Not Sharing: Some Vision-Language Models Overestimate Common Ground in Asymmetric Dialogue
paper.abstract: In collaborative dialogue, shared perception does not guarantee shared interpretation. Mutual understanding must be established through interaction. We investigate whether vision-language models (VLMs) can distinguish what could be shared from what has been shared between dialogue participants through grounding. We formulate this as an interpretation-matching task on 13,077 annotated reference expressions from HCRC MapTask dialogues, and evaluate VLMs under systematically controlled manipulation

summary.core_problem: 研究 VLM 在非对称协作对话中能否区分“双方可能共享的信息”和“已经通过对话建立共同理解的信息”。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态理解与互动 grounding 分析。它不直接推进统一多模态预训练，但指出视觉内容可能诱发过度对齐判断，对 VLM 数据与评测设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 将问题形式化为 interpretation-matching 任务，使用 HCRC MapTask 对话中的 13,077 条带标注指代表达。实验系统控制对话上下文和地图信息可见性，并比较真实地图图像、同内容文本描述和无信息图像对模型判断的影响。
summary.experiments: 摘要称提供真实地图图像能提升总体性能，但会让模型更倾向于预测双方已经对齐；同样地图内容的文本描述也复现该偏差，而无信息图像会抑制对齐预测，说明偏差来自任务相关地图内容而非视觉通道本身。提升以非对齐样本准确率下降为代价。
summary.authors_note: 机构为 Utrecht University；Albert Gatt 和 Massimo Poesio 在自然语言生成、指代与对话 grounding 方向有长期工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether VLMs can distinguish information that could be shared from information that has actually been grounded between participants in asymmetric dialogue.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal understanding and interaction-grounding analysis. It does not directly advance native multimodal pretraining, but it gives a useful signal for VLM data and evaluation design: task-relevant visual content can induce over-alignment predictions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors formulate the problem as an interpretation-matching task using 13,077 annotated referring expressions from HCRC MapTask dialogues. They systematically manipulate dialogue context and map-information access, comparing authentic map images, textual descriptions of the same map content, and non-informative images.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that authentic map images improve overall performance but push models toward over-predicting alignment. Text descriptions of the same map content reproduce the bias, while non-informative images suppress alignment predictions, suggesting the bias comes from task-relevant map content rather than the visual channel. The gain comes at the cost of worse accuracy on non-aligned cases.
summary_en.authors_note: The institution is Utrecht University. Albert Gatt and Massimo Poesio have long-running work on natural language generation, reference, and dialogue grounding.

recommendation.zh: 作为 VLM grounding 负例知道即可；看实验操控设计，别把它当成多模态预训练能力结论。
recommendation.en: Worth knowing as a VLM grounding failure case; read the manipulation design, not as a claim about multimodal pretraining capability.

paper.title: Technical Report of RoboSpatial Challenge at CVPR 2026: Selective Reasoning Activation and Reference-Frame Disambiguation for Embodied Spatial Reasoning
paper.abstract: Vision-language models achieve strong general perception but often struggle with the spatial reasoning required for embodied tasks. We present RoboSpatialBrain, our submission to the RoboSpatial Challenge at the Embodied Reasoning in Action Workshop, CVPR 2026, built on RoboBrain2.5-8B-NV. RoboSpatialBrain combines two training-free, inference-time mechanisms: a forced <think> prefix activation strategy paired with a task-specific post-prompt that elicits deliberate reasoning on context and comp

summary.core_problem: 解决VLM在具身空间推理中对参考系歧义和是否触发显式推理链把握不稳的问题。
summary.importance: 这是挑战赛技术报告，不是新的预训练方法。价值主要在于两个推理时技巧：选择性激活思维链，以及显式参考系重定向。对做多模态推理和具身VLM的人有一点实操参考，但对基座预训练启发有限。
summary.technical_approach: 基于 RoboBrain2.5-8B-NV，提出两项 training-free 推理机制：一是强制加入 <think> 前缀并配合任务特定后提示，促使模型在上下文与兼容性任务上进行显式推理；二是参考系重定向流水线，把相机中心和物体中心坐标系歧义显式消解。作者还探索了在兼容性数据上的微调及其与提示策略的相互作用。
summary.experiments: 在 RoboSpatial Challenge / RoboSpatial-Home 上评估，报告总体成功率 80.9%，获得挑战赛第一。摘要未给出更多基线细节、数据规模或统计显著性，因此更像经验性系统组合而非干净方法学结论。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets embodied spatial reasoning failures in VLMs, especially reference-frame ambiguity and when to trigger explicit reasoning.
summary_en.importance: This is a challenge technical report rather than a new pretraining method. Its value lies in two practical inference-time tricks: selective reasoning activation and explicit reference-frame redirection. Useful as a systems note for multimodal reasoning, but only loosely relevant to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Built on RoboBrain2.5-8B-NV, the system adds two training-free inference mechanisms: a forced <think> prefix plus task-specific post-prompt to elicit deliberate reasoning, and a reference-frame redirection pipeline to resolve camera-centric versus object-centric ambiguity. The authors also explore fine-tuning on compatibility data and its interaction with prompting.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on RoboSpatial Challenge / RoboSpatial-Home, it reports 80.9% overall success and first place in the challenge. The abstract does not provide much detail on baselines, data scale, or statistical rigor, so this reads more like a strong system recipe than a clean methodological result.

recommendation.zh: 比赛解法，方法新意一般；只看参考系消歧和 <think> 触发是否真带来稳定增益，别把榜单名次当成可迁移结论。
recommendation.en: A challenge solution with modest novelty; only inspect whether reference-frame disambiguation and forced <think> actually yield stable gains, and do not overread the leaderboard result.

paper.title: PIXELRAG: Web Screenshots Beat Text for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
paper.abstract: Augmenting large language models (LLMs) with retrieved web text has become a dominant paradigm, yet the web is not natively textual: existing systems depend on complex parsing pipelines that linearize HTML and discard layout, visual structure, and formatting. We introduce PixelRAG, a new retrieval-augmented method that represents websites in their native visual form and performs retrieval and reading entirely in pixel space, enabling an end-to-end architecture that eliminates text abstraction. P

summary.core_problem: 现有文本型网页检索增强生成（RAG）依赖脆弱且信息有损的HTML解析流程，会丢失网页布局、表格、图表、图片、格式提示等内容，导致检索与阅读阶段的级联信息损失。需要验证能否直接基于网页原生的像素空间表示完成端到端RAG，在规避解析损失的同时，支撑全量Wikipedia这类大规模语料的检索需求。
summary.importance: 验证了统一多模态建模在知识密集型任务上的落地可行性——如果视觉检索+多模态大模型（VLM）阅读可以替代基于规则的HTML解析与纯文本RAG管线，说明预训练阶段的多模态对齐（文本、视觉布局、结构化内容之间的对齐）已经足够成熟，可支撑原本需要显式符号处理的任务。该结论也可为网页领域多模态预训练数据构建、通用视觉检索模型的预训练目标设计提供参考。
summary.technical_approach: PIXELRAG管线包含三个核心阶段：1）网页渲染：将每个网页直接渲染为截图，切分为固定大小的切片，替代传统的HTML转文本分块流程；2）视觉检索：基于Qwen3-VL-Embedding视觉嵌入模型（针对网页截图场景做了微调）构建向量索引，支持3000万级截图切片的大规模检索；3）VLM阅读：将检索到的相关截图切片直接输入VLM生成答案，全流程无需任何HTML解析、文本提取或线性化预处理。
summary.experiments: 核心实验基于全量Wikipedia语料构建了含3000万截图切片的检索库，开展开放域网页问答测试。与基于SOTA HTML解析器构建的文本型RAG相比，PIXELRAG在涉及表格、图表、布局、图片信息的查询上表现更优——例如2010欧冠决赛射门次数的问题，文本RAG因解析丢失表格数据无法作答，PIXELRAG可正确输出结果。全流程无需文本抽象步骤，端到端消除了HTML解析带来的信息损失。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读先看架构对比示意图，直观了解文本RAG与PIXELRAG的核心差异；再看管线实现细节（截图分片策略、索引构建方法）与公开的案例对比结果。重点关注不同查询类型（纯文本、表格、图表、布局依赖）下的性能差异。预计阅读时间1小时。如果不研究RAG系统设计，可跳过底层工程优化细节，核心把握：原生视觉RAG在结构化网页内容上的表现优于依赖解析的文本RAG。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing text-based web retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) relies on brittle, lossy HTML parsing that discards layout, tables, charts, images, and formatting cues, leading to cascading information loss in retrieval and reading stages. The problem to validate is whether end-to-end RAG can run directly on webpages’ native pixel-space representation, avoiding parsing losses while supporting retrieval at the scale of full Wikipedia corpora.
summary_en.importance: Validates the practical viability of unified multimodal modeling for knowledge-intensive tasks. If visual retrieval plus vision-language model (VLM) reading can replace rule-based HTML parsing and text-only RAG pipelines, it confirms pre-trained multimodal alignment (between text, visual layout, and structured content) is mature enough to handle tasks previously requiring explicit symbolic processing. This finding also informs web-domain multimodal pre-training data curation and pre-training objective design for general-purpose visual retrieval models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The PIXELRAG pipeline includes three core stages: 1) Web rendering: each webpage is rendered directly to a screenshot and split into fixed-size tiles, replacing traditional HTML-to-text chunking; 2) Visual retrieval: a vector index is built using Qwen3-VL-Embedding (fine-tuned for web screenshot scenarios) to support large-scale retrieval over 30 million screenshot tiles; 3) VLM reading: retrieved relevant tiles are fed directly to a VLM for answer generation, with no HTML parsing, text extraction, or linearization preprocessing required at any stage.
summary_en.experiments: A retrieval datastore of 30 million screenshot tiles is built from the full Wikipedia corpus for open-domain web QA testing. Compared to text-based RAG built on state-of-the-art HTML parsers, PIXELRAG performs better on queries requiring table, chart, layout, or image context. For example, on the question about Inter Milan’s shots on target in the 2010 UCL final, text RAG fails to answer due to missing parsed table data, while PIXELRAG outputs the correct result. The entire pipeline eliminates text abstraction steps, removing parsing-induced information loss end-to-end.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, start with the side-by-side architecture comparison diagram to grasp the core difference between text RAG and PIXELRAG, then review pipeline implementation details (screenshot tiling strategy, index construction) and published case comparison results. Focus on performance gaps across query types (plain text, table, chart, layout-dependent). Estimated reading time: 1 hour. Skip low-level engineering optimizations unless working on RAG system design; the core takeaway is that native visual RAG outperforms parsing-dependent text RAG on structured web content.

recommendation.zh: 读系统设计和检索训练数据即可；它把“网页先转文本”这个默认假设打松了，值得做内部 RAG/VLM ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the system design and retrieval-data construction; it weakens the default assumption that web pages must be text-first, and is worth an internal RAG/VLM ablation.

paper.title: HKVLM: Faithful Reasoning Grounding by Binding Language Queries to a Frozen Detector
paper.abstract: Many visual requests -- ``the object to open this bottle'', ``the person not wearing a helmet'' -- require reasoning, not just category matching. Pure open-vocabulary detectors need an explicit phrase; vision-language models (VLMs) can reason yet ``see but mis-speak'', attending to the right region but returning the wrong box or label. We argue this is a \emph{binding} failure: in coordinate-as-text VLMs localization passes through the autoregressive head, coupling it to language generation; in

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 在视觉 grounding 中“语言推理意图”和“真实区域定位”绑定不稳的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM grounding 架构改造。它关注的不是多模态预训练本身，而是推理式视觉指代表达如何避免经过自回归语言头后产生坐标或标签错配。
summary.technical_approach: HKVLM 将定位从语言生成路径中移出：冻结的语言对齐检测器产生 class-agnostic region proposals，冻结语言模型把复杂请求编码为 referential query embeddings，再用轻量 alignment hook 在共享嵌入空间中做 contrastive retrieval 和 bipartite assignment；另有 perception-grounded faithfulness veto 用于抑制不可信绑定。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体数据集、模型规模、baseline 或数值结果。实验主张应当围绕推理式 grounding 请求，如“能打开瓶子的物体”“没戴头盔的人”等，而不是单纯类别匹配。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses unreliable binding between language-level reasoning intent and visual region localization in VLM grounding.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an architectural treatment of faithful VLM grounding rather than a pretraining recipe. The useful idea is to decouple localization from the autoregressive language head to reduce coordinate and label misbinding.
summary_en.technical_approach: HKVLM removes localization from the language generation path. A frozen language-aligned detector produces class-agnostic proposals, a frozen language model encodes reasoning requests into referential query embeddings, and a lightweight alignment hook performs contrastive retrieval and bipartite assignment in a shared embedding space. A perception-grounded veto filters unfaithful bindings.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not specify datasets, model sizes, baselines, or numerical gains. The intended evaluation appears to focus on reasoning-grounded visual requests rather than plain category matching.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图即可；“不要让 AR 头吐坐标”这个判断对 native VLM 设计有一点参考。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram; the useful prior is that AR coordinate generation is a brittle interface for native VLM grounding.

paper.title: PerceptionRubrics: Calibrating Multimodal Evaluation to Human Perception
paper.abstract: We introduce PerceptionRubrics, a rubric-based evaluation framework that addresses the gap between saturated benchmark scores and real-world brittleness. Shifting evaluation from holistic semantic matching to rigorous atomic auditing, PerceptionRubrics pairs 1,038 information-dense images with over 12,000 instance-specific rubrics. These criteria are derived from golden captions constructed via a novel Circular Peer-Review consensus pipeline and then distilled into a dual-stream system of Must-R

summary.core_problem: 解决现有多模态评测分数饱和、却无法反映真实视觉感知脆弱性的问题，尤其是模型在密集图像中对关键事实的漏判与细节误判。
summary.importance: 这是评测方法与评测资产贡献。它不是再做一个泛泛 benchmark，而是把多模态评测从整体语义匹配改成基于原子事实和强约束的 rubric 审计，对 VLM 训练目标和数据质量诊断都有直接价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PerceptionRubrics：先用 Circular Peer-Review 共识流程构造高质量 golden captions，再蒸馏成两类 rubric——Must-Right（必须正确的关键事实）和 Easy-Wrong（容易出错的细粒度细节）。评分上采用 Gated Scoring，不再线性平均，而是对关键事实错误施加近似二值惩罚，从而更接近人类对“关键事实错了就整体不可信”的判断。
summary.experiments: 数据包含 1,038 张信息密集图像和 12,000+ instance-specific rubrics。实验结论包括：模型在碎片化元素识别上可能得分不错，但在严格合取约束下明显失效；开放式问答不一定比封闭式设置更能揭示感知能力；现有高分模型在 dense visual auditing 下仍有明显 reliability gap。摘要未给出具体模型名单和数值，但评测设计本身比常见 caption/VQA 指标更有诊断性。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the mismatch between saturated multimodal benchmark scores and real perceptual brittleness, especially failures on mandatory visual facts and fine-grained details in dense images.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation-method and dataset contribution. Rather than adding another generic benchmark, it reframes multimodal evaluation as atomic, rubric-based auditing with hard constraints, which is directly useful for diagnosing VLM objectives and data quality.
summary_en.technical_approach: PerceptionRubrics first builds high-quality golden captions through a Circular Peer-Review consensus pipeline, then distills them into two rubric streams: Must-Right facts and Easy-Wrong details. Scoring uses a gated mechanism instead of linear averaging, so missing mandatory facts incurs sharp penalties, better matching how humans treat critical factual errors.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 1,038 information-dense images and over 12,000 instance-specific rubrics. Reported findings include a reliability gap where models can verify fragments yet fail strict conjunctive constraints, and an open-vs-closed stratification result suggesting open-ended formats do not necessarily expose perceptual competence better. The abstract does not provide exact model rosters or margins, but the evaluation design is clearly more diagnostic than standard caption/VQA metrics.

recommendation.zh: 这类评测对预训练最有用的地方不是榜单，而是把“关键事实错一条就该重罚”写进协议；先看 rubric 设计和 gated scoring，能直接反推数据与 loss 该怎么改。
recommendation.en: The value here is not the leaderboard but the protocol: it operationalizes the idea that missing one mandatory fact should dominate the score; read the rubric design and gated scoring to rethink data curation and training losses.

paper.title: HAT-4D: Lifting Monocular Video for 4D Multi-Object Interactions via Human-Agent Collaboration
paper.abstract: Extracting dynamic 4D object interactions from massive, in-the-wild monocular videos offers a highly efficient data collection pathway for scaling Embodied AI and training VLAs. However, existing monocular 4D reconstruction methods primarily focus on isolated objects, often failing under the severe occlusions and complex dynamics inherent in multi-object interactions. To bridge this gap, we propose HAT-4D, the first agentic framework designed to reconstruct the 3D geometry, temporal dynamics, an

summary.core_problem: 从野外单目视频中恢复多个物体的 3D 几何、时间动态和物理交互，解决遮挡、深度歧义和多物体交互导致的 4D 重建失败。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是面向具身 AI 数据采集的 4D 重建框架，并伴随开放世界交互重建 benchmark。它不是 LLM 预训练工作，但“从互联网视频构造可交互 4D 资产”的思路与 VLA 数据扩展有关。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 HAT-4D，一个结合 VLM 和多层级 human-in-the-loop 反馈的 agentic framework。VLM 用于解析视频中的物体与交互，人工反馈用于修正深度歧义和遮挡，随后进行 3D 生成和 4D propagation，以得到更物理合理的多物体交互资产。
summary.experiments: 构建或推动 MVOIK-4D 开放世界 monocular 4D interaction reconstruction benchmark。摘要未给出数据规模、baseline、指标和数值结果，无法判断提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper reconstructs 3D geometry, temporal dynamics, and physical interactions of multiple objects from in-the-wild monocular videos, addressing occlusion and depth ambiguity in 4D interaction reconstruction.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a 4D reconstruction framework and an open-world interaction benchmark for embodied-AI data collection. It is not LLM pretraining, but the idea of converting web-scale videos into interactive 4D assets is relevant to VLA data scaling.
summary_en.technical_approach: HAT-4D is an agentic framework that integrates VLMs with multi-level human-in-the-loop feedback. The VLM helps parse objects and interactions, while human feedback resolves depth ambiguity and occlusion during 3D generation and 4D propagation, producing physically plausible multi-object assets.
summary_en.experiments: The work introduces or supports MVOIK-4D, an open-world benchmark for monocular 4D interaction reconstruction. The provided abstract does not include dataset size, baselines, metrics, or numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 读动机即可：若要扩 VLA 数据，单目视频到 4D 资产是方向；但 human-in-loop 太重，离预训练数据引擎还有距离。
recommendation.en: Read the motivation only: monocular video-to-4D assets matter for VLA data scaling, but the human-in-the-loop design is still too heavy for a pretraining data engine.

paper.title: Vision-Default, Prior-Override: Causal Mechanisms of Perception-Knowledge Conflict in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-language models must reconcile visual evidence with memorized world knowledge when the two conflict. How they resolve this conflict shapes the reliability of multimodal systems, yet prior work characterizes it behaviorally without a component-level causal account. We combine activation patching across three granularities (residual stream, attention heads, and MLP sublayers) with model-component ablation studies and mechanistic analysis. Across three VLM families, we find that visual groun

summary.core_problem: 解释 VLM 在视觉证据与记忆中的先验知识冲突时，究竟由哪些组件决定模型更信图像还是更信先验。
summary.importance: 这是机制分析工作，不是新模型。价值在于把“视觉优先还是知识优先”从行为现象推进到组件级因果解释，对多模态统一预训练和对齐阶段的表征分工有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者结合 activation patching、按残差流/注意力头/MLP 子层三种粒度的干预，以及组件消融，分析三类 VLM 家族在 perception-knowledge conflict 下的因果路径。核心发现是：视觉 grounding 是默认态，而调用记忆先验依赖网络后半段一小撮因果必要的 attention heads。
summary.experiments: 覆盖三个 VLM 家族。论文报告仅 2.5%-4.8% 的注意力头对 prior grounding 具有因果必要性；消融这些头后，在 prior-knowledge prompts 下，68%-96% 的知识驱动回答会翻转为视觉驱动，而原本视觉驱动的预测只变化 0.8%-7.5%。这说明两种 grounding 机制并不对称。
summary.authors_note: University of Tübingen、Harvard University、The University of Texas at Austin。属于较扎实的 VLM 机制分析路线，但从公开信息看并非顶级实验室的大规模预训练项目。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks which internal components make a VLM follow visual evidence versus memorized prior knowledge when the two conflict.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic analysis rather than a new model. Its value is in moving the question from behavioral observation to component-level causal attribution, which matters for multimodal pretraining and alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors combine activation patching, interventions at three granularities (residual stream, attention heads, and MLP sublayers), and ablations across three VLM families. The key claim is that visual grounding is the default mode, while prior grounding depends on a small set of causally necessary attention heads in the later half of the network.
summary_en.experiments: The study spans three VLM families. It reports that only 2.5%-4.8% of attention heads are causally necessary for prior grounding; ablating them flips 68%-96% of knowledge-grounded answers to visually grounded ones under prior-knowledge prompts, while changing only 0.8%-7.5% of already visually grounded predictions.
summary_en.authors_note: University of Tübingen, Harvard University, and The University of Texas at Austin. This looks like a solid mechanistic VLM study, though not a flagship pretraining effort from a major frontier lab.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改 pretrain recipe，但会改你对 VLM 冲突解析的 prior：先看消融结果和头部定位，若现象稳，后续可直接拿来做 multimodal routing/regularization 假设。
recommendation.en: It does not change pretraining recipes, but it may change your prior on VLM conflict resolution: read the head-level causal ablations first, then decide whether to turn it into routing or regularization hypotheses.

institutions: The University of Texas at Austin

paper.title: Steering Vision-Language Models with Joint Sparse Autoencoders
paper.abstract: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) have shown promise for analyzing language models, but applying them to vision-language models (VLMs) often yields representations that are difficult to use as controllable cross-modal steering directions. We introduce the Joint Sparse Autoencoder (JSAE), which uses an explicit alignment constraint to jointly factorize sequence-pooled vision and language activations into shared, interpretable image/caption-level features. Applied to LLaVA, JSAE recovers cross-modal feat

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作想解决 VLM 机制分析里一个常见问题：普通 SAE 在视觉-语言联合表征上学到的特征往往不够可控，难以作为稳定的跨模态 steering 方向使用。
summary.importance: 贡献类型主要是机制分析方法改进，而不是预训练方法本身。它把 SAE 从单模态 LM 分析扩展到 VLM，并强调“共享、可解释、可干预”的图像/文本级特征分解，这对理解 VLM 内部对齐和层间可控性有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上提出 Joint Sparse Autoencoder（JSAE），在对视觉和语言激活做联合稀疏分解时加入显式对齐约束，使 sequence-pooled 的视觉与文本激活被映射到共享特征空间。随后用这些特征做双向干预：一类是 additive steering，向特征方向加偏置；另一类是 suppression，抑制对应特征，观察输出变化，并比较不同层的干预敏感性。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖三个 VLM：LLaVA-v1.6-Mistral-7B、Llama3-LLaVA-8B 和 Qwen3-VL-30B。论文声称 JSAE 能恢复出食物、动物等可识别跨模态概念，并观察到层依赖的不对称性：additive steering 在中后层、接近输出前的层效果最好，而 suppression 在各层的分数相对更平，至少在统计噪声范围内没有明显峰值。摘要未给出更细的定量增益，因此更适合作为现象性结果看待。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a recurring issue in VLM interpretability: standard SAEs often produce features that are hard to use as controllable cross-modal steering directions.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a mechanistic-interpretability contribution rather than a pretraining one. It extends SAE-style analysis from language models to VLMs and focuses on shared, interpretable, intervention-ready image/text-level features, which is mildly useful for understanding internal alignment in VLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method introduces a Joint Sparse Autoencoder (JSAE) with an explicit alignment constraint, jointly factorizing sequence-pooled vision and language activations into a shared sparse feature space. These learned features are then used for bidirectional interventions: additive steering and feature suppression, with layerwise sensitivity analyzed across the model stack.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on three VLMs: LLaVA-v1.6-Mistral-7B, Llama3-LLaVA-8B, and Qwen3-VL-30B. The paper reports that JSAE recovers recognizable cross-modal concepts such as food and animals, and finds a layer-dependent asymmetry: additive steering peaks in mid-to-late pre-output layers, while suppression remains relatively flat across layers within statistical noise. The abstract does not provide strong quantitative gains, so the result is more diagnostic than decisive.

recommendation.zh: 更像 VLM 可解释性的小步推进，不改 pretrain prior；只看层间干预不对称这个现象，若你在做 steering 或 SAE 才值得翻正文。
recommendation.en: This is a modest VLM interpretability paper, not a pretraining update; only the layerwise asymmetry in steering vs suppression is worth checking if you work on SAE or activation steering.

paper.title: P-MTP: Efficient Document Parsing via Multi-Token Prediction with Progressive Depth Scaling
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have revolutionized document parsing by enabling end-to-end mapping from images to structured text, imposing a significant latency bottleneck, particularly for token-dense documents. While Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) has emerged as a promising approach for accelerating inference, its potential is constrained by optimization instability when scaling to deeper look-ahead depth. In this paper, we propose \textbf{P-MTP}, a framework that leverages \textbf{Progressive M

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是文档解析 VLM 的一个很具体但也很现实的问题：输出序列很长，标准自回归解码一步只出一个 token，延迟高；而直接把 LLM 里的 multi-token prediction 套到文档解析上，又会在 look-ahead 深度变大时出现训练不稳和推理接受率下降。更细一点看，问题不只是“多预测几个 token 难”，而是远端 supervision 会在近端 token 已经错掉时继续回传梯度，造成错误轨迹上的噪声学习；同时固定深度 speculative drafting 也无法适应文档中不同区域的难度差异，简单区域浪费潜在加速，复杂区域则频繁 reject。论文的目标就是让 MTP 在文档解析这种 token-dense、视觉证据强约束的场景里，能把 look-ahead 深度真正做深，同时保持可训练、可接受、可落地。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身，它不是在改预训练范式，但对“训练目标如何服务高吞吐生成”有直接启发。第一，论文说明了在高确定性生成任务里，MTP 的瓶颈不只是模块设计，而是 loss 如何根据轨迹可靠性分配监督，这和预训练里 long-horizon target、any-order target、multi-step target 的稳定优化是同一类问题。第二，它把训练时的 trajectory-aware weighting 和推理时的 dynamic drafting 配成一套闭环，说明仅靠 inference trick 不够，训练目标必须显式建模 acceptance dynamics。第三，文档解析虽然是 VLM 任务，但其输出端是标准 LM 生成，很多观察可以迁移到代码生成、结构化抽取、OCR-heavy agent 这类高置信度 token generation 场景。贡献量级更像是“把已有 MTP 思路在一个高价值场景里做对”，不是新范式，但方法设计有一定普适性。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心有两部分。第一部分是 Progressive Curriculum Loss，用来解决深 look-ahead 训练不稳。论文不是对所有深度 k 的预测一视同仁地加权，而是给每个位置 t、每个深度 k 一个自适应权重 ω_{t,k}。这个权重由两类约束组成：Sequential Confidence Constraint 和 Retrospective Target Constraint。前者利用前面各层 look-ahead 预测的 softmax 置信度做累计约束，近似衡量“走到第 k 步这条路径是否还可信”；如果前面某一步已经低置信或偏离，后面更远的 supervision 会被压低。这样做的直接作用，是避免 distal target 在 proximal prediction 已经失败时继续制造 hallucinated gradients。后者则从回顾式目标一致性角度再做一次筛选，抑制那些和真实目标轨迹不一致的远端监督。两者叠加后，loss 会自然形成 easy-to-hard 的课程学习：先学稳近端，再逐步放开远端。

第二部分是 Confidence-Gated Dynamic Drafting，用于推理阶段动态决定实际 draft 多深。传统 MTP 常用固定 K，但固定 K 在文档解析里明显不合适，因为表格、公式、纯文本段落的局部熵差异很大。P-MTP 在每一步根据累计联合置信度判断是否继续向更深处 draft：如果前几步 token 的联合概率仍高，就继续扩展；一旦累计可靠性跌破阈值，就提前截断。这样优化的是 αK 而不是单独追求大 K，其中 α 是接受率。论文还强调 MTP module 需要足够轻量，否则额外前向开销 γ 会吃掉加速收益，因此他们采用 shared lightweight MTP module 递归地产生多个 look-ahead token，而不是为每个深度堆重头分支。

和已有方法相比，区别主要有三点。其一，不再使用 constant 或 static-decay loss weighting，而是显式让 loss 感知 trajectory divergence。其二，不再把 drafting depth 当成固定超参，而是把它做成基于置信度的在线决策。其三，场景上利用了文档解析“视觉证据强、输出分布尖锐”的特性，说明 MTP 在这类任务里比开放域文本生成更有条件做深 look-ahead。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文片段可以确认，论文报告的主结果是：在文档解析任务上，P-MTP 在几乎不损失解析精度的前提下，推理加速最高可到 5×。作者把这个结果归因于两点同时成立：训练阶段更深的 look-ahead 可以稳定学出来，推理阶段动态 drafting 又能把简单样本上的潜在接受长度真正兑现出来。

实验结构上，值得注意的应当包括几类。第一类是与标准 NTP、自带固定深度 MTP、不同静态 loss weighting 策略的对比，用来证明 progressive weighting 的必要性。第二类是 look-ahead 深度 K 的扩展实验，通常会展示随着 K 增大，基线方法 acceptance rate 明显下降，而 P-MTP 能把更深 K 维持在可用区间。第三类是动态 drafting 的消融，验证固定 K 即便训练得住，也会因为场景难度波动而损失 αK。第四类是模块开销分析，轻量 MTP 分支的额外 overhead γ 需要足够低，否则理论 speedup 不能转成 wall-clock gain。

目前可从正文直接提取的硬数字主要是“up to 5× speedup with negligible impact on parsing accuracy”。摘要截断，没有完整 benchmark 表、参数量、训练数据规模、具体 acceptance rate 和不同 K 下的曲线数字。如果精读原文，建议重点补齐：1）主干 VLM 规模；2）MTP module 参数占比；3）不同 K 的接受率 α；4）真实吞吐提升而非仅 token/s；5）在表格、公式、长文段等不同文档类型上的收益差异。这些数字决定方法是工程上可复用，还是只在特定设置下成立。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，但方法部分要读细。优先看 Introduction 里 Figure 1，对训练不稳和固定深度 drafting 低效的两个问题定义得比较清楚。然后直接看 Method 里 Progressive Curriculum Loss 的公式，重点确认 ω_{t,k} 的具体构成：累计置信度怎么计算，是否 stop-gradient，Retrospective Target Constraint 具体依赖 teacher target、accepted path 还是模型自身历史输出。这里决定它究竟是一个稳健的 credit assignment 机制，还是经验性 reweighting。

接着看 Confidence-Gated Dynamic Drafting 的算法描述和伪代码，关注阈值如何设、是否需要额外校准、不同深度共享不共享 hidden state。再看实验部分的三张关键图表：1）不同 K 下的训练稳定性或 loss 曲线；2）接受率/加速比随深度变化；3）精度-延迟 trade-off。若时间有限，30-40 分钟足够抓住主线；若想判断它对通用 LM 训练有没有启发，需要额外看 supplementary 里的 speedup 推导和失败案例，尤其是复杂布局下动态截断是否只是保守回退到浅层 MTP。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a practical bottleneck in document-parsing VLMs: decoding is slow because outputs are long and standard autoregressive generation emits one token per step. Multi-token prediction is an obvious acceleration route, but pushing the look-ahead depth deeper causes two coupled failures in this setting. During training, distal supervision becomes noisy once proximal predictions have already diverged, so deeper targets inject gradients along unreliable trajectories. During inference, a fixed drafting depth is a poor fit because document regions vary a lot in local difficulty: easy spans could support deeper drafting, while hard spans trigger frequent rejection. The paper tries to make deep MTP actually usable for token-dense document parsing, not just theoretically appealing.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is relevant to pretraining researchers because it isolates a general optimization issue: how to supervise multi-step predictions when later targets are only meaningful if earlier ones remain reliable. That same issue appears in long-horizon target design, speculative objectives, and broader non-standard LM training setups. A second useful point is that the paper treats training and inference as a coupled system: better acceptance at inference requires a trajectory-aware loss during training, not only a decoding heuristic. The contribution is best read as a solid adaptation of MTP to a high-value structured generation setting, with lessons that may transfer to code generation, OCR-heavy generation, and other high-confidence token prediction regimes.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has two main components. The first is Progressive Curriculum Loss, designed to stabilize deep look-ahead training. Instead of assigning a constant or hand-decayed weight to every prediction depth k at position t, the model uses an adaptive weight ω_{t,k}. This weight combines two constraints. The Sequential Confidence Constraint uses the softmax confidence of preceding look-ahead predictions to estimate whether the trajectory up to depth k is still trustworthy. If an earlier step is already uncertain or off-track, supervision for deeper predictions is down-weighted. This suppresses the classic failure mode where distal targets keep backpropagating through a path that has already collapsed. The Retrospective Target Constraint adds another filter based on consistency with the target trajectory, further reducing noisy supervision from unreliable deep predictions. Together, these terms create an implicit easy-to-hard curriculum: the model first learns stable short-horizon prediction and only gradually receives stronger supervision on deeper horizons.

The second component is Confidence-Gated Dynamic Drafting for inference. Standard MTP usually fixes the drafting depth K, but fixed K is suboptimal for document parsing because entropy varies sharply across layouts, tables, formulas, and plain text spans. P-MTP instead decides online how far to draft based on cumulative joint confidence. If the predicted path remains reliable, the model keeps extending the draft; if confidence drops below a threshold, it truncates early. This directly optimizes the useful quantity αK, where α is the acceptance rate, rather than maximizing K in isolation. The paper also keeps the MTP branch lightweight, using a shared module that recurrently produces multiple look-ahead predictions, so the extra overhead γ stays small enough for real wall-clock gains.

Relative to prior MTP work, the main differences are: trajectory-aware loss weighting instead of static weighting, adaptive drafting depth instead of fixed-depth drafting, and an explicit exploitation of the document-parsing regime where visual evidence makes token distributions sharper than in open-ended text generation.
summary_en.experiments:
From the full text provided, the main empirical claim is clear: P-MTP reaches up to 5× inference speedup on document parsing with negligible accuracy loss. The paper attributes this to the combination of stable deep look-ahead training and adaptive drafting at inference, rather than either component alone.

The most important experiments are likely organized around four questions. First, comparisons against standard next-token prediction, vanilla fixed-depth MTP, and static loss-weighting variants, to show that progressive weighting is necessary. Second, scaling studies over look-ahead depth K, where baseline MTP should show collapsing acceptance as K grows, while P-MTP remains usable at deeper horizons. Third, ablations on dynamic drafting, showing that even if a model can be trained with deep K, a fixed K still wastes speedup because local difficulty varies. Fourth, overhead analysis of the lightweight MTP module, since theoretical speedup only matters if the extra branch cost remains low.

The hard numbers visible in the provided text are limited to 'up to 5× speedup with negligible impact on parsing accuracy.' The excerpt does not include full benchmark tables, model size, training scale, acceptance-rate curves, or detailed latency breakdowns. When reading the original paper, the most important missing numbers to extract are: backbone VLM size, parameter share of the MTP module, acceptance rate α at different K, wall-clock throughput rather than token-level proxy metrics, and gains across different document types such as tables, formulas, and long text blocks.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim-level paper, but the method section deserves careful attention. Start with Figure 1 in the introduction, because it frames the two real problems cleanly: unstable deep supervision and inefficiency of fixed-depth drafting. Then go straight to the formulas for Progressive Curriculum Loss. The key questions are how cumulative confidence is computed, whether gradients are stopped through the weighting path, and what exactly the retrospective consistency term compares against. Those details determine whether the method is a principled credit-assignment mechanism or mostly a heuristic reweighting trick.

Next, read the algorithm for Confidence-Gated Dynamic Drafting and check how thresholds are chosen, whether calibration is needed, and how hidden states are reused across depths. In the experiments, focus on three plots or tables if available: training stability versus depth, acceptance/speedup versus depth, and the accuracy-latency trade-off. Around 30-40 minutes should be enough to capture the main idea. If the goal is to judge transferability to general LM training, also inspect the supplementary derivation of speedup and any failure cases on complex layouts, especially whether the dynamic policy often falls back to shallow drafting in hard regions.

recommendation.zh: 将 MTP 扩展到更深深度的训练 trick，其 Progressive Curriculum Loss 对稳定 MTP 训练有启发，值得看方法部分。
recommendation.en: Training tricks for scaling MTP to deeper depths; its Progressive Curriculum Loss is instructive for stabilizing MTP training. Worth reading the method section.

paper.title: Listening makes Vision Clear for VLMs
paper.abstract: Recent work typically assesses vision--language consistency using attention distributions of answer-side tokens. However, we observe that highest attention regions are not always consistent with the intended semantic token. This probably stems from decoding drift, where language priors from previously generated answer tokens accumulate and mismatch with visual attention. Besides the priors from previous answer tokens, we find that structural tokens, e.g., modality boundary markers, may encompass

summary.core_problem: 现有VLM视觉-语言一致性评估依赖答案生成侧token的注意力分布，受解码过程的语言先验和特殊token干扰，无法准确反映模型真实的视觉对齐情况。
summary.importance: 识别了VLM注意力评估中的两类系统性偏差来源，提出基于提示侧语义的激活图度量，提升VLM视觉-语言一致性评估的可靠性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Prompt-Vision Token Activation Map（PV-TAM），使用提示侧语义token而非生成侧答案token的注意力关联视觉区域，加入过滤器去除模态边界标记等结构token引入的系统偏差，结合激活强度的峰值分布而非仅mask重叠计算一致性。
summary.experiments: 摘要内容截断，未给出在具体VLM模型上的量化评估结果，仅描述了传统方法的偏差来源和新度量的核心设计思路。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing vision-language consistency evaluation for VLMs relies on attention distributions of answer-side tokens, which is distorted by decoding-time language priors and special token interference, failing to reflect true visual alignment.
summary_en.importance: Identifies two systematic bias sources in VLM attention evaluation, and proposes a prompt-side activation map metric to improve the reliability of vision-language consistency measurement.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the Prompt-Vision Token Activation Map (PV-TAM), which uses prompt-side semantic tokens instead of generated answer tokens to associate visual regions, adds a filter to remove systematic bias from structural tokens like modality boundary markers, and leverages peak activation distribution rather than mask overlap alone to measure consistency.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract is truncated, no quantitative evaluation results on specific VLMs are provided, only the bias sources of existing methods and core design of the new metric are described.

recommendation.zh: 指出VLM答案侧注意力的解码漂移与特殊token偏差问题，对多模态预训练注意力设计有弱参考，只看偏差分析段。
recommendation.en: Identifies answer-side attention drift and special token bias in VLMs, weak reference for multimodal pretraining attention design, only read the bias analysis section.

paper.title: ABACUS: Adapting Unified Foundation Model for Bridging Image Count Understanding and Generation
paper.abstract: ABACUS is a unified vision-language model that handles object counting, crowd counting, referring-expression counting, and count-faithful image generation without any benchmark-specific training required. Our model is built on existing 3B-parameter unified foundation model and is adapted for object localization tasks using three key innovations: density-aware adaptive zooming with objectness maps for spatial grounding; a boundary-aware count policy via GRPO to eliminate crop-boundary errors; and

summary.core_problem: 解决统一视觉语言模型在图像计数理解和计数一致图像生成之间能力不一致的问题，尤其是物体计数、密集人群计数、指代表达计数和生成图像中数量不守恒。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态后训练和统一理解-生成适配。它不是基座预训练工作，但把 GRPO 用在视觉计数策略和生成自校验上，对理解 VLM 的 RL 信号设计有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: ABACUS 基于已有 3B 参数统一基础模型进行适配，不针对单个 benchmark 训练。方法包含三点：用 objectness map 做 density-aware adaptive zooming，提高空间 grounding；用 boundary-aware count policy 结合 GRPO 减少裁剪边界带来的漏数/重复数；用 cycle-consistent GRPO，让理解分支自我评估生成结果，从而不依赖外部标注来约束生成数量。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在七个计数相关 benchmark 上取得领先结果，超过任务专用模型和更大的通用模型；但未提供具体模型底座名称、训练数据规模、GRPO 设置、各 benchmark 数值和提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: ABACUS targets the gap between count understanding and count-faithful image generation in unified vision-language models, covering object counting, crowd counting, referring-expression counting, and generation with correct object counts.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a multimodal adaptation and post-training recipe rather than base pretraining. Its useful signal is how GRPO can be shaped around visual counting policies and self-critique between understanding and generation branches.
summary_en.technical_approach: The model adapts an existing 3B unified foundation model without benchmark-specific training. It uses density-aware adaptive zooming with objectness maps for grounding, a boundary-aware count policy optimized with GRPO to reduce crop-boundary errors, and cycle-consistent GRPO where the understanding branch critiques generated outputs without external annotations.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports leading results on seven counting benchmarks, outperforming task-specific specialists and larger generalist models. It does not provide the exact backbone, training data scale, GRPO details, or per-benchmark effect sizes.

recommendation.zh: 只看 GRPO 计数策略和自循环校验设计；这是 VLM 后训练信号工程，不会改变预训练 prior。
recommendation.en: Skim only the GRPO count-policy and cycle-critique design; it is useful signal engineering for VLM post-training, not a pretraining prior shift.

paper.title: Look Light, Think Heavy: What Multimodal Chain-of-Thought Reasoning Can and Cannot Do
paper.abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) has become a standard method for improving reasoning capabilities in large language models (LLMs) by eliciting step-by-step thinking, but its effectiveness in multimodal tasks remains unclear. In this paper, we aim to systematically investigate the key question: What can multimodal Chain-of-Thought reasoning do, and where and why does it fall short? To this end, we evaluate 12 multimodal tasks across perception and reasoning categories using both 14 non-reasoning models an

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究多模态 Chain-of-Thought 的适用边界：CoT 在视觉语言任务中什么时候有帮助，什么时候会带来额外错误，以及当前多模态 reasoning model 为什么没有稳定地从长推理中受益。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的启发主要在两个方面。第一，视觉语言模型的 test-time scaling 不能直接照搬纯文本推理模型的经验；更长的语言推理不等于更好的视觉推理。第二，当前多模态 RLVR 或 reasoning 训练如果过度集中在数学题，可能会提高少数推理 benchmark，却不能形成广泛的视觉-语言推理能力。对预训练和中训练而言，这提示视觉 token 的持续利用、视觉反思能力、视觉工具调用和任务混合，比单纯拉长 CoT 更关键。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把多模态任务分成两类：感知任务和推理任务。感知任务包括综合评测、OCR、视觉 grounding、幻觉、知识型 VQA、目标计数；推理任务包括数学、科学、逻辑、算法、空间和多图推理。实验比较了 direct answering 与 CoT reasoning，并覆盖 14 个非 reasoning 模型和 8 个 reasoning 模型。分析不只看最终准确率，还进一步检查外部行为和内部机制。外部行为上，论文区分 visual reflection 和 verbal reflection：前者指模型是否持续回看和修正视觉信息理解，后者指语言层面的自我检查。内部机制上，论文观察长 CoT 中对视觉 token 与推理 token 的注意力分配，发现模型在生成较长推理时逐渐把注意力集中到语言推理 token，弱化对视觉输入的使用。这解释了标题中的 “Look Light, Think Heavy”：语言推理很长，但视觉信息利用不足。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 12 类多模态任务、14 个非 reasoning 模型和 8 个 reasoning 模型，包括 Qwen2.5-VL、Gemma-3、GPT-4.1、QVQ、Skywork-R1V2、Gemini-Thinking 等。主要结果是：CoT 对感知任务并不稳定，可能损害视觉 grounding、知识型 VQA 和目标计数等任务；对数学、科学、多图推理更有帮助，几乎在多数模型上带来正向收益；对逻辑和算法推理则高度依赖模型规模和基础能力，大模型更容易受益，小模型可能出现负收益。对 reasoning model 的比较显示，现有开源多模态 reasoning 模型在广泛任务平均表现上通常只有边际提升，可能因为训练主要集中在数学 RLVR。商业 reasoning 模型如 Gemini-2.0-Flash-Thinking 在更多推理任务上表现出更一致的增益。机制分析显示，verbal reflection 在推理中段上升后回落，而 visual reflection 随推理过程持续下降；长 CoT 中还存在对 reasoning tokens 的注意力偏置，视觉 tokens 被逐步忽视。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30 分钟。先看任务分类和模型列表，确认评测覆盖面；再看 RQ1 的 direct answer 与 CoT 对比，这是判断多模态 CoT 是否该启用的核心依据。RQ2 适合关注开源 reasoning VLM 与原模型的差距，尤其是数学 RLVR 训练带来的任务偏置。RQ3 最值得做预训练的人细看：visual reflection、verbal reflection 和 attention bias 的分析直接指向训练目标设计问题。若时间有限，优先看 Figure 1 及围绕三个 RQ 的实验结论；具体 benchmark 细节可以快速扫过。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies the operating range of multimodal Chain-of-Thought reasoning: when step-by-step reasoning helps vision-language models, when it hurts, and why current multimodal reasoning models do not consistently benefit from longer test-time reasoning.
summary_en.importance: The main lesson for foundation-model research is that visual-language test-time scaling cannot be copied directly from text-only reasoning models. Longer verbal reasoning does not guarantee better visual reasoning. The results also suggest that multimodal RLVR focused mostly on math problems can produce narrow gains without broad reasoning transfer. For pretraining and mid-training, the relevant issues are persistent use of visual tokens, visual introspection, tool-assisted perception, and task mixture design, rather than simply encouraging longer CoT traces.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study separates multimodal tasks into perception and reasoning categories. Perception tasks include broad multimodal evaluation, OCR, visual grounding, hallucination, knowledge-based VQA, and object counting. Reasoning tasks include math, science, logic, algorithmic reasoning, spatial reasoning, and multi-image reasoning. The experiments compare direct answering with CoT prompting across 14 non-reasoning models and 8 reasoning models. The analysis then goes beyond accuracy. It decomposes reflective behavior into visual reflection and verbal reflection, and inspects how attention shifts between visual tokens and reasoning tokens during long CoT generation. The key mechanism is that current models often reason extensively in language while progressively reducing their use of visual evidence.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers 12 multimodal task families and 22 models in total, including non-reasoning models such as Qwen2.5-VL, Gemma-3, and GPT-4.1, and reasoning models such as QVQ, Skywork-R1V2, and Gemini-Thinking. CoT is not uniformly beneficial. It can hurt perception-heavy tasks such as visual grounding, knowledge-based VQA, and object counting. It is more consistently useful for math, science, and multi-image reasoning. For logical and algorithmic reasoning, gains depend strongly on the model: larger models tend to benefit, while smaller models can degrade. Existing open-source multimodal reasoning models show only marginal average gains across the broad task set, likely because their training is dominated by math-oriented RLVR. Commercial reasoning models, especially Gemini-2.0-Flash-Thinking, show more consistent improvements on diverse reasoning tasks. The mechanism analysis reports a “Look Light, Think Heavy” pattern: verbal reflection rises and then falls through the reasoning trace, while visual reflection steadily declines; attention also becomes increasingly biased toward reasoning tokens over visual tokens.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30 minutes. Start with the task taxonomy and model list to understand the evaluation scope. Then read the RQ1 results comparing direct answering and CoT; this is the most practical part for deciding when multimodal CoT should be enabled. RQ2 is useful for understanding the gap between open-source reasoning VLMs and their base models, especially the task bias introduced by math-heavy RLVR. RQ3 is the most relevant part for pretraining researchers, because the visual-reflection and attention-bias analyses point to weaknesses in current training objectives. If time is limited, focus on Figure 1 and the conclusions around the three research questions, and skim the benchmark-specific details.

recommendation.zh: 值得看任务分组和失败案例；它会约束 VLM CoT 数据合成，避免把感知任务也硬写成长推理。
recommendation.en: Read the task split and failure cases; it constrains VLM CoT data synthesis by warning against forcing perception tasks into long reasoning traces.

The Laboratory of Cognition and Decision Intelligence for Complex Systems

paper.title: Gold Points Sniper: Self-guided Visual Reasoning in VLM for Fine-grained Action Understanding
paper.abstract: Robots operating in everyday environments must understand fine-grained human actions, intentions, and contextual cues from broad views where people occupy only small regions, a capability unmet by current systems. While open-vocabulary action recognition methods remain limited to assigning predefined labels, and vision-language models (VLMs) face an inherent trade-off between informational richness and factual fidelity in their outputs, neither approach achieves the deep semantic interpretation

summary.core_problem: 让轻量级 VLM 在宽视角场景中理解细粒度人体动作、意图和上下文线索。
summary.importance: 贡献属于 VLM 推理框架改进，面向机器人动作理解。它不是 native multimodal pretraining，也没有明显改变视觉 tokenizer、对齐目标或统一建模方式。
summary.technical_approach: Gold Points Sniper 包含三个模块：Gold Points Extractor 先让 VLM 找出与动作相关的关键视觉细节；Selective Socratic Questioner 通过选择性自问自答验证并修正这些细节；Semantic Entailment Evaluator 对生成的语义解释做量化评估。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体数据集、模型规模和提升幅度。实验目标是验证该框架是否能提升轻量 VLM 对细粒度动作的语义解释能力，并缓解输出信息丰富度与事实可靠性之间的张力。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to help lightweight VLMs understand fine-grained human actions, intentions, and contextual cues from wide-view scenes.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a VLM reasoning framework for robotic action understanding. It is not native multimodal pretraining and does not appear to change visual tokenization, alignment losses, or unified modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: Gold Points Sniper has three modules: a Gold Points Extractor that identifies action-relevant visual details, a Selective Socratic Questioner that validates and refines those details through self-questioning, and a Semantic Entailment Evaluator that scores the generated semantic interpretation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report datasets, model sizes, or numerical gains. The experiments are meant to show improved fine-grained semantic interpretation by lightweight VLMs while reducing the tension between rich outputs and factual fidelity.

recommendation.zh: 作为 VLM 自问自答式细粒度感知框架扫一眼即可；更像任务脚手架，不太会改变预训练判断。
recommendation.en: Glance at it as a VLM self-questioning scaffold for fine-grained perception; it is task-facing and unlikely to change pretraining priors.

paper.title: LaViSA: A Language and Vision Structural Ambiguity Benchmark
paper.abstract: Structural ambiguity arises when a single sentence admits multiple valid interpretations due to its syntactic structure, posing a fundamental challenge for language understanding. Visual scenes serve as useful cues for resolving such ambiguity, and Vision and Language Models (VLMs) need to be capable of deriving possible semantic interpretations from visual scenes. We introduce Language and Vision Structural Ambiguity (LaViSA), a benchmark designed to evaluate the ability of VLMs to resolve stru

summary.core_problem: 评测 VLM 是否能借助图像消解句法结构歧义，而不是只做表层图文匹配。
summary.importance: 这是一个评测贡献。结构歧义是语言理解里的老问题，但在 VLM 里常被更粗粒度的 caption/QA 指标掩盖。把“同一句话对应多种合法语义解析”显式做成图文基准，有助于检查模型到底有没有把视觉证据接到语言组合结构上。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 LaViSA 基准，包含歧义句、对应的去歧义句，以及与不同解释对应的图像，覆盖七类结构歧义。作者用该基准系统评测多种闭源和开源 VLM，比较参数规模与推理能力差异，观察模型在视觉辅助下选择正确语义解释的能力边界。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整数据规模与具体模型清单，但说明覆盖多类 VLM、不同参数规模和是否具备 reasoning 能力的模型。结论是：近期 VLM 能在一定程度上利用视觉线索做消歧，但在更细粒度、结构性更强的歧义类型上仍明显不足，说明当前多模态对齐并未稳定学到组合式语义解析。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自奈良先端科学技术大学院大学、RIKEN Guardian Robot Project 和大阪大学。

summary_en.core_problem: It evaluates whether VLMs can use visual evidence to resolve syntactic structural ambiguity, rather than relying on shallow image-text matching.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation contribution. Structural ambiguity is a classic language understanding problem, but standard VLM benchmarks often hide it behind coarse captioning or QA metrics. Turning it into an explicit vision-language benchmark probes whether models actually connect visual grounding to compositional linguistic structure.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces LaViSA, a benchmark with ambiguous sentences, their disambiguated counterparts, and images corresponding to different valid interpretations, spanning seven ambiguity categories. It then evaluates a range of proprietary and open-source VLMs across scales and reasoning profiles to measure visual disambiguation ability.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide full dataset size or a complete model list, but it states that the evaluation covers diverse VLMs with varying parameter scales and reasoning capabilities. The main finding is that recent VLMs can leverage visual scenes to some extent, yet still struggle on finer-grained and structurally demanding ambiguity cases, suggesting current multimodal alignment does not robustly capture compositional semantic parsing.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from NAIST, RIKEN Guardian Robot Project, and The University of Osaka.

recommendation.zh: 做多模态预训练的人可以把它当 stress test 备查；不改方法论，但能提醒你现有 VLM 可能只是学会了图文共现，没真接上句法组合性。
recommendation.en: Useful as a stress-test reference for multimodal pretraining: it likely won’t change your recipe, but it is a clean reminder that many VLMs may still ride on co-occurrence instead of grounded compositional syntax.

institutions: Nara Institute of Science and Technology

paper.title: SPOT-E: Test-Time Entropy Shaping with Visual Spotlights for Frozen VLMs
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) often underperform on evidence intensive tasks because decisive visual evidence are small, localized, and easy to overlook, leading to failures in evidence readout even when high-level reasoning is intact. Prior inference-time visual interventions can improve grounding without retraining, but they are largely open-loop and lack a mechanism to verify whether highlighted evidence is actually used. We study answer-span prediction entropy as a model-internal feedback si

summary.core_problem: 解决冻结 VLM 在证据密集型视觉问答中容易忽略小而局部的关键视觉证据的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是 VLM 推理时干预方法：用模型内部的 answer-span entropy 作为反馈信号，尝试让视觉 spotlight 不只是突出区域，而是被模型实际用于回答。对预训练研究的价值主要在于提供一种观察 VLM grounding 失败的内部信号。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SPOT-E，一种 plug-and-play test-time 方法。它为每个样本生成 question-conditioned visual spotlights，并通过轻量优化调整 spotlight；核心是 entropy-shaping objective：降低答案不确定性，同时保留 baseline 中高置信 token，避免单纯 entropy minimization 导致 shortcut collapse。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 benchmark、模型规模、baseline 或提升幅度；方法设定是 frozen VLM，不进行参数级再训练，优化发生在测试时的视觉 spotlight 生成或调节阶段。
summary.authors_note: 作者列表包括 Shuicheng Yan；题录未提供机构信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses failures of frozen VLMs on evidence-intensive tasks where the decisive visual clue is small, localized, and easily ignored.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a test-time intervention for VLM grounding. Its most relevant point for foundation-model researchers is the use of answer-span entropy as an internal signal, together with a correction for shortcut confidence.
summary_en.technical_approach: SPOT-E generates question-conditioned visual spotlights and optimizes them per instance with a lightweight test-time procedure. The key design is entropy shaping: reduce answer uncertainty while preserving high-confidence baseline tokens, so that low entropy is less likely to come from shortcut collapse.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify benchmarks, VLM sizes, baselines, or numerical gains. The setup keeps the VLM frozen and performs instance-level visual intervention at inference time.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Shuicheng Yan; no institutional metadata is provided in the prompt.

recommendation.zh: 只看 entropy-shaping 的定义和失败案例即可；它是 VLM grounding 信号设计的弱但有用证据。
recommendation.en: Read the entropy-shaping definition and failure cases; it is a modest but useful signal-design study for VLM grounding.

paper.title: The Hidden Evolution of Disguised Visual Context inside the VLM
paper.abstract: Visual tokens enter Large Language Models (LLMs) as raw, foreign signals. How they are transformed into meaningful representations and interact with the language space depends entirely on the integration architecture. Whether by treating visual tokens as in-context prompts within the input sequence or injecting them directly into the LLM's intermediate layers. A controlled comparison and understanding of how these architectural choices affect visual information and its internal transformation to

summary.core_problem: VLM 里“视觉信息如何进入 LLM”有两大路线：把视觉 token 当作输入序列的一部分（in-context injection），或在中间层用跨注意力/门控等方式注入（layer-wise injection）。现有对比往往被数据配比、token 预算、模型规模、训练策略等混杂因素污染，导致很难回答：到底是集成范式本身改变了模型内部的表征演化与视觉利用方式，还是别的因素。论文要解决的是：在严格控制训练条件下，隔离 integration 变量，系统比较两类范式在单图、多图、视频任务上的表现，并给出 LLM 内部视觉表征“如何演化”的机制性证据。
summary.importance:
这篇更偏 VLM 架构与机制分析，不是典型“纯预训练 recipe”。但它对做多模态基座预训练的人有现实价值：
- integration 选择会改变视觉表征在深度方向的连续性、频率信息偏好、以及向语言空间靠拢的方式，这些会直接影响长上下文、多视觉 token（OCR、视频）场景的可用性与算力开销。
- 它提供了一个相对干净的对照实验范式：同训练条件下比较架构差异，并用层间表征分析解释性能差距，能帮助减少“凭经验选架构”。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上不是提出新模型，而是做 controlled comparison + mechanistic analyses。
1) 控制变量：在尽量一致的训练条件下（相同/可比的数据、token 预算、规模与优化设置），实现代表性的 in-context 与 layer-wise injection VLM，并在单图、多图、视频基准上评测。
2) 四类机制分析（围绕 LLM 内部视觉表征）：
- 表征连续性：测试视觉 token 表征是否随层数平滑演化；作者声称两种范式在“跨层连续性”上有系统差异。
- 频率分析：用频域视角看不同深度捕获的视觉特征类型（更偏低频结构还是高频细节），并比较两种注入方式的偏好。
- 向语言空间的收敛：分析视觉表征是否、以及在何处更接近语言表征空间，从而解释跨模态兼容性差异。
- 生成时的视觉利用：分析生成过程中模型何时使用视觉信息；并指出仅看 attention allocation 不足以解释性能差距，关键在于 layer-wise 视觉表征质量。
3) 结论导向：把“注入位置”从工程选择提升为表征与可访问性（accessibility）选择，尤其针对需要组合大量细粒度视觉证据的任务（OCR、视频）。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 single-image、multi-image、video benchmarks，并在相同训练条件下对比两类 integration。
主要发现类型（按引言描述）：
- 两类范式在多任务上的强弱不同，且差异可被层间表征演化特征部分解释。
- attention 权重大小与性能不总一致；更决定性的因素是中间层视觉表征是否“可用”（质量、与语言空间的兼容、以及在深层是否被保留/变形）。
（注：你提供的全文片段未包含具体 benchmark 名称与数值表格；若需要精确数字与显著性结论，需要补充实验章节/附录。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30-45 分钟）：
- 先看实验设置里如何做到“只变 integration，不变其它”，这是可信度的根。
- 机制分析部分按四个问题读：跨层连续性、频率分析、语言空间收敛、生成时利用；优先看能把性能差距解释清楚的图（通常是 layer-wise 曲线/相似度矩阵/频谱统计）。
- 如果你关心长上下文/多图/视频，把多图与视频的对比结果和对应的表征分析对起来看，理解哪类 integration 更容易在深层保留细粒度证据。
- 预计阅读时间：只看结论与关键图表 30 分钟；把方法实现细节也过一遍约 45 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Vision tokens enter an LLM through different integration paradigms: (i) in-context injection, where visual tokens are concatenated with text at the input and processed by standard self-attention throughout; and (ii) layer-wise injection, where visual information is injected into intermediate layers via cross-attention/gating/other mechanisms. Prior comparisons are heavily confounded by differences in data mixtures, token budgets, model scale, and optimization, so it remains unclear what integration alone changes inside the LLM. This paper isolates integration as the primary variable, compares representative architectures under matched training conditions across single-image, multi-image, and video benchmarks, and characterizes how visual representations evolve inside the LLM.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an architecture/analysis paper for VLM pretraining rather than a new pretraining recipe. Still, it matters for foundation-model builders because integration design controls (a) compute and token budget behavior in long-context multimodal settings, and (b) whether fine-grained visual evidence (OCR, video) remains accessible to language generation at depth. The controlled setup plus layer-wise mechanistic probes provides a more reliable basis for choosing integration strategies than benchmark-only, confounded comparisons.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The contribution is a controlled comparison paired with mechanistic analyses.
1) Controlled training: implement in-context and layer-wise injection VLMs with otherwise matched training conditions (data/scale/token budget/optimization as aligned as possible).
2) Four complementary analyses of internal visual processing:
- Representational continuity across depth: whether visual token representations evolve smoothly layer by layer, and how this differs by paradigm.
- Frequency-based analysis: what spatial-frequency content is emphasized at different depths under each integration strategy.
- Convergence toward the language space: whether/where visual representations become more compatible with language representations.
- Visual usage during generation: when the model relies on visual information; they argue attention allocation alone does not explain performance gaps—representation quality at the injected layers is a key driver.
3) Interpretation: integration is framed as a choice that shapes representational accessibility across depth, especially for tasks requiring composition over many visual tokens (OCR, video).
summary_en.experiments:
They evaluate both paradigms on single-image, multi-image, and video benchmarks under matched training conditions.
Reported findings (as described in the introduction):
- Paradigms exhibit different strengths across tasks, and the differences correlate with distinct layer-wise representational dynamics.
- Attention mass on visual tokens is not a sufficient explanation; the quality and evolution of layer-wise visual representations better predict downstream capability.
(The provided excerpt does not include benchmark names or numeric tables; exact scores and deltas require the experiments/appendix sections.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~30–45 min):
- Start with the experimental controls: how they keep everything fixed except integration.
- Then read the four analysis blocks (continuity, frequency, language-space convergence, generation-time usage). Prioritize the layer-wise plots/matrices that connect representation dynamics to benchmark outcomes.
- If your focus is long-context multimodality, align the multi-image/video results with the corresponding representation analyses to see which paradigm better preserves fine-grained evidence at depth.

recommendation.zh: 读表征分析部分即可；若 setup 真公平，它能校准 connector 位置选择，不必太在意榜单分数。
recommendation.en: Read the representation analysis; if the setup is truly matched, it helps calibrate connector placement more than benchmark scores do.

paper.title: Occ-VLM: Occupancy Grounded Vision Language Model for Indoor Scene Understanding
paper.abstract: Recently, vision-language models (VLMs) have made significant progress in 3D scene understanding, driving advances in applications such as embodied intelligence and robotic vision. However, existing approaches typically either rely directly on explicit 3D inputs (e.g., point clouds or RGB-D sequences), or introduce an additional 3D geometry encoder to derive 3D-aware visual tokens from 2D images. Such designs structurally decouple 3D geometric perception from the rich 2D semantics learned via vi

summary.core_problem: 在只输入 posed RGB 图像、且不额外引入 3D 几何编码器的条件下，让 VLM 获得室内场景的 3D 几何理解能力。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM/3D 场景理解方法。它试图把 3D occupancy 作为辅助几何先验接入 2D 视觉编码器和 LLM 解码流程，关注统一 2D 语义与 3D 几何表示；这比普通 3D 下游任务更接近多模态预训练接口，但仍偏应用。
summary.technical_approach: Occ-VLM 使用单个 2D vision encoder 处理 posed RGB images，并重建 3D scene occupancy 作为辅助几何 prior；occupancy 被用于把前景 2D token 与 3D 空间建立空间关联，随后由 LLM 对这些融合了几何线索的 token 进行统一解码，避免显式点云/RGB-D 输入或独立 3D encoder 带来的结构割裂。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有披露模型规模、训练数据、benchmark、baseline 或具体提升幅度。预期实验会比较依赖点云/RGB-D、使用额外 3D encoder 的 3D VLM，以及纯 2D VLM 在室内场景问答、定位或关系理解上的表现。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to give a VLM 3D indoor-scene understanding from posed RGB images alone, without explicit 3D inputs or an additional geometry encoder.
summary_en.importance: This is a VLM and 3D scene-understanding method. It uses 3D occupancy as an auxiliary geometric prior to connect 2D visual tokens with LLM decoding, making it more relevant to multimodal pretraining interfaces than ordinary 3D downstream tasks, though it remains application-leaning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Occ-VLM uses a single 2D vision encoder over posed RGB images and reconstructs 3D scene occupancy as an auxiliary prior. The occupancy representation spatially associates foreground 2D tokens with 3D space, and an LLM decodes these geometry-grounded tokens. This avoids explicit point-cloud/RGB-D inputs and separate 3D geometry encoders.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not disclose model scale, training data, benchmarks, baselines, or quantitative gains. The likely evaluation compares against 3D VLMs using point clouds/RGB-D or extra 3D encoders, as well as pure 2D VLMs, on indoor scene QA, localization, or relation-understanding tasks.

recommendation.zh: 可看方法图和消融；occupancy 接 2D token 的接口有参考价值，但摘要未给规模证据。
recommendation.en: Worth checking the method diagram and ablations; the occupancy-to-2D-token interface is useful, but the abstract gives no scale evidence.

paper.title: Spectral Query-Key Product Weight Steering for Training-Free VLM Hallucination Mitigation
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) often generate fluent but visually unsupported descriptions, especially by mentioning objects absent from the image. We propose QK Product Steering, a data-free, training-free, and zero-inference-cost weight edit for reducing object hallucination. The method directly edits the per-head query-key product, the operator that produces pre-softmax attention logits, by suppressing a small number of dominant singular modes in selected middle layers. The edited product is t

summary.core_problem: 视觉语言模型(VLM)常生成图像中不存在的物体，产生物体幻觉，现有缓解方法多需要训练或额外推理成本。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出无数据、无训练、零额外推理成本的权重编辑方法缓解VLM物体幻觉，兼容分组查询注意力。
summary.technical_approach: 提出QK Product Steering：在中间层注意力头中抑制QK乘积的少量主导奇异模，通过闭式更新仅修改query权重、固定key权重，实现训练无感的权重编辑；还分解QK乘积为对称/反对称分量区分内容相似与方向注意力模式。
summary.experiments: 在3个基于GQA的VLM上，CHAIR_s指标平均相对降低4.0%，随机模控制组效果可忽略，基本不损失通用生成能力。

summary_en.core_problem: Vision-language models (VLMs) frequently hallucinate objects not present in images; existing mitigation methods usually require training or add inference overhead.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: data-free, training-free, zero-inference-cost weight edit to reduce VLM object hallucination, compatible with grouped-query attention.
summary_en.technical_approach: QK Product Steering suppresses a small number of dominant singular modes of the QK product in selected middle layers; applies closed-form query-only weight update while keeping shared keys fixed; further decomposes QK product into symmetric/antisymmetric components to separate content-similarity and directional attention patterns.
summary_en.experiments: Across 3 GQA-based VLMs, achieves average 4.0% relative CHAIR_s reduction; random-mode controls show negligible effect, with minimal loss of general generation capability.

recommendation.zh: 注意力QK谱分析+闭式权重编辑的思路干净，可迁移到纯LLM的幻觉/事实性修正，看奇异值分解部分即可。
recommendation.en: Clean approach of QK spectral analysis + closed-form weight editing transfers to hallucination / factuality correction in pure LLMs; read the SVD decomposition part only.

paper.title: Does VLA Even Know the Basics? Measuring Commonsense and World Knowledge Retention in Vision-Language-Action Models
paper.abstract: Embodied Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are typically obtained by fine-tuning powerful pretrained VLMs on robotics data, yet it is unclear how much commonsense and factual knowledge they retain after adaptation. Failures on knowledge-sensitive tasks are ambiguous, conflating missing knowledge with poor generalization of low-level control. We introduce Act2Answer, a lightweight protocol that adapts VLM knowledge benchmarks to VLA evaluation by requiring agents to answer through action. Each

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“VLA能不能完成操作任务”，而是一个更基础也更容易被忽略的问题：把强VLM微调成VLA之后，原来在视觉常识、事实知识、语义判断上的能力还剩多少。现有VLA评测大多把失败都记成任务失败，但任务失败可能来自感知、控制、环境扰动或规划，而不一定是知识缺失。作者因此提出一个尽量剥离控制干扰的评测协议，用动作而不是文本回答，把“知识是否还能驱动正确行为”单独测出来。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要在评测接口，而不是提出新的预训练方法。它把VLM→VLA适配中的知识保留问题显式化了，等于给“机器人微调是否造成灾难性遗忘”提供了一个可操作的测量工具。这个问题和持续预训练、模态迁移、post-train对表征的侵蚀都直接相关。对做统一多模态预训练的人，这篇文章的价值在于提醒：如果训练目标被动作监督强烈牵引，模型可能保留了底层表征，却失去了把知识映射成输出行为的能力；这和纯语言模型里常见的‘知道但答不出来’是同一类接口问题。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 Act2Answer。作者把已有VLM知识基准改写成短程桌面交互episode：每道题变成一个二选一动作选择，模型通过把物体放到某个候选位置来作答，而不是生成文本。这样做有两个目的。第一，避免直接用VLA的文本头或外接解码器，因为很多VLA并不以文本作为主输出；第二，把长时程控制、复杂规划和环境随机性压到最低，让评测更接近“给定视觉场景后，模型能否把语义判断转成一个简单动作”。

数据上，作者从现有VLM benchmark中整理出 1,720 个二分类问题，覆盖 12 个类别，包括属性、状态、颜色、对称、形状、情绪、名人、生命世界、计数、时间、交通、公共信息。每个问题都被实例化为仿真环境中的单步或短步选择任务。这个设计不是追求环境复杂度，而是追求诊断性。

分析上有两个层次。第一层是模型排名：比较 7 个现代VLA 与 9 个VLM基线，观察不同知识类别上的保留程度。第二层是 layerwise intent probing：对每层表征训练线性分类器，预测该episode的正确答案，借此判断答案相关信息在网络深度中的分布，以及失败究竟是“信息没了”还是“信息在内部但没有被动作头正确读出”。这一点比单纯报成功率更有研究价值，因为它把问题从行为层拆回表征层。

从全文表述看，作者还强调了一个概念分解：embodied task success 可以粗分为 perception、knowledge、control、environment 四部分。Act2Answer 的设计就是尽量固定后三者中的控制和环境复杂度，从而更干净地测知识贡献。这种分解虽然不新，但在VLA评测里执行得比较彻底。
summary.experiments:
关键实验结论有三点。

第一，当前VLA在简单感知类类别上通常还可以，但在 richer semantic categories 上相对其源VLM出现更明显退化。也就是说，颜色、形状、基础属性这类更接近视觉判别的问题保留较多；涉及常识、世界知识、社会语义或更抽象判断的类别，掉点更明显。摘要和正文可见的定量信息主要是评测规模：7 个VLA、9 个VLM、1,720 个二分类问题、12 个知识类别。你给出的全文片段没有完整主表数字，因此不适合编造具体百分比，但论文明确声称 VLA 与 source VLM 之间在 richer semantic categories 上存在“substantially larger gaps”。

第二，带有 VQA co-training 的模型在知识敏感任务上表现更强。这个观察很重要，因为它说明动作微调并不天然保留问答式知识接口，反而需要在训练中持续维持语言/问答监督，才能减少知识到动作映射的退化。这对多任务联合预训练和mid-training recipe有直接启发。

第三，layerwise probing 显示：有些失败样例里，答案相关信息在内部表征中仍然可线性读出，但最终动作选择仍然错误。这个结果说明问题不全是灾难性遗忘，也可能是 policy head、action interface 或训练目标造成的 readout mismatch。若把它类比到LLM，这相当于中间层已有可分信息，但最终解码路径没有把它稳定释放出来。

如果精读全文，建议重点核对：不同类别中VLA与对应VLM的差距是否一致；VQA co-training 的收益是否在所有模型族都成立；probe结果是否在深层更强，还是中层已足够线性可分。这些细节决定它更像“知识丢失”还是“接口失配”。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读到中度精读，重点不在方法复杂度，而在评测设计是否站得住。

建议先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，明确作者到底在测什么、为什么不用传统任务成功率。然后看 Methodology 里对 perception / knowledge / control / environment 的拆分，以及 Act2Answer 的任务构造细节，确认它是否真的降低了控制混杂因素。接着直接看主结果表：7 个VLA和9 个VLM在12类知识上的分布差异。最后看 layerwise intent probing 部分，这是全文最有研究味道的地方，能帮助判断失败来源。

如果时间有限，30 分钟可读完问题设定、benchmark构造和主结果；若要判断它对预训练/持续学习的启发，建议再花 20 分钟看 probing 和 VQA co-training 分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a simple but important question: after a strong VLM is adapted into a VLA policy, how much commonsense and factual knowledge is still retained and behaviorally accessible? Standard VLA evaluation collapses perception, control, planning, and environment into one task-success number, so a failure is hard to interpret. The authors aim to isolate the knowledge component by turning knowledge questions into minimal action-selection episodes.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an evaluation interface, not a new pretraining method. Still, the problem is highly relevant to foundation-model research: it operationalizes knowledge retention under modality and objective shift, which is closely related to catastrophic forgetting, continual pretraining, and pretrain-to-posttrain interface design. For multimodal foundation models, the paper makes a useful distinction between losing knowledge and losing the ability to route internal knowledge into the output action space.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core method is Act2Answer. Existing VLM knowledge benchmarks are converted into short tabletop episodes where the agent answers by taking a simple placement action among candidates instead of generating text. This design serves two purposes. First, many VLAs do not expose a clean text-generation interface, so text QA is not a faithful evaluation path. Second, by reducing the task to a short action episode, the benchmark minimizes confounds from long-horizon planning, motor execution, and environment complexity.

The benchmark contains 1,720 unique binary questions across 12 categories, including attribute, state, color, symmetry, shape, emotion, celebrity, living world, counting, time, traffic, and public information. The emphasis is diagnostic control rather than embodied realism.

The analysis has two layers. At the behavioral level, the paper compares 7 modern VLA systems against 9 strong VLM baselines to measure retention gaps across knowledge categories. At the representation level, it introduces layerwise intent probing: linear probes are trained on per-layer representations to predict the correct answer for each episode. This helps distinguish between two failure modes: the information is gone, or the information is still present internally but is not translated into the correct action.

A useful conceptual framing in the paper is the decomposition of embodied task success into perception, knowledge, control, and environment. Act2Answer is explicitly designed to hold control and environment complexity down so that knowledge-sensitive behavior becomes more measurable.
summary_en.experiments:
There are three main empirical takeaways.

First, current VLAs tend to remain reasonably strong on simple perceptual categories, but they show noticeably larger degradation on richer semantic categories relative to their source VLMs. In other words, low-level visual distinctions such as color or shape are retained better than broader commonsense or world-knowledge judgments. From the provided full text, the reliable quantitative facts are the evaluation scale: 7 VLAs, 9 VLM baselines, 1,720 binary questions, and 12 categories. The paper explicitly claims substantially larger VLA-VLM gaps on richer semantic categories, but the exact per-category numbers are not visible in the excerpt and should not be invented.

Second, VQA co-training is associated with stronger performance on knowledge-sensitive embodied tasks. This is an important recipe-level observation: action fine-tuning alone does not guarantee preservation of the knowledge interface, while continued QA-style supervision appears to help maintain it.

Third, the layerwise probing results suggest that answer-relevant information can remain linearly decodable from internal representations even when the final action is wrong. That points to a readout or interface problem, not only catastrophic forgetting. For foundation-model researchers, this is the most interesting result in the paper because it separates representational retention from behavioral accessibility.

When reading the full experiments, the key things to verify are whether the VQA co-training effect is consistent across model families, whether the VLA-VLM gap is uniform across categories, and where in depth the probe accuracy peaks.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is best read as a careful evaluation paper. Start with the introduction and the main figure to understand what is being measured and why standard task success is insufficient. Then read the benchmark construction and the perception/knowledge/control/environment decomposition in the methodology. After that, go directly to the main comparison tables between the 7 VLAs and 9 VLMs across the 12 categories. Finish with the layerwise intent probing section, which contains the most informative analysis.

If time is limited, 30 minutes is enough for the setup, benchmark design, and headline results. Add another 20 minutes for the probing section if you care about forgetting versus readout mismatch.

recommendation.zh: 把“微调后知识遗忘”与“控制执行失败”解耦得较干净，做视觉-动作统一建模的应读 §3 和探针结果。
recommendation.en: Cleanly disentangles post-fine-tuning knowledge forgetting from control failure; read §3 and the probing results if you work on vision–action co-training.

paper.title: OneCanvas: 3D Scene Understanding via Panoramic Reprojection
paper.abstract: Existing approaches to 3D scene understanding in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) either rely on complex, model-specific geometry encoders or large training budgets in pursuit of spatial reasoning. Instead, OneCanvas aggregates patch features from all views onto a single equirectangular panoramic canvas. Namely, each patch is unprojected to a 3D world coordinate using its depth and camera pose, then placed on the canvas at the continuous longitude and latitude of that point as seen from the canvas

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 做 3D 场景理解时对专用几何编码器和高训练成本的依赖，尝试用更简单的输入重表示让现成 VLM 获得空间理解能力。
summary.importance: 这属于多模态理解方法。价值在于提出一种不改 backbone、靠输入坐标系重构来注入 3D 信息的思路；对 native multimodal pretraining 的直接启发有限，但对“表示层统一而非架构层堆模块”这个方向有一定参考。
summary.technical_approach: OneCanvas 将多视角图像 patch 依据深度和相机位姿反投影到统一 3D 世界坐标，再映射到单张等距柱状全景 canvas 上；同时加入 3D 位置嵌入补回深度信息。这样预训练 VLM 可把该 canvas 当普通图像处理，无需复杂跨视角融合模块。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示方法在 3D 场景理解任务上与依赖专用几何编码器或大训练预算的方法比较，主打更少架构改动和更低训练成本。由于未见参数规模、训练数据和具体 benchmark 细节，当前只能判断其方法设计有一定巧思，但证据强度有限。
summary.authors_note: 作者名单中包含 Matthias Nießner，长期从事 3D 视觉、场景理解与生成建模相关研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the dependence of VLM-based 3D scene understanding on specialized geometry encoders and large training budgets, aiming to inject spatial reasoning through a simpler input representation.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal understanding method. Its main value is the idea of adding 3D structure through representation design rather than backbone modification. The direct relevance to native multimodal pretraining is limited but non-zero.
summary_en.technical_approach: OneCanvas unprojects patch features from multiple views into a shared 3D world coordinate system using depth and camera pose, then reprojects them onto a single equirectangular panoramic canvas. A 3D positional embedding is added to restore metric depth information, allowing a pretrained VLM to consume the result as if it were a normal image.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the method is compared against approaches that rely on dedicated geometry encoders or larger training budgets, emphasizing minimal architectural changes and lower training cost. Since parameter scale, training data, and benchmark details are not provided here, the evidence should be treated as suggestive rather than decisive.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Matthias Nießner, known for work in 3D vision, scene understanding, and generative modeling.

recommendation.zh: 思路比结果更值得看：它在输入表示层做 3D 对齐而不是改 VLM 主干；读方法图即可，别期待预训练层面的新结论。
recommendation.en: The idea matters more than the result: it injects 3D structure at the representation layer instead of changing the VLM backbone; read the method figure, not for pretraining conclusions.

paper.title: Unified Multimodal Autoregressive Modeling with Shared Context-Visual Tokenizer is Key to Unification
paper.abstract: Unified Multimodal Modeling aims to integrate visual understanding and generation within a single system. However, existing approaches typically rely on two disparate visual tokenizers, which splits the representation space and hinders truly unified modeling. We propose UniAR, a unified autoregressive framework where a single discrete visual tokenizer serves as the key bridge between understanding and generation, enabling a shared context in which the model can directly interpret its own generat

summary.core_problem: 统一多模态模型想做到“同一上下文里既能理解也能生成”，但主流做法往往用两套视觉 tokenizer（理解/生成各一套），导致生成出来的图像 token 不能被模型直接当作“可理解的上下文”使用，必须再走一次重编码，破坏 shared-context。论文要解决的是：能否用单一离散视觉 tokenizer 同时满足理解所需的语义抽象与生成所需的细节保真，并且在 AR next-token 框架下把视觉 token 的词表规模和序列长度做得足够可训练、可扩展。
summary.importance:
对预训练研究的直接启发点在 tokenizer 与统一建模接口：
1) 把“理解/生成分裂”归因到表示空间割裂，而不是简单的 loss 或解码器选择，强调 tokenizer 是 unified multimodal pretrain 的关键瓶颈之一；
2) 用 lookup-free 的 bitwise 离散化把视觉词表规模从“码本大小”约束中解放出来，提供一种不同于 VQ codebook 的扩展路径；
3) 训练上把视觉 tokenizer/decoder 冻结，把主要学习压力放在 AR 主干上，属于一种更接近“固定感知前端 + 统一 LM”的 recipe，便于稳定大规模预训练与后续对齐（SFT/RL）。
局限也明确：bitwise token 的可学习语义结构、以及“理论词表指数级”与“有效可用词表”的差距，需要看全文实验是否给出足够证据。
summary.technical_approach:
UniAR 的核心是“单 tokenizer + AR 统一建模”。关键组件：
1) 多层特征融合的视觉 tokenizer：从预训练 ViT/视觉编码器抽取多层特征，浅层保细节（纹理/颜色/边缘），深层保语义（物体/布局），融合后再离散化，试图同时服务生成与理解。相比只用最后一层做离散 token（更偏语义）或只做重建友好的低层特征（更偏细节），它把两类需求显式拼到同一 token 表示里。
2) lookup-free bitwise quantization：把连续特征映射为二进制向量（如 64-bit），不需要显式 codebook 查表；理论上 2^b 的组合数带来巨大词表容量。与 VQ-VAE/ViT-VQ 的差异在于：不学习离散码本，而是学习到二值化边界/投影，使离散码由 bit 组合决定。
3) 并行 bitwise 预测 + 2×2 网格：在 AR next-token 框架下，不是逐 bit 生成，而是在每个 2×2 spatial grid 内并行预测多级二进制向量，从而显著缩短视觉序列长度；论文声称达到 32× 的视觉压缩比。
4) DiT-based 视觉解码器 + 分辨率 upsampling：解码器只条件在视觉 token 上（不再额外喂文本 prompt），并通过 upsampling 支持高分辨率；文中给出 1024×1024 只需预测 256 个视觉 token 的设定。
5) 训练流程：三阶段（大规模多模态预训练 → 高质量数据 SFT → RL 提升生成），且 tokenizer 与 decoder 全程冻结；decoder 只在 RL 阶段用于把 token 解码成图像以计算 reward。这一点等价于把“视觉离散空间”当作固定通信协议，减少端到端联训的不稳定与漂移风险。
与相关工作对比：作者点名 Infinity（同样用二值量化）但强调其面向纯生成与重建优化；UniAR 目标是统一理解+生成，并采用标准 next-token（而非 next-scale）范式。
summary.experiments:
给定的全文片段没有包含可核验的完整实验表格与具体数值（如模型规模、预训练 token 数、各 benchmark 分数、消融提升幅度）。目前只能从引言提取作者主张：
- 生成侧：在“文本渲染（text rendering）”与“指令跟随（instruction-following）”的图像生成上达到作者声称的强结果，并展示编辑能力（加物体/换背景/改类别/改颜色等）。
- 理解侧：在标准多模态理解基准上“保持竞争力”。
- 效率侧：32× 视觉压缩；1024×1024 预测 256 视觉 token。
建议以全文的主结果表为准，重点核对：1) 单 tokenizer 是否在理解基准上显著落后于双 tokenizer 方案；2) bitwise 量化的重建质量与生成质量是否存在 trade-off；3) 并行 bitwise 预测是否带来训练不稳定或困惑度/错误传播问题；4) 冻结 tokenizer/decoder 是否限制了后期对齐收益。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（预计 25–40 分钟，按“是否值得精读”做判断）：
1) 先看 tokenizer 设计细节：多层特征如何融合（拼接/加权/金字塔）、融合后维度与归一化、二值化的具体实现（straight-through estimator？温度退火？）以及训练/冻结策略。
2) 看“并行 bitwise 预测”那一节：它决定了 AR 训练的序列长度、条件独立假设、以及是否引入额外的校准/一致性损失。
3) 直接翻主结果表：生成（指令跟随、文本渲染、编辑）与理解（常见 VQA/MMMU 类）各自的对比对象是谁，是否对齐同等训练数据与分辨率。
4) 必看消融：单层 vs 多层特征、VQ vs bitwise、是否冻结 tokenizer/decoder、视觉 token 数/bit 数变化对质量与理解的影响。
5) 如果论文给了 token 使用统计（bit 分布、有效码率、碰撞率/熵），这部分对判断“指数级词表是否真的被用起来”很关键。

summary_en.core_problem: Unified multimodal models aim to interleave visual understanding and visual generation in a single shared context. Most existing systems still rely on two different visual tokenizers (one for understanding, one for generation), which splits the representation space: images generated as tokens cannot be directly re-consumed for understanding without re-encoding.
