VLM knowledge is distributed across the vision encoder, text pathway, projector, and multimodal decoder, so output-level forgetting can be misleading. The proposed robustness view is relevant to data removal, copyright and privacy handling, continual pretraining, and multimodal safety evaluation. This is a skim-level paper for pretraining researchers, but the evaluation framing is useful.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper formulates a VLM as a composition of a vision encoder, a text encoder, and a multimodal decoding module, then decomposes unlearning into three coupled objectives: removing the forget-set influence, preserving retain-set performance, and maintaining general multimodal capability. It reviews existing VLM unlearning methods by the components they optimize or modify. The main technical contribution is an attack-based robustness protocol. In-context attacks add semantically related cues at inference time to test whether forgotten knowledge can be reactivated without parameter updates. In-distribution attacks further fine-tune the unlearned model on varying amounts of data from the original forget distribution to measure how quickly the target capability returns. Out-of-distribution attacks fine-tune on semantically different auxiliary data to test whether residual representations can transfer back to the forgotten concept. This separates output suppression from real removal of internal associations.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments evaluate representative VLM unlearning methods under unified prompt variants and the three robustness attacks. The main finding is that many methods pass standard forgetting tests but remain vulnerable once contextual cues or downstream retraining are introduced. This suggests that current approaches often weaken direct response paths while leaving enough residual multimodal structure for recovery. The visible manuscript excerpt does not include exact model names, dataset sizes, or numerical attack-recovery rates, so the key tables should be checked for forget accuracy, retain accuracy, general multimodal performance, and recovery under each attack.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Read the problem formulation to understand how forgetting, retention, and general multimodal capability are separated. Then inspect the taxonomy table to see which VLM components each unlearning family modifies. Spend most of the time on the attack definitions and the corresponding result tables. The most reusable part is the evaluation protocol. For data deletion or continual-pretraining rollback scenarios, the in-distribution attack is the most relevant stress test.

recommendation.zh: 把“unlearning 成功”改写成“在提示与再训练攻击下是否仍不可恢复”，这套评测框架值得直接搬进内部回归；但缺少机制定位，更多是红队信号。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming for its prompt/retraining-based reactivation tests—good to port into internal regression—though it’s more a red-team signal than a mechanistic explanation.

paper.title: STORM: Internalized Modeling for Spatial-Temporal Reasoning in Video-Language Models
paper.abstract: Many video reasoning tasks require tracking motion, temporal order, and evolving visual states across frames. Existing methods built on large vision-language models (LVLMs) often address this challenge by externalizing reasoning through textual chain-of-thought (CoT), keyframe selection, repeated frame reinsertion, or external tool use. While effective, such pipelines increase inference-time latency and engineering complexity, and they force temporal-visual evidence to be serialized into text or

summary.core_problem: TORM 解决的是视频语言模型在时空推理中对外部推理流程的依赖：现有方法常用文本 CoT、关键帧重插入、视频工具或多轮检索来补足动态证据，但这些做法会增加推理延迟，并把连续视觉变化强行序列化成文本。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练和多模态建模的启发在于 latent reasoning 的训练信号设计。它不是让模型在测试时生成更长的文本推理，也不是反复重编码视觉帧，而是在训练阶段用动态视觉证据约束一小段连续 latent slots，让模型把时序变化压进隐藏状态。这个方向值得关注，因为它把“中间推理”从离散文本 token 扩展到连续表示空间，更接近视频任务需要的并行、多因素状态追踪。
summary.technical_approach: TORM 使用两阶段训练。每个训练样本包含三类对齐信号：源视频采样关键帧、由教师推理计划生成的 thought video，以及最终答案序列。Stage I 在视频-问题上下文和答案之间插入少量 latent tokens，同时优化答案 token loss 和 latent-state alignment loss。alignment 的目标是让这些 latent hidden states 编码 thought video 的时序视觉特征，而不是生成显式文本 CoT。Stage II 接近 Coconut 式设置：latent slots 仍保留在序列中，但只监督最终答案，促使模型把 Stage I 学到的动态视觉对齐压缩成面向答案的内部推理过程。推理时不生成 thought video，不调用外部工具，也不重新插入帧；模型进入 latent segment 后做固定预算的连续 hidden-state rollout，然后恢复普通文本解码。与“thinking with images”或工具式视频推理相比，它把重计算放在训练期，推理期只保留一个有界 latent 轨迹。
summary.experiments: 给出的正文内容说明 TORM 在多个视频推理 benchmark 上提升准确率，并降低对测试时外部推理管线的依赖。可确认的实验结论是：训练期 thought-video supervision 加 latent alignment 能改善时空推理；Stage II 的答案-only 训练用于巩固内部化推理；推理时不需要生成视频、不需要反复访问帧、不需要外部工具。当前提供的全文片段没有暴露具体 benchmark 名称、数值提升、模型规模、latent token 数量和消融表，因此不宜补写具体数字。阅读时应重点核对完整实验表中三类对比：文本 CoT、外部视觉重访问/工具方案，以及无 thought-video alignment 的 latent baseline。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读方法部分，重点看 Figure 1、Figure 3、Stage I/Stage II 的 loss 设计，以及 thought-video supervision pipeline。预计阅读 30 分钟可以掌握主要思路。若时间有限，优先确认两个问题：latent states 对齐的是哪一层、哪一种 thought-video 表征；Stage II 去掉 latent supervision 后是否仍能保持收益。若完整版本包含消融，最该看 latent token 数量、thought video 质量、只用文本 CoT、只用答案监督、只用 Stage I 与两阶段训练的对比。

summary_en.core_problem: TORM addresses the reliance of video-language models on external reasoning pipelines for spatial-temporal reasoning. Textual CoT, keyframe reinsertion, repeated frame encoding, and tool-based video reasoning can help, but they add latency and force dynamic visual evidence into an inefficient textual or repeated-encoding format.
summary_en.importance: The useful idea for pretraining and multimodal modeling is the supervision of latent reasoning states. Instead of making the model produce longer textual rationales at inference time, the method uses dynamic visual evidence during training to shape a small set of continuous latent slots. This is relevant because video reasoning often requires tracking multiple evolving factors in parallel, and continuous hidden states are a more natural carrier for such information than a strictly serialized text trace.
summary_en.technical_approach: TORM uses a two-stage training procedure. Each training instance contains sampled keyframes from the source video, a generated thought video built from a teacher reasoning plan, and the target answer sequence. In Stage I, a small number of latent tokens are inserted between the video-question context and the final answer. The model is trained with answer-token loss and a latent-state alignment objective that makes the latent hidden states encode features of the thought video. The latent segment is therefore grounded in question-relevant motion and state changes without requiring textual CoT supervision. In Stage II, the latent slots remain in the sequence, but supervision is applied only to the final answer, similar in spirit to Coconut-style latent reasoning. This encourages the model to consolidate the aligned latent behavior into an answer-oriented internal reasoning process. At inference time, the model does not generate thought videos, revisit frames, or call external visual tools. It performs a bounded hidden-state rollout through the latent segment and then resumes normal text decoding.
summary_en.experiments: The provided content reports improvements across video reasoning benchmarks and reduced dependence on inference-time external reasoning pipelines. The supported conclusions are that thought-video supervision plus latent alignment improves spatial-temporal reasoning, that answer-only Stage II helps internalize the behavior, and that inference avoids video generation, frame reinsertion, and external tools. The supplied text does not include exact benchmark names, model sizes, latent-token counts, or numerical gains, so specific numbers should be checked in the full experimental tables. The most important comparisons to inspect are against textual CoT, external visual revisiting or tool-based pipelines, and latent baselines without thought-video alignment.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the method section, especially Figure 1, Figure 3, the two-stage loss design, and the thought-video supervision pipeline. Around 30 minutes should be enough to understand the contribution. The key details to verify are which hidden layers or representations are aligned to thought-video features, how many latent slots are used, and whether the gains persist after Stage II removes direct latent supervision. If the complete version includes ablations, prioritize the comparisons over latent-token count, thought-video quality, answer-only training, Stage-I-only training, and textual-CoT baselines.

recommendation.zh: 读方法图和 latent 对齐训练即可；想法对 native VLM reasoning 有用，但没数字前别把它当稳结论。
recommendation.en: Read the method diagram and latent-alignment setup; the idea is relevant to native VLM reasoning, but without numbers it should stay a hypothesis.

institutions: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill

paper.title: MAGIC: Multimodal Alignment & Grounding-aware Instruction Coreset for Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Instruction tuning of large vision-language models (LVLMs) increasingly depends on massive multimodal corpora, yet these datasets contain samples with substantial redundancy, low visual dependency, and highly imbalanced coverage of multimodal reasoning behaviors. As a result, uniform subsampling or naive score-based selection often yields suboptimal training subsets. We introduce MAGIC, a training-free, forward-only coreset selection method designed to construct compact yet behaviorally faithful

summary.core_problem: 视觉指令微调数据规模快速变大，但其中有大量重复样本、弱视觉依赖样本和行为覆盖不均衡样本；MAGIC 要解决的是如何在不训练选择器、不做反向传播的情况下，从多模态指令数据中选出小而有效的 coreset。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练研究的直接价值在于数据效率和数据诊断，尤其适合借鉴到 multimodal mid-training / instruction tuning 的数据筛选环节。它不是提出新的 VLM 架构，而是把样本的“视觉是否真的有用”“答案是否被图像支撑”“样本诱发的内部计算是否多样”三个信号组合起来。相比只按 loss、困惑度或单一质量分数排序，MAGIC 更关心行为覆盖，避免把预算集中在少数高分但同质的样本上。
summary.technical_approach: MAGIC 是一个 training-free、forward-only 的三阶段筛选流程。第一步用 Multimodal Gain 过滤弱多模态样本：比较有图像输入和仅文本输入时目标回答 likelihood 的改善，改善越大，说明图像对回答越关键。第二步用 Bridging Relevance 衡量答案 token 对视觉 token 的注意力集中程度，用来判断回答是否真正建立在视觉证据上，而不是语言先验。第三步构造 Skill-Neuron Signature：取样本前向时 FFN 中 top-activated neurons，形成离散指纹，再按这些 signature 分桶分配筛选预算。这个设计的关键不是连续 activation 聚类，而是用离散 neuron signature 做近似的行为覆盖，计算成本更低，也更容易扩展。
summary.experiments: 实验主要在 LLaVA-665K 和 Vision-Flan-186K 两个视觉指令数据集上进行，主模型是 LLaVA-1.5-7B，并测试向 LLaVA-1.5-13B 的迁移。使用 20% 数据预算时，MAGIC 在 LLaVA-665K 上达到 full-data finetuning 的 100.3% 相对性能，在 Vision-Flan-186K 上达到 101.6%。迁移到 LLaVA-1.5-13B 时仍保留 99.3% 相对性能。端到端 wall-clock runtime 相比全量微调减少 73.7%。这些结果说明，在该设置下，删掉 80% 数据并不必然损害性能；如果筛选信号能识别视觉依赖和行为覆盖，小数据子集可以接近甚至略好于全量训练。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中对现有 coreset 方法局限的拆分，再看 Methodology 里三个信号的定义：Multimodal Gain、Bridging Relevance、Skill-Neuron Signature。实验部分重点看 20% budget 下与 full-data、random、score-based、diversity-based 方法的对比，以及 LLaVA-1.5-7B 到 13B 的迁移结果。值得深挖的是 Skill-Neuron Signature 分桶：它提供了一种低成本 activation-aware data selection 思路，但也要注意其依赖具体 pretrained VLM，attention-based grounding 本身也可能受模型注意力可解释性限制。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses data inefficiency in visual instruction tuning: large LVLM instruction corpora contain redundant examples, weakly visual samples, and imbalanced coverage of multimodal behaviors, making naive subsampling or scalar ranking unreliable.
summary_en.importance: The useful signal for pretraining-oriented work is data selection rather than model architecture. MAGIC shows that multimodal instruction data can be filtered using intrinsic signals from a pretrained VLM, with no selector training and no backward pass. The main lesson is that high-quality coreset construction should preserve not only sample quality, but also visual dependence, grounding, and behavioral coverage.
summary_en.technical_approach: MAGIC uses a three-stage forward-only pipeline. Multimodal Gain measures how much the response likelihood improves when the image is provided compared with a text-only forward pass, filtering samples where the visual input is not needed. Bridging Relevance measures how sharply answer tokens attend to visual tokens, acting as a grounding signal. Skill-Neuron Signature records a discrete fingerprint of top-activated feed-forward neurons induced by each sample, then allocates the data budget across signature buckets to maintain behavioral diversity. The main distinction from prior coreset methods is that MAGIC avoids backward passes, proxy selector training, and expensive continuous activation-space clustering.
summary_en.experiments: The main experiments use LLaVA-665K and Vision-Flan-186K, with LLaVA-1.5-7B as the primary target model and transfer evaluation on LLaVA-1.5-13B. At a 20% selection budget, MAGIC reaches 100.3% relative performance compared with full-data finetuning on LLaVA-665K and 101.6% on Vision-Flan-186K. When transferred to LLaVA-1.5-13B, it retains 99.3% relative performance. End-to-end wall-clock time is reduced by 73.7% relative to full-data finetuning. These numbers suggest that much of the visual instruction data is redundant or weakly useful under this training setup.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 20–30 minutes. Read the motivation in the introduction, then focus on the definitions of Multimodal Gain, Bridging Relevance, and Skill-Neuron Signature. In the experiments, prioritize the 20% budget comparisons and the transfer result from LLaVA-1.5-7B to 13B. The most reusable idea is the discrete activation signature for behavior-aware data selection. The main caveats to keep in mind are dependence on the pretrained VLM used for scoring and the noisiness of attention as a grounding proxy.

recommendation.zh: 看三个 selection signal 的定义就够；它是实用数据筛选思路，但需警惕 neuron signature 跨模型泛化。
recommendation.en: Skim the three selection signals; it is a practical data-curation idea, but the cross-model validity of neuron signatures is the fragile part.

paper.title: LLaVA-OneVision-2: Towards Next-Generation Perceptual Intelligence
paper.abstract: We introduce LLaVA-OneVision-2 (LLaVA-OV-2), the most capable vision-language model in the LLaVA-OneVision series to date, achieving superior performance across a broad range of multimodal benchmarks. The model builds on a native OneVision-Encoder and incorporates Windowed Attention for efficient local computation while maintaining native resolution. Its key advance is codec-stream tokenization: it treats compressed video as a continuous bit-cost stream, where bit-cost dynamics determine adaptiv

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是一般意义上的“视频看得更准”，而是多模态大模型在固定视觉 token 预算下，如何更合理地表示长视频。现有 LVLM 大多仍是 frame-centric：均匀抽帧，或高低分辨率混采。这样做简单，也兼容图像 backbone，但它把视频当成离散帧集合，弱化了压缩视频里天然存在的预测结构：哪些时刻信息增量大，哪些区域只是可预测的延续。LLaVA-OneVision-2 试图把 token 分配从“按时间均匀切”改成“按码流信息密度分配”，让模型把预算集中在事件转折、运动残差高、bit-cost 高的片段与区域，从而提升长视频理解和细粒度时序定位。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要在两层。第一，它把视频 tokenization 从“解码后抽帧”推进到“利用 codec stream 作为先验”，这属于统一多模态预训练里很关键的一步：不是只改 encoder 结构，而是改输入表示与 token 分配原则。第二，它给出一个比较完整的 recipe：原生动态分辨率视觉编码器、codec-aware tokenization、统一 3D 位置编码、四阶段训练、长视频再编码，以及专门针对高频重复动作定位的 JumpScore 评测。对做原生多模态预训练的人，这篇文章的价值不在于某个 benchmark 分数，而在于它明确展示了：视频压缩格式本身可以成为 token budget allocator，而不是预处理噪声。量级上看，这更像是一个有潜力扩展的建模方向，而不是一次局部工程调参。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心有四部分。第一是 OV-Encoder 的延续与增强。模型建立在 native dynamic-resolution OneVision-Encoder 上，保留 codec patchification 思路，不再只从解码帧取 patch，而是让 I/P frame 及其预测残差信号参与视觉证据选择。第二是 codec-stream tokenization。作者把压缩视频视为连续 bit-cost stream，而不是固定 GOP 的帧序列。时间上，用 bit-cost dynamics 自适应决定 temporal group 边界；直觉上，码率突变往往对应场景切换、动作变化或新信息注入。空间上，用 motion-residual cues 从组内挑出更有信息量的区域，压成 compact visual canvases，并与 merge 对齐，减少无效 token。这样 token 密度跟随码流的信息变化，而不是跟随均匀时间采样。第三是 attention 与位置系统。为了在原生分辨率下控制计算，模型使用 spatial windowed attention 做局部计算，同时配合 group-visible masks 维持组内可见性约束；再用 shared 3D RoPE 把 codec canvases、普通采样帧和静态图像放进统一时空坐标系，避免不同输入路径的位置语义割裂。第四是训练 recipe。训练分四阶段逐步扩展能力：Stage 1 用约 85M image-text 和 4.2M 30 秒视频 caption 做图像 grounding 与短视频基础对齐；Stage 2 加入约 22M LLaVA-OneVision-1.5 指令数据、24M FineVision，以及 2.7M 30–60 秒和 700K 60–180 秒视频 caption；Stage 3 引入长视频 instruction 数据和 350K 10–15 分钟 caption，最长到 384 frames；Stage 4 用 variable-length-GOP codec pipeline 重新编码长视频，在 384/768 frames 上训练，并加入 4M 样本的 2D/3D spatial supervision。一个重要设计是训练时始终交织 codec-patchified video、uniformly sampled video 和 image/tiled input，而不是完全替换抽帧路径。作者后面的实验也说明，两种表示各有适用区间。
summary.experiments: 结果里最值得看的是三类。第一，JumpScore。作者认为现有视频 benchmark 对“高频重复动作中的正确实例定位”覆盖不足，于是构建了 temporal-localization benchmark。LLaVA-OneVision-2-8B 在 JumpScore 上达到 74.9 mAP，而 Qwen3-VL-8B 是 30.1，差 44.8 分。更关键的是同模型、同 token budget 下，codec-stream 输入比 frame-sampling 输入高 9.7 分，这直接支持了“码流驱动 token 分配”对时序 grounding 的帮助。第二，整体视频/空间/跟踪表现。文中给出 LLaVA-OV-2-8B 相比 Qwen3-VL-8B，在视频 benchmark 平均高 4.3 分，在 spatial benchmark 平均高 5.3 分，在 tracking benchmark 上 J&F 平均高 15.6。这个组合说明收益不只来自长视频 caption 数据量增加，也来自视觉表示和训练目标的协同。第三，方法边界。作者没有把 codec-stream 说成通用更优，而是明确指出：它更适合 coarse temporal structure 主导的任务，如 temporal grounding、event understanding、event ordering、salient retrieval；而对 detail-sensitive query，尤其依赖静态细节、小目标、轨迹连续性、边界级判断的任务，传统 frame sampling 仍更合适，因为它保留了更密的局部纹理和逐帧连续性。这一点很重要，说明 codec tokenization 不是替代一切，而是更像一种按任务分布优化 token budget 的机制。数据规模方面，文中强调额外扩展了约 8M re-captioned video samples 和 4M spatial corpus，这也是性能提升的重要组成部分。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时建议先看 Introduction，把作者要替换的对象想清楚：不是普通视频 encoder，而是“固定帧采样”这套 token allocation 假设。然后重点看 codec-stream tokenization 的方法图，尤其 temporal group 如何由 bit-cost dynamics 决定，spatial evidence 如何由 motion residual 压成 canvas。再看训练 recipe 的四阶段表格，理解为什么长视频和空间推理 supervision 被放到后期，而不是一开始混训。实验部分优先看三组：JumpScore 主结果、codec-stream vs frame-sampling 的 matched-budget 对比、以及作者总结的 failure mode/适用边界。如果时间有限，抓住一个核心问题即可：在同等 token 预算下，codec stream 到底把 token 从哪里挪到了哪里，哪些任务因此受益，哪些任务反而会受损。预计 30–45 分钟可以完成有效泛读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific bottleneck in multimodal pretraining: how to allocate a limited visual token budget for long videos more intelligently than uniform frame sampling. Most LVLMs still operate in a frame-centric regime, even when they mix resolutions. That design is convenient, but it treats video as a set of decoded images and ignores the predictive structure already present in compressed streams. LLaVA-OneVision-2 asks whether token density should follow information change in the codec stream—bit-cost spikes and motion residuals—rather than elapsed time or fixed frame slots.
summary_en.importance: Its value for foundation-model research is less about one more strong VLM and more about a shift in video tokenization. The work moves from decoded-frame observation toward codec-aware evidence allocation, which is a pretraining question: what representation should the model see, and how should scarce tokens be spent. It also provides a fairly complete recipe around that idea: native dynamic-resolution encoding, codec-stream tokenization, shared 3D positional geometry, staged scaling from images to long videos, and a new benchmark for transition-level grounding. For researchers working on unified multimodal pretraining, the main takeaway is that compression artifacts are not merely nuisance variables; they can serve as a useful prior for token allocation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has four main pieces. First, it extends the OneVision-Encoder line with native dynamic-resolution processing and codec patchification, so the model is not restricted to uniformly decoded frames. Second, the key contribution is codec-stream tokenization. Instead of treating a video as a fixed-GOP frame sequence, the model views the compressed stream as a continuous bit-cost signal. Temporal group boundaries are chosen adaptively from bit-cost dynamics, under the intuition that bitrate changes often correlate with scene transitions, motion changes, or semantic novelty. Within each temporal group, motion-residual cues are used to select salient spatial evidence and condense it into compact visual canvases aligned with the merge structure. This makes token density track information change in the stream rather than wall-clock time. Third, the architecture uses spatial windowed attention to keep native-resolution computation manageable, together with group-visible masks to preserve the intended visibility pattern. A shared 3D RoPE places codec canvases, sampled video frames, and still images into one spatiotemporal coordinate system, which is important because the model is trained on mixed input pathways. Fourth, the training recipe is progressive. Stage 1 uses about 85M image-text pairs and 4.2M 30-second video captions. Stage 2 adds roughly 22M LLaVA-OneVision-1.5 instruction samples, 24M FineVision samples, plus 2.7M 30–60s and 700K 60–180s video captions. Stage 3 extends to long-form video with video-instruction corpora and 350K captions for 10–15 minute videos at 384 frames. Stage 4 re-encodes long videos with a variable-length-GOP codec pipeline at 384/768 frames and adds a 4M-sample 2D/3D spatial supervision corpus. An important design choice is that codec-patchified videos, uniformly sampled videos, and image/tiled inputs are interleaved throughout training rather than replacing one another.
summary_en.experiments: Three result groups matter most. First, JumpScore, the new benchmark designed for temporal localization in high-frequency repeated motion. LLaVA-OneVision-2-8B reaches 74.9 mAP, while Qwen3-VL-8B gets 30.1, a gap of 44.8 points. More importantly, under matched visual-token budgets, codec-stream inputs outperform frame-sampling inputs by 9.7 points on the same benchmark. That is the clearest evidence that the token-allocation mechanism itself is doing useful work. Second, at the model level, LLaVA-OV-2-8B reports average gains of +4.3 on video benchmarks, +5.3 on spatial benchmarks, and +15.6 J&F on tracking benchmarks over Qwen3-VL-8B. Third, the paper is careful about where the method helps and where it does not. Codec-stream inputs are better for tasks dominated by coarse temporal structure—temporal grounding, event understanding, event ordering, salient retrieval—because they concentrate tokens around high-bit-cost intervals and high-residual regions. Frame sampling remains preferable for detail-sensitive queries where the decisive evidence is static, tiny, trajectory-specific, or boundary-level, because dense frame observations preserve local texture and frame-to-frame continuity better. The paper also scales data substantially, mentioning about 8M re-captioned video samples and a 4M spatial corpus, so the gains should be read as the result of both representation and training scale.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and method overview to pin down what is being replaced: not just a video encoder, but the assumption that visual tokens should be allocated by uniform frame sampling. Then focus on the codec-stream tokenization figures: how temporal groups are formed from bit-cost dynamics, how motion residuals select spatial evidence, and how the resulting canvases are fed into the encoder. After that, read the staged training recipe carefully, especially why long-video and spatial supervision are introduced later instead of mixed from the beginning. In the experiments, prioritize three parts: JumpScore, the matched-budget codec-stream versus frame-sampling comparison, and the discussion of task regimes where codec-aware inputs help or hurt. If time is limited, the key question to keep in mind is simple: under the same token budget, where are tokens being moved from and to, and which task families benefit from that reallocation. A useful skim should take about 30–45 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是视觉 tokenizer 思路，不是榜单；先读 codec-stream tokenization 和 3D RoPE 设计，判断它能否迁移到统一多模态 pretrain。
recommendation.en: The value is in the visual tokenizer idea, not the benchmark table; read the codec-stream tokenization and shared 3D RoPE sections to judge transferability to unified multimodal pretraining.

paper.title: FTibSuite: A Comprehensive Resource Suite for Tibetan Vision-Language Modeling
paper.abstract: Vision-language models have progressed rapidly, but Tibetan remains a severely underserved low-resource language due to the lack of reproducible training and evaluation infrastructure. To fill this gap, we introduce FTibSuite, a comprehensive resource suite for Tibetan vision-language research, consisting of FTibData (human-verified multimodal training corpora spanning continual pretraining, image-text alignment, and instruction tuning data), FTibBench (Tibetan adaptations of five mainstream mul

summary.core_problem: 藏语作为低资源语言缺乏可复现的多模态训练和评估基础设施，导致藏语视觉语言模型发展滞后
summary.importance: 数据和基准贡献，构建了首个全面的藏语视觉语言资源套件，包含训练数据、评测基准和可复现基线
summary.technical_approach: 构建FTibSuite，包含FTibData（人工验证的多模态训练语料）、FTibBench（五个主流多模态基准的藏语适配版，采用分层质量控制流程减少翻译噪声）和FTibVLM（基于Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct的三阶段适配流水线）
summary.experiments: 基于Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct构建基线，在FTibBench上MMBench准确率从42.97提升至67.78，POPE-random准确率从47.53提升至80.56，同时保留原中文能力

summary_en.core_problem: Tibetan as a low-resource language lacks reproducible multimodal training and evaluation infrastructure, hindering Tibetan vision-language model development
summary_en.importance: Data and benchmark contribution: the first comprehensive resource suite for Tibetan vision-language research, including training data, evaluation benchmarks, and reproducible baselines
summary_en.technical_approach: FTibSuite consists of FTibData (human-verified multimodal training corpora), FTibBench (Tibetan adaptations of five mainstream multimodal benchmarks with hierarchical QC to reduce translation noise), and FTibVLM (three-stage adaptation pipeline based on Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct)
summary_en.experiments: Baseline built on Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct; on FTibBench, MMBench accuracy improves from 42.97 to 67.78, POPE-random from 47.53 to 80.56, while preserving original Chinese capabilities

recommendation.zh: 低资源语言多模态资源建设，对研究小语种多模态对齐有参考价值，但方法上无范式创新，作为文献备查
recommendation.en: Low-resource language multimodal resource construction. Reference value for small-language multimodal alignment, but no paradigmatic innovation. Keep as literature reference.

paper.title: InterSketch: An Interleaved Reasoning Model with Self-correcting Visual Sketch and Stepwise Reward
paper.abstract: While vision-language models (VLMs) have exhibited multi-turn visual reasoning capabilities, their reasoning trajectories remain relatively shallow and are dominated by a text-centric paradigm, limiting their applicability to complex visual challenges. In contrast, human-like thought typically involves long-horizon reasoning with an interleaved visual-textual chain-of-thought (VT-CoT). To bridge this gap, we introduce InterSketch, an interleaved reasoning model to enhance the VT-CoT capability v

summary.core_problem: 现有视觉语言模型的多轮视觉推理轨迹偏浅且以文本为中心，缺乏人类式长程交错的图文思维链能力，难以处理复杂视觉任务
summary.importance: 方法创新+数据贡献，提出交错式图文推理范式，同时构建了高质量合成的交错图文思维链数据集
summary.technical_approach: 提出InterSketch模型，通过外部工具动态生成中间视觉草图并与文本推理交错执行，结合自校正反射机制与逐步奖励训练；冷启动阶段使用合成的高质量交错图文思维链数据集做训练
summary.experiments: 针对长程视觉理解任务验证有效性，摘要未披露具体模型参数量、完整基线对比与量化提升幅度

summary_en.core_problem: Existing vision-language models rely on shallow, text-centric multi-turn visual reasoning and lack human-like long-horizon interleaved vision-text chain-of-thought capabilities for complex tasks
summary_en.importance: Methodological and data contribution: proposes an interleaved vision-text reasoning paradigm and releases a high-quality synthetic interleaved VT-CoT dataset
summary_en.technical_approach: InterSketch dynamically generates intermediate visual sketches via external tools, interleaves them with textual reasoning, and trains with self-correction reflection and stepwise reward; uses a synthetic high-quality VT-CoT dataset for cold start
summary_en.experiments: Validated on long-horizon visual understanding tasks, no specific model size, full baseline comparison or quantitative improvement metrics are disclosed in the abstract

recommendation.zh: 属于多模态推理增强的增量工作，仅适合做多模态对齐的研究员参考，无需精读
recommendation.en: Incremental work on multimodal reasoning enhancement, only reference for multimodal alignment researchers, no need for close reading

paper.title: Not All Modalities Are Equal: Instruction-Aware Gating for Multimodal Videos
paper.abstract: Pre-trained video large language models excel at visual reasoning. However, they struggle when videos arrive with auxiliary streams, such as audio, depth map, or dense temporal evidence. In such a scenario, uniform fusion induces modality interference, allowing irrelevant channels to distract the model. To address this issue, we present a unified multimodal video understanding framework, named UniMVU, that performs instruction-aware fusion across video, audio, depth map, or any other modality in

summary.core_problem: 解决视频大模型在同时接收视频、音频、深度图等辅助流时，统一融合导致无关模态干扰的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM/视频理解中的融合机制改进。它强调模态重要性应随指令变化，而不是对所有模态做固定权重或均匀融合，对原生多模态预训练中的条件化模态选择有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 UniMVU，使用两级 instruction-aware gating：模态内部门控根据文本指令强调每个模态内的关键区域，模态级门控重新加权整条输入流。框架结合跨模态 self-attention、指令驱动的模态内部门控、带 control token 的模态级门控；对于时间对齐的流，还采用 fast-to-slow fusion 减少冗余。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露训练数据、模型规模、评测 benchmark、baseline 或具体提升幅度。可确认任务覆盖带辅助模态的视频理解，而不是通用 VLM 预训练 recipe 或新视觉 tokenizer。
summary.authors_note: Fahad Shahbaz Khan 是计算机视觉和多模态学习方向的知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses modality interference in video LLMs when videos are accompanied by auxiliary streams such as audio, depth, or dense temporal evidence.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a fusion mechanism for multimodal video understanding. It argues that modality relevance should be instruction-dependent rather than uniformly fused, which is mildly relevant to native multimodal pretraining and conditional modality selection.
summary_en.technical_approach: UniMVU uses two levels of instruction-aware gating: inner-modality gates highlight salient regions within each modality, and modality-level gates reweight entire streams. The framework combines cross-modal self-attention, instruction-conditioned inner-modality gating, a control-token-based modality gate, and fast-to-slow fusion for time-aligned streams.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not disclose training data, model scale, evaluated benchmarks, baselines, or quantitative gains. The work is positioned around auxiliary-stream video understanding rather than base VLM pretraining recipes or visual tokenization.
summary_en.authors_note: Fahad Shahbaz Khan is a well-known researcher in computer vision and multimodal learning.

recommendation.zh: 只看 gating 设计即可；这是多模态融合的合理工程修补，不足以改变 VLM 预训练判断。
recommendation.en: Skim only the gating design; this is a reasonable fusion fix, not evidence that should change VLM pretraining priors.

paper.title: DRScaffold: Boosting Dense-Scene Reasoning in Lightweight Vision Language Models
paper.abstract: Lightweight vision-language models perform competitively on standard benchmarks yet fail systematically in dense-scene reasoning, where multiple objects, attributes, and relations must be jointly grounded and resolved through multi-step inference. Such capability is critical for real-world applications where models must reliably interpret cluttered environments. Yet existing training signals provide no explicit grounding between reasoning steps and the underlying visual entities and relations, l

summary.core_problem: 轻量级 VLM 在密集场景中难以同时定位多个对象、属性和关系，导致推理链流畅但缺少视觉锚定。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个密集场景推理 benchmark 加一个监督微调框架。它对 VLM post-training 和多模态推理数据设计有参考价值，但不是原生多模态预训练范式或视觉 tokenizer 层面的工作。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先构建 DRBench，包含 2,943 张图像和 14,573 个问题，覆盖五类任务和三个递进推理层级。DRScaffold 把监督目标拆成四个因果顺序阶段，显式约束推理步骤与图像中的实体、属性、关系对齐；方法不改模型架构，属于结构化 SFT 监督。
summary.experiments: 实验面向轻量级视觉语言模型，在 DRBench 的密集场景推理任务上比较普通训练与 DRScaffold。摘要称该框架能提升 grounded reasoning，并缓解无视觉锚定的 chain generation，但未提供具体模型参数量和提升数字。

summary_en.core_problem: Lightweight VLMs struggle with dense-scene reasoning where multiple objects, attributes, and relations must be grounded jointly across multi-step inference.
summary_en.importance: The paper contributes a dense-scene reasoning benchmark and a supervised fine-tuning scaffold. It is useful for VLM post-training and multimodal reasoning data design, but it is not a native multimodal pretraining or visual-tokenization paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce DRBench with 14,573 questions over 2,943 images, organized into five task categories and three progressive reasoning layers. DRScaffold decomposes the supervision target into four causally ordered stages to force alignment between reasoning steps and visual entities, attributes, and relations, without changing the model architecture.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments evaluate lightweight VLMs on DRBench and compare standard training against DRScaffold. The abstract reports improved grounded reasoning and reduced visually unanchored reasoning chains, but does not provide parameter counts or exact gains.

recommendation.zh: 适合看数据 schema 和四阶段监督设计；对预训练结论弱，但能提醒轻量 VLM 的推理数据别只写 CoT。
recommendation.en: Skim the data schema and four-stage supervision design; weak for pretraining, but a useful reminder that lightweight VLM reasoning data should not be plain CoT.

paper.title: LocateAnything: Fast and High-Quality Vision-Language Grounding with Parallel Box Decoding
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) commonly formulate visual grounding and detection as a coordinate-token generation problem, serializing each 2D box into multiple 1D tokens that are learned and decoded largely independently. This token-by-token decoding mismatches the coupled structure of box geometry and creates a practical inference bottleneck due to strictly sequential generation. We introduce LocateAnything, a unified generative grounding and detection framework based on Parallel Box Decoding (

summary.core_problem: 视觉语言模型把 grounding 和 detection 表述为坐标 token 的串行生成，既破坏 box 几何元素之间的耦合，也带来解码延迟。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是 VLM grounding 的建模和工程改进：把 box/point 从多个独立坐标 token 改为原子几何单元并行解码，同时配套构建 1.38 亿样本级 LocateAnything-Data，用于提升开放定位数据覆盖。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Parallel Box Decoding，将边界框、点等几何结构作为一次性解码的单元，而不是按坐标 token 自回归展开。方法的关键是让模型在同一步内预测几何元素，保留框内几何一致性，并减少严格串行生成带来的推理瓶颈。另有可扩展数据引擎用于收集和整理大规模定位训练样本。
summary.experiments: 摘要披露训练数据超过 1.38 亿样本，并报告 PBD 同时提升解码吞吐和定位准确率；具体模型规模、baseline 名称、数据配比和提升幅度未在给定摘要中给出。

summary_en.core_problem: Current VLM grounding and detection systems often serialize each box into coordinate tokens, which weakens geometric coupling and creates an autoregressive decoding bottleneck.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a VLM grounding method plus a large data asset: boxes and points are decoded as atomic geometric units, and LocateAnything-Data provides more than 138M training samples for high-precision localization.
summary_en.technical_approach: LocateAnything introduces Parallel Box Decoding, predicting geometric objects such as boxes and points in one step instead of emitting coordinate tokens sequentially. This preserves intra-box consistency and exposes parallelism. The work also builds a scalable data engine to improve localization data diversity.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports over 138M training samples and claims gains in both decoding throughput and localization accuracy. Model sizes, baselines, and exact improvement numbers are not available in the provided abstract.

recommendation.zh: 对预训练不是主线；只看 PBD 如何替代坐标 token 串行生成，以及 1.38 亿定位数据的构造信号。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper; skim only the PBD replacement for serialized coordinate tokens and the 138M-sample grounding data engine.

paper.title: MuCRASP: Multimodal Chain-of-thought Reasoning aware Structured Pruning
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly rely on chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning to solve complex multimodal tasks, but their large parameter sizes make deployment expensive. Structured pruning offers a natural solution; however, existing methods fail to preserve CoT reasoning accuracy in VLMs. We identify two key reasons: (1) CoT consistency depends on sparse transition points (pivot tokens) in the generation trajectory, while existing pruning methods are CoT-agnostic; and (2) pruning method

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 结构化剪枝后多模态 CoT 推理能力下降的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态模型压缩方法。它关注推理部署成本，并把 CoT 轨迹中的关键 token 与跨模态激活差异纳入剪枝准则；对基座预训练启发有限，但对评估压缩是否破坏 reasoning path 有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MuCRASP，Multimodal Chain-of-thought Reasoning aware Structured Pruning。方法识别生成轨迹中的 sparse transition points，即 pivot tokens，认为这些位置对 CoT 一致性重要；同时建模视觉和文本模态的 activation distribution 差异，在全局参数预算下结合跨模态对齐与层敏感性来决定剪枝结构。
summary.experiments: 在四个 VLM 和三个 reasoning benchmarks 上评估。摘要称 MuCRASP 在不同剪枝强度下更好保留推理质量，但未给出具体模型名称、参数规模、剪枝比例和数值提升。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Kharagpur。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses degradation of multimodal CoT reasoning after structured pruning of VLMs.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal model-compression contribution. It focuses on deployment cost and asks whether pruning preserves reasoning trajectories and cross-modal alignment; its value for base pretraining is indirect.
summary_en.technical_approach: MuCRASP identifies sparse transition points, or pivot tokens, in the generation trajectory that are important for CoT consistency. It also accounts for different activation distributions across visual and textual modalities, combining cross-modal alignment and layer-wise sensitivity under a global parameter budget.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on four VLMs across three reasoning benchmarks. The abstract claims better preservation of reasoning quality under increasing compression, but does not provide model names, parameter sizes, pruning ratios, or numerical margins.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institution is Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Kharagpur.

recommendation.zh: 压缩论文里较少显式看 CoT 断点；可记住 pivot-token 诊断，不必细读剪枝算法。
recommendation.en: Compression papers rarely inspect CoT breakpoints explicitly; keep the pivot-token diagnostic, but the pruning algorithm can be skimmed.

paper.title: ProSR: Process-Shaped Spatial Reasoning for Reliable Chain-of-Thought in VLMs
paper.abstract: Reliable spatial reasoning remains a core bottleneck for vision-language models (VLMs). Existing mainstream training paradigms for spatial reasoning largely rely on outcome alignment or process imitation, lacking explicit constraints on the reasoning process, and therefore struggle to ensure genuine visual dependence and stable reasoning trajectories. In this paper, we construct a high-quality CoT dataset covering diverse spatial phenomena and diagnose the model's reasoning process, revealing tw

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作关注 VLM 空间推理中的一个老问题：模型即使答对，也不一定真的看图推理，更不一定有稳定的推理过程。作者把问题进一步拆成两个可诊断的过程缺陷。其一是 Spurious Grounding，模型在去掉图像后仍能给出相似 CoT，说明它可能主要依赖语言先验和数据偏置。其二是 Tail Instability，推理后段的不确定性反而上升，说明模型在接近答案时轨迹不稳。论文要解决的不是再做一个更大的空间数据集，而是如何把“过程可靠性”直接写进 RL 目标，而不是只优化最终答案正确率。
summary.importance: 对预训练主线来说，这不是核心论文，但有两个启发点。第一，它把 reasoning 训练中的过程退化现象显式量化了，说明只用 outcome reward 做 RL 很容易学到捷径，这和文本推理、工具使用、甚至代码推理中的 reward hacking 是同类问题。第二，它提出的约束方式不是监督 CoT 文本本身，而是约束推理过程中的不确定性轨迹与反事实行为，这比单纯 imitation 更接近“训练动力学约束”。如果以后把类似思想迁移到纯文本 LM 或多模态统一模型的 post-train，可能会比直接奖励长 CoT 更稳。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分两段。先做数据和诊断，再做过程塑形 RL。作者先构建了一个覆盖多类空间现象的 CoT 数据集，用它对模型做 SFT，得到具备初始空间 CoT 能力的 VLM。然后在这个基础上用 vanilla GRPO 做 RL，并系统分析 rollout 行为，发现仅靠最终答案奖励会诱发两类退化：Spurious Grounding 和 Tail Instability。

围绕这两个问题，ProSR 在 GRPO 目标里加入两个过程约束。第一个是 Counterfactual Invariance Penalty，用来抑制伪视觉依赖。具体做法是在 rollout 时额外引入 blank-image 条件，比较真实图像与空白图像条件下的 normalized entropy trajectory。如果两种条件下的不确定性轨迹过于相似，就施加惩罚。直觉上，真正依赖视觉证据的推理过程，在去掉图像后应当明显改变；如果几乎不变，说明模型没有认真用视觉输入。

第二个是 Tail Drift Penalty，用来抑制推理后段的不稳定。作者观察到合理的推理过程中，不确定性应当随着证据积累逐步收敛；若在后半段再次抬升，往往意味着模型在临近答案时发生摇摆、补编理由或切换策略。因此他们对 reasoning tail 的异常熵上升施加惩罚，鼓励轨迹在接近答案时稳定收束。

这个方法和常见 process supervision 的区别在于，它不直接要求模型模仿某条标准 CoT，而是把“是否看图”和“是否稳定收敛”变成可优化的行为约束。这样做的好处是，约束的是过程性质，而不是某种固定表述模板，理论上更有利于泛化。
summary.experiments:
作者在多个复杂和 OOD 空间推理 benchmark 上评测，报告平均准确率比已有方法提升 3.7%。除了答案准确率，论文还专门设计了四个诊断指标来测过程质量：Blank-image Accuracy、Same-Answer Rate、Normalized Trajectory Similarity、Late-Rise Rate。前几项主要测 Spurious Grounding，最后一项主要测 Tail Instability。

实验结论有两层。第一，ProSR 在常规 benchmark 上确实提升了最终任务表现，说明过程约束没有和答案正确率冲突。第二，更关键的是诊断指标同步改善：blank-image 条件下的异常可答性下降，真实图像与空白图像下的轨迹相似度降低，后段不确定性异常上升的比例也下降。这说明模型不是单纯学会了另一种表面模式，而是在更大程度上依赖视觉证据，并且推理轨迹更稳定。

从论文叙述看，作者还做了 vanilla GRPO 与 ProSR 的对比，以及两个 penalty 的消融。预期结论是两个约束各自对应不同退化模式，联合使用效果最好。给出的全文片段没有展开模型规模、训练步数、数据量和每个 benchmark 的逐项数字，因此无法在这里复述更细的表格，但实验设计本身是完整的：先证明问题存在，再证明约束能定向修复问题。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看引言里的问题定义和 Fig.1，确认作者发现的两类退化是否有说服力。然后直接看方法部分关于两个 penalty 的公式和实现，重点理解为什么用 entropy trajectory，而不是直接比较 token 或 CoT 文本。这个选择决定了方法是否只是另一个 process reward engineering。

接着看诊断指标定义和主实验表。若时间有限，优先看 blank-image 相关指标和 late-rise 指标，因为这两组最能说明方法到底有没有改变推理机制。最后看消融，判断 Counterfactual Invariance Penalty 与 Tail Drift Penalty 是否各自解决了对应问题，还是只是共同提供了正则化。

预计 30 到 45 分钟可以完成有效阅读。更值得带着问题去看的点有两个：一是 blank-image 反事实是否会误伤某些强语言先验任务；二是 entropy trajectory 作为过程代理变量是否足够稳健，是否会被解码策略或温度设置影响。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a familiar weakness in VLM spatial reasoning: a model can produce the correct answer without genuinely grounding its reasoning in the image, and even when it does reason, the trajectory may be unstable. The authors make this concrete with two diagnosed failure modes. Spurious Grounding means the model produces similar CoT behavior even when the image is removed, suggesting reliance on language priors or dataset bias. Tail Instability means uncertainty rises again late in the reasoning chain, indicating unstable convergence near answer generation. The goal is therefore not just better spatial accuracy, but process-level reliability under RL training.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining paper, but it is relevant to anyone thinking about reasoning optimization. The main lesson is that answer-only RL objectives can induce shortcut behavior even when benchmark accuracy improves. That is directly related to reward hacking in text reasoning, tool use, and code generation. A second useful idea is methodological: instead of supervising a canonical CoT string, the paper constrains process properties through uncertainty trajectories and counterfactual behavior. That is closer to shaping training dynamics than to plain imitation, and the idea could plausibly transfer beyond spatial VLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has two stages: diagnosis and process-shaped RL.

First, the authors build a spatial CoT dataset covering diverse spatial phenomena and use it for SFT, producing a VLM with initial chain-of-thought capability. They then continue training with vanilla GRPO using only final-answer correctness and analyze rollout behavior. This reveals two systematic degradations: Spurious Grounding and Tail Instability.

ProSR adds two penalties to the GRPO objective. The first is the Counterfactual Invariance Penalty. During rollout, the model is evaluated not only on the real image but also on a blank-image condition. The method compares the normalized entropy trajectories under the two conditions and penalizes excessive similarity. The intuition is simple: if the reasoning process truly depends on visual evidence, removing the image should materially change the uncertainty profile. If the trajectories remain too similar, the model is likely exploiting non-visual shortcuts.

The second is the Tail Drift Penalty. The authors observe that a healthy reasoning trajectory should gradually become more certain as evidence accumulates. When uncertainty rises again in the later part of the chain, it often signals instability, hesitation, or post-hoc rationalization near the answer. The penalty discourages this late-stage entropy increase and pushes the trajectory toward smoother convergence.

What distinguishes ProSR from standard process supervision is that it does not force the model to imitate a specific reference CoT. Instead, it optimizes for two process properties: visual dependence and stable convergence. That makes the method less tied to a fixed reasoning template and potentially more robust under distribution shift.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper reports an average accuracy gain of 3.7% over prior methods on multiple challenging and out-of-distribution spatial reasoning benchmarks. More importantly, it introduces four diagnostic metrics to measure process quality: Blank-image Accuracy, Same-Answer Rate, Normalized Trajectory Similarity, and Late-Rise Rate.

The results support two claims. First, ProSR improves standard task accuracy, so the process penalties do not merely regularize at the expense of final performance. Second, the diagnostic metrics improve in the expected direction: the model becomes less answerable under blank-image conditions, the trajectory similarity between real-image and blank-image settings decreases, and late-stage uncertainty spikes become less frequent. That suggests the model is relying more on visual evidence and reasoning more stably, rather than just learning another superficial pattern.

From the paper structure, there are also comparisons against vanilla GRPO and ablations for the two penalties. The likely takeaway is that each penalty targets a different degradation mode and the combination works best. The provided excerpt does not include all benchmark-level numbers, model sizes, or training-budget details, so the summary here focuses on the experimental logic rather than reproducing every table.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, start with the introduction and the figure that visualizes the two failure modes. The paper is only worth attention if those diagnostics are convincing. Then go straight to the method section and inspect the two penalties, especially why entropy trajectories are used instead of token-level CoT matching. That design choice is central.

Next, read the definitions of the diagnostic metrics and the main results table. If time is limited, prioritize the blank-image diagnostics and the late-rise metric, because they most directly test whether the method changes the reasoning mechanism rather than only the answer distribution. Finally, check the ablations to see whether the Counterfactual Invariance Penalty and Tail Drift Penalty each fix their intended issue or merely act as generic regularizers.

A useful reading time budget is 30 to 45 minutes. Two follow-up questions are worth keeping in mind: whether the blank-image counterfactual could over-penalize tasks with strong language priors, and how sensitive entropy-trajectory diagnostics are to decoding settings such as temperature.

recommendation.zh: 可扫数据诊断和两个 penalty；若证据扎实，它会提醒 VLM RL 不应只盯 outcome reward。
recommendation.en: Skim the diagnostics and the two penalties; if the evidence is clean, it argues against optimizing VLM RL on outcome reward alone.

paper.title: Rethinking VLM Representation for VLA Initialization
paper.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models widely adopt pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) as policy backbones, yet it remains unclear what kind of pretrained VLM representation is useful as a VLA initialization. In this paper, we study VLA initialization as a controlled representation-design problem along three axes: capability-level embodied VQA supervision, parameter-update strategy, and robot-data pretraining. Our experiments show that the original pretrained VLM representation is a key sourc

summary.core_problem: 研究什么样的预训练 VLM 表示适合作为 Vision-Language-Action 模型的初始化，而不是默认把 VLM finetune 成策略网络。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是表示迁移分析。它把 VLA 初始化拆成三个可控因素：具身 VQA 监督、参数更新策略、机器人数据预训练；对理解 VLM 表示如何迁移到行动模型有参考价值，但离 LLM 基座预训练仍有一层任务适配距离。
summary.technical_approach: 论文将 VLA 初始化设为受控 representation-design 问题，比较原始预训练 VLM 表示、具身 VQA 适配、LoRA 与 full finetune 等更新策略，以及机器人数据预训练。核心观察是保留原始 VLM 表示很关键，LoRA 比全量微调更稳，机器人数据预训练进一步改善初始化。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型参数量、具体 VLM/VLA backbone、机器人数据规模或数值提升；披露的实验结论包括：具身 VQA 适配收益依赖下游瓶颈，不同能力域收益不简单相加；LoRA 初始化可靠性优于 full finetune；分阶段 LoRA 机器人数据预训练得到最强变体。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies which pretrained VLM representations are useful for initializing Vision-Language-Action models, instead of assuming that any VLM adaptation will improve policy learning.
summary_en.importance: This is a representation-transfer analysis. It decomposes VLA initialization into embodied VQA supervision, parameter-update strategy, and robot-data pretraining. The findings are relevant to how pretrained VLM features transfer into action models, though the connection to LLM foundation pretraining is indirect.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors frame VLA initialization as a controlled representation-design problem. They compare the original pretrained VLM representation, embodied VQA adaptation, LoRA versus full finetuning, and robot-data pretraining. The central message is that preserving the pretrained representation matters, LoRA is more reliable than full finetuning, and staged LoRA-based robot-data pretraining works best among the studied variants.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, exact VLM/VLA backbones, robot-data scale, or quantitative gains. It reports qualitative findings: embodied VQA adaptation is bottleneck-dependent and non-additive across capability domains; LoRA is a more reliable initialization than full finetuning; robot-data pretraining further improves VLA initialization.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验分解和 LoRA-vs-full finetune 结果；它提醒预训练表示被过度重塑会伤迁移，但证据还偏机器人场景。
recommendation.en: Read only the factorized experiments and LoRA-vs-full-finetune result; the useful signal is that over-reshaping pretrained representations can hurt transfer, though the evidence is robotics-bound.

paper.title: Binding Visual Features Point by Point
paper.abstract: Despite success on standard benchmarks, vision language models display persistent failures on tasks involving processing of multi-object scenes, including many tasks that are relatively easy for humans. Recent work has found that these failures may stem from a basic inability to accurately bind object features in-context, a challenge that is referred to as the "binding problem" in cognitive science and neuroscience. The human visual system is thought to solve this binding problem via serial proc

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 VLM 在多物体场景中的特征绑定失败：模型能识别颜色、形状等局部特征，却会把不同物体的特征错误组合，例如把“蓝色方块”和“红色圆形”误读成“蓝色圆形”。论文重点不是提出一个新的 VLM 训练 recipe，而是解释为什么用文本输出空间坐标的 pointing 过程能缓解这类错误。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于，它把 VLM 的多物体失败归因到表示和注意力层面的干扰，而不是简单归因于数据不足或指令跟随能力不足。pointing-via-text 可以看作一种把串行视觉搜索过程显式接入语言生成轨迹的训练信号。它提示多模态预训练/后训练中，输出格式不只是监督答案，也能诱导模型形成内部算法，例如逐个定位、逐个绑定、再汇总判断。这对视觉 grounding、视觉 token 使用方式、以及 VLM 中间推理轨迹设计都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先用彩色形状视觉搜索任务分析绑定错误的来源。任务要求判断目标对象是否存在，例如绿色 T。干扰项共享目标的部分特征，因此模型必须正确绑定颜色与形状，而不能只做特征集合匹配。作者将错误与对象间共享特征导致的注意力干扰联系起来。随后分析 Molmo-7B 的 pointing-via-text 行为：模型在回答前依次输出物体坐标，虽然训练时没有显式监督内部注意力状态，但模型内部出现了类似视觉搜索的串行机制。论文进一步识别出一组 search heads，这些注意力头负责把当前生成步骤与图像中的下一个候选对象关联起来。作者还在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 中观察到类似机制，说明这不是单一模型偶然现象。最后，论文在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct、Gemma-3-12B、LLaVA-1.5-7B-HF 等模型上研究学习 pointing 对计数和视觉搜索的影响，结论是显式逐点枚举能减少绑定错误，并改善分布外泛化。
summary.experiments: 关键实验围绕三类问题展开。第一类是机制分析：在多彩形状视觉搜索任务中，模型的绑定错误与共享特征对象之间的注意力干扰有关。第二类是内部机制验证：Molmo-7B 在生成坐标序列时表现出逐对象搜索过程，作者定位到实现该过程的 search heads；类似头部也出现在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 中。第三类是行为实验：在计数和视觉搜索任务上，让模型学习 pointing-via-text 后，Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct、Gemma-3-12B、LLaVA-1.5-7B-HF 的绑定错误显著减少，并在分布外条件下有更稳定表现。提供内容中没有完整表格数字，因此不宜过度解读具体提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 binding problem 与 pointing-via-text 的问题定义；Results 里关于视觉搜索任务、注意力干扰、search heads 的机制分析；再看计数和视觉搜索的泛化实验。若关注 VLM 预训练，可重点思考两个点：第一，坐标输出为何能诱导内部串行搜索，而不仅是改变答案格式；第二，这类中间轨迹监督是否可以扩展到更一般的视觉 grounding、区域级 caption、视频事件绑定任务。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies feature binding failures in VLMs on multi-object scenes. These models may recognize individual attributes such as color and shape, but incorrectly combine attributes across objects, for example inferring a blue circle from a blue square and a red circle. The main goal is to explain why text-based pointing, where the model emits spatial coordinates before answering, helps with such failures.
summary_en.importance: The useful point for pretraining research is that the paper connects VLM failures to representational interference and attention mechanisms, rather than treating them only as data or instruction-following issues. Pointing-via-text acts as more than an output format: it can induce a serial visual search routine inside the model. This matters for multimodal training because intermediate supervision can shape internal algorithms, especially for grounding, object-wise reasoning, counting, and compositional visual understanding.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper first analyzes a colored-shape visual search task, where the model must decide whether a target such as a green T is present among distractors that share partial target features. This task isolates the binding requirement: the model must associate color and shape with the same object rather than rely on a bag of attributes. The authors link errors to attentional interference between objects with shared features. They then analyze Molmo-7B under pointing-via-text. Although internal attention states are not explicitly supervised, the model develops a serial search-like process while producing coordinate traces. The paper identifies a set of attention heads, called search heads, that implement this routine. Similar heads are reported in Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, suggesting that the mechanism is not unique to one model family. The behavioral side evaluates whether learning to point reduces binding errors in counting and visual search across Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, Gemma-3-12B, and LLaVA-1.5-7B-HF.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover mechanism and behavior. On controlled visual search tasks, binding errors are associated with interference among objects sharing features. In Molmo-7B, coordinate generation is accompanied by an internal object-by-object search routine, and specific search heads are identified as key components. The same type of mechanism is observed in Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct. On downstream-style controlled tasks such as counting and visual search, training models to point before answering reduces binding errors and improves out-of-distribution generalization. The provided text does not include full numeric tables, so the reliable takeaway is the direction and mechanism of the effect rather than a precise gain estimate.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Focus on the problem setup for binding errors, the visual search task, the mechanistic evidence for search heads, and the experiments on counting and out-of-distribution visual search. For multimodal pretraining work, the main question to examine is why coordinate traces induce serial attention rather than merely changing the response format, and whether similar intermediate traces can be used for broader grounding and compositional reasoning tasks.

recommendation.zh: 别把“加坐标就变强”当玄学：这篇更像在解释它修的是绑定歧义还是诱导串行处理；只看其机制实验与失败案例拆解就够。
recommendation.en: Don’t treat “add coordinates and it works” as magic—this tries to pin down whether it fixes binding ambiguity or induces serial processing; focus on the mechanistic probes and failure-case breakdowns.

paper.title: Faithful-MR1: Faithful Multimodal Reasoning via Anchoring and Reinforcing Visual Attention
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a promising paradigm for advancing complex reasoning in large language models, and recent work extends RLVR to multimodal large language models (MLLMs). This transfer, however, surfaces a faithfulness challenge: faithful perception of task-relevant visual evidence and faithful use of that evidence during reasoning, leading to unsatisfactory gains on multimodal benchmarks. Specifically, existing perception supervision often oper

summary.core_problem: Faithful-MR1 解决的是多模态 RLVR 中的“看见”和“用上”脱节问题。现有方法常奖励最终答案或文本化的视觉描述，但模型即使正确识别了图像证据，也可能在后续推理中丢掉、改写或被语言先验覆盖。作者把这类现象称为 perception–reasoning disconnect。
summary.importance: 这项工作属于多模态 post-train / RLVR 训练信号设计，对 VLM 预训练和后训练接口有参考价值。它指出多模态推理不能只把图像转成文字再做语言推理，也不能只用最终答案 reward 期待模型自动学会视觉 grounding。更有效的信号需要同时约束视觉证据的提取位置，以及推理过程中哪些 token 真正依赖这些视觉证据。
summary.technical_approach: Faithful-MR1 分为 Anchoring 和 Reinforcing 两个阶段。Anchoring 阶段把感知显式变成推理前的一个子任务：模型在完整推理前先生成专用的 <Focus> token，并通过 attention supervision 让该 token 直接对齐问题相关的图像区域。这里监督的是图像 region，而不是模型自己生成的视觉描述，因此信号更接近原始视觉证据。Reinforcing 阶段处理更难观察的 faithful use。作者用 counterfactual image intervention 对图像做 mask，找出哪些 response token 的预测会因为图像遮挡而变化，这些 token 被视为视觉因果相关的位置。训练时奖励答案正确、并且在这些视觉相关 token 上集中视觉注意力的轨迹。这个设计把 answer-level RLVR、区域 grounding、token-level 视觉依赖联系在一起。
summary.experiments: 实验基于 Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct 3B 和 7B。作者构造了 19.2K 条带 question-relevant bounding box 标注的 evidence-grounded training examples，用于区域级监督。论文报告在少于现有多模态 RLVR baseline 训练数据的条件下，Faithful-MR1 在多个多模态推理 benchmark 上优于当前方法。分析部分显示，单纯提高 perception text 的准确性并不稳定转化为最终答案提升；Faithful Use 与最终答案准确率的相关性更强。该结果支持了 PRD 是独立失败模式，而不是 perception accuracy 的附属现象。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。优先看 Section 4.4 的失败模式量化分析，它说明为什么只监督视觉描述不够。然后看 Anchoring 阶段的 <Focus> token 和 region-level attention supervision，再看 Reinforcing 阶段的 counterfactual image intervention。实验表格可以重点看 Qwen2.5-VL 3B/7B 上与 Vision-R1、Perception-R1、Vision-SR1、VPPO 类方法的差异。值得深挖的是 reward 是否可能被 attention proxy 欺骗，以及 counterfactual masking 找到的视觉相关 token 是否稳定。

summary_en.core_problem: Faithful-MR1 addresses a specific failure mode in multimodal RLVR: the model may perceive the relevant visual evidence correctly, but then fail to use it faithfully during reasoning. Existing methods often supervise textual visual descriptions or reward only the final answer. That leaves a gap between perception and reasoning, where visual evidence can be dropped, contradicted, or overridden by language priors.
summary_en.importance: The paper is relevant as a multimodal post-training signal design, with implications for the interface between VLM pretraining and RL-based reasoning training. It argues that answer-level rewards are not enough for visual reasoning. A useful training signal should constrain both where the model attends in the image and where the generated reasoning actually depends on visual evidence.
summary_en.technical_approach: Faithful-MR1 has two stages. The Anchoring stage inserts an explicit pre-reasoning step: before producing the full reasoning trace, the model emits a dedicated <Focus> token. The attention of this token is supervised against question-relevant image regions using bounding boxes. This gives a region-level perception signal rather than an indirect text-description signal. The Reinforcing stage targets faithful use. Since faithful use is not directly observable from the reasoning text, the method uses counterfactual image intervention: mask visual evidence and identify response tokens whose predictions shift. These tokens are treated as locations where vision causally matters. The RL objective then rewards trajectories that are answer-correct and concentrate visual attention at those visually causal reasoning positions.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct 3B and 7B backbones. The authors build a 19.2K-example evidence-grounded training corpus with bounding-box annotations for question-relevant regions. With less training data than prior multimodal RLVR baselines, Faithful-MR1 reports better performance across multimodal reasoning benchmarks. The diagnostic analysis shows that improving perception text alone does not reliably improve final answer accuracy. Faithful Use tracks answer accuracy more closely, supporting the claim that perception-reasoning disconnect is a separate failure mode.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Start with the failure-mode analysis, especially the part comparing perception coverage, faithful use, and final accuracy. Then read the Anchoring design around the <Focus> token and region-level attention supervision. The Reinforcing stage is the most technically useful part: focus on how counterfactual masking identifies visually causal response tokens and how that signal enters RL. In the experiments, compare the Qwen2.5-VL 3B and 7B results against Vision-R1, Perception-R1, Vision-SR1, and VPPO-style baselines. A useful follow-up question is whether the attention-based proxy can be gamed during training.

recommendation.zh: 值得看方法图和 reward 设计：它把多模态 RLVR 的失败点定位到视觉证据接口，而不是简单怪推理模型不够强。
recommendation.en: Read the method diagram and reward design: the useful signal is the diagnosis of the visual-evidence interface, not another claim that stronger reasoning fixes VLMs.

paper.title: Visual-Advantage On-Policy Distillation for Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: On-policy knowledge distillation has proven effective for language models, yet its application to vision-language models (VLMs) remains underexplored. We observe that standard on-policy distillation can improve a student's output quality while failing to strengthen its reliance on visual input: on vision-critical tokens, the student's predictions remain largely unchanged whether or not fine-grained visual detail is present, even though the teacher's predictions depend heavily on it.To make this

summary.core_problem: 标准在策略蒸馏应用到视觉语言模型（VLM）时，均匀加权的KL损失会被大量不依赖视觉信息的语言脚手架token稀释，学生模型仅能表面对齐教师输出，无法真正增强对细粒度视觉信息的依赖，视觉关键token的梯度贡献被严重弱化。
summary.importance: 为多模态模型蒸馏提供了token级的视觉依赖量化信号，避免蒸馏仅对齐语言表面特征，对VLM预训练后的蒸馏压缩、多模态对齐有实际参考价值，方法轻量无需额外标注或额外训练组件。
summary.technical_approach: 首先提出视觉优势（VA）的量化指标：对学生生成的每个token，计算教师模型在有细粒度视觉信息、无细粒度视觉信息两种条件下打分的对数概率差，用来表征每个token的视觉依赖程度。基于VA提出VA-OPD蒸馏方法，从两个粒度优化损失：1）轨迹层面，同prompt下生成的多个候选rollout按轨迹平均VA加权，视觉依赖更强的rollout梯度贡献更高；2）token层面，按VA将token分为高低两组，组内分别平均KL损失后再求和，避免高VA关键token的梯度被低VA语言token稀释。整个方案仅增加一次教师模型在退化图像上的前向传播，无额外标注、奖励模型或更多rollout的开销。
summary.experiments: 在4B/8B/32B三种教师规模、Geometry3K和ViRL39K两个训练语料、8个基准测试上验证，VA-OPD在所有基准上均超过标准在策略蒸馏。细粒度视觉依赖越强的任务提升越明显：HallusionBench提升2.5，AI2D提升2.4；使用更大规模的ViRL39K语料时，数学类任务平均提升3.8，视觉类任务平均提升2.5。训练过程中学生rollout的VA值与准确率同步上升，证明性能提升来自对视觉信息依赖的增强，而非单纯模仿教师的输出表面特征。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注Introduction部分的问题观察、VA指标定义，以及实验章节中移除高VA token损失的消融实验，可跳过具体训练超参数细节，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: When standard on-policy distillation is applied to vision-language models (VLMs), the uniformly weighted KL loss is diluted by a large volume of language scaffolding tokens that do not rely on visual input. The student model only aligns with the teacher's outputs at the surface level, failing to genuinely strengthen reliance on fine-grained visual details, with gradient contributions from vision-critical tokens heavily weakened.
summary_en.importance: It provides a token-level quantitative signal of visual dependency for multimodal model distillation, avoiding distillation that only aligns surface linguistic features. It has practical reference value for post-pretraining distillation, compression and multimodal alignment of VLMs, and the method is lightweight with no requirement for extra annotations or additional training components.
summary_en.technical_approach: First, the Visual Advantage (VA) metric is proposed: for each token generated by the student, calculate the log-probability difference of the token scored by the teacher under two conditions (with fine-grained visual details, and with fine-grained visual details degraded), which characterizes the visual dependency level of each token. The VA-OPD distillation method is built on VA, with loss optimized at two granularities: 1) Trajectory level: multiple candidate rollouts generated under the same prompt are weighted by their trajectory-averaged VA, so rollouts with stronger visual dependency contribute more to the gradient. 2) Token level: tokens are divided into high and low VA groups by VA value, KL loss is averaged separately within each group before summation, to avoid gradient dilution of high-VA critical tokens by low-VA linguistic tokens. The whole pipeline only adds one extra teacher forward pass on degraded images, with no extra cost of annotations, reward models or additional rollouts.
summary_en.experiments: Validated across 3 teacher sizes (4B/8B/32B), 2 training corpora (Geometry3K, ViRL39K) and 8 benchmarks, VA-OPD outperforms standard on-policy distillation on all benchmarks. Gains are more significant on tasks with higher fine-grained visual dependency: +2.5 on HallusionBench, +2.4 on AI2D. When using the larger ViRL39K corpus, the average gain on math tasks reaches 3.8, and the average gain on visual tasks reaches 2.5. The VA value of student rollouts rises synchronously with accuracy during training, proving performance gains come from enhanced reliance on visual information, rather than mere imitation of surface features of teacher outputs.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the problem observation and VA metric definition in the Introduction section, as well as the ablation experiment of removing loss on high-VA tokens in the experiment section. Specific training hyperparameter details can be skipped. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看的是训练信号分解思路，不是蒸馏本身；只看VA定义和高VA token分布，如果现象稳，很多多模态loss都该重写。
recommendation.en: What matters here is the supervision decomposition, not distillation per se; read the VA definition and token distribution first—if the effect is robust, many multimodal losses are underweighting the only tokens that matter.

paper.title: GeoWeaver: Grounding Visual Tokens with Geometric Evidence before Scene Reasoning
paper.abstract: Spatio-temporal reasoning in vision-language models requires visual representations that preserve physical geometry rather than merely semantic appearance. Recent multimodal models incorporate geometric information through structural branches, 3D-aware supervision, reasoning-stage fusion, or long-horizon memory. While these approaches demonstrate the importance of geometry for spatial intelligence, they typically treat geometric cues as a shared signal across all visual tokens. We note that this

summary.core_problem: GeoWeaver 解决的是 VLM 在空间和时序推理中视觉 token 缺少几何 grounding 的问题。作者的核心判断是：很多模型把几何信息作为后期融合信号交给语言解码器处理，导致解码器同时承担“视觉-几何对齐”和“关系推理”两个任务，空间关系、距离、方向、运动轨迹这类问题容易不稳定。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在多模态表示接口，而不是纯文本预训练。它强调几何信息不应只作为额外输入或 reasoning 阶段的辅助特征，而应在进入 LLM 前改写视觉 token 的表征。这对 native multimodal pretraining 有参考价值：视觉 tokenizer 或视觉 encoder 输出给语言模型的 token，不能只追求语义压缩，还需要保留可被语言模型使用的结构证据。贡献量级属于方法型增量，重点是 grounding 位置和 token-adaptive 几何证据分配。
summary.technical_approach: 方法采用 ground-then-reason 设计。输入视频帧先经过基础 VLM 的视觉分支得到语义视觉 token；同一批帧再经过冻结的 geometry encoder，构造多层级 geometry bank。随后，每个视觉 token 查询这个 geometry bank，并为不同几何层预测 routing weight。模型不是把所有几何层统一拼接给每个 token，而是用稀疏路由为每个 token 选择更相关的几何证据，再注入视觉表示。这样做的差别在于：传统 late fusion 或统一几何增强把 geometry 当作全局共享信号，容易带来冗余和干扰；GeoWeaver 把 geometry 当作 token 级条件证据，让不同空间角色的视觉 token 获得不同几何抽象。
summary.experiments: 文中描述了在多个 geometry-sensitive spatial reasoning benchmark 上相对强空间推理模型取得稳定改进，同时保持通用多模态能力。消融重点验证了两点：多层 geometry bank 的构造有必要，只用单层或缺少 reasoning-relevant geometry layer 会削弱效果；token-adaptive sparse evidence allocation 比统一暴露所有几何层更稳，因为它减少了无关结构信号对视觉 token 的干扰。给定材料没有提供具体模型规模、训练数据规模、benchmark 分数和提升幅度，因此不宜补充数字。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 15–20 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对“pre-reasoning geometric grounding”的定义，这决定了方法和普通几何特征融合的区别。再看 Figure 1 和 Method 里的三阶段流程：visual branch、geometry branch、token-adaptive grounding。重点关注 routing weights 和 sparse routing 的设计，它是主要方法点。实验部分可优先看 ablation：geometry bank 层级选择、是否稀疏路由、是否在 decoder 前注入几何证据。若关注 VLM 预训练接口，可进一步思考这个模块是否应在预训练阶段联合学习，而不是作为下游空间推理增强模块接入。

summary_en.core_problem: GeoWeaver targets a representation-side failure in VLM spatio-temporal reasoning: visual tokens often enter the language decoder without being grounded in usable geometric evidence. The decoder is then forced to solve visual-geometry alignment and relational reasoning at the same time, which is a poor division of labor for tasks involving distance, layout, direction, object motion, and temporal spatial relations.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining research lies in the multimodal interface. The work argues that geometry should shape visual tokens before language decoding, rather than being injected as a late auxiliary signal. This is relevant to native multimodal pretraining and visual tokenization: tokens handed to an LLM need to preserve structural evidence, not only semantic appearance. The contribution is a focused method-level improvement rather than a new foundation-model training recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework follows a ground-then-reason design. A semantic visual branch extracts visual tokens from the base VLM. In parallel, a frozen geometry encoder builds a multi-level geometry bank from the same frames. Each visual token then queries this bank and predicts routing weights over geometry layers. Instead of exposing every token to all geometry features, GeoWeaver applies sparse routing to select compact token-specific geometric evidence and injects it into the visual representation before language decoding. This differs from uniform geometry fusion: different tokens can retrieve different geometry abstractions according to their spatial roles, which reduces redundant structural signals and limits interference.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports consistent gains on geometry-sensitive spatial reasoning benchmarks while preserving general multimodal capability. The ablations support two claims: multi-level geometry banks are useful because different reasoning cases need different geometric abstractions, and sparse token-adaptive allocation works better than uniformly sharing geometry across tokens. The provided material does not include exact model sizes, training data scale, benchmark scores, or numerical improvement margins, so those details should not be inferred.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 15–20 minute skim is enough for most readers. Start with the Introduction to understand the pre-reasoning grounding formulation. Then inspect Figure 1 and the Method section for the three-stage pipeline: visual branch, geometry branch, and token-adaptive grounding. The key technical part is the routing mechanism over geometry layers. In the experiments, prioritize the ablations on geometry-bank construction, sparse routing, and injection position. For multimodal pretraining, the useful question is whether this kind of geometry grounding should be learned during pretraining rather than added as a downstream reasoning module.

recommendation.zh: 可扫方法图和消融；如果token级geometry routing收益稳定，值得借到native VLM预训练接口里试。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and ablations; if token-level geometry routing holds up, it is worth testing as an interface for native VLM pretraining.

paper.title: Thermo-VL: Extending Vision-Language Models to Thermal Infrared Perception
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) often fail under low illumination because their visual grounding is learned predominantly from RGB imagery, whereas thermal infrared preserves complementary scene structure when visible cues degrade. We present Thermo-VL, a wavelength-aware VLM that augments a frozen Molmo-7B backbone with a trainable thermal encoder and a text-guided dual-attention fusion module. Given aligned RGB tokens, thermal tokens, and prompt embeddings, the fusion module conditions thermal f

summary.core_problem: 解决 RGB 训练的 VLM 在低照度场景下视觉 grounding 失效的问题，通过热红外信号补充可见光信息。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是新模态适配和数据集/评测补充。它不是 native multimodal 预训练，但对“冻结大 VLM 后接入新传感器”的接口设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: Thermo-VL 冻结 Molmo-7B 主干，引入可训练热红外 encoder 和 text-guided dual-attention fusion module。融合模块同时利用 prompt embedding、RGB token 和 thermal token，将热红外证据以 gated residual 注入冻结 RGB 流，避免破坏原有 RGB-language 对齐接口；训练目标包括标准语言建模损失、辅助跨模态对齐损失和正则项。
summary.experiments: 论文引入 pixel-aligned RGB-thermal instruction-tuning dataset 和 Thermo-VL-Bench。摘要未给出完整模型规模之外的训练数据量、baseline 列表和具体分数；已知主干为 Molmo-7B，并声称低照度热红外感知优于 RGB-only VLM。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Johns Hopkins University；Vishal M. Patel 是计算机视觉和低层视觉方向的知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the failure of RGB-trained VLMs under low illumination by adding thermal infrared perception as a complementary visual signal.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is sensor-modality adaptation plus a dataset and benchmark, rather than native multimodal pretraining. It is useful for studying how to attach a new visual stream to a frozen VLM without damaging its existing RGB-language interface.
summary_en.technical_approach: Thermo-VL freezes a Molmo-7B backbone and adds a trainable thermal encoder with a text-guided dual-attention fusion module. The module conditions thermal features on prompt embeddings and RGB context, then injects them into the frozen RGB stream through a gated residual path. Training combines the standard language-modeling loss with auxiliary alignment and regularization losses.
summary_en.experiments: The work introduces a pixel-aligned RGB-thermal instruction-tuning dataset and Thermo-VL-Bench. The provided abstract does not expose full dataset size, baseline details, or exact scores; the known backbone is Molmo-7B, and the claimed gains target low-light thermal-aware perception over RGB-only VLMs.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Johns Hopkins University; Vishal M. Patel is a well-known researcher in computer vision and low-level vision.

recommendation.zh: 可只看 fusion module 和辅助 loss；它像传感器 adapter 论文，不是统一多模态预训练路线。
recommendation.en: Skim the fusion module and auxiliary losses; this is closer to a sensor-adapter paper than a native multimodal pretraining recipe.
