paper.title: From Seeing to Thinking: Decoupling Perception and Reasoning Improves Post-Training of Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs) emphasize long chain-of-thought reasoning; yet, we find that their performance on visual tasks is primarily limited by a lack of visual perception as opposed to reasoning itself. In this work, we systematically study the interplay between perception and reasoning in VLM post-training by decomposing their capabilities into three separate training stages: visual perception, visual reasoning, and textual reasoning, incorporating specialized training

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是一个在 VLM 后训练里很常见、但经常被推理训练掩盖的问题：模型在视觉任务上做不好，很多时候不是 reasoning 不够长，而是第一步 perception 就错了。作者把视觉能力拆成 visual perception、visual reasoning、textual reasoning 三个相对独立的维度，核心问题是：如果把这三种能力分开建模、分阶段训练，尤其先把 perception 打牢，是否能比当前把各种数据混在一起、主要强化长 CoT 的做法更有效。
summary.importance: 虽然这是 VLM post-training 论文，但对基座研究的启发不小，尤其在“能力拆分”和“训练顺序”上。它给出的结论很明确：视觉感知不是预训练后天然足够的底座能力，也不是靠更长推理就能补回来的；它需要专门数据、专门目标，而且训练顺序会显著影响最终效果。这个结论可以外推到更广义的多模态预训练和后训练接口：当模型能力由多个异质子能力组成时，把所有信号混合优化未必最好，按 capability dimension 做 curriculum 可能比按样本难度排序更关键。对纯文本 LLM 也有映射意义，比如 retrieval、tool use、long-context grounding 这类能力是否也应先单独固化再做复杂推理。
summary.technical_approach:
技术方案的核心是 staged post-training pipeline。作者构造了三套互不重叠的数据，分别对应 visual perception、textual reasoning、visual reasoning，然后按阶段依次训练，而不是把所有数据 merge 后统一采样。这里最关键的是第一阶段 visual perception。作者认为它的目标不是生成漂亮 caption，而是让模型稳定识别细粒度视觉实体、属性和空间关系，并把这些信息正确映射到文本表征中。

为此，他们从 DOCCI 这类细粒度图像-描述数据出发，把 image-caption 对转成 perception-focused QA 数据，而不是直接做 caption SFT。更进一步，作者比较了 caption-based SFT 和 RLVR。RLVR 指 reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards，奖励来自可验证答案是否正确。论文的判断是，caption SFT 往往给模型施加 token-level、off-policy 的模仿信号，容易把模型往数据分布较窄、甚至低于预训练语料质量的方向拉；而 RL 让模型在自身生成轨迹上更新，更适合学习“看清楚再回答”这种结果可验证的感知能力。

第二阶段是 textual reasoning，目的是补足纯文本链式推理能力，避免把视觉错误和文本推理错误混在一起。第三阶段才是 visual reasoning，把前两阶段学到的感知和文本推理结合到图像条件下的复杂任务中。作者还系统比较了 staged training 与 one-stage merged training，以及不同阶段顺序。结论是顺序不能乱，perception 必须先于 visual reasoning 固化，否则后续训练会在错误视觉表征上叠加更长的错误推理。

另一个有意思的点是作者把这种做法概括为 capability-dimension curriculum learning。它不是按 easy-to-hard 排样本，而是按能力维度安排优化路径。全文还进一步验证了它和 difficulty-based curriculum 是互补的，可以叠加。
summary.experiments:
实验最有说服力的部分是作者先做了错误归因。用 Claude-Haiku-4.5 分析 Qwen3-VL-8B 在 3 个 visual math 数据集上的错误样本，发现 86.9% 的错误可归因于视觉感知阶段出错，而不是后续推理本身。这给后面的 staged design 提供了直接动机。

性能上，加入 visual perception stage 后，Qwen2.5-VL-7B 在 WeMath 上比 base model 提升 7.43 个点；Qwen3-VL-8B 从 50.9% 提升到 56.1%。在 staged vs one-stage 对比中，staged-trained Qwen3-VL-8B 的 math reasoning accuracy 再提升 1.46 个点，同时 reasoning trace 长度缩短 20.8%，说明收益不是靠“想得更长”，而是前面看得更准。阶段顺序实验也很关键：如果打乱顺序，Qwen2.5-VL-7B 的平均 visual math 表现会从 42.3% 掉到 37.7%，说明 perception 作为 scaffold 的说法不是修辞，而是有明显数值支撑。

在训练目标对比上，用 SFT 替代 RL 做 visual perception 学习，会让 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 和 Qwen3-VL-8B 在 WeMath 上分别下降 8.1% 和 1.6%。这个结果支持作者关于 RLVR 更适合感知学习的判断。最终模型方面，staged-trained Qwen3-VL-8B 在 MathVista 上 75.9%，WeMath 上 56.1%，RealWorldQA 上 74.5%；与 OneThinker-8B 相比，在 WeMath 提升 1.5%，在 RealWorldQA 提升 3.0%。此外，capability-based staging 与 difficulty-based ordering 结合后，相比 merged training 还能带来 4.43% 的提升，说明两种 curriculum 维度确实可叠加。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇虽然标成 skim，但如果你关心多模态预训练和 post-train 接口，建议接近精读。先看 Introduction 里的错误分析动机，尤其 86.9% perception error 这个归因是全文立论基础。然后重点看 staged pipeline 和数据构造，弄清 visual perception 数据到底长什么样，和普通 caption SFT 有什么差别。接着看 4.3 和 4.4：一个讲 staged vs merged 以及顺序效应，一个讲 RLVR vs SFT，这两部分最能体现作者的核心判断。最后看 capability-dimension curriculum 的实验，判断这个概念是否能迁移到别的模态或纯文本场景。若时间有限，优先看 Figure 1、Figure 2、主结果表、阶段顺序实验和 RL 替代 SFT 的消融。预计 45-60 分钟能抓住主要贡献。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a common but often misdiagnosed issue in VLM post-training: many failures on visual tasks come from incorrect perception, not insufficient reasoning depth. The authors decompose VLM capability into three parts—visual perception, textual reasoning, and visual reasoning—and ask whether training them separately, in the right order, works better than the current practice of mixing all data and emphasizing long chain-of-thought reasoning.
summary_en.importance: Although this is framed as a VLM post-training study, the implications are broader for foundation-model research. The main message is clear: visual perception is not a solved byproduct of pretraining, and it cannot be reliably repaired by asking the model to reason longer. It needs dedicated data, a suitable training signal, and the right optimization order. That matters for multimodal pretraining and for the pretrain/post-train interface more generally. The paper also offers a useful abstraction—capability-dimension curriculum learning—which may transfer beyond vision to other heterogeneous capabilities such as retrieval, grounding, or tool use.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core method is a staged post-training pipeline. The authors build three disjoint datasets for visual perception, textual reasoning, and visual reasoning, and train them sequentially instead of merging all data into a single mixed stage. The most important stage is visual perception. Its goal is not to produce fluent captions, but to make the model reliably identify fine-grained entities, attributes, and spatial relations and align them correctly with text.

To do this, they start from fine-grained image-caption resources such as DOCCI and convert image-caption pairs into perception-focused QA data rather than directly applying caption SFT. They then compare caption-based SFT with RLVR, reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. Their argument is that caption SFT imposes token-level, off-policy imitation signals that can pull the model toward a narrower or lower-quality supervision distribution than its pretraining corpus, while RL keeps learning on-policy and is better suited for “see correctly, then answer” behaviors where correctness is externally verifiable.

The second stage is textual reasoning, which strengthens pure language reasoning so that visual errors and textual reasoning errors are not entangled. The third stage is visual reasoning, where the model combines the earlier perception and reasoning skills on image-conditioned tasks. The paper also compares staged training against one-stage merged training and studies stage order. The conclusion is that order matters: perception must be solidified before visual reasoning, otherwise later reasoning is built on faulty visual representations.

A useful conceptual contribution is the framing of this setup as capability-dimension curriculum learning. Instead of ordering samples by difficulty, it orders optimization by capability type. The paper further shows that this is complementary to standard difficulty-based curricula.
summary_en.experiments:
The most convincing part is the initial error attribution. Using Claude-Haiku-4.5 to analyze incorrect outputs from Qwen3-VL-8B on three visual math datasets, the authors estimate that 86.9% of the errors are caused by perception failures rather than downstream reasoning. That directly motivates the staged design.

In terms of performance, adding a visual perception stage gives a 7.43-point gain over the Qwen2.5-VL-7B base model on WeMath, and raises Qwen3-VL-8B from 50.9% to 56.1%. In the staged-versus-one-stage comparison, staged Qwen3-VL-8B improves math reasoning accuracy by 1.46 points while producing 20.8% shorter reasoning traces, which suggests the gain comes from better perception rather than longer deliberation. The stage-order ablation is also important: disrupting the order drops average visual math performance of Qwen2.5-VL-7B from 42.3% to 37.7%, supporting the claim that perception is a scaffold rather than just another training component.

For training objective comparison, replacing RL with SFT in the visual perception stage causes WeMath accuracy drops of 8.1% for Qwen2.5-VL-7B and 1.6% for Qwen3-VL-8B. This supports the claim that RLVR is a better signal than caption SFT for perception learning. The final staged Qwen3-VL-8B reaches 75.9% on MathVista, 56.1% on WeMath, and 74.5% on RealWorldQA. Relative to OneThinker-8B, it improves by 1.5% on WeMath and 3.0% on RealWorldQA. The curriculum result is also notable: combining capability-based staging with difficulty-based ordering yields a 4.43% gain over merged training, outperforming either dimension alone.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is labeled skim, but it is worth reading more carefully if you care about multimodal pretraining or the post-train interface. Start with the motivation and the 86.9% perception-error analysis in the introduction, because that is the foundation of the paper’s argument. Then read the staged pipeline and data construction sections to understand what the perception data actually looks like and how it differs from ordinary caption SFT. After that, focus on Sections 4.3 and 4.4: one covers staged versus merged training and stage order, the other compares RLVR with SFT. Those sections contain the strongest evidence for the paper’s central claims. If time is limited, prioritize Figure 1, Figure 2, the main results table, the stage-order ablation, and the RL-versus-SFT comparison. Around 45 to 60 minutes should be enough to extract the main ideas.

recommendation.zh: 对VLM训练策略有实用insight——视觉感知是瓶颈、RL比SFT更适合学感知、分阶段优于混合训练。做VLM预训练的研究员值得看实验设计和§3-4的分析。
recommendation.en: Useful insights for VLM training strategy: perception is the bottleneck, RL outperforms SFT for perception, staged training beats joint training. VLM pretraining researchers should read §3-4 and the experimental design.

paper.title: DeltaPrompts: Escaping the Zero-Delta Trap in Multimodal Distillation
paper.abstract: Distillation enables compact Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to obtain strong reasoning capabilities, yet the prompts driving this process are typically chosen via simple heuristics or aggregated from off-the-shelf datasets. We reveal a critical inefficiency in this approach: up to 69% of the prompts in standard chart / document reasoning datasets are effectively zero-delta, meaning the teacher and student already induce the exact same answer distribution. Training on these prompts provides minima

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的不是蒸馏目标怎么写，而是蒸馏数据里哪些 prompt 真正有学习价值。作者指出，多模态蒸馏里一个被长期忽略的问题是：大量现成 chart/document reasoning 数据对 teacher 和 student 来说几乎没有分歧，因而蒸馏信号接近于零。文中把这种现象称为 zero-delta trap。若 teacher 与 student 在某个输入上诱导出的答案分布相同或近似相同，那么无论做 forward KL、reverse KL，还是 on-policy distillation，这个样本都很难继续推动 student 学到新能力。核心问题因此变成：如何系统地找到并构造那些能暴露 teacher-student capability gap、同时又保持技能覆盖面的 prompt，而不是继续堆更多现成题目。
summary.importance: 对预训练/蒸馏研究的启发主要有两层。第一，它把“数据质量”具体化成了 teacher-student 分歧强度，而不是传统的数据难度、人工标签质量或题型覆盖率。这一点对蒸馏、continual pretrain、teacher-generated SFT 都有直接参考价值。第二，它给出一个很实用的判断：当 student 已经较强时，蒸馏瓶颈往往不在优化器或 loss，而在训练分布里缺少真正有梯度价值的样本。文中在多模态推理上验证了这一点，但这个结论对文本蒸馏也成立，尤其适用于强 student 从更强 teacher 学习时的数据筛选与合成。贡献量级上，它不是提出新蒸馏目标，而是重新定义蒸馏数据构造原则；这类工作通常不会立刻改写范式，但很可能改变后续数据管线的设计。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是用 answer divergence（记作 Δ）近似每个 prompt 的蒸馏价值。作者没有直接估计完整序列分布之间的 divergence，因为序列级 KL 既昂贵又噪声大，尤其在长链式推理和多模态输出里更难稳定。替代做法是只看离散答案分布：给定一个 prompt，让 teacher 和 student 产生答案分布，再衡量两者在答案层面的差异。若 Δ≈0，则该 prompt 被视为 zero-delta；若 Δ>0，则说明这个样本暴露了功能差距，更适合蒸馏。

但作者进一步指出，简单从现有数据中过滤 non-zero-delta 样本并不够，因为过滤后剩余样本的技能多样性会明显下降，容易把训练集收缩成少数高分歧但窄覆盖的题型。为此他们设计了一个分阶段的数据合成管线，而不是只做筛选。第一阶段是 seed-guided synthesis：把现有 chart/document 等数据集当作种子，不直接拿来训练，而是让 teacher 基于这些种子扩展 prompt 池，主动搜索更高 Δ 的变体。第二阶段是 skill-targeted augmentation：针对 student 尚未表现出的具体推理技能继续定向增广，目标不是单纯提高难度，而是提高 capability gap 并补足覆盖面。整个流程里 teacher 既是数据生成器，也是 gap 的参照系。

最终得到的 DeltaPrompts 是一个 200k 规模的合成数据集，强调两个约束：一是非零 answer divergence，二是广泛技能覆盖。训练上既支持 on-policy distillation，也支持把它当作 off-policy SFT 资源。方法与已有工作最大的区别在于：过去很多蒸馏工作把 prompt 看成固定背景，只在 loss、采样或 on/off-policy 机制上做文章；这篇工作把 prompt distribution 本身当成主要优化对象，并给出可操作的 proxy 指标和合成流程。
summary.experiments:
实验里最关键的发现有三点。第一，现有标准 chart/document reasoning 数据集中，最高可有 69% 的 prompt 属于 effectively zero-delta，也就是 teacher 和 student 诱导出相同答案分布。这直接解释了为什么蒸馏收益会很快饱和，而且继续加同类数据规模帮助不大。第二，在只保留 non-zero-delta 样本时，虽然单样本学习价值提高，但数据多样性显著下降，因此“过滤”不是完整解法。第三，DeltaPrompts 在多个设置下都带来稳定收益。

文中报告，基于 200k 合成 prompt，在 chart/document reasoning 与高分辨率、感知导向推理任务上做 on-policy distillation，可带来最高 15% 的相对提升；而且这个提升是在已经较强、且经过较多优化的 Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking 之上取得的，不是弱基线上的轻松增益。作者还展示了跨模型族迁移：用同一批 DeltaPrompts，不重新生成数据，也能迁移到 GLM-4 系列并获得收益，说明数据并未过度绑定某个 student。另一个值得注意的结果是 out-of-domain transfer：在 STEM reasoning 上也有外溢收益，说明这些 prompt 并非只记住 chart/document 模板，而是确实推动了更一般的推理能力。除此之外，DeltaPrompts 作为 off-policy SFT 数据也明显优于常见的现成数据混合。

从消融逻辑看，最值得注意的是作者把“更多数据”“更高 Δ”“更广覆盖”拆开验证：zero-delta 数据即便继续扩容也很快饱和；只追求高 Δ 而忽略覆盖面也不稳；两者结合才形成持续收益。这部分对数据工程很有参考价值。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，但建议把引言和方法部分认真看完，因为作者真正有价值的地方不在 benchmark 分数，而在问题定义。优先看三部分：
1. 引言与“What prompts are fit for distillation?”这一节。这里把蒸馏价值重新表述为 per-prompt capability gap，值得细读。
2. answer divergence 的定义与为何不用 sequence-level divergence。这里能看出作者在工程上做了什么取舍。
3. 数据分析和消融图表，尤其是 zero-delta 比例、过滤后多样性下降、以及 DeltaPrompts 相对现成数据混合的收益。

如果时间有限，先抓住两个问题：为什么 zero-delta 会让蒸馏饱和；为什么简单过滤不够而必须做 synthesis。预计 20–30 分钟可以读到主要信息。若想深挖，可继续看附录里关于 divergence 估计、数据生成细节和质量过滤的实现，因为这些部分决定了方法能否迁移到纯文本蒸馏或其他模态。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a data-centric question in multimodal distillation: which prompts actually carry learning signal? The main claim is that a large fraction of commonly used chart/document reasoning prompts are effectively useless for distillation because the teacher and the student already induce the same answer distribution on them. The authors call this the zero-delta trap. If the teacher-student gap is near zero on a prompt, optimizing KL-style distillation objectives on that prompt contributes little, regardless of whether the training is off-policy or on-policy. The real problem, then, is not how to tweak the distillation loss, but how to construct prompts that reliably expose capability gaps while preserving broad skill coverage.
summary_en.importance: Its value is less about a new objective and more about a sharper definition of data quality for distillation. The paper operationalizes useful training data as prompts with non-trivial teacher-student disagreement, rather than prompts that are merely difficult, diverse, or drawn from standard benchmarks. That framing matters beyond VLM distillation. It is relevant to teacher-generated SFT, continual pretraining with synthetic data, and strong-student / stronger-teacher transfer in general. The practical message is clear: once the student is already competent, the bottleneck often shifts from optimization to prompt distribution. In that sense, this work is a meaningful contribution to data construction methodology, even if it does not introduce a new modeling paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The central tool is answer divergence, denoted as Delta, used as a proxy for the distillation value of a prompt. Instead of estimating sequence-level divergence between teacher and student distributions, which is expensive and noisy for long multimodal reasoning outputs, the paper measures divergence over the induced discrete answer distribution. Prompts with Delta approximately zero are treated as zero-delta prompts; prompts with non-zero Delta are considered informative because they reveal a functional gap between teacher and student.

A key observation is that simple filtering is not enough. If one only keeps non-zero-delta prompts from existing datasets, the remaining pool becomes much narrower in skill coverage. So the authors do not stop at selection. They build a staged synthesis pipeline. First, seed-guided synthesis expands the prompt pool from existing chart/document datasets, using them as seeds rather than as direct training data. The goal is to search for prompt variants with higher answer divergence. Second, skill-targeted augmentation explicitly generates prompts around reasoning skills that the student still fails to exhibit, so the dataset improves both disagreement and coverage.

The resulting dataset, DeltaPrompts, contains 200k synthetic prompts designed to satisfy two constraints: non-zero answer divergence and broad skill diversity. The same dataset can be used for on-policy distillation or as an off-policy SFT resource. The main difference from prior distillation work is conceptual: earlier work mostly treated prompts as fixed and focused on the objective, decoding, or policy mismatch; this paper treats the prompt distribution itself as the primary optimization target.
summary_en.experiments:
The most important empirical findings are straightforward and useful. First, in standard chart/document reasoning datasets, up to 69% of prompts are effectively zero-delta, meaning the teacher and student induce the same answer distribution. This explains why distillation gains saturate quickly even when more data is added. Second, simply filtering to non-zero-delta prompts improves per-sample usefulness but hurts diversity, so filtering alone is not a sufficient solution. Third, the synthesized DeltaPrompts dataset produces consistent gains across settings.

The paper reports a 200k-prompt synthetic corpus and shows up to 15% relative improvement in on-policy distillation on chart/document reasoning and high-resolution perception-centric reasoning tasks. Importantly, these gains are obtained on top of an already strong student, such as Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking, rather than on a weak baseline. The gains also transfer across model families: the same DeltaPrompts data improves GLM-4 models without regenerating the dataset. There is also out-of-domain transfer to STEM reasoning, suggesting that the prompts are not merely overfitting benchmark templates. In addition, DeltaPrompts works well as an off-policy SFT resource and outperforms standard off-the-shelf data mixtures.

The ablation logic is one of the stronger parts of the paper. It separates the effects of more data, higher Delta, and broader coverage. More zero-delta data saturates quickly. High-Delta data without coverage is brittle. The combination of disagreement and diversity is what sustains improvement.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper, but the framing is worth reading carefully. Start with the introduction and the section on what makes prompts fit for distillation. That is where the paper earns its value. Then read the definition of answer divergence and the discussion of why sequence-level divergence is avoided. After that, focus on the dataset analysis and ablations: the zero-delta ratios, the diversity collapse after filtering, and the comparison between DeltaPrompts and standard data mixtures.

If time is limited, keep two questions in mind: why does zero-delta data cause saturation, and why is synthesis necessary beyond filtering? Around 20 to 30 minutes should be enough to extract the main ideas. If you want to adapt the method to text-only distillation or other modalities, the appendix on divergence estimation, generation details, and quality filtering is the part to inspect more closely.

recommendation.zh: 零delta陷阱的观测可直接复用在所有蒸馏任务的数据筛选流程，仅需阅读第3节的散度量化方法
recommendation.en: The zero-delta trap observation can be directly reused for data selection in all distillation tasks, only read §3 for divergence quantification methods

paper.title: Are VLMs Seeing or Just Saying? Uncovering the Illusion of Visual Re-examination
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) often produce self-reflective statements like "let me check the figure again" during reasoning. Do such statements trigger genuine visual re-examination, or are they merely learned textual patterns? We investigate this via VisualSwap, an image-swap probing framework: after a model reasons over an image, we replace it with a visually similar but semantically different one and test whether the model notices. We introduce VS-Bench, 800 image pairs curated from MathVist

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要回答的问题很直接：VLM 在长链推理里说“我再看一眼图”“让我重新检查图像”时，是否真的重新读取了视觉证据，还是只是生成了一个看起来像自我反思的语言模板。作者把这个问题做成了一个可操作的诊断设定：先让模型基于原图完成一段推理，再在保留上下文的情况下把图像替换成一张高层视觉相似、但决定答案的细节不同的新图，然后要求模型继续反思。如果模型真的会在反思时重新 grounding 到当前图像，它应该能发现前后不一致并修正答案；如果不会，它就会沿着旧推理惯性继续说下去。论文关心的不是一般视觉问答准确率，而是 CoT 过程中“自发视觉复查”这一能力是否真实存在。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，但对多模态基座研究有明确价值。第一，它揭示了一个很具体的 failure mode：VLM 的自反思文本不等于视觉再感知，语言上的“检查”可能只是生成习惯。对做 native multimodal pretrain、视觉 token 设计、cross-attention 机制的人来说，这说明当前模型在长推理链中维持视觉 grounding 的能力并不可靠。第二，它把问题从最终答对没答对，推进到“中间推理是否重新访问模态证据”，这类诊断比普通 benchmark 更接近训练目标设计。第三，结果对 test-time scaling 也有提醒：thinking model 并不天然更会看图，反而可能因为更长的文本轨迹而更脱离视觉输入。对后续做多模态 RL、反思式推理、或 tool-augmented re-reading 的工作，这篇论文提供了一个很好的评测切口。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 VisualSwap，两阶段 probing。第一阶段，模型在图像 I_a 和问题 Q 上正常生成推理。第二阶段，保留已有 reasoning context，把输入图像替换成 I_b，并提示模型重新检查或反思。这里的关键设计不是简单换图，而是要求 I_a 和 I_b 在高层外观上相似，但在决定答案的局部细节上不同，且问题 Q 对两张图都成立，只是正确答案不同。这样可以排除“图完全变了所以模型当然能发现”的简单情况，真正测试模型是否会重新读取细粒度视觉信息。

为了支撑这个设定，作者构建了 VS-Bench，包含 800 个样本，来自 MathVista、MathVerse、MathVision、MMMU-Pro 等偏复杂推理的数据源。样本构造强调两点：一是视觉相似性，二是 ground-truth answer 的可分性。这个 benchmark 的价值在于它不是测一般视觉理解，而是测“在已有长文本上下文干扰下，模型能否重新 grounding”。

机制分析部分，作者进一步看 attention。结论不是模型完全不看图，而是自反思语句只带来很弱的 image-token attention 增幅，远低于用户显式要求“重新检查图像”时的水平。也就是说，模型会说出 re-examination 的话，但这种内部生成的 CoT 触发不了足够强的视觉回看。作者还比较了多轮用户指令与自发反思，在相同上下文负载下，外部指令能明显恢复视觉 grounding，这说明问题不只是长上下文记忆衰减，更像是 intrinsic CoT 缺少稳定的跨模态回指机制。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 15 个模型，来自 Qwen3-VL、Kimi-VL、ERNIE-VL 等系列。主结果很醒目：图像替换后，模型普遍无法察觉变化，性能大幅下滑，最大跌幅接近 60 个点。文中给出的代表性数字包括：ERNIE-4.5-VL-Thinking 从 79.9% 降到 19.6%；Qwen3-VL-32B-Thinking 的跌幅为 48.3%，而对应 Instruct 版本只有 17.9%；更大模型也没有缓解，Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B 的跌幅 54.6%，反而高于 Qwen3-VL-8B 的 39.4%。这几组数字共同说明三个结论：一，问题不是个别模型偶发失误，而是系统性现象；二，thinking model 比 instruct model 更脆弱；三，参数规模扩大并不能自动修复。

机制实验里，attention 分析显示自反思阶段对视觉 token 的关注只略有上升，但远不足以支持有效的视觉重审；而多轮用户显式指令在同样上下文下能显著提高视觉注意力并恢复表现。作者还观察到，随着 reasoning context 变长，模型更容易停留在先前文本轨迹中，形成 reasoning inertia。这个现象很重要，因为它把失败原因从“视觉编码不够强”进一步定位到“长 CoT 过程中语言轨迹压制了视觉再接入”。如果正文里还有按任务类型、图像差异粒度、swap 时机的分组结果，这些会帮助判断问题究竟更偏向注意力分配、上下文锁定，还是训练数据里缺少真正的视觉复查行为。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读到中等深度。先看 Introduction 和 VisualSwap 设定，理解作者为什么要用‘先推理再换图’而不是直接做对抗样本。然后看 VS-Bench 的构造标准，重点确认 image pair 是否真的控制了高层相似、细节差异和答案变化三件事。实验部分优先看主表，尤其是 thinking vs instruct、不同模型规模、以及 direct inference on swapped image 与 reflective re-examination 的对比。机制部分值得看 attention 可视化或统计图，因为论文最有信息量的地方不只是“掉分了”，而是“为什么掉分”。如果时间有限，25-35 分钟足够抓住结论。若要深挖，建议重点思考两点：这种 failure 是训练目标没有鼓励中途重新看图，还是架构上文本状态对视觉状态的回写通路太弱；以及多轮用户指令能恢复 grounding，是否意味着未来应把 re-attend 做成显式动作或工具调用，而不是指望模型在 CoT 里自发完成。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a precise question: when a VLM says things like “let me check the figure again” during chain-of-thought reasoning, does it actually re-examine the image, or is that phrase just a learned textual pattern? The authors turn this into a controlled diagnostic setup. A model first reasons over an image-question pair. Then, while preserving the generated reasoning context, the image is swapped with a visually similar but semantically different one, and the model is prompted to reflect or re-check. If the model truly re-grounds on the current visual input, it should notice the inconsistency and revise its answer. If not, it will continue along the inertia of the earlier textual reasoning. The target is therefore not generic VQA accuracy, but the authenticity of visual re-examination inside multimodal reasoning.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is highly relevant to multimodal foundation-model work. First, it exposes a concrete failure mode: self-reflective language in VLMs does not imply renewed visual grounding. For researchers working on native multimodal pretraining, visual tokenization, or cross-modal attention design, this suggests that current systems do not reliably maintain visual grounding over long reasoning traces. Second, the paper shifts evaluation from final-answer correctness to whether the model actually revisits modality evidence during reasoning, which is closer to the training objective design problem. Third, it carries an important message for test-time scaling: thinking-style VLMs are not necessarily better at looking again; longer reasoning can make them more detached from the image. That makes the work useful for future multimodal RL, reflection-based reasoning, and explicit re-attention mechanisms.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core method is VisualSwap, a two-stage probing framework. In stage one, the model performs standard reasoning on an image I_a and question Q. In stage two, the prior reasoning context is kept, but the image is replaced with I_b, and the model is asked to reflect or re-check. The key design choice is that I_a and I_b are visually similar at a coarse level, yet differ in the fine-grained details that determine the answer, and the same question remains valid for both images while the correct answer changes. This avoids trivial swap detection and specifically tests whether the model re-reads fine visual evidence under a strong textual prior.

To support this setup, the authors build VS-Bench, a benchmark of 800 image pairs derived from MathVista, MathVerse, MathVision, and MMMU-Pro. The benchmark is designed around two constraints: high visual similarity and answer separability. Its value lies in probing re-grounding under long-context interference, rather than generic visual understanding.

The paper also includes a mechanism analysis based on attention. The result is not that models completely ignore images, but that self-reflective phrases trigger only a small increase in attention to image tokens, far weaker than explicit user instructions asking the model to inspect the image again. In other words, the model can say it is re-examining without allocating enough visual attention to actually do so. The authors further compare self-initiated reflection with multi-turn user prompting and show that external instructions can restore visual grounding under the same context load. This suggests the issue is not only long-context degradation, but also a limitation of intrinsic CoT as a trigger for cross-modal re-attention.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments cover 15 models from the Qwen3-VL, Kimi-VL, and ERNIE-VL families. The main result is strong and consistent: after the image swap, models usually fail to detect the change and suffer large performance drops, in some cases close to 60 points. Representative numbers reported in the paper include ERNIE-4.5-VL-Thinking dropping from 79.9% to 19.6%; Qwen3-VL-32B-Thinking dropping by 48.3%, while the corresponding Instruct model drops by only 17.9%; and larger models not helping, with Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B showing a 54.6% drop versus 39.4% for Qwen3-VL-8B. These numbers support three conclusions: the failure is systematic rather than anecdotal, thinking models are substantially more vulnerable than instruct models, and scaling model size does not fix the issue.

The mechanism experiments show that self-reflection leads to only a marginal increase in image-token attention, insufficient for effective visual re-examination. By contrast, explicit multi-turn user instructions significantly raise visual attention and recover performance under the same context conditions. The paper also finds that longer reasoning contexts strengthen reasoning inertia: the model becomes more committed to its earlier textual trajectory and less responsive to current visual evidence. This is an important diagnosis, because it points beyond weak visual encoding and toward a failure of re-entry from language state back into visual grounding during long CoT generation. If the full paper includes breakdowns by task type, swap difficulty, or swap timing, those would be especially useful for localizing the failure more precisely.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper, but it is worth reading beyond the abstract. Start with the problem setup and the VisualSwap protocol to understand why the authors use a reason-then-swap design instead of standard adversarial evaluation. Then inspect the VS-Bench construction criteria, especially whether the image pairs truly control for coarse similarity, fine-detail differences, and answer changes. In the experiments, prioritize the main tables comparing thinking vs instruct models, model scaling, and reflective re-examination versus direct inference on the swapped image. The mechanism section is the most informative part after the headline results, because the paper is strongest when it explains why the failure happens rather than merely showing a score drop. A 25-35 minute read should be enough for the main ideas. For deeper reading, focus on whether the issue is primarily due to training objectives that never reward mid-reasoning visual revisits, or due to architectural limitations in how textual state re-engages visual state.

recommendation.zh: 只看 VisualSwap setup 和 attention 分析即可；它提醒多模态 CoT 里的“再看图”大多不是一次新的视觉读入。
recommendation.en: Read the VisualSwap setup and attention analysis; it is a clean warning that multimodal CoT “looking again” often does not re-read the image.

paper.title: Deep Pre-Alignment for VLMs
paper.abstract: Most Vision Language Models (VLMs) directly map outputs from ViT encoders to the LLM via a lightweight projector. While effective, recent analysis suggests this architecture suffers from an alignment challenge: visual features remain distant from the text space in the initial layers of the LLM, forcing the model to waste critical depth~\cite{zhang-etal-2024-investigating,artzy-schwartz-2024-attend} on superficial modality alignment rather than deep understanding and complex reasoning. In this wo

summary.core_problem: 现有VLM架构通过轻量投影层连接ViT编码器与LLM，视觉特征与LLM文本空间存在较大模态差距，导致LLM前几层消耗大量容量完成浅层模态对齐，占用了原本用于深度理解和复杂推理的参数资源，还容易引发语言能力的灾难性遗忘。
summary.importance: 为VLM预训练的模态对齐环节提供了模块化优化思路，不需要改动现有LLM的训练目标和推理策略即可快速落地，同时验证了模态对齐前置对大尺度VLM性能提升的可扩展性，也为缓解多模态预训练中的灾难性遗忘提供了新路径。
summary.technical_approach: 提出深度预对齐（DPA）架构，将原有ViT编码器替换为小型感知VLM模块，该模块包含ViT、投影层和小型语言模型块，通过内部语言层逐步完成视觉特征到文本空间的预对齐，再经过简单投影层输入目标LLM。训练沿用标准VLM两阶段流程：第一阶段仅更新投影层，用图文对数据适配维度；第二阶段用高质量视觉指令数据端到端微调。
summary.experiments: 在8个多模态基准、3个文本基准上验证，相比LLaVA基线，4B尺度平均多模态性能提升1.9个点，32B尺度提升3.0个点，性能增益随模型规模增大而提升；适配通义千问3、LLaMA 3.2两类LLM架构均有效；文本性能下降幅度分别降低32.9%（4B）和21.6%（32B）；32B模型仅带来2%的吞吐量损失，额外开销可忽略。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看引言部分关于VLM内部层模态对齐开销的分析，以及实验部分的灾难性遗忘缓解效果和扩展性测试，预计阅读时间15分钟，不需要深究小型感知VLM的训练细节，核心关注架构设计和消融结果。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing VLM architectures connect ViT encoders to LLMs via lightweight projectors, leading to significant modality gaps between visual features and the LLM's text embedding space. This forces lower layers of the target LLM to allocate large capacity to shallow modality alignment instead of deep understanding and complex reasoning, and also triggers catastrophic forgetting of pre-trained language capabilities.
summary_en.importance: Provides a modular optimization approach for modality alignment in VLM pre-training, which can be implemented rapidly without modifying existing LLM training objectives or inference pipelines. It also validates the scalability of upstream alignment for performance gains in large-scale VLMs, and offers a new path to mitigate catastrophic forgetting in multimodal pre-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the Deep Pre-Alignment (DPA) architecture, which replaces the standard ViT encoder with a small perceiver VLM module. The perceiver includes a ViT, a projector, and small LLM blocks, which progressively pre-align visual features to the target text space via its internal language layers, before feeding to the target LLM through a simple alignment projector. Training follows the standard two-stage VLM recipe: stage 1 only updates the alignment projector on image-caption data to fit dimension requirements; stage 2 performs end-to-end fine-tuning on high-quality visual instruction data.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on 8 multimodal benchmarks and 3 text benchmarks. Compared to the LLaVA baseline, average multimodal performance gains reach 1.9 points at 4B scale and 3.0 points at 32B scale, with gains scaling up with model size. Improvements are consistent across both Qwen3 and LLaMA 3.2 LLM backbones. Text performance degradation is reduced by 32.9% for 4B models and 21.6% for 32B models. The architecture only introduces 2% throughput loss for 32B models, with negligible additional overhead.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the introduction section's analysis of modality alignment overhead in VLM internal layers, and the experiment section's results on catastrophic forgetting mitigation and scalability testing. Expected reading time is 15 minutes. No need to dig into training details of the small perceiver VLM, focus on architectural design and ablation findings.

recommendation.zh: 只看表示距离分析和 4B/32B 消融；若 baseline 公平，它会影响多模态预训练里 encoder-projector 的默认设计。
recommendation.en: Read the representation-distance analysis and 4B/32B ablations; if the baselines are fair, this changes the default encoder-projector design for VLM pretraining.

paper.title: CoRDS: Coreset-based Representative and Diverse Selection for Streaming Video Understanding
paper.abstract: Streaming video understanding with large vision-language models (VLMs) requires a compact memory that can support future reasoning over an ever-growing visual history. A common solution is to compress the key-value (KV) cache, but existing streaming methods typically rely on local token-wise heuristics, such as recency, temporal redundancy, or saliency, which do not explicitly optimize whether the retained cache is representative of the accumulated history. We propose to view KV-cache compressio

summary.core_problem: 流式视频理解中VLM的KV缓存压缩依赖局部token级启发式方法（如新近性、时间冗余），未显式优化保留内容是否代表累积视觉历史。
summary.importance: 方法创新：将KV缓存压缩视为coreset选择问题，在联合KV表示空间中做几何覆盖优化。
summary.technical_approach: CoRDS方法：(1)双准则目标平衡key和value空间的覆盖度，同时保留检索结构和输出相关信息；(2)正交性驱动的多样性准则促进保留子集的多样性。
summary.experiments: 在流式视频理解任务上验证，据称优于局部启发式方法。
summary.authors_note: UBC、Vector Institute，Leonid Sigal是资深CV/VLM领域知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: KV-cache compression for streaming video understanding with VLMs relies on local token-wise heuristics (recency, temporal redundancy, saliency) that do not explicitly optimize whether retained content represents accumulated visual history.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: reframes KV-cache compression as a coreset selection problem, optimizing geometric coverage in joint KV representation space.
summary_en.technical_approach: CoRDS method: (1) bicriteria objective balancing coverage in key and value spaces, preserving both retrieval structure and output-relevant information; (2) orthogonality-driven diversity criterion for diverse retained subsets.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on streaming video understanding tasks, outperforming local heuristic methods.
summary_en.authors_note: UBC, Vector Institute; Leonid Sigal is a well-known researcher in CV/VLM.

recommendation.zh: 将coreset方法应用于KV缓存压缩是新颖视角，但属于视频VLM推理优化，对LLM基座预训练研究员参考价值有限，仅作方法灵感参考。
recommendation.en: Coreset-based KV compression is a novel perspective but limited to video VLM inference optimization; minimal relevance for LLM foundation pretraining; reference for method inspiration only.

paper.title: Pelican-Unified 1.0: A Unified Embodied Intelligence Model for Understanding, Reasoning, Imagination and Action
paper.abstract: We present Pelican-Unified 1.0, the first embodied foundation model trained according to the principle of unification. Pelican-Unified 1.0 uses a single VLM as a unified understanding module, mapping scenes, instructions, visual contexts, and action histories into a shared semantic space. The same VLM also serves as a unified reasoning module, autoregressively producing task-, action-, and future-oriented chains of thought in a single forward pass and projecting the final hidden state into a den

summary.core_problem: 现有具身智能模型多采用独立模块拼接的流水线架构，感知、推理、世界建模、动作策略四部分相互割裂，存在语义断层、泛化性差、长时序任务误差累积等问题。
summary.importance: 提出具身智能的统一建模范式，为多模态预训练向具身场景扩展提供架构设计参考，验证了共享表示联合优化的可行性，不需要在各专项能力上做性能妥协。
summary.technical_approach: 采用单VLM作为共享的理解与推理模块，将场景、指令、视觉上下文、动作历史映射到统一语义空间，自回归生成面向任务、动作、未来的思维链并输出隐变量；后续接统一未来生成器（UFG），基于该隐变量在同一扩散去噪过程中用两个模态头同时生成未来视频和底层动作；训练时语言、视频、动作损失同时回传到共享表示层，实现四类能力联合优化。
summary.experiments: 单checkpoint在三类任务上表现突出：8个VLM基准得分64.7，同等参规模型中最优；WorldArena基准得分66.03，排名第一；RoboTwin动作基准得分93.5，对比方法中平均排名第二。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第2节统一范式的定义、第3节模型架构设计、第4节核心实验结果，跳过相关工作和冗余实验细节部分，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Most existing embodied intelligence models adopt a pipeline architecture stitched with independent modules, leading to fragmentation across perception, reasoning, world modeling and action policy, which causes semantic gaps, poor generalization, and error accumulation in long-horizon tasks.
summary_en.importance: It proposes a unified modeling paradigm for embodied intelligence, provides architecture design references for extending multimodal pretraining to embodied scenarios, and verifies that joint optimization of shared representations requires no performance tradeoff across individual specialized capabilities.
summary_en.technical_approach: A single VLM serves as the shared understanding and reasoning module, which maps scenes, instructions, visual contexts and action histories into a unified semantic space, autoregressively generates task-, action- and future-oriented chains of thought, and outputs the corresponding latent variable. A Unified Future Generator (UFG) conditions on this latent variable, and generates both future videos and low-level actions via two modality-specific heads within the same diffusion denoising process. During training, language, video and action losses are all backpropagated to the shared representation layer to enable joint optimization of four capabilities.
summary_en.experiments: A single checkpoint achieves strong performance across three task categories: 64.7 on 8 VLM benchmarks, best among models with comparable parameter scale; 66.03 on WorldArena, ranking first; 93.5 on RoboTwin action benchmark, second average rank among compared methods.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 for the definition of unified paradigm, Section 3 for model architecture design, Section 4 for core experiment results. Skip related work and redundant experiment details. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 具身智能统一建模的尝试——用单一VLM+扩散生成器连接推理、视频预测和动作生成。共享表示学习的思路对多模态预训练有一定参考。只看方法架构部分即可。
recommendation.en: An attempt at unified embodied intelligence — a single VLM + diffusion generator connecting reasoning, video prediction, and action generation. The shared representation approach has some reference value for multimodal pretraining. Just read the architecture section.

institutions: Beijing Innovation Center of Humanoid Robotics (X-Humanoid)

paper.title: ICED: Concept-level Machine Unlearning via Interpretable Concept Decomposition
paper.abstract: Machine unlearning in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) is typically performed at the image or instance level, making it difficult to precisely remove target knowledge without affecting unrelated semantics. This issue is especially pronounced since a single image often contains multiple entangled concepts, including both target concepts to be forgotten and contextual information that should be preserved. In this paper, we propose an interpretable concept-level unlearning framework for VLMs, which co

summary.core_problem: VLP中机器遗忘通常在图像或实例级别执行，难以精确移除目标知识而不影响无关语义——单张图像常包含多个纠缠概念。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出可解释的概念级遗忘框架，通过MLLM构建紧凑的任务特定概念词汇，实现细粒度知识操控。
summary.technical_approach: ICED框架：(1)用MLLM从遗忘集中构建任务特定概念词汇；(2)将视觉表示分解为语义概念的稀疏非负组合；(3)在概念级别优化遗忘，选择性抑制目标概念同时保留非目标语义。
summary.experiments: 在VLM遗忘任务上验证，据称在保留非目标语义的同时有效移除目标概念。
summary.authors_note: 福建师范大学、NTU、UNSW、Data61 CSIRO，无特别知名作者。

summary_en.core_problem: Machine unlearning in VLMs typically operates at image or instance level, struggling to precisely remove target knowledge without affecting unrelated semantics — single images often contain multiple entangled concepts.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: interpretable concept-level unlearning framework using MLLM to construct compact task-specific concept vocabulary, enabling fine-grained knowledge manipulation.
summary_en.technical_approach: ICED framework: (1) MLLM-constructed task-specific concept vocabulary from forgetting set; (2) visual representation decomposed into sparse non-negative combinations of semantic concepts; (3) concept-level optimization for selective suppression of target concepts while preserving non-target semantics.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on VLM unlearning tasks, effectively removing target concepts while preserving non-target semantics.
summary_en.authors_note: Fujian Normal University, NTU, UNSW, Data61 CSIRO; no well-known authors.

recommendation.zh: 概念级遗忘是有趣方向，但属于VLM安全领域的小众研究，对LLM基座预训练研究员参考价值有限，仅作领域追踪即可。
recommendation.en: Concept-level unlearning is an interesting direction but a niche area in VLM safety; limited reference value for LLM foundation pretraining researchers; track only.

paper.title: Bad Seeing or Bad Thinking? Rewarding Perception for Vision-Language Reasoning
paper.abstract: Achieving robust perception-reasoning synergy is a central goal for advanced Vision-Language Models (VLMs). Recent advancements have pursued this goal via architectural designs or agentic workflows. However, these approaches are often limited by static textual reasoning or complicated by the significant compute and engineering burden of external agentic complexity. Worse, this heavy investment does not yield proportional gains, often witnessing a "seesaw effect" on perception and reasoning. This

summary.core_problem: 视觉语言模型（VLM）训练中，感知错误（bad seeing）和推理错误（bad thinking）在最终输出中纠缠在一起，无法进行模态级别的信用分配。现有主动感知方法依赖复杂的多轮函数调用或Agent框架，计算和工程开销大，且容易出现感知提升但推理能力下降的"跷跷板效应"。
summary.importance: 提出了将VLM的感知过程从隐状态中外显化的思路，通过结构化分离感知和推理步骤，使得可以独立对视觉感知质量进行监督。这一方向对于VLM训练范式有启发意义——从整体结果监督转向模块化、组件级别的信用分配。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方案包含三个部分：(1) 强制VLM在生成过程中用<recognition>和<think>标签显式分离感知块和推理块，将感知从隐空间外显到文本序列中；(2) 代理感知验证（Perception Verification via Proxy）：将VLM输出的视觉描述喂给纯文本推理模型（如Qwen2.5-72B），在不给定原图的情况下看纯文本模型能否答对题目，以此判断视觉感知是否提取了足够的推理信息；(3) 结构化言语验证（SVV）：用结构化的自然语言验证协议替代传统LLM裁判的整体主观判断，让裁判按步骤执行验证协议，降低奖励信号的方差。三者统一为模态感知信用分配机制（MoCA），分别惩罚感知错误和推理错误。
summary.experiments: 论文声称在多模态推理benchmark上超过了当前最优的视觉语言推理模型，但方法部分未完成，具体实验数字、参数量、数据规模和消融实验结果未在提供的全文内容中给出。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第3章方法部分的三个核心组件设计（感知外显化、代理验证、结构化验证），以及与现有主动感知Agent框架的对比讨论。如果实验部分完整，关注跨benchmark的性能对比和消融实验中各组件的贡献度。预计阅读时间15-20分钟。
summary.authors_note: 机构和作者信息未在提供的内容中标注，无法确认。

summary_en.core_problem: In vision-language model (VLM) training, perception errors (bad seeing) and reasoning errors (bad thinking) are entangled in the final output, making modality-level credit assignment impossible. Existing active perception methods rely on complex multi-turn function calling or agent frameworks with high compute/engineering overhead, and often suffer from a 'seesaw effect' where perception improvements come at the cost of reasoning capabilities.
summary_en.importance: Presents the idea of externalizing a VLM's perception process from latent states, enabling independent supervision of visual perception quality through structurally separating perception and reasoning steps. This direction is informative for VLM training paradigms — shifting from holistic outcome supervision to modular, component-level credit assignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core solution has three parts: (1) Force the VLM to explicitly separate perception blocks and reasoning blocks using <recognition> and <think> tags during generation, externalizing perception from latent space into text sequences; (2) Perception Verification via Proxy: feed the VLM's visual descriptions to a text-only reasoner (e.g., Qwen2.5-72B) and check if it can answer correctly without the original image, to judge whether visual perception extracted sufficient information for reasoning; (3) Structured Verbal Verification (SVV): replace the holistic subjective judgment of traditional LLM judges with a structured natural language verification protocol, instructing the judge to execute the protocol step-by-step, reducing reward signal variance. These are unified into the Modality-aware Credit Assignment (MoCA) mechanism, punishing perception and reasoning errors separately.
summary_en.experiments: The paper claims to outperform state-of-the-art vision-language reasoners across multimodal reasoning benchmarks, but the methods section is incomplete — specific numerical results, parameter sizes, data scales, and ablation study results are not provided in the available full content.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 (methodology) for the three core component designs (perception externalization, proxy verification, structured verification) and the comparison discussion with existing active perception agent frameworks. If the experiments section is complete, pay attention to cross-benchmark performance comparisons and ablation studies on component contribution. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutional and author information is not labeled in the provided content and cannot be confirmed.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫方法和实验拆分：多模态 RL 的关键常在 reward 可归因性，不在 agent 外壳。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and ablations: the useful signal is reward attribution for VLM RL, not the agentic framing.

paper.title: Bridging the Missing-Modality Gap: Improving Text-Only Calibration of Vision Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are often deployed on text-only inputs, although they are trained with images. We find that removing the vision modality causes large drops in accuracy and severe miscalibration, and the model does not behave like its original language backbone under text-only prompting. This failure is not explained only by missing semantic information. Even when text descriptions preserve key content, confidence becomes unreliable, while adding a visual signal through generated im

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 VLM 在没有图像输入、只处理文本请求时的可靠性问题。核心发现是：多模态适配后的模型并不会自然退回到原来的语言模型行为；缺失视觉模态会造成准确率下降和更严重的置信度失准，而且这种问题不能只靠把图像内容写成文字描述来解决。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练和 native multimodal 训练有一个直接提醒：统一 VLM 不是简单的“LLM 加视觉接口”。多模态训练会改变模型在纯文本分布上的内部状态和校准特性。对于把统一多模态模型作为通用入口的系统，这意味着 text-only 能力需要单独评估，尤其要看 calibration，而不只是看准确率。它的启发点主要在训练分布匹配和缺失模态鲁棒性，不是一个新的大规模预训练范式。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先构造几组对照来定位问题。第一组是在 VQA 上比较原始 Image+Question 和把图像替换为高质量 caption 的 Description+Question。第二组比较 VLM 的 text-only 行为和其语言骨干模型，说明多模态适配后模型并不等价于 backbone LLM。第三组用文本生成图像再喂给 VLM，观察视觉信号是否能恢复性能和校准。基于这些现象，作者提出 Latent Imagination Module，简称 LIM。LIM 不是生成像素级图像，而是从文本中预测一组“想象”的视觉 latent embedding，再通过轻量 cross-attention 注入冻结的 VLM backbone。这样做的目标是让纯文本输入触发更接近多模态训练时的内部表示，减少缺失模态带来的分布偏移。和 caption augmentation 相比，它补的是表示空间中的视觉条件，而不是增加更多自然语言 token；和 text-to-image augmentation 相比，它避免了昂贵且不稳定的像素生成。
summary.experiments: 论文在 VQA-v1 上做了主要现象验证，模型以 LLaVA-1.5-7B / Vicuna-1.5-7B 为代表。Image+Question 条件下，LLaVA 准确率为 88.29%，ECE 为 0.0884；把图像替换为文本描述后，准确率降到 72.30%，ECE 升到 0.2540。这个结果说明 caption 仍保留不少语义信息，但置信度明显过高，校准损坏比准确率下降更突出。作者还报告，提供由描述生成的图像可以部分恢复准确率和校准，支持“视觉信号本身参与了模型状态形成”的解释。LIM 的实验重点是 text-only benchmark 和 modality-mismatched setting 下的校准改善，但给出的正文片段没有完整表格数字，不能确认具体提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看 Empirical Findings 中三组对照实验，尤其是 Figure 1 的 accuracy/ECE 分解，因为这部分比方法本身更有信息量。方法部分重点看 LIM 如何接入冻结 VLM、imagined latent 的训练目标是什么、cross-attention 的位置和参数规模。若关注多模态预训练，应继续检查附录中的 caption 生成协议、text-to-image 再生成设置，以及 calibration 指标计算方式，避免把 caption 质量或提示格式误判为缺失模态效应。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a practical failure mode of VLMs under text-only deployment. A multimodally adapted model does not simply fall back to the behavior of its original language backbone. Removing the visual modality hurts accuracy and, more importantly, makes confidence estimates poorly calibrated. Replacing the image with a textual description does not fully fix the issue.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to pretraining is the distributional lesson for native multimodal models. A unified VLM should not be assumed to preserve the text-only behavior of its LLM backbone after multimodal adaptation. Missing-modality robustness and calibration need to be evaluated explicitly. The contribution is more diagnostic and systems-facing than a new pretraining recipe, but it points to a real interface problem in unified multimodal backbones.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper first isolates the failure through controlled comparisons. It compares standard VQA inference with Image+Question against a caption-substituted Description+Question setting, then compares text-only VLM behavior with the original LLM backbone, and finally tests whether generated visual inputs can recover part of the lost performance. The proposed Latent Imagination Module avoids pixel-level image generation. It predicts visual latent embeddings from text through a lightweight cross-attention module and feeds these embeddings into a frozen VLM backbone. The design choice is important: linguistic augmentation adds more text tokens, while LIM tries to restore the missing visual conditioning signal in representation space. Compared with text-to-image augmentation, it is cheaper and avoids relying on the quality of synthesized pixels.
summary_en.experiments: The main diagnostic experiments use VQA-v1 with LLaVA-1.5-7B and Vicuna-1.5-7B. In the Image+Question setting, LLaVA reaches 88.29% accuracy with an ECE of 0.0884. In the Description+Question setting, accuracy drops to 72.30%, while ECE increases to 0.2540. The caption still carries substantial semantic information, but the model becomes much more overconfident. The paper also reports that feeding generated images from the same descriptions partially restores both accuracy and calibration, supporting the hypothesis that a visual signal changes the internal inference state. The provided text does not include complete LIM result tables, so exact gains for the proposed module cannot be verified here.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. The most useful part is the empirical diagnosis, especially the accuracy and ECE comparison in Figure 1. Then check how LIM is inserted into the frozen VLM, what supervision is used for imagined latents, and where the cross-attention module sits. For multimodal pretraining readers, the appendix details on caption generation, text-to-image regeneration, and calibration computation are worth checking before accepting the missing-modality interpretation.

recommendation.zh: 值得看缺失模态实验：它提醒 VLM 的文本通道不是原 LM，训练时该显式测模态缺省。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming for the missing-modality experiments: a VLM’s text path is not just the original LM, so modality absence should be tested explicitly.

institutions: Kim Jaechul Graduate School of AI, KAIST

paper.title: Utility-Oriented Visual Evidence Selection for Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation
paper.abstract: Visual evidence selection is a critical component of multimodal retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), yet existing methods typically rely on semantic relevance or surface-level similarity, which are often misaligned with the actual utility of visual evidence for downstream reasoning. We reformulate multimodal evidence selection from an information-theoretic perspective by defining evidence utility as the information gain induced on a model's output distribution. To overcome the intractability of

summary.core_problem: 解决多模态 RAG 中视觉证据选择的问题：语义相关的图片不一定能真正提升模型回答，需要按下游推理效用筛选证据。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态 RAG 方法与理论分析。它把 evidence selection 从相似度排序改写为信息增益估计，强调 evidence 对输出分布的实际影响；对 VLM 评测和推理时检索有参考价值，但离预训练目标设计较远。
summary.technical_approach: 论文定义 evidence utility 为视觉证据对模型输出分布带来的 information gain。由于直接在答案空间优化不可行，作者引入 latent evidence helpfulness，并证明在温和假设下，按该 latent variable 的信息增益排序等价于按答案空间效用排序。实现上提出 training-free、surrogate-accelerated 框架，用轻量多模态模型近似估计证据效用。
summary.experiments: 在 MRAG-Bench 和 Visual-RAG 上跨多个模型家族评测，报告相较语义相关性或表层相似度方法有一致提升。摘要未给出具体 VLM 规模、候选证据数量、推理成本或提升幅度，需要看正文表格确认收益是否覆盖 surrogate 估计开销。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Arizona State University 和 Texas A&M University；未从给定信息中确认知名作者或团队代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles visual evidence selection in multimodal RAG, where semantically relevant images may not be the ones that improve downstream reasoning.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal RAG method with an information-theoretic framing. It shifts evidence ranking from similarity to estimated utility on the model's output distribution. It is useful for VLM evaluation and inference-time retrieval, but only indirectly related to pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors define evidence utility as the information gain induced by visual evidence on a model's output distribution. Because direct answer-space optimization is intractable, they introduce a latent variable for evidence helpfulness and prove that ranking by information gain on this latent variable is equivalent to answer-space utility under mild assumptions. The implementation is training-free and uses lightweight multimodal surrogates to estimate utility efficiently.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments on MRAG-Bench and Visual-RAG across multiple model families show consistent improvements over semantic relevance and surface-similarity selectors. The abstract does not report model sizes, candidate pool size, latency, or exact gains, so the cost-benefit tradeoff requires checking the main tables.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Arizona State University and Texas A&M University; no widely known author or representative prior work can be verified from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 读 latent helpfulness 的证明和代价表即可；它提醒检索信号要测 utility，不要只测相似度。
recommendation.en: Read the latent-helpfulness proof and cost table; the useful lesson is to measure retrieval utility rather than similarity alone.

paper.title: What Happens Before Decoding? Prefill Determines GUI Grounding in VLMs
paper.abstract: Existing training-free approaches for GUI grounding often rely on multiple inference runs, such as iterative cropping or candidate aggregation, to identify target elements. Despite this additional computation, each forward pass still independently interprets the instruction and parses the visual layout, without enabling progressive interaction among visual tokens. In this paper, we study what happens during GUI grounding in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and identify a previously overlooked bottl

summary.core_problem: GUI grounding 中，VLM 的定位误差到底主要发生在“prefill理解/候选选择”还是“decoding输出坐标”阶段，以及如何在不训练的情况下修正。
summary.importance: 贡献是推理阶段机制分析：把GUI grounding拆成prefill候选选择与decoding坐标细化两阶段，并指出prefill是瓶颈；对做VLM训练/对齐的人是有用的诊断视角，但方法本身是inference trick。
summary.technical_approach: 提出两阶段解释：prefill阶段决定候选UI元素集合，decoding阶段只做坐标细化；据此给出Re-Prefill：用注意力引导再做一次prefill以改进候选选择，属于training-free多次前向的推理改造。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体VLM、GUI基准、提升幅度与额外计算开销；核心应在消融：一次prefill vs 二次prefill、以及prefill错误是否不可逆。
summary.authors_note: Guangming Laboratory、NUS、Peking University、University of Waterloo、CUHK-Shenzhen。

summary_en.core_problem: In GUI grounding, whether errors mainly come from the prefill (understanding/candidate selection) stage or the decoding (coordinate emission) stage, and how to fix it without training.
summary_en.importance: A mechanism/diagnostic contribution for VLM inference: grounding behaves as a two-stage process where prefill dominates; useful for training/alignment folks as a failure-mode lens, though the proposed fix is an inference trick.
summary_en.technical_approach: Argues prefill selects candidate UI elements and decoding only refines coordinates; proposes Re-Prefill, an attention-guided second prefill pass to refine target selection in a training-free manner.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract omits the exact VLMs, GUI benchmarks, gains, and compute overhead; the key value should be in ablations showing irreversibility of prefill mistakes.
summary_en.authors_note: Guangming Laboratory; NUS; Peking University; University of Waterloo; CUHK-Shenzhen.

recommendation.zh: 把GUI grounding失败归因到prefill而非decoding是个好诊断框架；只需看机制证据与消融，方法像多跑一次前向的补丁。
recommendation.en: The prefill-vs-decode diagnosis is the real value; read the evidence/ablations, while Re-Prefill itself is basically an extra forward-pass patch.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong (Shenzhen)

paper.title: Birds of a Feather Flock Together: Background-Invariant Representations via Linear Structure in VLMs
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs), such as CLIP and SigLIP 2, are widely used for image classification, yet their vision encoders remain vulnerable to systematic biases that undermine robustness. In particular, correlations between foreground objects and their backgrounds constitute a salient and practically important class of spurious dependencies. In this work, we revisit the well-known property of high linear additivity in VLM embedding spaces and show that it enables a decomposition of scene rep

summary.core_problem: CLIP等VLM的视觉编码器易受前景与背景的虚假关联影响，鲁棒性不足。
summary.importance: 方法创新，利用VLM嵌入空间的线性可加性实现前后景分解，提出无需少数类样本的背景不变表示预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 基于VLM嵌入空间的线性结构，将场景表示分解为前景和背景组件，用合成数据构造预训练目标，学习背景不变的前景表示。
summary.experiments: 在Waterbirds数据集100%虚假关联设置下（无少数类训练样本），最差组准确率首次超过90%，同时具备较强的模拟到真实迁移能力。
summary.authors_note: 独立研究者工作。

summary_en.core_problem: Vision encoders of VLMs like CLIP are vulnerable to spurious correlations between foreground objects and backgrounds, leading to insufficient robustness.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation; leverages the linear additivity of VLM embedding spaces to achieve foreground-background decomposition, and proposes a background-invariant representation pretraining method that requires no minority-class samples.
summary_en.technical_approach: Based on the linear structure of VLM embedding spaces, decomposes scene representations into foreground and background components, and uses synthetic data to construct pretraining objectives for learning background-invariant foreground representations.
summary_en.experiments: Achieves the first worst-group accuracy exceeding 90% on the Waterbirds dataset under 100% spurious correlation setting (no minority-class training samples), with strong sim-to-real transfer performance.
summary_en.authors_note: Work by independent researchers.

recommendation.zh: VLM鲁棒性改进的小增量工作，核心结论可作为文献备查，无需通读正文。
recommendation.en: A minor incremental work on VLM robustness improvement; core conclusion can be kept as literature reference, no need to read the full text.

paper.title: VideoRouter: Query-Adaptive Dual Routing for Efficient Long-Video Understanding
paper.abstract: Video large multimodal models increasingly face a scalability bottleneck: long videos produce excessively long visual-token sequences, which sharply increase memory and latency during inference. While existing compression methods are effective in specific settings, most are either weakly query-aware or apply a fixed compression policy across frames, proving suboptimal when visual evidence is unevenly distributed over time. To address this, we present VideoRouter, a query-adaptive dual-router fra

summary.core_problem: 长视频VLM的视觉token序列过长，导致推理内存和延迟大幅上升，现有压缩方法query感知弱或策略固定，在视觉证据时间分布不均时效果差
summary.importance: 工程创新，提出查询自适应的双路由框架，在保证精度的前提下优化长视频推理效率
summary.technical_approach: 基于InternVL构建双路由架构：语义路由选择时间覆盖策略，在全局覆盖和高分辨率保留之间切换；图像路由利用LLM早期层打分帧相关性，压缩无关帧保留关键帧细节；构建两个专用数据集用于路由训练
summary.experiments: 基于InternVL实现，相比基线方法在精度下降可接受的范围内降低了推理资源消耗，具体数值未在摘要中完整披露
summary.authors_note: 北京大学，无知名作者

summary_en.core_problem: Long-video VLMs face scalability bottleneck from overlong visual token sequences, which sharply increase inference memory and latency; existing compression methods are weakly query-aware or use fixed policies
summary_en.importance: Engineering innovation, proposes a query-adaptive dual routing framework to optimize long-video inference efficiency while preserving accuracy
summary_en.technical_approach: Built on InternVL: Semantic Router selects allocation policy between broad temporal coverage and high-resolution preservation; Image Router scores frame relevance with early LLM layers to compress irrelevant frames; two custom datasets are built for router training
summary_en.experiments: Implemented on InternVL, reduces inference resource cost with acceptable accuracy drop compared to baselines, full quantitative results are not disclosed in the abstract
summary_en.authors_note: Peking University, no notable authors

recommendation.zh: 长视频VLM推理优化的增量工作，仅关注推理效率的研究员可扫方法部分，预训练研究员无需深读
recommendation.en: Incremental long-video VLM inference optimization, only for efficiency-focused researchers, no deep read for pretraining researchers.

paper.title: Uncovering Entity Identity Confusion in Multimodal Knowledge Editing
paper.abstract: Multimodal knowledge editing (MKE) aims to correct the internal knowledge of large vision-language models after deployment, yet the behavioral patterns of post-edit models remain underexplored. In this paper, we identify a systemic failure mode in edited models, termed Entity Identity Confusion (EIC): edited models exhibit an absurd behavior where text-only queries about the original entity's identity unexpectedly return information about the new entity. To rigorously investigate EIC, we constru

summary.core_problem: 研究多模态知识编辑后的一个失效模式：模型在文本查询原实体时，错误返回新实体信息，出现实体身份混淆。
summary.importance: 价值主要在诊断和 benchmark，而不是新预训练方法。它提醒 VLM 的知识编辑并没有真正改写图像-实体绑定，更多是在表层关系上过拟合。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Entity Identity Confusion（EIC）现象，并构建 EC-Bench 专门检测编辑前后 image-entity binding 与 entity-entity relational knowledge 的变化。论文将问题归因于现有 MKE 方法没有区分 I-E 绑定和 E-E 关系，导致模型把新名字当作伪标签，而图像表征仍指向旧实体。
summary.experiments: 在多模态知识编辑设定下做诊断评测，核心结果是现有编辑方法会系统性触发 EIC。摘要未给出具体模型、编辑方法覆盖范围和量化幅度，因此目前更适合作为 failure mode 备查，而不是高优先级主线阅读。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自中科院自动化所 NLPR / MAIS、北京邮电大学、国科大、华中科技大学，属于国内多模态与模式识别方向团队。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a failure mode in multimodal knowledge editing: after editing, text-only queries about the original entity can incorrectly return information about the new entity, causing entity identity confusion.
summary_en.importance: Its value is mainly diagnostic rather than methodological. The key takeaway is that current VLM editing methods may not truly rewrite image-entity bindings, but instead overfit shallow relational associations.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors define Entity Identity Confusion (EIC) and build EC-Bench to probe how image-entity bindings and entity-entity relational knowledge shift before and after editing. They argue that existing MKE methods fail to separate I-E binding from E-E relations, so the model keeps perceiving the image as the original entity while treating the new name as a spurious label.
summary_en.experiments: The work evaluates multimodal knowledge editing systems under this diagnostic setup and reports that EIC is a systematic failure mode. The abstract does not provide enough detail on model coverage, editing methods, or effect sizes, so this is better treated as a useful failure-mode reference than a top-priority read.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from NLPR/MAIS at CAS, BUPT, UCAS, and HUST, representing a Chinese multimodal and pattern-recognition research cluster.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但它把“编辑改的是绑定还是标签”这个问题挑明了；做 VLM memory/editing 的人看 benchmark 定义即可，别把编辑成功率当真改知识。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it cleanly asks whether editing changes bindings or just labels; if you work on VLM memory/editing, read the benchmark setup and be skeptical of headline edit success.
