Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences
Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications
University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
Huazhong University of Science and Technology
State Key Laboratory of Multimodal Artificial Intelligence Systems (MAIS)

paper.title: PRISM: Perception Reasoning Interleaved for Sequential Decision Making
paper.abstract: Scaling LLM-based embodied agents from text-only environments to complex multimodal settings remains a major challenge. Recent work identifies a perception-reasoning-decision gap in standalone Vision-Language Models (VLMs), which often overlook task-critical information. In this paper, we introduce PRISM, a framework that tightly couples perception (VLM) and decision (LLM) through a dynamic question-answer (DQA) pipeline. Instead of passively accepting the VLM's description, the LLM critiques it

summary.core_problem: 在具身智能中，将 VLM 作为感知模块、LLM 作为决策模块的松耦合架构，往往导致 VLM 忽略任务关键信息，从而限制了 LLM 在视觉环境中的决策能力。
summary.importance: 提出了一种感知与决策紧密耦合的新范式，通过动态问答机制解决了 VLM 描述不充分的问题，为多模态具身智能体的架构设计提供了有价值的参考，特别是如何利用 LLM 的推理能力来引导 VLM 的感知。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PRISM 框架，包含动态问答（DQA）机制。VLM 先提供初始场景描述，LLM 根据目标对其进行批评，发现信息缺失并向 VLM 提出目标导向的问题。VLM 回答后，LLM 将交互反馈综合成紧凑的、任务驱动的场景描述，最后基于此描述生成动作。这种闭环交互无需人工标注，且允许使用基于文本的 RL 方法进行训练。
summary.experiments: 在 ALFWorld 和 Room-to-Room (R2R) 基准测试中，PRISM 显著优于现有的基于图像的模型。消融实验证明了 DQA 机制在两个基准测试中都能带来一致的性能提升，并验证了生成的问答和描述的有效性。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读 Method 部分关于 DQA 机制的设计，了解 LLM 如何引导 VLM 提取关键信息。可以泛读实验结果，关注 PRISM 与松耦合架构的性能对比。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In embodied AI, loosely coupled architectures using VLMs for perception and LLMs for decision-making often lead VLMs to overlook task-critical information, limiting LLMs' decision-making capabilities in visual environments.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a new paradigm tightly coupling perception and decision-making through dynamic question-answering, addressing the inadequacy of VLM descriptions. It offers a valuable reference for multimodal embodied agent architecture, specifically on using LLM reasoning to guide VLM perception.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces the PRISM framework with a Dynamic Question-Answering (DQA) mechanism. The VLM provides an initial scene description; the LLM critiques it against the goal, identifies missing information, and queries the VLM. After the VLM answers, the LLM synthesizes the feedback into a compact, task-driven description used for action generation. This closed-loop interaction requires no manual annotation and allows training with text-based RL methods.
summary_en.experiments: PRISM significantly outperforms existing image-based models on ALFWorld and Room-to-Room (R2R) benchmarks. Ablation studies demonstrate consistent performance gains from the DQA mechanism across both benchmarks and validate the effectiveness of the generated questions, answers, and descriptions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Method section detailing the DQA mechanism to understand how the LLM guides the VLM to extract key information. Skim the experimental results, paying attention to the performance comparison between PRISM and loosely coupled architectures. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 多模态具身Agent架构的有效探索，VLM与LLM闭环交互的设计值得在Agent系统中借鉴。只看方法部分和实验结果即可。
recommendation.en: Useful exploration of embodied multimodal agent architecture; the closed-loop VLM-LLM interaction design is transferable to agent systems. Read method and results only.

paper.title: CC-OCR V2: Benchmarking Large Multimodal Models for Literacy in Real-world Document Processing
paper.abstract: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) have recently shown strong performance on Optical Character Recognition (OCR) tasks, demonstrating their promising capability in document literacy. However, their effectiveness in real-world applications remains underexplored, as existing benchmarks adopt task scopes misaligned with practical applications and assume homogeneous acquisition conditions. To address this gap, we introduce CC-OCR V2, a comprehensive and challenging OCR benchmark tailored to real-world d

summary.core_problem: 评估大多模态模型在真实企业文档 OCR 场景中的文字识别、解析、定位、信息抽取和问答能力。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM/OCR benchmark。它补足了现有 OCR 评测过于干净、任务范围偏窄、采集条件同质化的问题，对理解 LMM 在文档 literacy 上的真实短板有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 CC-OCR V2，覆盖 5 条 OCR-centric track：text recognition、document parsing、document grounding、key information extraction、document question answering，并刻意加入真实应用中的 hard cases 和 corner cases。
summary.experiments: 数据集包含 7,093 个高难样本；评测 14 个先进 LMM。摘要结论是现有模型距离真实企业文档处理要求仍有明显差距，但未给出具体模型列表、参数量和分项提升数字。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Northeastern University；从摘要看主要是文档 OCR 与多模态评测工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether large multimodal models can handle OCR-heavy real-world enterprise document processing rather than clean benchmark-style OCR.
summary_en.importance: It is a VLM/OCR benchmark contribution. The main value is exposing the gap between standard OCR evaluations and practical document literacy workloads with heterogeneous acquisition conditions and corner cases.
summary_en.technical_approach: CC-OCR V2 is organized around five OCR-centric tracks: text recognition, document parsing, document grounding, key information extraction, and document question answering. The benchmark emphasizes difficult and underrepresented real-world cases.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 7,093 challenging samples and evaluates 14 advanced LMMs. The abstract reports that current models remain below real-world deployment requirements, but does not provide model sizes or detailed per-model numbers.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Northeastern University; the work appears centered on document OCR and multimodal evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 偏应用 benchmark；做 native VLM 预训练可扫任务 taxonomy 和失败类型，不必细读排行榜。
recommendation.en: Mostly an applied benchmark; for native VLM pretraining, skim the task taxonomy and failure cases, not the leaderboard.

paper.title: MHPR: Multidimensional Human Perception and Reasoning Benchmark for Large Vision-Languate Models
paper.abstract: Multidimensional human understanding is essential for real-world applications such as film analysis and virtual digital humans, yet current LVLM benchmarks largely focus on single-task settings and lack fine-grained, human-centric evaluation. In this work, we introduce MHPR, a comprehensive benchmark for joint perception-reasoning over human-centric scenes spanning individual, multi-person, and human-object interaction dimensions. MHPR comprises a multi-level data design-Captioned Raw Data (C-RD

summary.core_problem: 如何评估大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）在以人为中心的场景中的多维感知和推理能力？
summary.importance: 提出了 MHPR，一个针对以人为中心场景的细粒度、多维度的 LVLM 评估基准，填补了现有基准在多任务和细粒度评估上的空白。
summary.technical_approach: 构建了包含个体、多人和人机交互维度的多级数据集（C-RD, SFT-D, RL-D, T-D），并设计了自动化的 caption/VQA 生成 pipeline（ACVG），通过属性分解、重写和多模型投票确保标注质量。
summary.experiments: 在细粒度属性（外观、服装、姿势等）和高级语义（社会关系、动作、空间关系等）上评估了 SOTA LVLM。
summary.authors_note: 清华大学团队。

summary_en.core_problem: How to evaluate the multi-dimensional perception and reasoning capabilities of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) in human-centric scenes?
summary_en.importance: Introduces MHPR, a fine-grained, multi-dimensional benchmark for LVLMs in human-centric scenes, filling the gap in multi-task and fine-grained evaluation of existing benchmarks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs a multi-level dataset (C-RD, SFT-D, RL-D, T-D) covering individual, multi-person, and human-object interaction dimensions. Designs an automated caption/VQA generation pipeline (ACVG) using attribute decomposition, rewriting, and multi-model voting to ensure annotation quality.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated SOTA LVLMs on fine-grained attributes (appearance, clothing, pose, etc.) and high-level semantics (social relations, actions, spatial relations, etc.).
summary_en.authors_note: Tsinghua University team.

recommendation.zh: 特定领域（以人为中心）的 VLM Benchmark，作为评测集备查，不需精读。
recommendation.en: Domain-specific (human-centric) VLM benchmark, keep as reference for evaluation sets, no need to read in detail.

paper.title: GEASS: Training-Free Caption Steering for Hallucination Mitigation in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) excel at grounded reasoning but remain prone to object hallucination. Recent work treats self-generated captions as a uniformly positive resource, yet we find that naively embedding one can degrade rather than help--dropping Qwen2.5-VL-3B accuracy on HallusionBench by nearly 10 points. Two structural properties explain this. First, captions anchor not only the model's final answer but also its reasoning trajectory and lexical choices. Second, caption errors are asym

summary.core_problem: VLM 的幻觉缓解里，“给模型塞一段自生成 caption 当额外证据”看起来合理，但全文指出它会因为锚定效应（caption 会重塑推理轨迹与措辞）而在 caption 有错时放大伤害；同时 caption 的错误结构是强不对称的：遗漏多、捏造少，但捏造的单次代价更大。核心问题变成：能否在不训练、不开额外 caption 质量模型的情况下，对每个 query 自适应地决定 caption 应该影响模型多少，从而只吃到 caption 的增益、尽量规避其误导？
summary.importance: 这不是预训练论文，属于推理期的训练-free steering/融合策略；但对“训练信号质量与推理行为”的研究有两点启发：1）把 caption 当作一种外部 noisy teacher signal，强调其错误分布（omission vs fabrication）会决定最优融合策略，这个视角可迁移到合成数据/自训练数据的质量建模；2）用 logit-level 的可计算代理（置信度、信息增益、分歧惩罚）做动态门控，提供了一种低成本的 test-time mixture-of-experts/mixture-of-evidence 形式。对预训练的直接贡献有限，但对 VLM 可靠性与“外部证据注入”的方法论有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
GEASS（Gated Evidence-Aware Selective Steering）是一个 plug-and-play 的推理模块，不改模型参数：
- 双路径前向：同一问题跑两次解码/前向，一次不带 caption（clean path），一次带 caption（caption path），得到两套 logits。
- 三个信号控制 caption 影响强度（logit 融合权重/门控）：
  1）Confidence gate（Gated）：用 clean path 的最大概率/置信度衡量“模型是否需要外部帮助”。高置信度时倾向少用 caption，避免被锚定带偏。
  2）Information-gain weight（Evidence-Aware）：用 caption 引入后熵下降（entropy reduction）衡量 caption 是否真的提供了对当前 query 有用的信息，而不是只改变措辞。
  3）Disagreement penalty（Selective）：当两路径预测分歧大时，提高使用 caption 的门槛；编码“caption 更常遗漏、偶尔捏造但代价大”的先验——caption 更适合用来加强模型已有判断，而不适合强行推翻。
- 关键取舍：不去提升 caption 本身质量（避免更强 captioner/外部验证的额外成本），而是承认 caption 混合质量并在 logit 层面调制其锚定效应。代价是每个 query 额外两次前向（文中表述为 only two extra forward passes）。
summary.experiments:
全文在引言给了一个强对照：Qwen2.5-VL-3B 在 HallusionBench 上，直接嵌入自生成 caption 会把准确率从 61.19 降到 51.31（接近 10 点）。GEASS 的目标是在保留 caption 对“全局内容覆盖”的帮助时，避免这种系统性退化。
从摘录能确认：评测包含 HallusionBench，且提到也在 POPE 上验证；并强调训练-free、兼容标准解码。具体 GEASS 带来的提升幅度、在不同问题类型（全局 vs 细节）上的分层结果、以及三信号的消融贡献，需要看实验表格与分组分析部分才能给出精确数字。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–35 分钟）：
- 先看 Section 3（文中提到）关于 anchoring effect 与 error asymmetry 的实证分析：它解释了“为什么 caption 会害人”，比方法本身更可迁移。
- 再看 GEASS 的三信号定义与融合公式：尤其是 entropy reduction 的计算细节、以及 disagreement penalty 如何实现（阈值/温度/重加权）。
- 实验部分重点看：按问题类型分桶（global/detail）的结果、caption 错误类型统计（omission/fabrication）与性能相关性、以及消融（去掉 gate / IG / penalty 各自会怎样）。

summary_en.core_problem: Using self-generated captions as extra evidence is a common hallucination-mitigation trick for VLMs, but the paper shows it can significantly hurt because captions anchor not only the final answer but also the reasoning trajectory and lexical choices. Caption errors are also asymmetric: omissions are frequent, fabrications are rarer but far more damaging per instance. The problem is therefore per-query: how to decide, at inference time and without training, when and how strongly a caption should influence decoding so that it helps on global-coverage queries but does not mislead on detail-sensitive ones.
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining paper; it is a training-free test-time steering method. Still, it offers transferable lessons for foundation-model research around noisy auxiliary signals: (1) treat captions as a noisy teacher/evidence source whose error distribution (omission vs fabrication) dictates the optimal fusion rule—an angle that also applies to synthetic data and self-training pipelines; (2) implement dynamic evidence gating via cheap, logit-level proxies (confidence, information gain, disagreement), resembling a test-time mixture-of-evidence mechanism. Direct impact on pretraining objectives is limited, but it informs reliability and evidence-injection design for VLM systems.
summary_en.technical_approach:
GEASS (Gated Evidence-Aware Selective Steering) is plug-and-play and parameter-free:
- Two-path inference: run the model with the original prompt (clean path) and with an appended self-caption (caption path), producing two logit streams.
- Logit-level modulation using three signals:
  1) Confidence gate: uses the clean-path max probability as a proxy for whether external evidence is needed.
  2) Evidence-aware weight: measures caption usefulness via entropy reduction induced by the caption (information gain proxy).
  3) Selective disagreement penalty: when the two paths disagree, raise the threshold for letting the caption override, encoding the prior that captions mostly omit and occasionally fabricate (high-cost).
- Design choice: do not improve caption quality (no stronger captioner or external verification); instead, control the anchoring effect by regulating caption influence at the logits. Overhead is two additional forward passes per query, compatible with standard decoding as long as logits are accessible.
summary_en.experiments:
A key motivating result is explicit: on HallusionBench, Qwen2.5-VL-3B drops from 61.19 to 51.31 accuracy when a self-generated caption is naively embedded, showing unconditional caption trust is harmful. GEASS is evaluated on HallusionBench and mentioned to be validated on POPE as well.
The excerpt does not include the final GEASS gains, per-category breakdowns (global vs detail questions), or ablations for the three signals; those numbers should be taken from the main experiment tables and grouped analyses.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–35 minutes):
- Prioritize the analysis section (referred to as Section 3) that demonstrates anchoring effects and the omission/fabrication asymmetry; this is the most reusable part.
- Then read the GEASS formulation: exact definitions of entropy reduction, how disagreement is quantified, and the fusion rule.
- In experiments, focus on: stratified results by question type, caption error-type statistics, and ablations removing each of the three signals.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 caption 负收益分析；它提醒图文中间监督要按 query 过滤，别把自生成 caption 当免费 grounding 信号。
recommendation.en: Worth reading for the negative-caption analysis; it is a useful warning that generated captions are not free grounding signals and need query-level filtering.

paper.title: MIRL: Mutual Information-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) frequently suffer from visual perception errors and hallucinations that compromise answer accuracy in complex reasoning tasks. Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) offers a promising solution by optimizing policies using answer correctness signals. Despite their effectiveness, prevailing RLVR methods face two critical limitations. First, much of the sampling budget is wasted on trajectories doomed to fail due to early visual description errors. Seco

summary.core_problem: 在 VLM 的 RLVR（用“答案是否正确”做可验证奖励）训练里，采样成本高且奖励稀疏：大量 rollout 早期就因视觉描述错误而“注定失败”，但仍被完整采样；同时失败只给一个序列级 0/1 信号，无法区分是视觉感知阶段错了还是后续推理错了，导致 credit assignment 很差。
summary.importance: 对“RL 如何更有效地改 VLM 的视觉 grounding”给出一个工程上可落地的中间信号：把互信息（MI）从推理时的 hallucination 抑制手段迁移到训练时，既做低成本的轨迹筛选，也给视觉描述阶段提供独立奖励。对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 post-train（RLVR / GRPO 系）里如何把算力花在更有希望的轨迹上、如何把视觉与推理解耦优化，有明确启发。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分两件事：
1) MI 预筛选 + forking 采样：先从当前策略网络低成本生成多条“视觉描述”（paper 中称 pre-sampled descriptions），用描述与图像之间的互信息作为质量代理，选 top-K 高 MI 的描述再进入后续昂贵的完整推理采样；低 MI 的描述直接丢弃，从而把 rollout 预算集中到更可能成功的分支。
2) 解耦奖励与更新：把训练过程拆成“描述阶段”和“推理/作答阶段”。描述阶段对所有预采样描述都立刻给 MI-based reward 做更新；推理阶段只对高 MI 分支做完整采样，并用最终可验证任务奖励（答案正确性）做策略更新。这样 MI 信号专门拉高视觉 grounding 质量，而最终 reward 仍负责推理正确性，缓解稀疏奖励下的归因混淆。
实现上强调模块化：在 rollout 逻辑里加 forking，在 loss 里加两类 reward；可插到 GRPO、DAPO 这类 RLVR 框架里，不改核心优化器。
summary.experiments: 覆盖数学推理与通用 VQA：MathVista、MathVerse、We-Math、M3CoT、MMStar、RealWorldQA 等。文中给出一个代表性预算配置：先采样 10 条描述，用 MI 选 top-6；每条描述再采样 12 条完整轨迹。对比“直接采样 16 条完整轨迹”，MIRL 在验证集准确率的收敛速度更快，并在总体计算成本下降约 25% 的情况下取得更高性能。消融结论：只用 MI reward 明显不如 MI + task correctness 的组合，说明 MI 更适合作为感知阶段的代理信号，而推理仍需要最终可验证监督。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：
- 先看 Figure 1：它基本把“为什么要解耦、为什么 MI 能同时解决采样效率与 credit assignment”讲清楚。
- 重点看方法部分对两阶段更新的定义：哪些样本拿 MI reward、哪些样本拿 task reward，以及 forking 的预算分配细节（top-K、每分支轨迹数）。
- 再看消融：MI-only vs task-only vs decoupled 的差距，用来判断 MI 信号的边界条件。
预计 30–45 分钟可抓住主要贡献；若要复现，优先核对 MI 估计方式与 rollout 预算配置。

summary_en.core_problem: RL with verifiable rewards (answer correctness) for VLMs is both expensive and poorly shaped: many rollouts are doomed early due to incorrect visual descriptions but still consume full sampling budget, and a single terminal 0/1 reward cannot tell whether failures come from visual grounding or later reasoning, leading to weak credit assignment.
summary_en.importance: The paper contributes a practical intermediate signal for VLM RL post-training: mutual information (MI) between generated descriptions and the image is used (i) to pre-screen branches before expensive rollouts and (ii) as a dedicated reward for the perception/description stage. It is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is relevant to the pretrain↔posttrain loop because it changes how RL budget is allocated and how supervision is decomposed across generation stages.
summary_en.technical_approach:
MIRL combines two ideas:
1) MI-based pre-screening with forking: sample multiple candidate visual descriptions cheaply, score each by MI with the image, keep top-K, and only then run expensive full reasoning rollouts from those descriptions. This reallocates sampling to higher-potential trajectories.
2) Decoupled rewards/updates: all pre-sampled descriptions receive immediate MI-based rewards to update the description policy, while only high-MI branches are fully rolled out and updated with the terminal task reward (verifiable answer correctness). This separates supervision for visual grounding from supervision for reasoning.
Engineering-wise, it is implemented as a modular change to rollout (forking) plus loss computation (two reward channels), and is designed to plug into GRPO/DAPO-style RLVR without changing the core optimizer.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on MathVista, MathVerse, We-Math, M3CoT, MMStar, and RealWorldQA. A representative budget: sample 10 descriptions, select top-6 by MI, then sample 12 full trajectories per selected description. Compared to directly sampling 16 full trajectories, MIRL reaches higher validation accuracy faster and reports ~25% compute reduction while improving final performance. Ablations indicate MI-only training underperforms the combined MI + task-reward setup, suggesting MI is a useful proxy for perception quality but not a replacement for correctness supervision in reasoning.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan:
- Start with Fig. 1 to understand the failure modes and the decoupled training design.
- Read the method section focusing on (a) how MI is computed/approximated, (b) the exact forking budget (top-K, trajectories per branch), and (c) which tokens/segments receive which reward.
- Check the ablations contrasting MI-only, task-only, and decoupled training to learn where MI helps and where it saturates.
~30–45 minutes is enough for the main ideas; deeper reading is needed only if you plan to implement MI scoring and rollout scheduling.

recommendation.zh: 只看 MI reward 定义和 forking 消融；它抓住了 VLM-RLVR 的 credit assignment 痛点，但别先信泛化结论。
recommendation.en: Read the MI reward definition and forking ablations; it targets a real VLM-RLVR credit-assignment issue, but do not overtrust generalization claims.

paper.title: AutoFocus: Uncertainty-Aware Active Visual Search for GUI Grounding
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have enabled autonomous GUI agents that translate natural language instructions into executable screen coordinates. However, grounding performance degrades in high-resolution interfaces, where dense layouts and small interactive elements expose a resolution gap between modern displays and model input constraints. Existing zoom-in strategies rely on fixed anchors, heuristic grids, or reinforcement learning, lacking a principled mechanism to adaptively determine where

summary.core_problem: 高分辨率 GUI 中，小控件和密集布局会让 VLM 坐标 grounding 失效；论文尝试用不确定性驱动的主动搜索来决定放大哪里。
summary.importance: 贡献是通用 GUI agent 的推理时 grounding 方法，不需要训练；有一定方法信号，因为它把坐标生成 token 的 perplexity 当作空间不确定性估计。
summary.technical_approach: AutoFocus 对坐标生成采样多个候选点，用横纵轴 token-level perplexity 构造各向异性高斯空间概率场，再根据不确定区域自适应选择局部放大和细化搜索，而不是固定网格、固定 anchor 或 RL 学到的缩放策略。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 benchmark、VLM backbone、屏幕分辨率、baseline 或数值提升；只能确认方法是 training-free，并面向高分辨率 GUI grounding。
summary.authors_note: Wuhan University of Technology；Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses GUI grounding failures in high-resolution screens, where dense layouts and small elements exceed the effective input resolution of current VLMs.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training-free inference method for GUI agents. The useful idea is to treat coordinate-token perplexity as a spatial uncertainty signal for active visual search.
summary_en.technical_approach: AutoFocus samples multiple coordinate hypotheses, converts axial token-level perplexities into an anisotropic Gaussian probability field, and adaptively zooms into uncertain regions instead of relying on fixed grids, anchors, or reinforcement-learned zoom policies.
summary_en.experiments: The supplied abstract does not provide benchmark names, backbone models, screen resolutions, baselines, or numerical gains; it only specifies the training-free GUI grounding setup.
summary_en.authors_note: Wuhan University of Technology; Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences.

recommendation.zh: 预训练无关，但 perplexity 当 grounding 不确定性这个 trick 可偷；只看方法图和不确定性构造。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the perplexity-as-grounding-uncertainty trick is reusable; read only the method figure and uncertainty formulation.

institutions: Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences

paper.title: The Effects of Visual Priming on Cooperative Behavior in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: As Vision-Language Models (VLMs) become increasingly integrated into decision-making systems, it is essential to understand how visual inputs influence their behavior. This paper investigates the effects of visual priming on VLMs' cooperative behavior using the Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma (IPD) as a test scenario. We examine whether exposure to images depicting behavioral concepts (kindness/helpfulness vs. aggressiveness/selfishness) and color-coded reward matrices alters VLM decision patterns.

summary.core_problem: VLM集成到决策系统时，视觉输入对其合作决策行为的影响规律尚不明确，缺乏对应的评估与缓解方案
summary.importance: 原理分析类贡献，首次系统验证视觉启动效应在VLM决策场景中的存在，为VLM安全部署的鲁棒性评估提供参考
summary.technical_approach: 以迭代囚徒困境为测试场景，测试不同语义的提示图像、颜色编码奖励矩阵对多个SOTA VLM决策模式的影响，对比提示修改、CoT推理、视觉token缩减三种缓解策略的效果
summary.experiments: 覆盖多款主流SOTA VLM，验证视觉内容和颜色线索均会显著影响VLM决策，不同模型的易感性、缓解策略的有效性存在明显差异

summary_en.core_problem: The influence pattern of visual inputs on cooperative decision-making of VLMs integrated into decision systems is unclear, lacking corresponding evaluation and mitigation solutions
summary_en.importance: Mechanism analysis contribution, first systematically verifies the existence of visual priming effect in VLM decision scenarios, provides reference for robustness evaluation of VLM safe deployment
summary_en.technical_approach: Uses Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma as test scenario, tests the impact of images with different semantics and color-coded reward matrices on decision patterns of multiple SOTA VLMs, compares effectiveness of three mitigation strategies: prompt modification, CoT reasoning, visual token reduction
summary_en.experiments: Covers multiple mainstream SOTA VLMs, verifies that both visual content and color cues significantly affect VLM decisions, susceptibility and mitigation effectiveness vary obviously across models

recommendation.zh: 属于VLM行为鲁棒性的边际分析，仅作为多模态对齐的参考素材，看摘要结论即可
recommendation.en: Marginal analysis of VLM behavioral robustness, only reference for multimodal alignment, read abstract only

paper.title: GLM-5V-Turbo: Toward a Native Foundation Model for Multimodal Agents
paper.abstract: We present GLM-5V-Turbo, a step toward native foundation models for multimodal agents. As foundation models are increasingly deployed in real environments, agentic capability depends not only on language reasoning, but also on the ability to perceive, interpret, and act over heterogeneous contexts such as images, videos, webpages, documents, GUIs. GLM-5V-Turbo is built around this objective: multimodal perception is integrated as a core component of reasoning, planning, tool use, and execution,

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是：如果目标不是做一个“能看图的聊天模型”，而是做一个真正可执行多模态 agent 的基础模型，那么视觉感知、语言推理、工具调用、规划和执行应该怎样在同一个训练体系里被原生整合。论文关心的核心矛盾有两个。第一，多模态能力常常被当作外挂接口接到语言模型上，导致视觉只负责提供局部证据，无法深度参与推理和行动。第二，agent 能力如果直接端到端优化，训练信号稀疏、验证困难、任务定义不稳定，容易学到脆弱策略。GLM-5V-Turbo 试图通过新的视觉编码器、适配多模态输入的 multi-token prediction、深度融合的多模态训练，以及大规模多任务 RL，把“看、想、用工具、执行”放进一个更统一的基础模型框架。
summary.importance: 从基座研究角度，这篇工作的价值不在 benchmark 罗列，而在它展示了一条 native multimodal foundation model 的工程路线。它同时覆盖视觉 tokenizer/encoder、预训练 recipe、语言模型训练目标扩展、SFT 与 RL 的衔接、以及 agent 基础设施。对预训练研究员最有启发的有三点。第一，视觉侧不是简单接一个现成 encoder，而是单独做两阶段预训练，并明确处理表示学习与跨模态对齐的张力。第二，作者把 MTP 从纯文本扩展到多模态，讨论了 image token 应该怎样进入 MTP head，这属于训练目标层面的设计，而不是普通系统技巧。第三，论文强调 agent 能力更适合分层优化，而不是一把梭端到端训练，这对 pretrain 和 post-train 接口很有参考意义。需要注意的是，这篇工作更偏系统化技术报告，预训练细节虽有信息量，但很多结论仍需结合后续公开实验或复现来判断稳健性。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上有四个关键部分。第一是视觉编码器 CogViT。作者没有直接沿用通用 CLIP/ViT，而是做了两阶段预训练。阶段一是蒸馏式 masked image modeling，用 student ViT 重建被 mask 区域在双教师特征空间中的表示：SigLIP2 提供偏语义的表征，DINOv3 提供偏纹理/局部结构的表征。35% masking ratio，224×224 分辨率，数据配比是 80% 高质量自然图像、10% instruction-following data、10% scientific imagery。这里的设计意图很明确：先把视觉 backbone 的通用感知能力打牢，避免过早被图文对齐目标牵着走。训练上使用 Muon optimizer，并引入 QK-Norm 来抑制注意力 logit 爆炸，说明作者在大规模视觉预训练稳定性上做了针对性处理。阶段二转向 contrastive image-text pretraining，用 SigLIP loss 做图文对齐。升级点包括 NaFlex 可变分辨率输入、64K global batch 的大规模对比训练、以及 8B 中英双语图文语料。这里体现的是先表示、后对齐的路线，而不是从头只做对比学习。

第二是 MMTP，Multimodal Multi-Token Prediction。标准 MTP 在文本里很自然，因为 prefix token 可以直接嵌入后送入 MTP head；但多模态场景下，图像 token 怎么传给 MTP head 并不显然。作者比较了三种方案：直接传视觉 embedding；在 MTP head 里完全屏蔽视觉 token，退化成 text-only MTP；保留视觉位置信息，但把视觉 token 内容替换成共享可学习的 <|image|> token。最终采用第三种。原因是它在优化和系统效率之间更平衡：直接传视觉 embedding 会增加 head 侧负担和不稳定性；完全屏蔽视觉 token 又损失多模态条件信息；共享 special token 则保留“这里有图像”的结构信号和位置信息，同时避免把高维视觉特征直接灌进 MTP head。这个点很值得预训练研究员关注，因为它触及多模态 LM 训练目标如何与基础设施兼容的问题。

第三是多模态训练与深度融合。论文强调 vision-language integration 不是只在 SFT 阶段做，而是贯穿 pre-training 和 supervised fine-tuning。虽然公开内容没有把所有数据配比和 curriculum 细节完全展开，但可以看出作者在追求“视觉参与推理主干”，而不是“视觉先编码成几个 token 再让语言模型自己想办法用”。

第四是 joint RL 与 agent 基础设施。作者在 30 多类任务上做联合强化学习，覆盖 perception、reasoning、agentic capabilities，并配套优化了大规模 multimodal RL 的基础设施。更重要的是，论文明确总结出一个经验：agent 能力往往通过 hierarchical optimization 学得更好，而不是 monolithic end-to-end training。这意味着他们实际训练中很可能把感知、工具使用、规划、执行拆成不同层次或不同阶段优化，而不是只用统一 reward 直接推全链路。
summary.experiments: 视觉侧，CogViT 在 general object recognition、fine-grained understanding、geometric/spatial perception 上给出竞争性结果，论文用 Figure 1 做了汇总展示。虽然这里更像 encoder 报告而非独立论文，但它说明两阶段 recipe 不是只服务某个单一 benchmark。模型整体上，GLM-5V-Turbo 在多模态 agent 相关 benchmark 上给出一组较强结果：ImageMining 30.7，BrowseComp-VL 51.9，MMSearch 72.9，SimpleVQA 78.2；GUI agent 任务上 AndroidWorld 75.7，OSWorld 62.3；Claw 体系评测上 PinchBench 87.0/80.7，ClawEval 57.7/75.0，ZClawBench 57.6。编码方面，多模态 Design2Code 94.8，超过 Claude Opus 4.6；文本代码能力也没有因多模态扩展而明显受损，CC-Backend 22.8、CC-Frontend 68.4、CC-RepoExploration 72.2，甚至超过语言基座 GLM-5-Turbo。对预训练读者更值得看的不是这些绝对分，而是几个设计选择的实验支持：一是 MMTP 三种视觉 token 传递方式的比较，最终为何 <|image|> 占优；二是 CogViT 两阶段预训练是否优于直接图文对齐；三是 joint RL 是否真的带来多任务泛化，而不是只在少数 agent benchmark 上过拟合。若正文给出消融，重点应关注 Muon、QK-Norm、NaFlex、SigLIP loss、大 batch bilingual corpus 这些训练 recipe 对稳定性和迁移性的影响。
summary.reading_guide: 如果从基座预训练角度读，优先看 Model, Training, and Infrastructure 这一节。先抓 CogViT 的两阶段 recipe：为什么先做蒸馏式 MIM，再做对比式图文对齐；双教师 SigLIP2 + DINOv3 分别提供什么；QK-Norm 和 Muon 在这里解决什么训练问题。然后重点看 MMTP 的设计比较，这部分最接近“训练目标创新”，也是全文里最有可迁移性的点。接着再看多模态训练和 joint RL，判断作者所谓 hierarchical optimization 到底落在数据组织、损失设计还是训练阶段划分上。实验部分不必逐个 benchmark 细读，先看能支持设计选择的消融和对比。若只想快速把握主线，30 分钟内读完 CogViT + MMTP + 关键 benchmark 表即可。若要深读，建议额外追问三个问题：第一，MMTP 在多模态下是否真的改善 sample efficiency 或 generation length；第二，视觉 encoder 的独立增强是否会和 LLM 主干对齐产生张力；第三，joint RL 的收益有多少来自任务覆盖面扩大，有多少来自 reward/verification 体系本身更成熟。
summary.authors_note: 智谱 GLM 团队技术报告，围绕 GLM-5V-Turbo 与多模态 agent 训练体系展开。公开文本中未完整列出作者背景细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a broader question than image understanding: if the target is a native multimodal agent rather than a language model with a vision plug-in, how should perception, reasoning, planning, tool use, and execution be integrated into one foundation-model stack? The central tension is that many multimodal systems still treat vision as an auxiliary interface to a language model, which limits how deeply visual evidence participates in reasoning and action. A second tension is optimization: end-to-end agent training is often unstable because rewards are sparse, task definitions are underspecified, and verification is hard. GLM-5V-Turbo addresses this by combining a dedicated vision encoder, a multimodal extension of multi-token prediction, deeply integrated multimodal training, and large-scale joint RL over heterogeneous agent tasks.
summary_en.importance: For a pretraining-oriented reader, the value is not the benchmark spread by itself. The value is that the paper lays out a concrete route toward a native multimodal foundation model. It touches the full stack: visual representation learning, cross-modal alignment, language-model objective design, the pretrain-to-posttrain interface, and multimodal RL infrastructure. Three parts are especially relevant. First, the vision side is not treated as a frozen external encoder; it is pretrained with a deliberate two-stage recipe that separates representation learning from alignment. Second, the paper extends multi-token prediction into the multimodal setting and explicitly studies how image tokens should enter the MTP head. That is a training-objective question, not just a systems trick. Third, the report argues that agentic capability is learned more effectively through hierarchical optimization than through monolithic end-to-end training, which is directly relevant to how pretraining and post-training should be coupled.
summary_en.technical_approach:
There are four main technical components. First, CogViT, a parameter-efficient vision encoder trained in two stages. Stage 1 uses distillation-based masked image modeling. A student ViT reconstructs masked regions in the feature spaces of two teachers: SigLIP2 for semantic representations and DINOv3 for texture and local structure. The setup uses a 35% masking ratio at 224x224 resolution, with a quality-aware data mixture of 80% high-quality natural images, 10% instruction-following data, and 10% scientific imagery. The intent is clear: build a strong visual backbone before forcing it into cross-modal alignment. Training uses the Muon optimizer, and QK-Norm is introduced to stabilize attention by mitigating logit explosion. Stage 2 switches to contrastive image-text pretraining with the SigLIP loss. The main upgrades are variable-resolution NaFlex inputs, a 64K global batch for large-scale contrastive learning, and an 8B bilingual Chinese-English image-text corpus. This is a representation-first, alignment-second recipe rather than pure contrastive training from scratch.

Second, MMTP, or Multimodal Multi-Token Prediction. In text-only MTP, prefix tokens can be passed naturally into the MTP head via token embeddings. In multimodal settings, however, it is unclear how image tokens should be exposed to the MTP head. The paper compares three options: directly passing visual embeddings, masking out visual tokens entirely at the MTP head, or preserving visual positional information while replacing visual content with a shared learnable <|image|> token. GLM-5V-Turbo adopts the third option. The reason is the trade-off between optimization and infrastructure efficiency. Direct visual embeddings make the head heavier and potentially less stable; removing visual tokens entirely loses multimodal conditioning; the shared special token preserves the structural signal that image content exists at certain positions without injecting full visual features into the MTP head. This is one of the most interesting parts of the paper for foundation-model training.

Third, multimodal training is deeply integrated across pretraining and supervised fine-tuning, rather than adding vision only at the instruction-tuning stage. The public text does not expose every data-mixture and curriculum detail, but the intended direction is clear: vision should participate in the model’s reasoning backbone, not merely provide a few side tokens.

Fourth, the paper performs joint reinforcement learning over more than 30 task categories spanning perception, reasoning, and agentic behavior, supported by dedicated multimodal RL infrastructure. The more important takeaway is the training philosophy stated in the report: agentic competence is often learned better through hierarchical optimization than through monolithic end-to-end training. That suggests the system likely decomposes perception, tool use, planning, and execution into different optimization layers or stages rather than relying on a single unified reward over the full chain.
summary_en.experiments: On the vision side, CogViT is reported to achieve competitive results on general object recognition, fine-grained understanding, and geometric or spatial perception, summarized in the paper’s overview figure. On the full model side, GLM-5V-Turbo reports strong results on multimodal agent benchmarks: 30.7 on ImageMining, 51.9 on BrowseComp-VL, 72.9 on MMSearch, and 78.2 on SimpleVQA. On GUI-agent tasks it reaches 75.7 on AndroidWorld and 62.3 on OSWorld. On Claw-based evaluations it reports 87.0/80.7 on PinchBench, 57.7/75.0 on ClawEval, and 57.6 on ZClawBench. For coding, it scores 94.8 on Design2Code, outperforming Claude Opus 4.6, while preserving or improving text-only coding relative to GLM-5-Turbo on CC-Backend, CC-Frontend, and CC-RepoExploration. For a pretraining reader, the most useful evidence is not the absolute benchmark list but the support for specific design choices: the comparison among the three MMTP visual-token interfaces, whether the two-stage CogViT recipe beats direct image-text alignment, and whether joint RL improves broad generalization rather than overfitting a narrow set of agent tasks. If the full report includes ablations, the most informative ones are likely around Muon, QK-Norm, NaFlex, SigLIP loss, and the large bilingual corpus.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the model, training, and infrastructure section first. Start with the CogViT recipe and ask why the paper separates masked-image distillation from image-text alignment. Pay attention to the role of the two teachers, the data mixture, and the stabilization choices such as Muon and QK-Norm. Then focus on MMTP. This is the part closest to a training-objective contribution, and it is the most transferable idea in the report. After that, read the multimodal training and joint RL sections with one question in mind: what exactly does hierarchical optimization mean in their implementation? Is it a curriculum, a task decomposition, a reward decomposition, or a staged training pipeline? In the experiments, prioritize ablations and design comparisons over the benchmark catalog. If time is limited, 30 minutes is enough to read the CogViT section, the MMTP comparison, and the main result tables. For deeper reading, keep three questions in mind: whether MMTP improves sample efficiency or generation behavior in multimodal settings, whether stronger standalone vision pretraining creates alignment tension with the language backbone, and how much of the RL gain comes from broader task coverage versus better reward and verification design.

paper.title: DenseStep2M: A Scalable, Training-Free Pipeline for Dense Instructional Video Annotation
paper.abstract: Long-term video understanding requires interpreting complex temporal events and reasoning over procedural activities. While instructional video corpora, like HowTo100M, offer rich resources for model training, they present significant challenges, including noisy ASR transcripts and inconsistent temporal alignments between narration and visual content. In this work, we introduce an automated, training-free pipeline to extract high-quality procedural annotations from in-the-wild instructional vide

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是视频理解模型本身，而是一个更前置的问题：怎样把 HowTo100M 这类噪声很大的野生 instructional video，自动转成可用于训练长时程视频-语言模型的高质量、时序对齐、步骤级标注数据。难点有两个。第一，ASR 文本噪声重，口语化、指代多、冗余多。第二，讲解和实际动作经常不同步，旁白可能早于或晚于视觉动作。如果直接拿原始 transcript 训练，模型学到的是错位的语言-视觉对应关系，长视频 procedural reasoning 会被系统性污染。论文的目标，是在不额外训练标注模型的前提下，用现成 VLM/LLM 搭出一个可扩展的数据生产流水线，把长视频切成视觉一致的片段，生成步骤描述，再做语义和时间上的校正与合并。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要在数据工程，而不是模型结构。它提供了一个较完整的范式：当原始多模态语料规模很大但对齐质量差时，可以先做结构化重建，再把数据喂给下游预训练或微调。这个思路对视频预训练、长时程 VLM、甚至语音/视频统一建模都成立。贡献量级上，它不是提出新的预训练目标，而是证明了“高质量自动重标注”本身可以成为数据放大器：从约 10 万 instructional videos 中抽取出 200 万条细粒度 procedural steps，并且这些自动标注在人工基准上接近可用，进一步带来 dense captioning、procedural grounding、cross-modal retrieval 的一致提升。对做 pretrain 的人，真正有启发的是数据清洗、时序切分、候选生成、推理式精修这条链路，而不是单点模型性能。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分三段。第一段是视频过滤与分段。作者从 HowTo100M 中筛 instructional videos，并把长视频切成视觉上相对一致的 shots。这里的目的不是传统镜头检测本身，而是给后续步骤生成提供更稳定的局部上下文，避免一个 prompt 同时覆盖多个动作。与此同时，还会过滤视觉-文本明显失配的内容，减少后续大模型在坏样本上“硬解释”。第二段是候选步骤生成。作者使用 Qwen2.5-VL-72B 联合看视频帧和对应 transcript，为每个 shot 生成候选 procedural step。这里关键不是简单 caption，而是要求输出结构化、可执行、与片段绑定的步骤描述，因此它更接近 procedural abstraction：把口语化 narration 和视觉动作压缩成规范步骤。第三段是步骤精修与合并。作者用 DeepSeek-R1 对候选步骤做两类处理：一类是语义清洗，把含糊指代、口语冗余、碎片化表达改写成更清晰的 instruction-like step；另一类是时间修正与跨 shot 合并，把被切碎的同一动作合并，或把错位的描述重新对齐到更合理的时间段。这个设计体现了明确分工：Qwen2.5-VL 负责感知与局部 grounding，DeepSeek-R1 负责长上下文推理、重写和全局一致性整理。相比早期直接用单个 AR 模型从 transcript 生成步骤，这里更强调“先局部感知，再全局整理”，原因是长视频中的误差主要来自局部视觉遗漏和全局时间错配，两者需要不同能力的模型处理。论文还构建了 DenseCaption100 作为 100 个视频的人写 dense annotation benchmark，用来验证自动流水线的质量，而不是只看下游任务分数。
summary.experiments: 数据侧，最终得到 DenseStep2M：约 100K instructional videos、约 2M fine-grained procedural steps，平均每个视频对应多条时序步骤。验证侧，作者人工构建 DenseCaption100，对自动标注与人工标注做对齐评估。摘要里没有给出完整数字表，但从正文描述看，自动生成结果在语义相关性和时间对齐上都达到较强的人类一致性，说明这套 training-free pipeline 不是只会生成流畅文本，而是真能提供可训练的时序 supervision。应用侧，作者把 DenseStep2M 用于微调 vision-language models，在生成式任务上提升 dense captioning 和 procedural grounding，在判别式任务上提升 cross-modal retrieval。这里最值得注意的不是某一个 benchmark 的绝对值，而是收益具有任务一致性：如果数据只是语言重写得更好，通常只会改善 caption；如果时间对齐也更准，grounding 和 retrieval 也会一起受益。这个结果间接支持了作者关于“结构化重标注优于直接使用原始 ASR”的判断。消融层面，全文重点应当比较三类因素：是否做 shot segmentation、是否做 alignment filtering、是否加入 DeepSeek-R1 refinement。通常这三步分别对应局部上下文稳定性、坏样本剔除、全局语义/时间修正，少掉任何一步，数据质量都会明显下降。
summary.reading_guide: 建议先看 Introduction 里对问题的界定，重点理解作者为什么不直接把 HowTo100M transcript 当 supervision。然后精读方法部分的 Figure 1 和 Sec. 3.2-3.4：一是视频切分和过滤标准，二是 Qwen2.5-VL 生成候选步骤的 prompt/输入组织方式，三是 DeepSeek-R1 如何做 refinement 和 merge。真正值得深挖的是“模型分工”而不是“用了哪个大模型”：如果换成别的 VLM/LLM，这条流水线是否仍成立，取决于局部 grounding 与全局整理是否被清楚拆开。实验部分优先看 DenseCaption100 的人工对齐评测，再看下游微调收益。若时间有限，抓住数据构建流程图、质量验证表、以及去掉 refinement/filtering 的消融即可，预计 20-30 分钟能把主线读清。若从预训练角度深入，建议额外思考两个问题：第一，自动重标注带来的收益，究竟来自文本规范化还是时间对齐改善；第二，这种 pipeline 能否迁移到语音、网页操作轨迹、GUI demonstration 等其他长序列多模态数据。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a data construction problem rather than a new video model: how to turn noisy in-the-wild instructional videos into temporally grounded, step-level supervision that is actually usable for long-horizon video-language training. Raw instructional corpora such as HowTo100M are attractive because they contain rich procedural demonstrations, but they are hard to use directly. ASR transcripts are noisy, colloquial, and full of ambiguous references. More importantly, narration and visual actions are often misaligned in time. If such data is consumed as-is, a model learns corrupted visual-language correspondences. The paper proposes a scalable, training-free pipeline that segments videos, filters poorly aligned content, generates candidate procedural steps, and then refines and merges them into a dense step annotation set.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is on the data side. For pretraining-oriented work, the paper is useful because it shows that large noisy multimodal corpora can be upgraded through structured relabeling rather than discarded or used raw. That is relevant not only to long-video VLMs, but also to any setting where supervision exists at scale but with weak temporal or semantic alignment. The contribution is not a new objective or architecture. The contribution is a practical recipe for converting weakly aligned multimodal traces into higher-quality supervision. The resulting DenseStep2M dataset contains roughly 100K instructional videos and 2M fine-grained procedural steps, and the paper shows that this relabeling pipeline improves downstream dense captioning, procedural grounding, and retrieval after fine-tuning.
summary_en.technical_approach: The pipeline has three stages. First, video filtering and segmentation. The system identifies instructional videos and splits each long video into visually coherent shots. This is not just a preprocessing convenience. It creates local contexts where a single action or sub-action is more likely to dominate, which makes later grounding more reliable. The pipeline also filters segments with poor visual-text alignment to avoid forcing the model to explain mismatched evidence. Second, candidate step generation. Qwen2.5-VL-72B is used to jointly inspect frames and transcripts and produce candidate procedural steps for each shot. The target is not generic captioning. It is structured procedural abstraction: converting noisy narration plus visual evidence into concise, instruction-like steps tied to temporal spans. Third, refinement and merging. DeepSeek-R1 is then used to clean up semantics, resolve vague references, improve temporal alignment, and merge fragmented steps across neighboring shots when they belong to the same action. This division of labor is the key design choice. The VLM handles local perception and grounding; the reasoning LLM handles long-context cleanup, rewriting, and global consistency. Compared with earlier pipelines that relied on a single model over transcripts or coarse visual cues, this design explicitly separates local multimodal evidence extraction from global temporal-semantic consolidation. The paper also introduces DenseCaption100, a human-annotated benchmark of 100 instructional videos, to validate annotation quality directly rather than relying only on downstream task gains.
summary_en.experiments: On the data side, the pipeline produces DenseStep2M with about 100K videos and 2M fine-grained procedural steps. On the validation side, the paper uses DenseCaption100 to compare automated annotations against human-written dense annotations. The abstract does not expose the full metric table, but the paper’s central claim is that the generated annotations align well with human standards in both semantics and temporal grounding. On the model side, fine-tuning VLMs on DenseStep2M improves both generative tasks, such as dense captioning and procedural grounding, and discriminative tasks, such as cross-modal retrieval. That pattern matters. If the pipeline only improved linguistic fluency, one would expect gains mostly on captioning. Gains on grounding and retrieval suggest that temporal alignment quality also improved. The most informative ablations are likely the ones removing shot segmentation, alignment filtering, or the DeepSeek-R1 refinement stage. These components correspond to local context stabilization, bad-sample removal, and global semantic-temporal correction, respectively, so they are the natural places to inspect where the quality gains actually come from.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and focus on the failure mode of using raw ASR supervision for long-horizon video learning. Then read the pipeline figure and the sections on segmentation, candidate generation, and refinement. The key question is not which frontier models were used, but why the pipeline is split into local multimodal grounding and global reasoning-based consolidation. That design choice is the main transferable idea. In the experiments, prioritize the DenseCaption100 quality evaluation before looking at downstream fine-tuning results. If reading time is limited, the pipeline overview, the annotation quality table, and the ablations on filtering/refinement are enough to capture the paper’s value in about 20 to 30 minutes. For a pretraining reader, two follow-up questions are worth keeping in mind: whether the gains come more from text normalization or from better temporal alignment, and whether the same relabeling recipe can be transferred to other long-sequence multimodal data such as speech, GUI trajectories, or web interaction traces.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫方法和数据质检部分；它反映了长视频预训练数据从抓取转向模型辅助清洗的工程路线。
recommendation.en: Skim the pipeline and quality-control sections; it reflects the shift from raw long-video scraping to model-assisted curation for pretraining data.

paper.title: World2VLM: Distilling World Model Imagination into VLMs for Dynamic Spatial Reasoning
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown strong performance on static visual understanding, yet they still struggle with dynamic spatial reasoning that requires imagining how scenes evolve under egocentric motion. Recent efforts address this limitation either by scaling spatial supervision with synthetic data or by coupling VLMs with world models at inference time. However, the former often lacks explicit modeling of motion-conditioned state transitions, while the latter incurs substantial compu

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是一般的图文理解，而是 VLM 在“动态空间推理”上的短板：给定当前视角和一个自运动轨迹，模型往往不能稳定推断场景会如何变化，也不能从视角变化反推出相机动作。已有两条路各有明显问题：一条是继续堆静态空间数据和合成监督，但缺少显式的动作→状态转移建模；另一条是在推理时外挂 world model 做 imagination，但代价高，而且能力没有真正写进 VLM 参数里。World2VLM 的核心问题因此很明确：能不能把 world model 作为训练期教师，把“动作条件下的视角转移规律”蒸馏进 VLM 本身，让部署时仍然只用普通 VLM 推理。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要在训练范式，而不在某个 benchmark 分数。它提出了一种很清楚的 teacher-student 路线：world model 不一定要作为在线推理模块存在，也可以作为离线数据与监督生成器，给 VLM 注入原本难以从静态图文对中学到的转移动力学先验。这个思路对原生多模态预训练和 post-train 接口都有启发：一是说明生成式环境模型可以作为高质量 supervision source，而不只是 inference-time tool；二是说明“空间 imagination”这类能力可以通过结构化任务设计和后训练强化被内化，而不是永远依赖外部系统。量级上，它更像一个有方法论价值的后训练框架，而不是改写 VLM 预训练主范式的工作。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由三部分组成。第一部分是 transition construction。作者从锚点观测 s_t 出发，采样参数化的 egocentric action a_t，用可控 world model 生成动作后的未来视图 s_{t+1}^{WM}。文中强调 teacher 可以替换，实验里用了 Stable Virtual Camera 和 HY-WorldPlay 两类 world model，目的是验证监督信号并不强依赖某一个生成器。关键不只是生成新图，而是把“源视图—动作—目标视图”组织成几何一致、动作语义明确的转移样本。

第二部分是 bidirectional spatial supervision。作者没有只做单向的 action→future view 预测，而是同时构造 forward 和 inverse 两类任务。forward spatial reasoning 要求模型根据当前观测和动作，预测未来视角下的结果；inverse spatial reasoning 则要求模型根据前后视图恢复导致变化的动作。这个设计抓住了动态空间理解的两个面向：一是识别 latent transition，二是把 transition 向未来传播。相比只做 caption 或 QA，这种任务化监督更接近“状态转移建模”。

第三部分是两阶段 post-training。先做 SFT，让模型学会在结构化空间任务上输出稳定答案；再做 task-aware GRPO refinement，进一步优化结构化空间输出。这里的 GRPO 不是泛泛地加 RL，而是围绕空间任务的正确性信号做强化，使模型在离散动作、视角变化、结果描述上更稳。作者的立场很明确：SFT 负责把 teacher signal 写进模型，GRPO 负责 sharpen 决策边界和输出格式。

从方法取舍看，这篇工作刻意避开了 test-time coupling。原因不是 world model 没用，而是在线耦合会把推理成本、系统复杂度和误差传播都带进部署阶段。World2VLM 选择把 world model 的价值前移到训练期，用一次性蒸馏换部署时的简单性。这一点对多模态基座训练很重要。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 SAT-Real、SAT-Synthesized、VSI-Bench、MindCube 四个带明显动态或视角变化属性的 benchmark。论文主结论是：相对 base Qwen2.5-VL，World2VLM 在四个数据集上都有一致提升；在 SFT 之上再加 GRPO，还能继续提升。作者还把它和一种 MindJourney 风格的 test-time world-model-coupled baseline 做比较，结果显示离线蒸馏后的单体 VLM 不仅部署更轻，而且效果更稳。

从全文可确认的实验重点有三类。第一类是 teacher ablation：使用不同 world model 作为教师，验证 gains 不是某个生成器偶然带来的。第二类是 training recipe ablation：比较 base model、SFT-only、SFT→GRPO，说明两阶段训练各自贡献。第三类是 benchmark/category analysis：在 SAT-Real 上做细粒度类别分析，提升主要集中在 egocentric movement、action consequence、perspective taking 这些真正依赖动态空间想象的子项，而不是静态识别项。这一点很关键，因为它说明模型不是单纯靠更强视觉识别拿分。

需要说明的是，给出的全文片段没有完整表格和全部数字，因此无法可靠抄出每个 benchmark 的精确分数、样本规模和训练 token 量。能确定的硬信息包括：学生模型基座是 Qwen2.5-VL；训练包含 SFT 和 GRPO 两阶段；教师 world model 至少包含 Stable Virtual Camera 与 HY-WorldPlay；作者声称相对先前方法 proving-style 的 test-time coupling 更有效且更省部署开销。若做精读，建议直接核对主结果表、teacher ablation 表和 SAT-Real 分类结果图，把每个数据集上的绝对提升幅度补齐。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合按“问题设定—监督构造—训练配方—误差归因”来读。

先看 Introduction，重点不是任务背景，而是作者为什么否定两条常见路线：纯数据扩充缺少动作条件转移，test-time coupling 成本高。这个判断决定了整篇方法设计。

然后看 Method 里的 Figure 2 和 transition construction 部分。这里是全文最重要的地方：样本是怎么从 anchor observation、camera trajectory 和 world model generation 变成可训练的结构化 supervision 的。如果这一段设计不严，后面的提升就可能只是数据增强而不是“蒸馏空间 imagination”。

接着看 bidirectional task suite。要特别注意 forward / inverse 两类任务的定义、输入输出格式、是否共享模板、是否有动作离散化或文本化编码。这些细节决定模型学到的是空间规律，还是只是在做模板匹配。

再看 SFT→GRPO 的 reward 设计与训练细节。这里值得深挖的问题有两个：一是 GRPO 奖励是否真正对齐空间正确性，还是主要奖励格式与关键词；二是 RL 阶段是否带来分布偏移，尤其在真实图像 benchmark 上是否比合成集更敏感。

实验部分建议优先看四类内容：主表、teacher 替换实验、SFT vs GRPO 消融、SAT-Real 细粒度类别分析。阅读时间大约 30–45 分钟可以抓住主线；如果要判断它对原生多模态预训练是否有迁移价值，需要再花时间看附录里的数据构造和 prompt 模板。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific weakness of current VLMs: dynamic spatial reasoning under egocentric motion. Standard VLMs can describe a static scene, but they often fail when asked to infer how the scene changes after a camera movement, or to recover the motion that caused a viewpoint change. Prior work mainly follows two routes: scaling synthetic spatial supervision, which still lacks explicit action-conditioned transition modeling, or coupling a VLM with a world model at inference time, which improves reasoning but adds substantial runtime cost and leaves the VLM itself unchanged. The central question here is whether a world model can act as a training-time teacher so that motion-conditioned spatial imagination is internalized into the VLM parameters.
summary_en.importance: Its value is methodological rather than benchmark-centric. The paper shows a clean teacher-student recipe where a generative world model is used offline to create structured supervision for a VLM. That matters for multimodal pretraining and the pretrain/post-train interface: world models do not have to remain external inference modules; they can become supervision generators that inject transition dynamics priors into a foundation model. The contribution is not a new pretraining objective in the narrow sense, but a practical post-training framework for transferring action-conditioned spatial structure into a deployed VLM without requiring test-time world-model calls.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three main components. First, transition construction. Starting from an anchor observation s_t, the framework samples a parameterized egocentric action a_t and uses a controllable world model to synthesize a future view s_{t+1}^{WM}. The teacher is intentionally modular; the experiments instantiate it with Stable Virtual Camera and HY-WorldPlay to test whether the supervision depends on a specific generator. The key point is not image generation alone, but the creation of geometrically aligned source-action-target triples with explicit motion semantics.

Second, bidirectional spatial supervision. Instead of training only on forward prediction, the paper builds both forward and inverse tasks. Forward spatial reasoning asks the model to infer the consequence of an action given the current observation. Inverse spatial reasoning asks it to recover the action from the before/after views. This is a sensible design choice: dynamic spatial competence requires both identifying the latent transition and propagating it to unseen future states. Compared with generic VQA-style supervision, this is much closer to learning state transitions.

Third, a two-stage post-training recipe. The model is first trained with SFT on the structured spatial tasks, then refined with task-aware GRPO. The role split is clear: SFT transfers the teacher signal into the model, while GRPO sharpens structured outputs and decision boundaries for action-conditioned reasoning. The paper does not present RL as a generic add-on; it is used to improve correctness on spatially grounded outputs.

A notable design choice is the deliberate avoidance of test-time coupling. The authors are not arguing that world models are unnecessary; rather, they move the world-model benefit into training so deployment remains a standard single-model VLM inference pipeline. That trade-off is important for scalable multimodal systems.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation covers SAT-Real, SAT-Synthesized, VSI-Bench, and MindCube, all of which contain substantial viewpoint-conditioned or dynamic spatial reasoning components. The main empirical claim is consistent improvement over the base Qwen2.5-VL model on all four benchmarks. The GRPO stage further improves over the SFT checkpoint. The paper also compares against a MindJourney-style test-time world-model-coupled baseline and reports that the distilled standalone VLM is both more effective and cheaper at deployment.

The most informative experimental axes are threefold. First, teacher ablations: different world models are used as teachers, suggesting the gains are not tied to one specific generator. Second, training-recipe ablations: base model vs SFT-only vs SFT→GRPO, which isolates the contribution of each stage. Third, fine-grained category analysis on SAT-Real: the gains are concentrated on egocentric movement, action consequence, and perspective taking, which supports the claim that the method improves motion-conditioned reasoning rather than static recognition.

The provided full-text excerpt does not include the complete result tables, so it is not safe to fabricate exact benchmark scores, sample counts, or training-scale numbers. What can be stated reliably is that the student backbone is Qwen2.5-VL, the training recipe is SFT followed by GRPO, and the teacher side includes at least Stable Virtual Camera and HY-WorldPlay. For a careful read, the main result table, teacher ablation table, and SAT-Real category breakdown are the places to extract the exact absolute gains.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it in the order of problem framing, supervision construction, training recipe, and error attribution.

Start with the introduction, especially the argument against the two common alternatives: static data scaling without explicit transition modeling, and inference-time world-model coupling with high runtime overhead. That framing explains why the method is built the way it is.

Then move to Figure 2 and the transition-construction section. This is the core of the paper. The important question is how anchor observations, camera trajectories, and world-model generations are turned into structured supervision rather than mere data augmentation.

Next, inspect the bidirectional task suite. Pay attention to the exact definitions of forward and inverse tasks, the input/output format, and whether actions are discretized or textualized. These details determine whether the model is learning spatial regularities or just matching templates.

After that, read the SFT→GRPO section carefully. Two questions matter: whether the GRPO reward truly reflects spatial correctness rather than formatting, and whether the RL stage introduces distribution shift, especially between synthetic and real-image benchmarks.

In the experiments, prioritize the main benchmark table, teacher replacement ablations, SFT vs GRPO ablations, and the fine-grained SAT-Real analysis. Around 30–45 minutes is enough to capture the main idea. If the goal is to assess transferability to native multimodal pretraining, spend extra time on the appendix sections covering data construction and prompting templates.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是“把 world model 当教师而不是外挂模块”这个接口设计；先读训练 recipe 和对比 test-time coupling 的表，别把它误当成预训练突破。
recommendation.en: The useful idea is the interface: treat the world model as a teacher rather than a runtime plug-in; read the training recipe and the comparison against test-time coupling, but don’t mistake it for a pretraining breakthrough.

paper.title: Instruction-Evidence Contrastive Dual-Stream Decoding for Grounded Vision-Language Reasoning
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) exhibit strong performance in instruction following and open-ended vision-language reasoning, yet they frequently generate fluent outputs that are weakly grounded in visual evidence. Prior works have shown that instruction prompting further worsens this issue by amplifying language priors, especially when the visual signal is uncertain or ambiguous. To address this challenge, we propose a decoding framework that explicitly balances linguistic informativeness and vis

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 在指令跟随时语言先验过强、输出流畅但缺乏视觉证据支撑的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏解码层方法改进，不是预训练范式创新；但它触及一个真实问题：instruction tuning 可能削弱 grounded generation，这对多模态后训练与评测有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 IECD2，在每个解码步维护 instruction-driven 与 evidence-driven 两个 token 分布，并用基于对称 KL 的对比门控自适应融合，抑制被语言先验偏好但缺乏图像支持的 token。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模与具体 benchmark；从设定看应在 grounded VQA/视觉推理类任务上，对比标准解码与可能的对比解码变体，关注 grounding 与回答质量的平衡。
summary.authors_note: 印度理工学院 Kharagpur 的工作，作者与机构在 VLM 方向有一定学术背景，但不属于顶级实验室范式型输出。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the tendency of VLMs to produce fluent but weakly grounded outputs when instruction following amplifies language priors.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a decoding-time method rather than a pretraining innovation, but it touches a real issue: instruction tuning can hurt grounding, which matters for multimodal post-training and evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: IECD2 keeps two token distributions at each decoding step—an instruction-driven stream and an evidence-driven stream—and adaptively fuses them with a symmetric-KL contrastive gate to suppress tokens unsupported by the image.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model scale or exact benchmarks; the setup likely evaluates grounded VQA or visual reasoning tasks against standard decoding and contrastive decoding baselines, focusing on the trade-off between grounding and response quality.
summary_en.authors_note: A paper from IIT Kharagpur; academically relevant in VLMs, but not a paradigm-setting output from a top lab.

recommendation.zh: 这是典型 decoding patch，不会改写 pretrain prior；若你做 VLM 对齐，只看双流门控和 grounding 指标定义即可。
recommendation.en: A classic decoding patch, not something that changes pretraining priors; if you work on VLM alignment, just inspect the dual-stream gate and grounding metrics.

paper.title: HuM-Eval: A Coarse-to-Fine Framework for Human-Centric Video Evaluation
paper.abstract: Video generation models have developed rapidly in recent years, where generating natural human motion plays a pivotal role. However, accurately evaluating the quality of generated human motion video remains a significant challenge. Existing evaluation metrics primarily focus on global scene statistics, often overlooking fine-grained human details and consequently failing to align with human subjective preference. To bridge this gap, we propose HuM-Eval, a novel human-centric evaluation framework

summary.core_problem: 视频生成模型中人体动作质量很关键，但现有视频指标偏向全局场景统计，不能细致评估人体结构、姿态和运动稳定性。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是视频生成评测框架和 benchmark。它把人类主观偏好中的人体因素拆成全局质量、解剖正确性和三维运动稳定性，适合评估人物视频生成。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 HuM-Eval 粗到细评估框架：先用 VLM 做全局视频质量粗评，再用 2D pose 检查人体解剖正确性，并用 3D human motion 表征评估运动稳定性；同时引入 HuM-Bench 作为配套 benchmark。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告 HuM-Eval 与人类偏好的平均相关性达到 58.2%，优于已有 baseline；未给出 benchmark 规模、模型列表或各子指标的详细提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自中国人民大学高瓴人工智能学院。摘要中没有显示知名 LLM 预训练团队或代表性基础模型工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses evaluation of human-centric video generation, where global video statistics often miss anatomical plausibility and motion stability.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an evaluation framework and benchmark for generated human-motion videos. It decomposes subjective quality into global quality, anatomical correctness, and 3D motion stability.
summary_en.technical_approach: HuM-Eval follows a coarse-to-fine design: a VLM first assesses global video quality, then 2D pose checks anatomical correctness, and 3D human-motion estimation evaluates temporal stability. HuM-Bench is introduced as the associated benchmark.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports an average human-correlation score of 58.2%, outperforming existing baselines. It does not provide benchmark size, evaluated model lists, or detailed per-component gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the Gaoling School of Artificial Intelligence, Renmin University of China. No direct foundation-model pretraining team signal is visible from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 对基座训练只提供评测侧弱信号；看相关性实验即可，方法本身偏人物视频生成质检。
recommendation.en: For pretraining work this is weakly relevant; the human-correlation study is the useful part, while the method is mostly video-generation QA.

paper.title: Aligned Multi-View Scripts for Universal Chart-to-Code Generation
paper.abstract: Chart-to-code generation converts a chart image into an executable plotting script, enabling faithful reproduction and editable visualizations. Existing methods are largely Python-centric, limiting practical use and overlooking a critical source of supervision: the same chart can be expressed by semantically equivalent scripts in different plotting languages. To fill this gap, we introduce Chart2NCode, a dataset of 176K charts paired with aligned scripts in Python, R, and LaTeX that render visua

summary.core_problem: 解决 chart image 到可执行绘图代码生成时过度依赖 Python、缺少多语言等价监督的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是数据和轻量适配方法：Chart2NCode 提供 176K 图表及 Python、R、LaTeX 对齐脚本，能支持更贴近实际编辑需求的 chart-to-code 评测与训练。
summary.technical_approach: 数据侧用 metadata-to-template 流水线生成多语言脚本，并通过渲染验证和人工质检保证视觉等价；模型侧基于 LLaVA 风格架构，提出 CharLuMA，在多模态 projector 上加入语言条件的低秩子空间混合，让共享视觉理解和目标绘图库/语言专门化解耦。
summary.experiments: 摘要称进行了广泛实验，但未给出完整模型规模、训练 token、baseline 名称或提升幅度；可确认的是任务覆盖 Python、R、LaTeX 三种输出语言，并围绕视觉等价的 chart reproduction 评估。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Singapore Management University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets chart-to-code generation beyond Python-only settings, where the same chart should be reproducible as executable scripts in multiple plotting languages.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is a dataset and adaptation contribution: Chart2NCode contains 176K charts aligned with visually equivalent Python, R, and LaTeX scripts, enabling multi-language supervision for editable chart reconstruction.
summary_en.technical_approach: The dataset is built with a metadata-to-template pipeline, rendering verification, and human quality checks. The model, CharLuMA, follows a LLaVA-style design and adds a language-conditioned mixture of low-rank subspaces to the multimodal projector, sharing chart understanding while routing generation toward the target language.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports extensive experiments but does not expose model sizes, data scale beyond the dataset, named baselines, or numeric gains. The confirmed setup evaluates chart reproduction across Python, R, and LaTeX.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Singapore Management University.

recommendation.zh: 作为 VLM 到结构化代码输出的数据点可扫，CharLuMA 更像任务适配模块，不会改变预训练侧 prior。
recommendation.en: Worth a glance as a VLM-to-structured-code data point; CharLuMA is task adaptation rather than a pretraining-level idea.

paper.title: Grounding Before Generalizing: How AI Differs from Humans in Causal Transfer
paper.abstract: Extracting abstract causal structures and applying them to novel situations is a hallmark of human intelligence. While Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong performance on a wide range of reasoning tasks, their capacity for interactive causal learning -- inducing latent structures through sequential exploration and transferring them across contexts -- remains uncharacterized. Human learners accomplish such transfer after minimal exposure, whereas classi

summary.core_problem: 验证当前前沿大语言模型和视觉语言模型是否具备人类级别的交互式因果结构迁移能力，即通过主动探索归纳潜在因果结构并跨场景迁移的能力，这一问题此前未在交互式决策场景下得到系统验证。
summary.importance: 揭示了当前预训练模型因果表征的核心缺陷：现有预训练习得的因果知识属于符号关联类型，而非真正的结构抽象，为后续预训练阶段引入因果结构归纳目标、提升模型泛化能力提供了明确的问题方向。
summary.technical_approach: 改编原本用于对比人类与强化学习智能体表现的OpenLock基准测试范式，对4款前沿模型（GPT-5.2、Claude-4.5-Sonnet、Gemini-3-Flash、DeepSeek-V3.2）开展测试，设置纯文本、纯图像、图文结合三种输入模态，对比模型与人类在单环境因果发现效率、输入模态对推理的影响、跨环境结构迁移三个维度的表现差异。
summary.experiments: 核心实验结果：1. 纯文本场景下，模型的单环境因果发现效率与人类持平或更高；2. 加入视觉输入的场景中模型性能反而下降，说明当前视觉语言模型依赖符号处理逻辑，而非真正的多模态融合推理；3. 人类进入新环境后首次尝试即可利用此前学到的因果结构获得正向迁移，所有测试模型均不具备该能力，必须在新环境中先独立找到至少一个解才会出现效率提升，符合事后环境对齐的特征，而非真正的结构抽象；4. 模型在共因、共果两类因果结构上表现出人类没有的性能不对称性，说明其依赖预训练阶段习得的启发式偏差，而非方向中立的因果表征。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看引言部分的因果迁移问题定义、实验章节的三个核心结论，预计阅读时间15分钟，不需要深入研究OpenLock范式的具体实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: It verifies whether state-of-the-art LLMs and VLMs have human-level interactive causal structure transfer capability, which refers to inducing latent causal structures through active exploration and transferring such structures across contexts. This capability has not been systematically tested in interactive decision-making scenarios before.
summary_en.importance: It reveals core defects of causal representations in current pre-trained models: causal knowledge learned from pre-training is symbolic and associative, rather than genuine structural abstraction. It provides a clear problem direction for introducing causal structure induction objectives in the pre-training stage to improve model generalization.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work adapts the OpenLock benchmark paradigm originally designed to compare causal transfer performance between humans and RL agents. It tests four frontier models (GPT-5.2, Claude-4.5-Sonnet, Gemini-3-Flash, DeepSeek-V3.2) under three input modalities (text-only, image-only, text+image), and compares performance between models and humans across three dimensions: single-environment causal discovery efficiency, impact of input modality on reasoning, and cross-environment structure transfer.
summary_en.experiments: Key findings: 1. In text-only settings, model single-environment causal discovery efficiency matches or exceeds human performance; 2. Model performance degrades when visual input is added, indicating current VLMs rely on symbolic processing rather than genuine multimodal fusion reasoning; 3. Humans show positive transfer from the first attempt when entering a new environment by leveraging previously learned causal structures, while none of the tested models demonstrate this capability: efficiency gains only appear after models independently find at least one solution in the new context, consistent with post-hoc environmental grounding rather than real structural abstraction; 4. Models show performance asymmetry between Common Cause and Common Effect causal structures that is absent in human learners, indicating they rely on heuristic biases encoded during pre-training rather than direction-agnostic causal representations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the causal transfer problem definition in the Introduction section and three core experimental conclusions. Estimated reading time is 15 minutes, no need to dive into detailed implementation of the OpenLock paradigm.

recommendation.zh: 应读实验设计和错误类型；它把“会答因果题”和“能交互归纳因果结构”切开，能校准 reasoning eval。
recommendation.en: Read the experimental setup and error taxonomy; it cleanly separates answering causal questions from interactively inducing causal structure.

paper.title: Foveated Reasoning: Stateful, Action-based Visual Focusing for Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-language models benefit from high-resolution images, but the increase in visual-token count incurs high compute overhead. Humans resolve this tension via foveation: a coarse view guides "where to look", while selectively acquired high-acuity evidence refines "what to think". We introduce Foveated Reasoner, an autoregressive vision-language framework that unifies foveation and reasoning within a single decoding trajectory. Starting from a low-resolution view, the model triggers foveation o

summary.core_problem: VLM 需要高分辨率才能看清细节，但视觉 token 数随分辨率上升导致注意力计算爆炸。现有“视觉聚焦/放大”方法要么多次跑模型（multi-pass，状态被打断、成本高），要么用文本坐标/工具调用表达注视点（token 开销大、格式脆弱）。论文要解决的是：能否把“决定看哪里”和“基于看到的证据推理”放进同一条自回归解码轨迹里，用非语言动作完成 stateful 的证据获取。
summary.importance:
对预训练研究的相关性偏间接，但对多模态基座的训练范式有启发：
- 把“视觉证据获取”显式建模为动作序列（policy），并与文本生成共享同一隐藏状态，这更接近可微/可学习的感知-推理闭环，而不是外部多轮调用。
- 两阶段训练（coldstart 监督 + RL）提供了一种把离散动作（选区域、取高分辨率 crop）纳入训练的工程路径，和当前 VLM 的 tool-use / agentic perception 有接口。
如果你的关注点是纯预训练目标与数据配比，这篇更像架构/训练流程的参考；如果做原生多模态、长上下文视觉 token 成本控制，它更实用。
summary.technical_approach:
Foveated Reasoner（FoveateR）的核心是“单次、自回归、状态连续”的 foveation：
1) 输入从低分辨率全局视图开始，先用少量视觉 token 建立粗理解。
2) 在生成过程中，模型可以触发一个非语言的 foveation action（类似眼跳），选择若干区域去请求高分辨率证据。
3) 系统从原图裁剪/提取对应高分辨率 patch，并把这些高分辨率视觉 token 注入回同一条解码轨迹（不重启模型、不重新跑一遍完整 forward），从而保持隐藏状态连续。

对比已有两类方法：
- multi-pass：每次 zoom 都要重新跑一遍 VLM，推理状态被重置；
- text-grounded：用坐标字符串/特殊 token 表达区域，既占 token 又容易格式错。
FoveateR 把“看哪里”从文本通道移到动作通道，减少 token 负担，也避免坐标解析脆弱性。

训练：两阶段。
- coldstart：用监督信号先教会模型基本的 foveation 行为（论文强调不需要人工标注的 foveation 轨迹，通常意味着用启发式/自动生成的区域监督或从任务信号反推）。
- RL：再用强化学习联合优化“何时 zoom、zoom 哪、回答质量”，把证据获取策略和最终任务回报绑定。
summary.experiments:
论文宣称在多个基准上优于近期视觉聚焦方法，并验证：
- 在相近或更低的视觉 token/计算预算下，细粒度视觉任务准确率更高；
- 单轨迹 stateful 机制减少多次解码 pass 的开销；
- 相比文本坐标方案，输出更稳健（不依赖严格格式）。

你给的全文片段未包含实验表格与具体数字（分辨率设置、foveation 步数、token/latency 节省、各 benchmark 提升幅度）。要做可复现的量化总结需要补齐实验章节。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（30–45 分钟）：
1) 先看方法图（通常是 Figure 1/框架图）：确认“动作触发→取高分辨率证据→注入同一解码轨迹”的数据流，理解它为何不是 multi-pass。
2) 精读训练部分：coldstart 的监督信号怎么来、RL 的 action space/奖励怎么定义、是否有约束避免无意义频繁 zoom。
3) 看效率-精度曲线：同等计算预算下的提升是否来自更高分辨率 token，还是来自更好的策略。
4) 看消融：去掉 stateful 注入、改成文本坐标、改成多 pass，性能/成本如何变化。

summary_en.core_problem: High-resolution images improve VLM accuracy but explode visual-token count and attention cost. Existing visual focusing either (a) runs the model multiple times on crops (expensive and breaks reasoning continuity) or (b) encodes focus as text coordinates/tool calls (token overhead and brittle formatting). The paper aims to implement foveation as a stateful, non-linguistic action process within a single autoregressive decoding trajectory.
summary_en.importance: This is not a tokenizer/scaling-law paper, but it matters for multimodal foundation-model training as an example of making perception an explicit, learnable action policy that shares hidden state with language generation. The two-stage recipe (coldstart supervision + RL) is a practical pathway to train discrete evidence-acquisition behaviors without hand-labeled foveation trajectories, aligning with broader trends in agentic perception and tool-augmented multimodal models.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Foveated Reasoner (FoveateR) integrates focusing and reasoning in one continuous AR rollout:
1) Start from a low-res global view to keep initial visual tokens cheap.
2) During decoding, the model can emit a foveation action (non-text) that selects regions to inspect.
3) The system retrieves high-res evidence (crops/patches) from the original image and injects the resulting visual tokens back into the same decoding trajectory, preserving hidden-state continuity (no restart, no separate pass).

This avoids multi-pass recomputation and avoids text-based coordinate serialization.

Training is two-stage:
- Coldstart: supervised bootstrapping of foveation behavior (the paper claims no human-annotated foveation trajectories, implying heuristic/auto-derived supervision).
- Reinforcement learning: jointly optimize the foveation policy (when/where to zoom) and final answer quality via task reward, tying evidence acquisition to downstream success.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper reports improvements over recent visual focusing baselines across multiple benchmarks, emphasizing better accuracy under constrained compute/visual-token budgets, reduced overhead versus multi-pass approaches, and robustness versus text-coordinate methods.

The provided excerpt does not include the quantitative tables (resolutions, number of foveation steps, token/latency savings, benchmark deltas). Exact numbers require the experiments section.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 min):
1) Start with the system diagram to verify the “action → high-res retrieval → same-trajectory injection” mechanism.
2) Read the training section carefully: action space, reward design, and how coldstart supervision is generated.
3) Check accuracy–compute curves to see whether gains hold at matched budgets.
4) Review ablations that replace stateful injection with multi-pass or text coordinates to isolate what actually drives improvements.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是“把视觉取证动作并入解码轨迹”这个接口设计，不一定改变预训练范式，但若你在做 native multimodal 或 test-time compute，先看 RL 目标和 token-budget 曲线。
recommendation.en: What matters is the interface: visual evidence acquisition is folded into the decoding trajectory. It likely won't change pretraining priors by itself, but if you work on native multimodal models or test-time compute allocation, inspect the RL objective and token-budget curves first.

paper.title: Symbolic Grounding Reveals Representational Bottlenecks in Abstract Visual Reasoning
paper.abstract: Vision--language models (VLMs) often fail on abstract visual reasoning benchmarks such as Bongard problems, raising the question of whether the main bottleneck lies in reasoning or representation. We study this on Bongard-LOGO, a synthetic benchmark of abstract concept learning with ground-truth generative programs, by comparing end-to-end VLMs on raw images with large language models (LLMs) given symbolic inputs derived from those images. Using symbolic inputs as a diagnostic probe rather than

summary.core_problem: 区分抽象视觉推理失败究竟来自推理能力不足，还是来自视觉表示/符号化瓶颈。
summary.importance: 这篇的价值在诊断而不在新模型。对做 native multimodal pretrain 的人，它提供了一个很实用的判断框架：若把图像替换成结构化符号输入后性能大幅上升，那么瓶颈更可能在视觉 tokenizer、表示抽取和对齐，而不是语言侧推理器本身。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在 Bongard-LOGO 上比较两类系统：一类是端到端 VLM 直接看原始图像；另一类是先把图像转成带有 ground-truth generative programs 的符号输入，再交给 LLM 做推理。提出的 Componential-Grammatical 范式本质上是把任务重写为基于 LOGO 动作程序或结构化描述的符号推理问题，并通过输入格式、概念提示和最小视觉 grounding 做消融，定位性能来源。
summary.experiments: 在 Bongard-LOGO synthetic benchmark 上，给定符号输入的 LLM 在 Free-form 问题上达到 90% 中段准确率，而强视觉基线在匹配任务定义下接近随机。实验重点是 raw image vs symbolic input 的巨大差距，以及不同符号格式和提示方式的影响。由于这是合成基准和诊断式实验，外推到真实 VLM 仍需谨慎。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether failures on abstract visual reasoning come mainly from weak reasoning or from representational and grounding bottlenecks in the visual pipeline.
summary_en.importance: Its value is diagnostic rather than architectural. For native multimodal pretraining, it offers a useful lens: if performance jumps when raw images are replaced by structured symbolic inputs, the bottleneck is more likely in visual tokenization, representation extraction, or alignment rather than in the language-side reasoner.
summary_en.technical_approach: On Bongard-LOGO, the authors compare end-to-end VLMs operating on raw images against LLMs given symbolic inputs derived from the images using ground-truth generative programs. Their Componential-Grammatical paradigm reformulates the task as symbolic reasoning over LOGO-style action programs or structured descriptions. Ablations on input format, explicit concept prompts, and minimal visual grounding are used to localize the source of gains.
summary_en.experiments: On the synthetic Bongard-LOGO benchmark, LLMs with symbolic inputs reach mid-90s accuracy on Free-form problems, while a strong visual baseline stays near chance under matched task definitions. The key result is the large raw-image versus symbolic-input gap, plus ablations on symbolic format and prompting. Since this is a synthetic diagnostic setup, extrapolation to real-world VLMs should be cautious.

recommendation.zh: 做 VLM 预训练的人可以看这篇确认一个老问题：不少“推理失败”其实是表示失败；读实验主表和符号输入消融就够，别把合成任务结果外推过头。
recommendation.en: If you work on VLM pretraining, this is a clean reminder that many reasoning failures are really representation failures; read the main comparison and symbolic-input ablations, but do not over-extrapolate from the synthetic setup.

paper.title: Environmental Understanding Vision-Language Model for Embodied Agent
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown strong perception and reasoning abilities for instruction-following embodied agents. However, despite these abilities and their generalization performance, they still face limitations in environmental understanding, often failing on interactions or relying on environment metadata during execution. To address this challenge, we propose a novel framework named Environmental Understanding Embodied Agent (EUEA), which fine-tunes four core skills: 1) object pe

summary.core_problem: 现有VLM驱动的具身智能体在真实交互中“环境理解”不稳：要么依赖环境元数据，要么在交互成功/失败判断与目标完成判定上出错，导致执行不可靠。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是把具身执行拆成四类可监督/可对齐的“技能头”（感知、规划、动作可行性、目标识别）并加上恢复与偏好优化流程；更偏系统化后训练配方，而非预训练范式创新。
summary.technical_approach: 提出EUEA框架：对VLM进行技能化微调，覆盖(1)对象感知(找相关物体)、(2)任务规划(子目标序列)、(3)动作理解/成功率判断、(4)目标识别/完成判定；引入recovery step用这些技能做失败后的纠错；再用GRPO阶段对“技能预测不一致”进行优化以提升稳定性。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据规模、基线与量化提升幅度；仅声称在instruction-following具身任务上提升可靠执行，并减少对环境元数据依赖。

summary_en.core_problem: VLM-driven embodied agents often fail at robust environmental understanding during interaction, either relying on environment metadata or making wrong judgments about action success and goal completion.
summary_en.importance: The work is mainly a systematized post-training recipe: decomposing execution into four trainable skill heads plus recovery and preference-style optimization, rather than a new pretraining paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach: EUEA fine-tunes a VLM on four skills: object perception, task planning (interaction subgoals), action understanding (success likelihood), and goal recognition (completion). It adds a recovery step leveraging these skills and a GRPO stage to reduce inconsistencies among skill predictions.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model/data scale, baselines, or quantitative gains; it claims improved reliability on instruction-following embodied tasks and reduced reliance on environment metadata.

recommendation.zh: 更像“具身VLM的技能拆分+GRPO配方”，对预训练启发有限；只需看技能分解与GRPO如何定义一致性信号。
recommendation.en: Mostly a skill-decomposition + GRPO post-training recipe for embodied VLMs; limited pretraining insight—skim how they define and optimize cross-skill consistency.

paper.title: EmbodiedMidtrain: Bridging the Gap between Vision-Language Models and Vision-Language-Action Models via Mid-training
paper.abstract: Vision-Language-Action Models (VLAs) inherit their visual and linguistic capabilities from Vision-Language Models (VLMs), yet most VLAs are built from off-the-shelf VLMs that are not adapted to the embodied domain, limiting their downstream performance. In this work, we propose EmbodiedMidtrain to bridge the gap between VLMs and VLAs. We first characterize the data distribution gap between them, showing that VLA data occupy compact regions that are largely separated from the broader VLM distribu

summary.core_problem: 现有视觉语言动作模型（VLA）大多采用通用预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）作为骨干网络，VLM预训练数据分布和VLA所用的机器人交互轨迹数据分布存在显著差异，直接微调VLM无法有效适配具身场景，限制了VLA的下游性能。
summary.importance: 验证了中期训练（mid-training）在跨领域模型初始化中的价值，提出的数据选择方法可以较低成本提升VLA的初始适配性，对多模态预训练到下游垂直领域适配的流程优化有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出EmbodiedMidtrain框架，首先训练一个轻量 proximity 估计器，在冻结的VLM特征上做二分类区分VLA和VLM数据，输出的分数作为每个VLM样本与VLA域的对齐度；从大规模VLM数据池中选出对齐度最高的样本组成中期训练数据集，用该数据集对VLM做中期训练后，再作为VLA微调的初始化。该方法不需要修改VLM或VLA的架构，可扩展性强。
