summary.experiments: 在Calvin ABC-D、SimplerEnv Bridge、Libero-10三个具身机器人基准上测试，1.1B参数的中期训练后模型获得显著性能提升；筛选出的数据集可跨架构迁移，用InternVL3.5-1B选出的数据集在Qwen3VL-2B上也能获得一致提升；学习得到的proximity估计器效果优于人工设计的特征空间距离、困惑度等指标；中期训练的优势从微调初期就存在，且随训练进程差距逐渐扩大，说明其提供了更优的初始化而非临时领先。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注数据分布差异分析、proximity估计器设计和跨架构迁移实验部分，预计阅读时间25分钟，无需深挖机器人任务的具体评测细节，优先关注中期训练的数据选择逻辑和效果。

summary_en.core_problem: Most Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models use off-the-shelf general-purpose Vision-Language Model (VLM) backbones, which have a significant distribution gap between VLM pretraining data and VLA robotic interaction trajectory data. Direct fine-tuning of VLMs cannot effectively adapt to embodied scenarios, limiting downstream VLA performance.
summary_en.importance: It validates the value of mid-training for cross-domain model initialization. The proposed data selection method improves VLA initialization adaptability at low cost, which provides reference for optimizing the pipeline from multimodal pretraining to vertical domain adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The EmbodiedMidtrain framework is proposed. First, a lightweight proximity estimator is trained to classify VLA and VLM data on frozen VLM features, and the output score is used as the alignment degree between each VLM sample and the VLA domain. The highest-aligned samples are selected from a large VLM pool to form a mid-training dataset, which is used to mid-train the VLM before VLA fine-tuning. No architectural changes to VLMs or VLAs are required, and the pipeline is scalable.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted on three embodied robot benchmarks: Calvin ABC-D, SimplerEnv Bridge, and Libero-10. The 1.1B parameter mid-trained model achieves significant performance gains. The curated dataset transfers across architectures: the mixture selected with InternVL3.5-1B also brings consistent gains on Qwen3VL-2B. The learned proximity estimator outperforms hand-crafted metrics like feature space distance and perplexity. The advantage of mid-training emerges from the earliest fine-tuning steps and widens over time, indicating it provides a fundamentally better initialization rather than a transient head start.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the data distribution gap analysis, proximity estimator design, and cross-architecture transfer experiments. Estimated reading time is 25 minutes. No need to dive into specific evaluation details of robotic tasks, prioritize the data selection logic and effect of mid-training.

recommendation.zh: 将 mid-training 概念引入具身 VLA 领域，其数据筛选引擎（proximity estimator）的设计对跨域数据混合有一定参考价值，建议关注其数据分布差异的量化分析部分。
recommendation.en: Introduces mid-training to embodied VLAs; the design of the proximity estimator for data filtering offers insights for cross-domain data mixing. The quantitative analysis of distribution gaps is worth skimming.

institutions: Language Technologies Institute, Carnegie Mellon University
Bosch Research North America & Bosch Center for Artificial Intelligence (BCAI)

paper.title: Do Vision-Language Models Truly Perform Vision Reasoning? A Rigorous Study of the Modality Gap
paper.abstract: Reasoning in vision-language models (VLMs) has recently attracted significant attention due to its broad applicability across diverse downstream tasks. However, it remains unclear whether the superior performance of VLMs stems from genuine vision-grounded reasoning or relies predominantly on the reasoning capabilities of their textual backbones. To systematically measure this, we introduce CrossMath, a novel multimodal reasoning benchmark designed for controlled cross-modal comparisons. Specific

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要回答一个很直接但过去常被混在一起的问题：当前 VLM 在所谓“视觉推理”任务上的表现，到底来自真正基于视觉输入的推理，还是主要来自其语言骨干本身的文本推理能力。作者认为，现有 benchmark 大多没有把这两件事严格拆开，因此高分并不能说明模型真的会做 vision-grounded reasoning。论文的核心工作就是构造一个信息严格等价的跨模态评测框架，定量测出 text-only、image-only、image+text 三种输入下的能力差异，也就是所谓 modality gap。
summary.importance: 从基座研究视角看，这篇工作更像一篇高质量评测论文，而不是新模型方法。它的重要性在于把一个长期模糊的问题做成了可测量对象：如果 image+text 还不如 text-only，说明视觉分支并没有稳定地把信息转成可被推理利用的表示，甚至可能引入噪声。这对多模态预训练、模态对齐、视觉 token 设计、post-training 数据构造都有直接启发。对纯 LLM 预训练本身的影响有限，但对“统一模态是否真的统一了推理”这个问题有很强的诊断价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上最关键的是 benchmark 设计，而不是某个复杂算法。作者提出 CrossMath：任务是 2D 网格中的交叉数学方程填空，模型需要按顺序预测缺失数值。这个任务被选中的原因很明确：它天然依赖二维空间布局、局部约束传播和多步 deduction，因此比普通 OCR 或图文问答更接近真正的视觉推理。

CrossMath 的设计有三个约束。第一，vision-first：问题本身需要空间和几何式的布局理解，而不是只靠语言先验。第二，difficulty stratification：通过程序化生成控制网格大小、缺失方程数量、运算符复杂度，形成不同难度层级，避免任务太简单导致模型都饱和，或者太难导致全都接近随机。第三，也是最关键的一点，cross-modal equivalence：每道题都被构造成 image-only、text-only markdown table、image+text 三个版本，并保证任务相关信息完全一致，评测集还经过人工核验。这样，模态间性能差异就可以更可信地归因于模型的模态推理能力，而不是信息不对称。

在方法贡献上，论文还做了一个小型干预实验：用仅图像输入的 CrossMath 训练集，对 Qwen3.5-9B 做 SFT 和 GRPO 后训练，观察是否能缩小 modality gap。这里的意义不在于提出新的 RL 算法，而在于验证“视觉推理差距是否可通过针对性 post-training 被修复”，以及这种修复会不会伤害原有能力。
summary.experiments:
实验结论很清楚，也有些反直觉。第一，多个先进 VLM 在 CrossMath 上普遍呈现 text-only 最好、image+text 次之、image-only 最差的排序。也就是说，加入视觉输入并没有稳定带来增益，反而常常拖累表现。这直接支持了论文的核心判断：当前模型更多是在借助语言骨干做推理，而不是在视觉表征上完成推理。

第二，作者构建了三档难度的数据集，包含 5,000 条训练样本和 250 条评测样本，评测集由人工验证三种模态形式的信息等价。这个规模不算大，但对于高控制变量的诊断 benchmark 是合理的，重点在于严格性而不是覆盖面。

第三，后训练实验显示，针对 image-only 输入做 SFT 和 GRPO 能显著提升视觉推理表现，并有效缩小不同模态之间的性能差距。论文还报告了 OOD 评测：这种后训练没有明显破坏模型原有能力，并且在外部视觉数学任务上也有一致增益。这个结果说明 modality gap 不是完全由架构上限决定，至少部分来自训练分布和后训练目标不匹配。

从全文逻辑推断，值得重点看的消融包括：不同难度下 gap 是否扩大；image+text 为何不升反降，是视觉噪声、跨模态对齐不足，还是 decoder 更偏向文本通道；以及 SFT 与 GRPO 各自带来的增益差异。如果这些分析做得扎实，这篇 benchmark 的解释力会比单纯 leaderboard 更强。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，但要认真看 benchmark 设计细节。先看 Introduction 和任务定义，确认作者为什么认为现有多模态 benchmark 不能隔离视觉推理。然后重点看 CrossMath 的构造方式：三种模态版本如何保证信息完全一致，难度如何程序化控制，人工核验做到了什么程度。接着看主结果表，尤其是 text-only、image-only、image+text 的相对排序，以及不同模型、不同难度上的变化。

如果只花 30 分钟，建议看任务示例图、数据构造流程、主结果表和 post-training 结果。若要深挖，最值得思考的是两个问题：第一，image+text 退化说明了什么，是视觉编码质量问题，还是多模态融合时语言通道压制了视觉通道；第二，为什么只用 image-only 数据做后训练反而能补上 gap，这对多模态预训练阶段的数据配比和训练目标设计有什么反推意义。这两个问题和基座模型训练更相关。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a clean evaluation question: when modern VLMs perform well on so-called visual reasoning tasks, are they actually reasoning over visual inputs, or are they mostly relying on the reasoning ability of their language backbone? The authors argue that existing benchmarks usually entangle modalities or leak textual priors, so strong scores do not isolate genuine vision-grounded reasoning. Their goal is to build a controlled benchmark where text-only, image-only, and image+text versions contain the same task-relevant information, making the modality gap measurable rather than anecdotal.
summary_en.importance: For foundation-model research, this is primarily an evaluation contribution, but an important one. It turns a vague concern into a controlled measurement: if image+text underperforms text-only, then the visual pathway is not reliably contributing usable reasoning signal and may even inject noise. That has direct implications for multimodal pretraining, modality alignment, visual tokenization, and post-training data design. It is less central to core LLM pretraining than to multimodal foundation modeling, but it is highly relevant as a diagnostic study of whether unified models actually unify reasoning across modalities.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The main contribution is the benchmark design, CrossMath, rather than a new model architecture. The task is a 2D grid of intersecting mathematical equations with missing values, and the model must infer the missing numbers in sequence. This task is chosen because it naturally requires spatial layout understanding, local constraint propagation, and multi-step deduction, making it more suitable for probing visual reasoning than standard OCR-heavy or text-biased multimodal tasks.

CrossMath is built around three design principles. First, the task is vision-first: optimal performance should depend on reasoning over spatial structure rather than exploiting language priors. Second, difficulty is stratified through procedural generation by varying grid size, number of missing equations, and operator complexity, so the benchmark can separate models across scales and avoid ceiling or floor effects. Third, and most importantly, each puzzle is instantiated in three strictly equivalent formats: image-only, text-only as a markdown table, and image+text. The evaluation set is manually verified for cross-modal information equivalence. This is the key methodological move, because it allows performance differences to be attributed to modality-specific reasoning rather than missing information.

The paper also includes a targeted intervention: Qwen3.5-9B is post-trained on image-only CrossMath data using SFT and GRPO. This is not presented as a new RL method; its role is to test whether the observed modality gap is trainable away and whether improving visual reasoning harms the model’s existing capabilities.
summary_en.experiments:
The main empirical result is clear and somewhat uncomfortable for current VLMs: across strong models, text-only performs best, image+text is worse, and image-only is worst. In other words, adding visual input does not reliably help and often hurts. This directly supports the paper’s central claim that current VLMs lean heavily on textual reasoning rather than robust visual reasoning.

The benchmark itself contains three difficulty levels, with 5,000 training samples and 250 evaluation samples. The evaluation split is manually checked to ensure that the three modality versions are information-equivalent. The dataset is not large by pretraining standards, but that is not the point; the value lies in control and interpretability.

The post-training results are also important. SFT and GRPO on image-only CrossMath data significantly improve visual reasoning performance and reduce the gap across modalities. The paper further reports out-of-distribution evaluations showing that this targeted post-training preserves the model’s original capabilities and transfers to external vision-based math tasks. That suggests the modality gap is not purely an architectural ceiling; at least part of it comes from training objectives and data distributions that undertrain visual reasoning.

The most useful analyses to inspect are likely difficulty-wise breakdowns of the gap, why image+text degrades relative to text-only, and the relative contributions of SFT versus GRPO. If those sections are solid, the benchmark offers more than a leaderboard; it becomes a useful probe of multimodal training failure modes.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper, but the benchmark construction deserves careful attention. Start with the introduction and task setup to see why the authors think prior multimodal benchmarks fail to isolate visual reasoning. Then read the CrossMath construction details: how the three modality versions are made strictly equivalent, how difficulty is controlled procedurally, and how human verification is used. After that, go straight to the main result tables, especially the ranking among text-only, image-only, and image+text across models and difficulty levels.

If you only have half an hour, read the task examples, dataset construction section, the main comparison table, and the post-training results. The deeper questions worth carrying forward are: what exactly does image+text degradation reveal about multimodal fusion, and why does image-only post-training help close the gap without damaging general capability? Those are the parts most relevant to future multimodal pretraining and alignment design.

recommendation.zh: VLM模态能力评估的控制变量设计严谨，可参考其思路设计多模态预训练的消融实验
recommendation.en: The control variable design of VLM modality capability evaluation is rigorous, can refer to its idea for designing multimodal pretraining ablation experiments

paper.title: Aligning What Vision-Language Models See and Perceive with Adaptive Information Flow
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong capability in a wide range of tasks such as visual recognition, document parsing, and visual grounding. Nevertheless, recent work shows that while VLMs often manage to capture the correct image region corresponding to the question, they do not necessarily produce the correct answers. In this work, we demonstrate that this misalignment could be attributed to suboptimal information flow within VLMs, where text tokens distribute too much attent

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 在已关注到正确图像区域时仍答错的问题，论文将其归因于解码阶段文本到视觉的信息流分配不佳。
summary.importance: 这类工作对基座预训练不是直接贡献，但对理解 VLM 推理失败模式有一定价值：它把错误从“没看见”区分为“看见了但被无关视觉 token 干扰”。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出一种基于 token dynamics 的推理时调制方法：根据视觉 token 在解码过程中的动态行为估计其重要性，抑制无关视觉 token 对文本 token 的注意力影响，从而改善感知与回答一致性。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模和数据集，但应是在多个 VLM 基准上比较原始解码与信息流调制后的问答/grounding 表现。由于是 inference-time intervention，结论更像诊断与补丁，而非训练范式变化。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the case where VLMs attend to the right image regions yet still answer incorrectly, attributing the issue to suboptimal information flow during decoding.
summary_en.importance: This is not a direct pretraining contribution, but it is somewhat useful for understanding VLM failure modes: the problem may be not 'not seeing' but 'seeing the right region and still being distracted by irrelevant visual tokens.'
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes an inference-time token-dynamics method that estimates visual token importance from decoding dynamics and modulates cross-modal information flow so text tokens rely more on relevant visual tokens.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes or datasets, but the evaluation is likely on several VLM benchmarks comparing vanilla decoding against the proposed information-flow modulation. Since it is an inference-time intervention, the result is more diagnostic/patch-like than a training paradigm shift.

recommendation.zh: 想看 VLM 为何“定位对了但答案错了”，这篇有诊断价值；但它更像推理补丁，不会改变预训练侧的主线判断。
recommendation.en: Useful if you care about the 'grounded correctly but answered wrongly' failure mode in VLMs, but treat it as an inference patch rather than a pretraining-level insight.

paper.title: Learning Adaptive Reasoning Paths for Efficient Visual Reasoning
paper.abstract: Visual reasoning models (VRMs) have recently shown strong cross-modal reasoning capabilities by integrating visual perception with language reasoning. However, they often suffer from overthinking, producing unnecessarily long reasoning chains for any tasks. We attribute this issue to Reasoning Path Redundancy in visual reasoning: many visual questions do not require the full reasoning process. To address this, we propose AVR, an adaptive visual reasoning framework that decomposes visual reasonin

summary.core_problem: 解决视觉推理模型在简单样本上也生成冗长推理链、导致 token 浪费和推理低效的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个后训练式的推理效率工作，贡献点在于把视觉推理拆成不同认知功能，并让模型自适应选择推理格式。对预训练研究员的价值主要在于：它提供了一个关于“何时不该推理过度”的可操作训练信号。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AVR 框架，将视觉推理分为视觉感知、逻辑推理、答案应用三类功能，并允许模型在 Full Format、Perception-Only Format、Direct Answer 三种输出格式间动态选择。训练上使用 FS-GRPO，这是对 GRPO 的改造，目标是在保持正确率的同时鼓励更短、更合适的推理路径。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明在多个视觉语言 benchmark 上评测，核心结果是显著减少 token 使用，同时保持正确性；但给出的摘要片段未包含具体模型规模、训练数据量、baseline 名称和精确提升幅度，因此目前只能判断其重点是 inference-time reasoning efficiency，而非基础建模能力提升。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the tendency of visual reasoning models to produce unnecessarily long reasoning chains even for easy examples, wasting tokens and inference budget.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training style efficiency paper. Its main value is the idea of decomposing visual reasoning into cognitive functions and training the model to choose the minimal sufficient reasoning format. For pretraining researchers, the useful signal is about when explicit reasoning is unnecessary.
summary_en.technical_approach: AVR decomposes visual reasoning into visual perception, logical reasoning, and answer application, and lets the model choose among three response formats: Full Format, Perception-Only Format, and Direct Answer. Training uses FS-GRPO, an adaptation of GRPO that rewards efficient reasoning-path selection while preserving correctness.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract says AVR is evaluated on multiple vision-language benchmarks and substantially reduces token usage while maintaining accuracy. However, the provided abstract fragment does not include model sizes, training scale, named baselines, or exact gains, so the main takeaway is inference-time reasoning efficiency rather than a foundation-model capability shift.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练论文，但“按题目难度选择推理格式”这个信号值得借到后训练里；只看方法段和效率-准确率权衡图就够了。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the idea of selecting reasoning format by task difficulty is worth borrowing into post-training; read the method and the efficiency–accuracy tradeoff figures only.

paper.title: Boosting Visual Instruction Tuning with Self-Supervised Guidance
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) perform well on many vision-language tasks but often struggle with vision-centric problems that require fine-grained visual reasoning. Recent evidence suggests that this limitation arises not from weak visual representations, but from under-utilization of visual information during instruction tuning, where many tasks can be partially solved using language priors alone. We propose a simple and lightweight approach that augments visual instruction tuning wi

summary.core_problem: 如何解决多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在指令微调阶段因过度依赖语言先验而导致细粒度视觉推理能力不足的问题？
summary.importance: 数据构造创新。揭示了 VLM 视觉能力不足的瓶颈在于指令微调阶段的数据利用率，而非视觉表征本身，并提供了一种极低成本的无监督数据增强方案。
summary.technical_approach: 将经典的自监督视觉任务（如旋转预测、颜色匹配、跨视图对应）转化为自然语言指令形式的“图像-指令-响应”三元组，强制模型在微调时必须依赖视觉证据而非语言先验。
summary.experiments: 无需人工标注、无需修改架构或增加额外训练阶段。在多个模型上验证了该自监督引导方法能有效提升视觉中心任务的性能。
summary.authors_note: Sorbonne University 与 Valeo.ai 合作工作，Nicolas Thome 和 Spyros Gidaris 在计算机视觉领域有深厚积累。

summary_en.core_problem: How to overcome the poor fine-grained visual reasoning in MLLMs caused by their over-reliance on language priors during instruction tuning?
summary_en.importance: Data construction innovation. Reveals that the bottleneck in VLM visual capabilities lies in data utilization during instruction tuning rather than the visual representations themselves, offering a low-cost unsupervised data augmentation solution.
summary_en.technical_approach: Reformulates classical self-supervised visual tasks (e.g., rotation prediction, color matching) into natural language instructions as image-instruction-response triplets. This forces the model to rely on visual evidence rather than language priors during tuning.
summary_en.experiments: Requires no human annotations, architectural modifications, or additional training stages. Validated across multiple models, showing improved performance on vision-centric tasks.
summary_en.authors_note: Collaboration between Sorbonne University and Valeo.ai; Nicolas Thome and Spyros Gidaris are established researchers in computer vision.

recommendation.zh: 通过将自监督视觉任务转化为指令微调数据，低成本缓解了 VLM 严重依赖语言先验的问题，数据构造思路非常实用，只看方法设计即可。
recommendation.en: A practical data-centric trick to mitigate language priors in VLMs by translating self-supervised visual tasks into instruction tuning data.

paper.title: Why MLLMs Struggle to Determine Object Orientations

summary.core_problem: 论文要验证一个在多模态领域很流行的归因：MLLM在2D朝向/旋转判断上表现差，是因为视觉编码器（CLIP/SigLIP/ViT等）在表征中没有保留朝向信息；若编码器不含该信息，后端LLM自然无法恢复。作者用可控实验直接检验“朝向信息是否可从视觉embedding线性读出”。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于：很多“能力缺失”并不一定来自表征缺失，而可能来自跨模态对齐、指令跟随、解码/推理接口、或训练目标对几何属性的利用方式不足。结果显示朝向信息在embedding中可被高精度线性探测（MAE<3°），因此问题更可能出在：1）视觉token到语言空间的对齐/投影与信息瓶颈，2）指令数据与监督信号没有迫使模型在生成时使用该几何信息，3）多图/单图设定下的比较与参照框架建模不足。这对后续“几何能力提升”的方法设计（例如在对齐阶段加入显式几何任务、改进视觉-语言桥接层、或在后训练中加入可验证的空间监督）提供了更精确的诊断起点。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是表征探测而非改模型：选取4个开源MLLM体系（LLaVA-OneVision、Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct、LLaVA-1.5-13B、LLaVA-1.6-vicuna-13B），覆盖3类视觉编码器（SigLIP、ViT、CLIP）。针对两种输入范式设计可控旋转任务：(1) 双图输入：给原图与旋转图，预测旋转角；(2) 单图输入：把可旋转前景patch叠加到自然背景上，仅旋转前景，预测前景相对背景的角度（用圆形patch减少边界伪影）。从模型内部提取视觉encoder embedding，用线性ridge回归器预测旋转角度，在未见过的旋转角上测试。进一步分析误差分布形态（近似高斯）与信息分布方式（朝向信号分散在embedding的成千上万维度，而非少数维度）。
summary.experiments: 核心结果是“可线性读出”且误差很小：在多组设置（6个图像集、不同前景尺度、不同前景/背景组合）上，线性回归从SigLIP/ViT/CLIP的视觉embedding预测旋转角的平均绝对误差始终小于3°。误差分布近似高斯，说明信号稳定且噪声行为良好。作者还观察到朝向信息不是集中在少量特征上，而是弥散分布在大量embedding维度中，暗示简单的少量特征选择难以“显式抽取”该能力。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议（约20–30分钟）：先看Introduction里对“编码器缺失假说”的形式化与实验问题定义；再看Methodology里两种任务构造（双图 vs 单图patch叠加）与为何这样控制伪影；最后看结果部分的MAE<3°结论、误差高斯性与“信息弥散”分析。带着问题读：既然线性可读出，为何端到端问答仍失败？优先从视觉-语言桥接层、指令数据覆盖、以及生成式解码是否能稳定利用连续角度信息这三条线索延伸。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests a common hypothesis for why MLLMs fail at 2D orientation/rotation questions: the visual encoder (CLIP/SigLIP/ViT) allegedly does not preserve orientation information in its representations, making it unrecoverable downstream. The authors directly evaluate whether rotation angles are linearly decodable from internal visual embeddings under controlled setups.
summary_en.importance: For foundation-model pretraining and multimodal representation learning, the main insight is diagnostic: a downstream capability failure does not necessarily imply missing information in the encoder. Since rotations are recoverable with very low error via a linear probe (MAE < 3°), the bottleneck likely lies in cross-modal alignment/projection, supervision that fails to incentivize using geometric cues, or the generative interface (instruction following / decoding) rather than the encoder itself. This reframes where to intervene: alignment-stage objectives, bridge modules, and post-training data that explicitly trains the model to use geometric signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: The approach is probing-based. The authors examine four open-source MLLMs (LLaVA-OneVision, Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, LLaVA-1.5-13B, LLaVA-1.6-vicuna-13B) spanning three vision encoders (SigLIP, ViT, CLIP). They design two controlled protocols: (1) two-image input where the model sees an image and its rotated version and must infer the rotation; (2) single-image input where a rotatable circular foreground patch is composited onto a natural background, rotating only the foreground to avoid boundary artifacts. They extract the vision-encoder embeddings and train a linear ridge regressor to predict rotation angles, testing on unseen rotations. They further analyze the error distribution (approximately Gaussian) and how orientation information is distributed across embedding dimensions (diffuse across tens of thousands of features).
summary_en.experiments: Across multiple image sets and conditions (including varying foreground scales and different foreground/background pairs), linear regression on SigLIP/ViT/CLIP embeddings predicts rotations with mean absolute error consistently below 3°. Prediction errors are roughly Gaussian, indicating stable, well-behaved noise. Orientation information is not localized to a small subset of features but spread across a large fraction of the embedding dimensions, suggesting the signal is present but not trivially “explicit” in a small bottleneck.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes: read the Introduction for the encoder-missing-information hypothesis and evaluation framing; then the Methodology for the two protocols (two-image vs composited single-image) and artifact control; then the Results for the MAE<3° finding, Gaussian error characterization, and the ‘diffuse signal’ analysis. Keep a research question in mind: if the signal is linearly decodable, why does end-to-end VQA fail—bridge layers, instruction data, and decoding/formatting of continuous angles are the likely culprits.

recommendation.zh: 它直接推翻“朝向差=编码器没信息”的常见甩锅：embedding线性可读到很准，下一步该查对齐瓶颈/指令监督是否逼模型用几何；看线性探测与误差表就够。
recommendation.en: It kills the lazy prior that “orientation fails because the encoder lacks it”: a linear probe recovers angles well, so you should audit the alignment bottleneck and supervision; read the probing setup + error table.

paper.title: MODIX: A Training-Free Multimodal Information-Driven Positional Index Scaling for Vision-Language Models

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的问题是：现有RoPE类位置编码在VLM中对所有token使用统一的pos index/步长（stride），忽略了跨模态与模态内的信息密度差异，导致注意力“把位置分辨率浪费在冗余视觉patch上”，而对信息更密集的文本或关键视觉区域分配不足；作者将“位置粒度”视为一种隐式资源，提出在推理时按信息贡献动态缩放位置索引（positional index scaling）。
summary.importance: 对预训练/基础模型研究的启发在于：1）把位置编码从“固定序列编号”提升为可调的资源分配问题，尤其适用于多模态token数极不均衡（视觉远多于文本）的场景；2）提供一种训练free的推理期改造思路：不改参数、不改结构，仅通过改变RoPE输入的pos index来重分配相对距离，从而影响注意力模式。对做VLM预训练的人来说，这提示了一个潜在方向：在预训练阶段显式学习/正则化“模态自适应位置粒度”，或把信息密度与位置分辨率耦合进建模目标，而不是事后推理期补丁。
summary.technical_approach:
MODIX（Multimodal Information-Driven Positional IndeX Scaling）是一个推理期框架，核心做法是：保持文本token的pos index不变，仅对视觉token的pos index进行“非均匀拉伸/压缩”（通过调整stride）以改变RoPE中的相对距离Δp。
它用两条信息度量路径来估计“视觉模态该用多细的位置粒度”：
- 模态内信息密度（intra-modal density）：对每个模态的embedding做基于协方差的熵（covariance-based entropy）估计，用来刻画该模态token整体信息量/冗余程度。
- 跨模态交互强度（inter-modal interaction）：用cross-modal alignment度量文本-视觉之间的对齐/依赖强度，体现任务中模态贡献的动态性。
综合得到模态贡献分数C̃_m，并按Δ_m ∝ 1/C̃_m设定视觉stride：信息贡献越低（更冗余）→ stride越大→ pos index更稀疏→ RoPE相对距离被“压缩/粗化”；信息贡献越高→ stride更小→ 更细的位置分辨率。随后重建单调递增的P′并直接喂给RoPE，达到无需训练即可改变注意力分配的目的。
summary.experiments:
作者在三种VLM（Qwen3-VL、InternVL3.5、LFM2-VL，1B–8B）与七个基准（ScienceQA、RealWorldQA、DocVQA、ChartQA、AI2D、BLINK、Video-MME）上评估，报告“持续一致的提升”，并声称MODIX能随任务自动调整位置粒度（例如文档/图表类任务可能更依赖文本或局部高信息视觉区域）。
但你提供的全文片段未包含具体结果表（各benchmark提升多少、是否在所有模型上均显著、stride范围/超参、对长视频token的影响等），因此无法安全给出精确数字；如补充实验表/附录，我可以把每个基准的绝对分与增益逐项整理，并分析哪些任务收益最大及其与alignment/entropy指标的相关性。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（预计25–35分钟）：
1）先看Methodology里对“uniform positional indices在RoPE下如何影响attention距离”的推导，理解为什么改P就能改注意力。
2）重点看两条度量：covariance-based entropy怎么估、cross-modal alignment怎么定义，以及二者如何融合成C̃_m并映射到stride（Δ_m ∝ 1/C̃_m是关键）。
3）实验部分优先看跨模型一致性与跨任务差异：哪些任务提升最大（DocVQA/ChartQA/Video-MME往往最能体现模态不均衡），以及是否有消融（只用entropy/只用alignment/不同stride策略）。
4）如果你关心预训练启发，建议额外思考：这种推理期pos缩放是否会破坏预训练时学到的RoPE分布外泛化边界、以及与长上下文RoPE scaling（NTK/YaRN等）是否存在耦合或冲突。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a positional-encoding inefficiency in RoPE-based VLMs: they assign uniform positional indices/stride to all tokens, ignoring large information-density asymmetry (dense text vs redundant visual patches) and task-dependent modality importance. This leads to suboptimal attention allocation where redundant visual regions can dominate positional resolution while informative content is underrepresented.
summary_en.importance: For foundation-model research, MODIX reframes positional granularity as an implicit resource-allocation knob, particularly relevant when vision tokens vastly outnumber text tokens. It also highlights a lightweight, training-free inference-time intervention: changing only the positional indices fed into RoPE can reshape relative-distance geometry and attention patterns without touching weights. This suggests potential pretraining directions: learning modality-adaptive positional granularity or coupling information density with positional resolution during training rather than relying on inference-time patches.
summary_en.technical_approach:
MODIX (Multimodal Information-Driven Positional IndeX Scaling) is an inference-time method that keeps text positions intact and rescales vision positional indices via adaptive stride, producing a monotonic P′ used directly by standard RoPE.
It estimates modality contribution with two signals:
- Intra-modal information density: covariance-based entropy computed from modality embeddings to quantify redundancy/information richness.
- Inter-modal interaction: cross-modal alignment measuring how strongly modalities interact for the current input/task.
These are fused into a contribution score C̃_m, and the vision stride is set by Δ_m ∝ 1/C̃_m: lower contribution (more redundancy) → larger stride (coarser positional spacing), higher contribution → smaller stride (finer spacing). The resulting adjusted relative distances |p′_i − p′_j| alter RoPE rotations and thus attention allocation.
summary_en.experiments:
Reported evaluation covers three VLMs (Qwen3-VL, InternVL3.5, LFM2-VL; 1B–8B) on seven benchmarks (ScienceQA, RealWorldQA, DocVQA, ChartQA, AI2D, BLINK, Video-MME) with consistent gains, and qualitative claims that MODIX adapts positional granularity to task characteristics.
However, the provided full-text excerpt does not include the quantitative tables/ablations, so exact deltas, hyperparameters, and where gains concentrate cannot be reliably enumerated here without the missing sections.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–35 minutes):
1) Read the RoPE formulation and the argument that modifying positional indices changes relative-distance geometry and attention.
2) Focus on how covariance-based entropy and cross-modal alignment are defined and combined into C̃_m, and how C̃_m maps to stride.
3) In experiments, check cross-model consistency and which benchmarks benefit most; look for ablations (entropy-only vs alignment-only, different stride mappings).
4) If you care about pretraining implications, consider distribution-shift risks: whether inference-time index scaling conflicts with RoPE behaviors learned during pretraining and how it interacts with long-context RoPE scaling methods.

recommendation.zh: 训练 free 改 RoPE 的 pos index 来做“位置分辨率预算”挺巧，但像推理期补丁、泛化边界不明；只扫核心公式与消融表。
recommendation.en: Clever training-free RoPE index scaling as a “positional resolution budget,” but it feels like an inference patch with unclear generalization; skim the key equation and ablation table.

paper.title: Don't Show Pixels, Show Cues: Unlocking Visual Tool Reasoning in Language Models via Perception Programs

summary.core_problem: 当 MLLM 搭配视觉工具（深度/光流/对应/检测等）时，模型往往“看不懂”工具输出：把深度图、光流场等以像素级/密集数值 token 直接序列化输入，会与 LLM 的语言推理表征不匹配，导致模型依赖语言先验、无法有效利用工具提供的真实视觉线索。论文要解决的是：在不增加工具调用、不做训练/微调的前提下，如何把视觉工具输出转换成 LLM 更可读、可推理的表示，从而显著提升视觉工具推理能力。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接贡献有限（training-free 方法），但对“数据表示/Tokenizer/跨模态接口”很有启发：它把瓶颈从“更大模型/更多 tool calls/更复杂 agent”转移到“工具输出的表示层”，提出一种可泛化的语言原生结构化表示（类似为工具输出设计的中间语言/序列化协议）。这对后续做多模态预训练或工具增强预训练的人很关键：1）提示应在预训练阶段就对齐这类结构化 cue 表示；2）为 tokenizer/序列化格式设计提供了明确目标（紧凑、可定位、可组合、可比较），可能比直接喂 dense 数值更数据高效。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 Perception Programs（P2）：把原始工具输出“改写”为紧凑、结构化、带空间落点的语言原生摘要，强调标准化三件事：what（感知信号是什么）、where（在图像哪里）、以及可选的 how（局部区域之间关系）。
- 形式化：像素域 Ω 上定义一组 primitives，每个 primitive 具有空间支持集 Sp（patch/point/whole image 等）与归一化位置 cp（把像素坐标映射到 0..1000 的规范坐标系）。
- 统一 schema：不同模态（深度、光流、对应、定位等）都用同一套“条目式/符号式”结构表达，使 LLM 通过“阅读”而非“从密集 token 猜测”来使用工具证据。
- 训练与推理开销：不需要对 MLLM 做参数更新，不改架构，不增加额外工具调用；只是把同一工具输出换一种序列化/摘要方式再喂给模型。
- 关键洞察与对比：作者通过分析指出 LLM 对 raw 工具输出的理解会随分辨率上升迅速退化（例如深度 patch 相对顺序无法保持），而 CoT 式口头描述反而会引入噪声并降低性能；因此需要“结构化 cue”而非“更多自然语言解释”。
summary.experiments:
评测覆盖 BLINK 的 6 个任务（文中称 depth、flow、correspondence、jigsaw-style reasoning、object localization 等）。关键结果（引言给出）：
- 相比 raw tool use：在大模型（GPT-5 Mini、Gemini 2.5 Pro）上平均提升 19.48%。
- 在开源小模型（InternVL3.5-22B/44B、Qwen3VL-44B）上提升 22.18%。
- 相比此前最好结果：全基准平均提升 19.66%。
- 诊断实验：让 GPT-5 Mini 口头复述其对 raw depth map 的理解，随着网格分辨率增加，Kendall’s τ 迅速趋近 0，说明相对深度排序信息未被可靠保留；在 correspondence 任务中模型倾向复读输入 token 而非基于图像内容推理。
- 与 agentic tool-use 结合：把 P2 接到现有 agent 工具使用方法上，在 depth 与 localization 任务上再带来 18.28% 提升，说明它不仅提升单步读图，也提升工具链路的可解释性与有效性。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 40-60 分钟）：
1）先读 Perception Programs 形式化定义与 schema：重点看 primitive 的字段设计、空间归一化坐标、以及不同模态如何映射到统一条目结构（这是可迁移到预训练/Tokenizer 设计的核心）。
2）看“bottleneck analysis”相关图表：尤其是 Kendall’s τ 随 grid resolution 变化的曲线，以及 correspondence 中“复读 token”现象的案例，理解为何 raw 序列化会失败。
3）看主结果表：按模型规模分组的提升幅度，确认 P2 是否对小模型更友好（这对数据效率/表示效率很关键）。
4）快速扫一遍与 agentic 方法结合的实验：理解 P2 作为中间表示层如何插入现有 tool-use pipeline。
如果你做预训练：建议额外思考如何把 P2 这种 cue schema 纳入预训练数据（合成 P2-annotated 工具输出）以及 tokenizer 对结构化字段/坐标的编码策略。

summary_en.core_problem: When MLLMs are paired with vision tools (depth, optical flow, correspondence, detectors), they often fail to exploit the tool outputs. A major reason is representational mismatch: dense, pixel-level or numeric serializations are hard for language-native reasoning, so models fall back to language priors. The paper addresses how to re-represent tool outputs so that off-the-shelf LLMs can reliably parse and reason over them—without extra tool calls, fine-tuning, or architectural changes.
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining contribution per se (training-free), but highly relevant to foundation-model data/representation research. It reframes the bottleneck from “bigger models / more tool calls / more agent steps” to “the serialization protocol of perceptual evidence.” For pretraining and tokenizer/interface design, it suggests a concrete target: compact, structured, spatially grounded cue representations that are compositional and easy to read. This can inform (1) multimodal pretraining curricula that include tool-cue supervision, and (2) tokenizer/format choices for structured fields (coordinates, regions, relations) that may be far more data-efficient than feeding dense arrays.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Perception Programs (P2) convert raw tool outputs into compact, structured, language-native summaries that standardize: what signal is present, where it is grounded in the image, and optionally how regions relate.
- Formalization: define primitives over the pixel domain Ω, each with a spatial support Sp (point/patch/image) and a normalized location cp in a canonical 0..1000 coordinate system.
- Unified schema across modalities: depth, flow, visual/semantic correspondence, jigsaw-style reasoning, and localization are all expressed via the same itemized symbolic format, enabling LLMs to “read cues” rather than infer them from dense tokens.
- Plug-and-play: no parameter updates, no architecture changes, and no additional tool calls—only a rewrite of the existing tool output before it is passed to the model.
- Diagnostic insight: the authors argue that natural-language CoT verbalizations of dense cues can be noisy and even harmful; what’s needed is a structured cue language, not more free-form explanation.
summary_en.experiments:
Evaluated on six BLINK tasks spanning multiple tool modalities.
- Average gain vs raw tool serialization: +19.48% on larger proprietary models (GPT-5 Mini, Gemini 2.5 Pro).
- Gains on open-source models (InternVL3.5-22B/44B, Qwen3VL-44B): +22.18%.
- Average improvement over the prior best across benchmarks: +19.66%.
- Bottleneck analysis: for depth maps, GPT-5 Mini’s ability to preserve relative patch ordering collapses as grid resolution increases; Kendall’s τ quickly approaches 0. For correspondence, the model often copies tokens instead of reasoning about image content.
- Integration with agentic tool-use pipelines: adding P2 yields an additional +18.28% on depth and localization tasks, indicating benefits beyond single-step interpretation.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (40–60 minutes):
1) Read the P2 definition/schema carefully (primitives, fields, coordinate normalization, and how different modalities map into the unified format). This is the transferable core for representation/tokenizer research.
2) Study the bottleneck-analysis figures (especially Kendall’s τ vs grid resolution) to internalize why dense serializations fail.
3) Check the main results table broken down by model family/scale to see whether P2 disproportionately helps smaller models (a key data-efficiency signal).
4) Briefly review the section that plugs P2 into existing agentic tool-use methods to understand insertion points and interface assumptions.
If your focus is pretraining, consider how to generate P2-annotated corpora (tool outputs + P2) and what tokenization/format constraints best preserve spatial/relational structure.

recommendation.zh: 只看表示层怎么把 dense 工具输出变成可组合的“cue 语言”；对后续预训练接口/Tokenizer 设计是明确 action，但实验更像强 prompt 工程，别过度信结论。
recommendation.en: Skim for the representation/interface idea: turning dense tool outputs into composable cue-language; actionable for pretrain tokenization, but evidence feels prompt-heavy—treat gains as a signal, not a theorem.

paper.title: PromptEcho: Annotation-Free Reward from Vision-Language Models for Text-to-Image Reinforcement Learning

summary.core_problem: 文本到图像(T2I)的RL能提升prompt following，但奖励信号难：CLIP类过于粗粒度，VLM奖励模型需要偏好标注与额外训练，直接让VLM打分又不稳定（采样随机/幻觉）。论文要解决的是：如何在“零标注、零奖励模型训练”的条件下，构造一个稳定、细粒度、可扩展（随VLM变强自动变强）的奖励，用于T2I的RL优化。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的意义在于“把预训练目标直接当作可用奖励/监督信号”的范式：PromptEcho用冻结VLM的token级交叉熵（与VLM预训练目标一致）作为reward，绕开偏好标注与reward model训练。这对更广义的RL-pretrain/后训练有启发：当一个强基座模型已通过大规模预训练学到对齐知识时，可以用其原生似然/损失作为确定性奖励，减少对人类偏好与额外标注的依赖，并天然具备scaling属性（换更强VLM即更强reward）。此外，它把“理解(对齐知识)”与“推理式评审(生成式打分)”区分开，强调确定性、可微/可控的打分路径。
summary.technical_approach:
PromptEcho奖励：给定生成图像x与原始prompt c，向冻结VLM输入(图片x, 引导query q，如“Describe this image in detail.”)，然后把c当作label，在对应token位置计算VLM输出对c的token级交叉熵loss，reward取其相反数：图像越能让VLM高概率“复述”出prompt token序列，reward越高。关键点：
1）确定性：不做自回归采样生成描述，直接用logits算CE，避免InferScore的随机性与幻觉。
2）细粒度：token级似然对属性/关系/计数等更敏感（至少理论上比单一CLIP相似度更细）。
3）可扩展：reward质量随开源VLM能力提升而提升，无需重训reward model。

RL算法：采用AWM(Advantage Weighted Matching)用于扩散模型RL，使用纯ODE采样避免探索噪声导致画质下降；训练流程为：从caption数据采样prompt→T2I生成一组图→冻结VLM算PromptEcho reward→组内相对优势(advantage)→AWM更新。

数据构造：内部约100K高质量“概念丰富”图片，用Qwen3-VL-32B在固定提示下生成200–400词的长caption作为训练prompt分布，强调覆盖对象、属性、空间关系、颜色纹理等。
summary.experiments:
论文在给定全文片段中明确给出部分关键数字与设置：
- 适配两种SOTA T2I模型：Z-Image 与 QwenImage-2512。
- DenseAlignBench胜率提升：+26.8pp / +16.2pp（对应两模型）。
- 在公开基准上“持续增益”：GenEval、DPG-Bench、TIIFBench（未在片段中给出具体分数）。
- 声称可迁移到文本渲染(text rendering)任务。

但当前提供的全文仍缺少实验细节：PromptEcho相对CLIP/RewardDance/InferScore的完整对比表、训练步数/采样预算、VLM选择与尺寸对reward质量的scaling曲线、以及关键消融（guiding query选择、只算部分token/加权、caption长度影响、不同VLM的reward一致性与偏置）。这些决定了方法是否真正“细粒度且稳健”。若补充实验章节，我可以把每个benchmark的绝对分、显著性、以及画质-对齐权衡（FID/IS/偏好）系统拆解。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（30–45分钟）：
1）Method：把reward公式看清楚——哪些token计入loss、是否mask掉系统prompt/引导query、是否做长度归一化、如何处理BPE/tokenizer导致的词粒度问题。
2）Section 4/5（实验与分析，需你补齐后半部分）：重点看三类消融——(a) VLM能力scaling：换不同VLM reward是否单调提升；(b) 与InferScore对比：确定性带来的方差下降与稳定训练证据；(c) reward hacking：模型是否学会生成“让VLM容易复述prompt”的捷径而非真实对齐（例如过度文字化、模板化纹理）。
3）数据：100K内部数据+Qwen3-VL-32B长caption的分布是否会引入风格偏置；caption过长时token级CE是否更偏向语言先验而非视觉证据。

值得深挖（对预训练/后训练更关键）：PromptEcho本质是“用教师模型的条件似然当reward”。可以类比到LLM领域：用冻结teacher对(student输出|上下文)的NLL作为确定性reward/优势信号，探索其与DPO/IPO/RLVR的关系，以及在持续学习中作为无标注对齐约束的可行性。

summary_en.core_problem: RL can improve prompt following in text-to-image generation, but reward design is the bottleneck: CLIP-like scores are too coarse, VLM-based reward models require costly preference annotations and extra training, and prompting a VLM to judge alignment is stochastic and hallucination-prone. The paper asks: can we build a high-quality, deterministic reward with zero annotation and zero reward-model training?
summary_en.importance: The key contribution is a paradigm shift: directly reuse a pretrained VLM’s native training objective (token-level cross-entropy) as an RL reward, instead of training a separate reward model or relying on sampled VLM judgments. This is conceptually relevant to RL-pretrain / post-training more broadly: when a strong foundation model already encodes alignment knowledge, its conditional likelihood can serve as a scalable, annotation-free, deterministic supervision signal. The method also cleanly separates “encoded understanding/alignment” from “reasoning-based judging”, arguing the former is more stable as a reward source.
summary_en.technical_approach:
PromptEcho reward: for a generated image x from prompt c, feed (x, a fixed guiding query q such as “Describe this image in detail.”) into a frozen VLM M, then treat the original prompt c as the label sequence and compute token-level cross-entropy over the positions of c. The reward is the negative CE:
- Deterministic: no autoregressive sampling of a description, avoiding randomness and VLM hallucinations in scoring.
- Fine-grained: token-level likelihood is intended to be sensitive to missing attributes, relations, and counting.
- Scalable: reward quality improves automatically with stronger open-source VLMs, without re-annotation or reward-model retraining.

RL optimization: they use Advantage Weighted Matching (AWM) for diffusion-model RL, emphasizing pure ODE sampling to avoid quality degradation from exploration noise. Pipeline: sample prompts → generate a group of images → compute PromptEcho rewards via frozen VLM → compute group-relative advantages → update the T2I model.

Data: an internal ~100K high-quality, concept-rich image set; Qwen3-VL-32B generates long (200–400 word) detailed captions under a fixed query to form the prompt distribution.
summary_en.experiments:
Concrete numbers present in the provided text:
- Evaluated on two T2I models: Z-Image and QwenImage-2512.
- DenseAlignBench win-rate gains: +26.8 percentage points / +16.2 pp.
- Reported consistent gains on GenEval, DPG-Bench, and TIIFBench (exact scores not included in the excerpt).
- Claimed successful application to text rendering.

What’s missing due to truncation: full benchmark tables, training budgets, comparisons against CLIP/InferScore/RewardDance-style rewards, VLM-choice scaling curves, and critical ablations (guiding query, length normalization, token weighting, robustness and reward hacking). With the full experimental section, I can extract exact deltas and analyze the alignment–image-quality trade-off.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
1) Method section: verify the exact CE computation (masking, length normalization, which tokens are scored, tokenizer effects).
2) Experiments/analysis (once available): focus on (i) scaling with VLM strength, (ii) stability vs InferScore (variance, training collapse rates), (iii) reward hacking checks (does the model exploit VLM priors rather than improving visual faithfulness?).
3) Data construction: assess whether long VLM-generated captions bias training toward verbose language priors and how that impacts reward reliability.

Deep-dive for foundation-model researchers: view PromptEcho as “teacher conditional NLL as reward”. Map it to LLM post-training (DPO/RLVR) and explore whether deterministic likelihood-based rewards can replace preference labels in certain regimes, and how this interacts with continual learning constraints.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫一眼 reward 定义：用冻结 VLM 的 token-level NLL 当确定性奖励，比“让模型当评委打分”干净，适合你内部先快速复现做 RL 管线对比。
recommendation.en: Skim the reward construction: using frozen VLM token-level NLL as a deterministic reward is cleaner than judge-style scoring, and is easy to slot into an internal RL pipeline for a quick baseline.

paper.title: Grid2Matrix: Revealing Digital Agnosia in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) excel on many multimodal reasoning benchmarks, but these evaluations often do not require an exhaustive readout of the image and can therefore obscure failures in faithfully capturing all visual details. We introduce Grid2Matrix (G2M), a controlled benchmark in which a model is shown a color grid and a color-to-number mapping, and must output the corresponding matrix. By varying grid size and the number of colors, G2M provides a simple way to increase visual complex

summary.core_problem: 揭示视觉语言模型（VLMs）在需要详尽读取图像细节（如网格颜色映射）时存在的严重信息丢失问题（数字失认症）。
summary.importance: 设计了一个极简且无语义干扰的 probing 基准 Grid2Matrix，证明了 VLM 在密集视觉信息提取上的缺陷并非单纯由视觉编码器导致。
summary.technical_approach: 通过向模型展示颜色网格和颜色到数字的映射，要求输出对应的矩阵。通过改变网格大小和颜色数量来控制视觉复杂度，并对视觉编码器进行特征探测（probing）。
summary.experiments: 发现 VLM 在 zero-shot 端到端评估中在极小网格上就出现早期崩溃；但 probing 结果显示，视觉编码器保留的网格信息远多于端到端输出，表明信息在后续模块（如 projector 或 LLM）中丢失。

summary_en.core_problem: Reveals severe information loss (digital agnosia) in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) when exhaustive readout of visual details is required.
summary_en.importance: Designs a clean, semantics-free probing benchmark (Grid2Matrix) to demonstrate that VLM deficits in dense visual extraction are not solely caused by the vision encoder.
summary_en.technical_approach: Tasks models to output a matrix based on a color grid and a color-to-number mapping. Varies grid size and color count to control complexity, and probes the visual encoders directly.
summary_en.experiments: Finds VLMs exhibit sharp early collapse on surprisingly small grids in zero-shot end-to-end evaluation. However, probing shows visual encoders retain substantially more information than the end-to-end outputs, indicating loss in subsequent modules.

recommendation.zh: 设计极其 clean 的 probing 实验，证明 VLM 密集视觉信息的丢失瓶颈不仅在 vision encoder，对下一代多模态架构（如 projector 设计）有直接启发。
recommendation.en: A very clean probing setup proving the bottleneck for dense visual extraction isn't just the vision encoder; highly relevant for next-gen VLM architecture design.

paper.title: Do Thought Streams Matter? Evaluating Reasoning in Gemini Vision-Language Models for Video Scene Understanding
paper.abstract: We benchmark how internal reasoning traces, which we call thought streams, affect video scene understanding in vision-language models. Using four configurations of Google's Gemini 2.5 Flash and Flash Lite across scenes extracted from 100 hours of video, we ask three questions: does more thinking lead to better outputs, where do the gains stop, and what do these models actually think about? We introduce three evaluation metrics. Contentfulness measures how much of the thought stream is useful sce

summary.core_problem: 评估内部推理轨迹（thought streams / CoT）在视觉语言模型处理视频场景理解任务中的实际收益和饱和点。
summary.importance: 定量分析了多模态模型在推理期计算（inference-time compute）的 scaling 行为，提出了衡量思考内容有效性和忠实度的新指标。
summary.technical_approach: 使用 Gemini 2.5 Flash 和 Flash Lite 在 100 小时视频场景上进行测试。引入 Contentfulness（有用内容占比）、Thought-Final Coverage（思考到输出的转化率）和 Dominant Entity Analysis 三个指标，并用 GPT-5 作为裁判。
summary.experiments: 发现增加思考带来的质量提升会迅速进入平台期，大部分收益集中在前几百个 token 内；Flash Lite 在质量和 token 消耗之间取得了最佳平衡。

summary_en.core_problem: Evaluates the actual benefits and saturation points of internal reasoning traces (thought streams / CoT) for video scene understanding in VLMs.
summary_en.importance: Quantitatively analyzes the scaling behavior of inference-time compute in multimodal models, introducing new metrics for thought utility and faithfulness.
summary_en.technical_approach: Tests Gemini 2.5 Flash and Flash Lite on 100 hours of video scenes. Introduces metrics like Contentfulness, Thought-Final Coverage, and Dominant Entity Analysis, using GPT-5 as an independent judge.
summary_en.experiments: Finds that quality gains from additional thinking plateau quickly, with most improvements occurring in the first few hundred tokens; Flash Lite offers the best quality-to-token balance.

recommendation.zh: 对多模态 CoT 的定量分析，指出视频理解任务中 inference-time compute 的收益极易饱和，打破了 'think longer, do better' 的线性预期。
recommendation.en: Quantitative analysis of multimodal CoT showing that inference-time compute gains plateau very quickly in video understanding, challenging the 'think longer, do better' expectation.

paper.title: Grid2Matrix: Revealing Digital Agnosia in Vision-Language Models

summary.core_problem: 现有视觉语言模型在多模态推理榜单上表现强，但这些评测往往不要求“穷尽式读取”图像细节，掩盖了模型在密集空间转录（dense spatial readout）上的系统性失败。作者提出并验证一种现象：模型在很小的网格规模就会突然崩溃（非渐进退化），即便视觉编码器内部仍保留可恢复的结构信息，最终语言输出却无法忠实表达——称为“Digital Agnosia（数字失认）”。
summary.importance: 密集空间读取是表格解析、图表阅读、表单理解、GUI操作等关键能力的底座。若VLM在“逐格/逐像素级别的忠实转录”上存在早期崩溃，那么在许多看似简单但要求高保真读图的任务中会出现不可预测错误。G2M提供了一个低语义干扰、可连续调难度的诊断基准，用于定位问题究竟出在视觉编码、跨模态对齐、还是语言表达/解码环节。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建Grid2Matrix（G2M）基准：输入为512×512的彩色N×N网格图像 + 颜色到整数的映射字典；模型需输出对应的N×N整数矩阵，要求空间位置完全一致。难度由两轴控制：网格大小N（3到64）与颜色数C（3到10），在固定分辨率下逐步提高信息密度，从而最小化语义与先验干扰，聚焦“密集空间转录”。评测上先做零样本端到端Exact Match，观察随N/C变化的性能曲线；再对开源VLM的视觉编码器做隔离探针（probe），测试编码器表征中可线性/轻量恢复的网格结构，并与端到端输出对比以识别“表征-表达鸿沟”。进一步用空间热力图分析错误形态，并研究patch-grid对齐（网格单元与视觉编码器patch边界的相对关系）、模型规模与多模态对齐强度对崩溃点的影响。
summary.experiments:
核心发现包括：
1) 多个前沿VLM在零样本端到端评测中出现“早期、陡峭的崩溃”，在相当小的网格尺寸上Exact Match直接掉到接近0，而不是随密度逐步下降。
2) 对视觉编码器做probe可恢复出显著多于端到端输出所体现的网格结构信息，说明并非纯粹“看不见”，而是信息未能被下游语言模块可靠读取/表达（Digital Agnosia）。
3) 错误具有强结构性：与空间形态、patch与网格对齐关系密切相关；扩大模型或更强对齐并不能简单消除该问题。
这些实验把问题从“感知缺失”推进到“跨模态接口与生成表达失败”的诊断层面，为后续改进（更好的对齐、读出机制、结构化解码、视觉token设计等）提供依据。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读建议）
1) Introduction：理解作者为何认为现有多模态榜单掩盖了dense readout问题，以及“Digital Agnosia”的定义与研究问题拆解。
2) The Grid2Matrix Benchmark：精读任务构造（N、C两轴）、固定分辨率设定的含义、评测指标（全局Exact Match与逐格分析）。
3) 端到端崩溃曲线的主结果图/表：重点看“崩溃发生在多小的N”以及“是否陡峭而非平滑退化”。
4) Vision encoder probing实验：这是论文最关键的因果指向证据——编码器可恢复但输出失败，建议仔细看probe设置、对比方式与结论边界。
5) Patch-grid alignment与错误热力图：理解错误为何结构化、为何与patch边界相关，这直接指向可能的架构/预处理改进方向。

skim（泛读建议）
- 先读Introduction + G2M定义，快速建立任务直觉。
- 直接看端到端Exact Match随N/C变化的核心图表，确认“早崩溃”现象。
- 再扫一眼encoder probe对比图，理解“表征-表达鸿沟”的主张。
- 最后略读alignment/scale分析，知道作者排除了哪些简单解释（仅靠更大模型/更强对齐不够）。
summary.authors_note: 作者强调G2M的价值在于“控制变量”：用合成网格最小化语义干扰，提供连续可调的视觉密度，从而把VLM在密集空间保真上的失败模式显性化；并通过encoder probe提出Digital Agnosia这一更精确的诊断框架（信息可能在内部存在，但无法被语言输出忠实表达）。

summary_en.core_problem: Current VLM benchmarks often do not require exhaustive image readout, masking systematic failures on dense spatial transcription. The paper shows that VLMs can abruptly collapse on surprisingly small grids (not a gradual degradation). Moreover, vision encoders may still retain recoverable structure, while the end-to-end language output fails to faithfully express it—termed “Digital Agnosia,” a representation-to-expression gap.
summary_en.importance: Dense spatial fidelity underpins practical tasks like table parsing, chart reading, form understanding, and GUI interaction. If VLMs fail at faithful local readout, they can produce brittle, hard-to-detect errors in seemingly simple but high-precision settings. G2M offers a controlled, semantics-minimized diagnostic to localize whether failures stem from visual encoding, multimodal alignment, or language-side access/decoding.
summary_en.technical_approach: Grid2Matrix (G2M) is a synthetic benchmark: the input is a 512×512 image of an N×N colored grid plus a color-to-integer dictionary; the model must output the exact N×N integer matrix preserving spatial arrangement. Difficulty is controlled by grid size N (3–64) and number of colors C (3–10) at fixed resolution, increasing visual density while minimizing semantic confounds. The evaluation first measures zero-shot end-to-end Exact Match as N/C increase. Then it probes isolated vision encoders of open-weight VLMs to test how much grid structure is recoverable from encoder representations, comparing this to end-to-end outputs to identify a representation–expression gap. Additional analyses include spatial error heatmaps, patch–grid alignment effects (interaction between grid cells and encoder patch boundaries), and the roles of model scaling and multimodal alignment strength.
summary_en.experiments:
Main findings:
1) Frontier VLMs show a sharp early collapse in zero-shot end-to-end performance: Exact Match drops to ~0 on relatively small grids, often abruptly rather than smoothly.
2) Vision-encoder probes recover substantially more grid structure than end-to-end outputs reveal, indicating the failure is not purely missing visual information but a downstream access/expression failure (Digital Agnosia).
3) Errors are highly structured and depend on spatial morphology and patch–grid alignment; neither larger models nor stronger alignment straightforwardly resolves the issue.
Overall, the experiments shift the diagnosis from “can’t see” to “can’t reliably read out / express what is encoded,” motivating improvements in alignment interfaces, readout mechanisms, structured decoding, and visual tokenization.
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep dive)
1) Introduction: why standard multimodal benchmarks can hide dense-readout failures; the definition and framing of Digital Agnosia.
2) The Grid2Matrix Benchmark: task construction, the N/C difficulty axes, fixed-resolution rationale, and metrics (Exact Match + per-cell analysis).
3) Core end-to-end results (collapse curves/tables): focus on how early and how abruptly collapse occurs.
4) Vision encoder probing: the key evidence for a representation-to-expression gap—read probe setup, comparisons, and limitations carefully.
5) Patch–grid alignment + error heatmaps: understand why errors are structured and how patch boundaries shape recoverability.

skim (fast pass)
- Read the Introduction and G2M definition to get the setup.
- Jump to the main Exact Match vs. N/C plots to see the early-collapse phenomenon.
- Skim the encoder-probe comparison figures to grasp the representation–expression gap claim.
- Lightly scan alignment/scale analyses to see which simple explanations are ruled out.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper’s emphasis is controlled diagnosis: synthetic grids minimize semantic shortcuts and provide a continuously tunable density knob, making dense spatial fidelity failures explicit. By showing that encoder representations can retain recoverable information while language outputs collapse, it motivates the Digital Agnosia framing and points to multimodal interface/readout as a key bottleneck.

recommendation.zh: 诊断很干净：把“密集读图”失败从语义噪声里剥出来，建议直接看崩溃拐点曲线与分解实验，用来指导你做对齐/解码侧 ablation。
recommendation.en: Clean diagnostic setup that isolates dense readout failure—look at the sharp breakdown curves and factorized ablations to guide alignment vs decoding-side investigations.

paper.title: A Progressive Training Strategy for Vision-Language Models to Counteract Spatio-Temporal Hallucinations in Embodied Reasoning

summary.core_problem: 现有VLM在多图对比/时序推理中存在“多图推理幻觉”：模型强依赖输入顺序等表面时间先验（sequence bias），导致同一任务在正序与逆序提问时性能断崖式下跌，无法基于视觉证据进行真实的因果-状态判断（如“哪一帧更接近任务完成”）。
summary.importance: 该问题直接影响具身场景中的奖励建模/进度评估与操作决策：机器人需要判断动作是否真正推进任务，而不是把“后出现的帧=更接近完成”当作捷径。若不消除时序偏置，VLM在动态交互、操控状态变化、部分回退等常见情形下会产生高置信错误，带来安全与鲁棒性风险。
summary.technical_approach:
论文给出“数据+训练范式”的完整解法：
1) STCR-CoT数据集：从真实操作视频构建大规模CoT监督。先对视频做10×时间下采样以减少抖动噪声并拉大状态差异，再用多粒度滑窗（不同间隔/窗口）抽取帧对形成由易到难的比较样本；每个样本提供细粒度空间状态分析（推理链）与最终“更接近完成”的判定标签。核心监督信号是结构化推理过程，强制模型学习“先感知细节、再下判断”的可验证路径。
2) Progressive Training（两阶段全参微调）：
  - Stage 1 CoT-Supervised Pre-training：用CoT数据全参微调，显式监督完整推理链+最终标签，建立稳定的空间-时序逻辑框架，削弱对位置/顺序捷径的依赖。
  - Stage 2 Weakly-Supervised Fine-tuning：用易规模化获取的弱标注数据（仅最终标签）继续训练。弱标注数据通过“帧顺序交换+多尺度采样”等低成本引擎生成，几乎无额外标注风险；移除推理链后迫使模型调用Stage 1学到的认知范式完成判断，从而把显式推理内化为可迁移能力。
3) 关键思想：用强监督CoT“教会怎么想”，再用海量弱监督“练到能泛化”，并通过正/逆序对照显式对抗时序偏置。
summary.experiments: 论文报告：CoT模型在测试集平均准确率达87.07%；更关键的是正序/逆序任务的性能差距被压缩到6.53%，显著缓解基线模型的顺序依赖与时序幻觉。作者还强调弱监督数据规模存在正向scaling law：随着tag-only数据增大，性能持续提升，验证“先CoT打底、再弱监督扩展”的有效性。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读）：
- Introduction：抓住“multi-image reasoning hallucination”的定义、成因（监督稀疏+预训练时序先验）与为何“更接近完成”可视作reward modeling代理任务。
- Dataset章节：重点看(1) 10×下采样的动机（去噪+拉大状态差），(2) 多粒度滑窗如何形成难度课程，(3) CoT标注的结构（空间细节→判定）以及“30M细粒度空间标注”的含义与覆盖范围。
- Progressive training段落：对比Stage1/Stage2的监督差异、为何必须“全参微调”、以及弱标注数据引擎（顺序交换、多尺度采样）如何在不引入标注错误的情况下扩容。
- 实验部分（尤其正/逆序对照）：重点核对forward vs reverse gap如何定义、基线差距多大、以及该方法把gap压到6.53%的证据链。
skim（泛读）：
- 只读Introduction末尾贡献点+Dataset构建流程概览+两阶段训练流程图/伪代码（若有）+主表（accuracy与forward/reverse gap）。
- 若时间有限，优先看“弱标注可扩展数据引擎”与“gap指标”，它们是论文最可迁移的工程与评测资产。
summary.authors_note: 作者将问题从“模型不会推理”具体化为“监督结构导致模型学到顺序捷径”，并用CoT强监督+弱监督扩展的课程式训练把显式推理内化，最终用“正/逆序差距”作为反幻觉的关键度量；整体更像一套面向具身reward/进度判断的训练配方与数据引擎。

summary_en.core_problem: Current VLMs suffer from “multi-image reasoning hallucination” in spatiotemporal comparison: they over-rely on superficial temporal/order priors (sequence bias). As a result, performance collapses when the same query is asked in forward vs. reversed frame order, indicating shortcut learning rather than evidence-grounded causal state reasoning (e.g., “which frame is closer to task completion”).
summary_en.importance: This failure mode is critical for embodied AI because progress estimation is a proxy for reward modeling and decision making. Robots must judge whether actions truly advance task state; if a model equates “later input = more complete,” it will produce high-confidence errors under common conditions such as partial progress, regressions, and dynamic interactions—hurting robustness and safety.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper proposes a full “data + training paradigm” solution:
1) STCR-CoT dataset: built from real operational videos with large-scale Chain-of-Thought supervision. Videos are temporally downsampled by 10× to reduce noise (e.g., camera shake) and enforce meaningful state changes. Multi-granularity sliding windows sample frame pairs at different intervals to create a natural difficulty curriculum. Each sample includes a structured spatiotemporal reasoning trace (fine-grained spatial analysis) plus a final label indicating which frame is closer to completion; the reasoning trace is the main supervisory signal.
2) Progressive two-stage full-parameter fine-tuning:
  - Stage 1 (CoT-Supervised Pre-training): fine-tune on CoT data with supervision over the full reasoning chain and the final label, enforcing a “perceive-then-judge” cognitive pattern and reducing reliance on positional cues.
  - Stage 2 (Weakly-Supervised Fine-tuning): fine-tune on scalable tag-only data (final labels only). A low-cost data engine leverages inherent video causality via frame-order swapping and multi-scale sampling to generate massive weakly-labeled pairs with minimal risk of annotation errors. Removing explicit reasoning forces the model to internalize the Stage-1 reasoning paradigm.
3) Key idea: teach explicit reasoning first, then scale with weak supervision to generalize, while explicitly countering chronological bias via forward/reverse order evaluation.
summary_en.experiments: Reported results: the CoT-trained model reaches 87.07% average test accuracy. More importantly, robustness to sequence bias improves substantially—the forward vs. reverse performance gap is reduced to 6.53%. The paper also claims a positive scaling law in Stage 2: increasing the volume of weakly-supervised tag-only data consistently improves performance, supporting the “study-then-practice” progressive recipe.
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep dive):
- Introduction: focus on the definition/diagnosis of multi-image hallucination, the causal explanation (sparse supervision + pretraining temporal priors), and why “closer-to-completion” serves as a reward-modeling proxy.
- Dataset section: (1) rationale for 10× downsampling, (2) how multi-granularity sliding windows implement a difficulty curriculum, (3) the structure of CoT annotations and what “30M fine-grained spatial annotations” concretely means.
- Progressive training: understand the supervision difference between Stage 1 vs Stage 2, why full-parameter tuning is used, and how the weak-label data engine (order swapping, multi-scale sampling) scales without introducing label noise.
- Experiments with forward/reverse controls: verify how the gap is defined and the evidence that it drops to 6.53%.
skim (quick read):
- Read contribution bullets, dataset pipeline overview, the two-stage training description/diagram (if any), and the main results table emphasizing accuracy and forward/reverse gap.
- If time is limited, prioritize the scalable weak-label data engine and the gap metric—these are the most reusable components.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper reframes “poor reasoning” as a supervision-structure problem that induces order shortcuts, then uses CoT-then-weak-supervision progressive training to internalize evidence-grounded reasoning. The forward/reverse gap is treated as the key anti-hallucination metric, positioning the method as a practical training recipe for embodied progress/reward assessment.

recommendation.zh: 把它当诊断+训练日程：重点看如何打掉sequence bias的progressive curriculum；若你做视频预训练，建议加反序对照做回归测试。
recommendation.en: Use it as a diagnosis + training schedule: focus on the progressive curriculum that breaks sequence bias; for video pretraining, add reverse-order controls as a regression test.

paper.title: From Perception to Planning: Evolving Ego-Centric Task-Oriented Spatiotemporal Reasoning via Curriculum Learning

summary.core_problem: 具身、第一视角（egocentric）长程任务需要模型同时具备：细粒度空间感知、任务状态评估（是否更接近目标）、以及跨多步的规划推理。但现有VLM多来自被动视频学习，强依赖固定因果顺序的时间先验，遇到反事实顺序、多帧比较、状态回退/失败等就产生时空幻觉与泛化崩溃，难以支撑可靠的长程规划。
summary.importance: 这是通往通用具身智能的核心瓶颈：真实环境任务（整理桌面、做饭）包含长时依赖、动作失败与非单调进度，系统必须能判断“动作是否推进任务”并据此规划下一步。若模型只会跟随时间顺序而非理解状态-目标关系，就无法稳定执行长程任务，也无法形成可控、可解释的规划链路。
summary.technical_approach:
EgoTSR提出三大支柱，核心是“从感知到规划”的课程式演化：
1) EgoTSR-Data（46M）+ Curriculum Learning（三阶段）：
  - CoT阶段（15M）：用Chain-of-Thought显式建立“Perception-Planning-Decision”通路（先空间理解，再任务含义，再决策）。
  - Tag阶段（16M）：仅用最终标签弱监督，把显式推理内化为直觉式判断，同时对抗时间/顺序偏置。
  - Long-Horizon阶段（15M）：用“正交原子操作”的长程样本巩固泛化与组合能力，面向多步依赖与规划。
  该范式强调“easy-to-hard、explicit-to-internalized”，并声称能在消除chronological bias的同时兼顾原子感知与全局规划。
2) Reasoning-Enhanced Task Decomposition（推理增强任务分解）：把高层自然语言任务自动分解为若干“正交”的原子步骤序列，并显式建模因果依赖，将隐式规划转为可控逻辑路径，缩小高层语义与低层执行之间的鸿沟。
3) Dual-Level Evaluation Framework（双层评测）：同时评估(1)细粒度原子执行/感知精度与(2)长程时空规划的逻辑一致性，并通过正/逆序等设置缓解时间偏置对评测的污染；覆盖人类示范、仿真与真机平台。
summary.experiments: 论文给出总体结果：在长程逻辑推理任务上达到92.4%准确率，同时保持88.2%的细粒度感知精度，宣称解决“原子感知 vs 全局规划”的权衡；消融指出课程学习对消除chronological bias不可或缺，而任务分解机制是复杂依赖下提升准确率的关键因素。作者还分析训练轨迹，描述模型向稳健双向推理“振荡式收敛”，并在LIBERO、SIMPLER及多种真实机器人平台（Franka、Agibot、So-100）做案例验证稳定性与适应性。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读）：
- Figure 1（若可见）：左侧课程范式（CoT→Tag→Long）是全文主线；中间任务分解机制展示“高层指令→原子步骤”的可控逻辑；右侧双层评测定义了论文的评价坐标系。
- Methods 3.1：三阶段数据子集的目标差异、各阶段输入输出形式（是否含CoT、是否仅tag、长程样本如何组织）、以及如何显式对抗时间偏置。
- Methods 3.2：任务分解的“正交原子步骤”定义、因果依赖如何表示、以及它如何提升长程规划的可控性与可解释性。
- Experiments：重点看(1)原子感知与长程规划的双指标主表，(2)消融：去掉课程/去掉任务分解的退化幅度，(3)正/逆序或反事实设置下的鲁棒性。
- Case studies：真机与仿真对比，关注失败模式是否与“状态回退/遮挡/非单调进度”相关。
skim（泛读）：
- 读Introduction贡献点+Figure 1+主结果表（92.4/88.2）+两项关键消融结论（课程学习必要、任务分解关键）。
- 若只关心可复用方法：优先扫3.2任务分解与评测框架定义，数据规模细节可后置。
summary.authors_note: 作者把具身时空推理能力刻画为一条发展路径：先显式空间理解，再内化为任务状态判断，最终上升到长程规划；并用大规模分阶段数据与任务分解把“能看懂”推进到“能规划且可控”。论文的价值不仅在指标提升，也在于给出数据组织、训练课程与评测体系的成套范式。

summary_en.core_problem: Egocentric embodied long-horizon tasks require (i) fine-grained spatial perception, (ii) task-state assessment (is the system closer to the goal), and (iii) multi-step planning. Existing VLMs, largely trained on passive videos with fixed causal order, overfit temporal priors and exhibit spatiotemporal hallucinations under counterfactual orderings, multi-frame comparisons, failures, and regressions—breaking generalization needed for reliable planning.
summary_en.importance: This is a central bottleneck for general-purpose embodied AI: real-world tasks (tidying, cooking) involve long dependencies, non-monotonic progress, and frequent failures. Systems must judge whether actions truly advance task state and plan accordingly. If models follow chronology rather than state-goal causality, long-horizon execution becomes unstable and uncontrollable.
summary_en.technical_approach:
EgoTSR is built on three pillars, centered on curriculum-driven evolution from perception to planning:
1) EgoTSR-Data (46M) + Curriculum Learning (3 stages):
  - CoT stage (15M): Chain-of-Thought supervision to explicitly establish a “Perception-Planning-Decision” pathway.
  - Tag stage (16M): weak supervision with final labels only to internalize explicit reasoning into intuitive judgments and counter chronological/sequence bias.
  - Long-Horizon stage (15M): long-horizon samples composed of orthogonal atomic operations to consolidate compositional generalization and multi-step reasoning.
  The curriculum is framed as “easy-to-hard, explicit-to-internalized.”
2) Reasoning-Enhanced Task Decomposition: automatically decomposes high-level task instructions into sequences of orthogonal atomic steps with explicit causal dependencies, turning implicit planning into a controllable logical path and bridging high-level semantics to low-level execution.
3) Dual-Level Evaluation Framework: evaluates both atomic-level perceptual/execution accuracy and long-horizon logical consistency, with settings designed to mitigate chronological bias; spans human demos, simulation, and real-robot tests.
summary_en.experiments: Reported results: 92.4% accuracy on long-range logical reasoning while maintaining 88.2% fine-grained perceptual precision, claiming to resolve the trade-off between atomic perception and global planning. Ablations indicate the curriculum is indispensable for removing chronological bias, while task decomposition is decisive for maximizing accuracy under complex logical dependencies. The paper also discusses an oscillatory training trajectory toward robust bidirectional reasoning and provides qualitative validation across LIBERO, SIMPLER, and real robots (Franka, Agibot, So-100).
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep dive):
- Figure 1 (if available): left = curriculum (CoT→Tag→Long) as the main storyline; middle = task decomposition from instruction to atomic steps; right = dual-level evaluation axes.
- Methods 3.1: what each stage teaches, I/O formats (with/without CoT, tag-only, long-horizon organization), and how chronological bias is explicitly addressed.
- Methods 3.2: definition of “orthogonal atomic steps,” representation of causal dependencies, and why this improves controllability/interpretability in long-horizon planning.
- Experiments: (1) main table with dual metrics (atomic vs long-horizon), (2) ablations removing curriculum/decomposition, (3) robustness under forward/reverse or counterfactual ordering.
- Case studies: focus on failure modes tied to regressions, occlusions, and non-monotonic progress.
skim (quick read):
- Read contribution bullets, Figure 1, the main results (92.4/88.2), and the two key ablation takeaways (curriculum is necessary; decomposition is critical).
- For reusable ideas, prioritize task decomposition (3.2) and the evaluation framework; dataset-scale details can be deferred.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper frames embodied spatiotemporal reasoning as a developmental trajectory—explicit spatial understanding → internalized task-state judgment → long-horizon planning—and operationalizes it via staged large-scale data, task decomposition, and a dual-level benchmark. Its contribution is as much a training/evaluation paradigm as it is a performance gain.

recommendation.zh: 读课程学习如何把“感知→状态评估→规划”拆开训练；对预训练启示是要显式覆盖回退/失败轨迹，否则时序捷径会偷走泛化。
recommendation.en: Read how the curriculum separates perception, state assessment, and planning; the pretraining takeaway is to explicitly include rollback/failure trajectories or temporal shortcuts will kill generalization.

paper.title: Counting to Four is still a Chore for VLMs

summary.core_problem: 论文聚焦一个“看似简单但长期未解”的问题：当前主流视觉-语言模型（VLM）在基础视觉扎根能力上仍明显薄弱，尤其是对象计数（counting）。作者进一步追问：模型的计数到底来自真实视觉证据，还是被语言先验/提示牵引？以及这种失败发生在VLM流水线的哪个组件（视觉编码器、模态投影器、LLM骨干）？
summary.importance: 计数是更复杂视觉推理（实例分割、关系推理、空间规划、工具调用前的感知校验等）的底层能力。若VLM在“3到12个简单几何体”都不稳健，说明其多模态对齐与信息保真存在结构性缺陷。更关键的是，现有评测多只看最终答案，难以定位错误源头；本文通过机制分析把“看见了但没用上”的问题拆解到具体模块与注意力分配层面，为后续改进提供可操作诊断信号。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由三部分构成：
1) CountingTricks 评测套件：程序化生成约18k样本，覆盖32种“patchification/量化对齐”设置。核心变量是对象中心与patch网格的相对位置（cell-centered、对齐垂直/水平网格线、四patch交点等，模拟特征被切碎的最坏情况），并叠加尺寸异质、位置抖动、尺度膨胀、密集相邻等因素；同时加入对抗提示（Digit-in-Conflict），在文本中注入错误计数暗示（N±1/N±2）以测语言先验主导。
2) 行为+机制联合分析：除准确率外，引入更细粒度的诊断指标（文中提到attn-IoU等）并做注意力分析；同时提出“组件级探针框架”，在视觉编码器、模态投影器（vision-to-LLM projector）与LLM骨干不同阶段挂载轻量检测头/探针，比较各层对“计数相关视觉证据”的可读出性，从而定位信息在哪一步开始衰减。
3) MAS（Modality Attention Share）：为缓解“语言注意力压制视觉”的不平衡，通过正则化方式重分配跨模态注意力，让模型在需要计数时被迫重新关注视觉token，从而提升复杂计数场景的稳健性。
summary.experiments:
实验围绕三条主线展开：
- 基准评测：在10个3B–11B开源VLM上系统测试CountingTricks，比较不同patch对齐、尺度、密度与抖动条件下的计数准确率退化，并评估对抗提示下输出被错误数字牵引的程度。
- 机制定位：通过注意力与探针读出，作者报告“计数相关视觉证据在模态投影阶段最强，但进入LLM后显著衰减”，指向瓶颈不是“没看见”，而是“视觉证据未能在语言主导的推理过程中保持/被使用”。
- 方法改进：在上述诊断基础上加入MAS进行训练/正则，作者称可获得稳定、可复现的准确率增益（最高约1%的一致提升），体现其主要价值在于纠偏注意力分配而非大幅改架构。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读）：
- 重点章节：CountingTricks构建细节（32种case的定义与动机）、对抗提示Digit-in-Conflict设置；机制分析部分（注意力分析、attn-IoU、组件级探针框架与“投影器最强但LLM衰减”的证据链）；MAS的正则形式与训练细节。
- 重点图表：Fig.2（32种patchification case总览，理解本文“量化/切碎”假设的关键）；模型列表Table 1；任何展示“不同组件可读出性/注意力随层衰减”的图；对抗提示导致输出偏移的统计图。
- 创新点抓手：①把计数失败系统化归因到patch对齐与语言先验；②用组件级探针把“信息流失”定位到投影器→LLM阶段；③用MAS以最小改动纠正跨模态注意力占比。

skim（泛读）：
- 建议先看Introduction（问题与结论预告）、CountingTricks的case定义（1–4与A–D，以及密集/尺度扩展组）、以及机制分析的核心结论段（视觉证据在投影器最强但后续衰减）。
- 若只关心可用结论：直接看对抗提示实验与MAS带来的增益汇总，理解“语言提示会拉偏计数、需要显式约束模型回看视觉”。
summary.authors_note: 作者的核心立场是：VLM计数差并非单纯视觉编码器不够强，而是多模态信息在进入LLM推理后被语言先验压制，导致“看见但没坚持到最后”。因此他们强调诊断（benchmark+探针）与轻量纠偏（MAS）两条线：先定位信息衰减发生在哪里，再用注意力再分配去缓解。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper investigates a persistent weakness of modern vision-language models (VLMs): basic object counting. Beyond measuring wrong final answers, it asks whether VLMs count from actual visual evidence or from language priors/prompts, and pinpoints where in the VLM pipeline (vision encoder, modality projector, or LLM backbone) the failure emerges.
summary_en.importance: Counting is a foundational grounding skill that underlies richer multimodal reasoning (instance-level understanding, spatial relations, verification before tool use, etc.). If VLMs fail on counting simple shapes, it indicates a structural issue in multimodal alignment and information preservation. The work is valuable because it moves from output-only evaluation to mechanistic diagnosis, producing actionable signals about where visual evidence is lost and how language dominance distorts predictions.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The approach has three components:
1) CountingTricks benchmark: ~18k programmatically generated images across 32 controlled patchification/layout settings. It varies how object centers align with the vision encoder patch grid (cell-centered vs aligned to grid lines vs centered at a 4-patch intersection—worst fragmentation), plus size heterogeneity, positional jitter, scale dilation, and high-density adjacency. It also introduces adversarial prompts (Digit-in-Conflict) that inject an incorrect suggested count (N±1/N±2) to test language-prior dominance.
2) Behavioral + mechanistic analysis: besides accuracy, the paper uses finer diagnostics (e.g., attention-based measures such as attn-IoU) and attention inspection. Crucially, it proposes a component-wise probing framework by attaching lightweight heads to the vision encoder, modality projector, and LLM backbone to measure how well count-relevant visual evidence is linearly/readably present at each stage.
3) Modality Attention Share (MAS): a regularization-based technique that redistributes cross-modal attention, forcing the model to re-attend to visual tokens during counting, mitigating the dominance of linguistic context.
summary_en.experiments:
Experiments follow three threads:
- Benchmarking: evaluate 10 open-weight VLMs (3B–11B) on CountingTricks, quantifying accuracy degradation across patch alignment, scale, density, and jitter; and measuring susceptibility to adversarial numeric suggestions.
- Mechanistic localization: via attention analysis and probing, the paper reports that count-relevant visual evidence is strongest at the modality projection stage but substantially degrades inside the LLM, implying the issue is not initial “seeing” but failure to retain/use visual evidence under linguistic dominance.
- Mitigation: applying MAS yields consistent (up to ~1%) accuracy gains, positioning MAS as a lightweight correction of attention imbalance rather than a major architectural overhaul.
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep dive):
- Key sections: CountingTricks construction (the 32 cases and why they stress patch fragmentation), Digit-in-Conflict prompting; the mechanistic analysis section (attn-IoU/attention evidence, component-wise probes, and the projector→LLM degradation claim); MAS objective/regularization and training details.
- Key figures/tables: Fig.2 (the 32 patchification cases—central to the paper’s hypothesis), Table 1 (model lineup), any plots showing probe readout strength across components/layers and attention decay, and statistics showing prompt-induced count shifts.
- Innovation checklist: (i) controlled patch-alignment stress tests for counting, (ii) component-level probing to localize where visual evidence is lost, (iii) MAS to rebalance modality attention.

skim (high level):
- Read Introduction for the framing and main conclusion; skim the definition of case types (1–4 and A–D, plus scale/density groups); then jump to the mechanistic takeaway that evidence peaks at the projector and decays in the LLM; finally glance at the MAS results summary to see the practical impact.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors’ main claim is that VLM counting failures are largely due to visual evidence being overridden or not preserved during language-dominated reasoning, not because the model cannot initially perceive the objects. They therefore emphasize diagnosis (benchmark + probes) and a minimal intervention (MAS) that nudges attention back toward visual tokens.

recommendation.zh: 只看机制定位部分：计数失败到底卡在视觉编码还是LLM接管；能直接指导你做模块级 ablation。
recommendation.en: Skim for the component attribution—whether counting breaks in the vision encoder or gets overridden by the LLM; it directly suggests module-level ablations.

paper.title: Cognitive Pivot Points and Visual Anchoring: Unveiling and Rectifying Hallucinations in Multimodal Reasoning Models

summary.core_problem: 论文聚焦多模态大推理模型（MLRMs）在长链式推理（CoT）中更易产生幻觉这一核心问题，并提出“Reasoning Vision Truth Disconnect（RVTD，推理-视觉真实脱节）”：模型在需要视觉证据校验的关键推理转折处，反而显著减少对图像证据的利用，导致推理链被语言先验“接管”。
summary.importance: 该问题直接指向当前“test-time compute scaling + 长CoT”范式在多模态场景的系统性风险：推理越长、越复杂，越可能在不自知的情况下偏离视觉事实。论文的价值在于把幻觉从“输出层面错误”下钻到“内部机制失效”（注意力/跨模态绑定在特定层与特定token处崩解），从而为可解释诊断与可训练纠偏提供了更可操作的靶点。
summary.technical_approach:
方法与分析主线分三段：
(1) 现象刻画（宏观）：对比非推理生成与CoT推理，发现CoT全程视觉注意力更低（Fig.1），呈现模式级从视觉扎根转向语言内推。
(2) 机制定位（中观+微观）：提出“认知分叉点/枢轴点”（cognitive bifurcation points），通常由however/wait等转折词触发；这些位置语义不确定性上升（高熵），且幻觉往往紧随其后。关键矛盾是：越不确定越需要看图，但这些token到图像token的注意力反而变弱（Fig.2）。进一步做层级归因，发现浅层与深层相对稳定，真正的“视觉语义锚定（Visual Semantic Anchoring）”失效集中在中间层：在中间层，真实token与幻觉token的跨模态互信息/耦合差距迅速拉大（Fig.3a），注意力也呈现真实token更强更聚焦、幻觉token更弱更弥散（Fig.3b），并在head维度上表现为中间层多头一致性激活缺失（Fig.4）。
(3) 训练纠偏（内生化）：提出V-STAR（Visual Structural Training with Attention Reinforcement）。核心是从“只监督结果”转向“结果+内部注意力结构”的联合治理：
- HVAR（Hierarchical Visual Attention Reward）：在GRPO式RL框架中，把中间层（锚定层）在高熵分叉点处的视觉注意力作为分层奖励信号，鼓励模型在最需要证据时把注意力对准图像并更集中。
- FRM（Forced Reflection Mechanism）：构造“Generate-Reflect-Regenerate”轨迹，在初答后插入显式反思触发，强制模型回看视觉证据以打破认知惯性，把外部去偏干预转化为模型内部的自纠错能力。
summary.experiments:
从给定全文片段可确认的实验/证据主要是机制性实证：
- Fig.1：CoT推理相较非推理生成，跨层视觉注意力整体更低。
- Fig.2：转折token附近出现高熵/高不确定性，同时文本到图像token注意力显著走弱，幻觉片段常在其后出现。
- Fig.3：中间层出现跨模态互信息/绑定差距扩大；真实token注意力更强且更聚焦，幻觉token更弱更弥散。
- Fig.4：中间层head级视觉注意力在真实生成中更一致、更高分，幻觉生成更零散。
（注：你提供的正文在V-STAR训练与最终定量指标处被截断，因此无法严格复述其具体数据集、指标提升幅度与消融结论；若补充后半部分可进一步把“纠偏效果”写成可复现的实验摘要。）
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读）：
- 重点读引言中RVTD定义与Fig.1：把“CoT更少看图”这一反直觉现象建立为论文主命题。
- 精读“认知分叉点”分析与Fig.2：关注转折词/高熵状态的操作化方式，以及“高不确定+低视觉注意”的因果叙事链。
- 精读层级定位部分（Finding 2 / Sec.3.4）与Fig.3、Fig.4：这是论文最关键的可解释证据，回答“视觉信息在哪一层丢的、怎么丢的”。建议对照看(a)互信息/耦合差距曲线与(b)注意力形态差异，并结合head可视化理解“锚定层”的具体含义。
- 精读方法部分V-STAR：重点抓两点——HVAR为何要“分层+只在高熵点强化+锁定中间层”；FRM如何把反思插入RL轨迹、它与单纯self-consistency/多次采样的区别。
skim（泛读）：
- 先读引言+贡献列表，快速建立RVTD→分叉点→中间层锚定失效→V-STAR的因果链。
- 只看四张关键图（Fig.1-4）配合图注即可把主要发现读懂。
- 方法只需抓住：用“内部注意力奖励”替代/补充“只看最终对错”的监督，以及用“强制反思轨迹”促使回看图像证据。
summary.authors_note: 作者的核心立场是范式转移：多模态推理的幻觉治理不应停留在解码期外部约束或仅做结果级监督，而应面向网络内部的“视觉语义锚定”机制进行显式引导，尤其在高熵的认知枢轴点处强化视觉证据查询；同时通过反思式轨迹把去偏能力内生化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets hallucinations in Multimodal Large Reasoning Models (MLRMs) during long chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, and formulates the “Reasoning Vision Truth Disconnect (RVTD)”: precisely when visual evidence is needed to resolve uncertainty, the model under-queries the image and continues reasoning mainly from language priors.
summary_en.importance: It exposes a systemic risk of the prevailing paradigm (test-time compute scaling + long CoT) in multimodal settings: longer reasoning traces can become less visually grounded and thus more hallucination-prone. The key contribution is moving from outcome-level error descriptions to an internal-mechanism diagnosis—pinpointing where and when cross-modal grounding collapses—enabling more actionable training-time fixes.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work proceeds in three steps:
(1) Macro phenomenon: compared with non-reasoning generation, CoT reasoning shows consistently lower visual attention across the network (Fig.1), indicating a mode shift from visual grounding to linguistic inference.
(2) Mechanism identification: it introduces “cognitive bifurcation/pivot points,” often marked by transition words (e.g., “however”, “wait”). These positions exhibit high semantic uncertainty (high entropy) and hallucinations frequently occur right after them. Critically, at these high-entropy pivots, text-to-image attention weakens instead of strengthening (Fig.2).
Layer-wise interpretability then localizes the failure: shallow and deep layers are relatively stable, while intermediate layers show the decisive divergence. In intermediate layers, the text–image mutual-information/binding gap between grounded vs. hallucinatory tokens grows sharply (Fig.3a); grounded tokens allocate stronger and more concentrated visual attention, whereas hallucinatory tokens show weaker, more diffuse attention (Fig.3b). Head-wise comparisons further confirm that truthful generations have stronger, more consistent activations in intermediate layers, while hallucinations are sporadic (Fig.4). This is framed as a breakdown of “Visual Semantic Anchoring” in intermediate layers.
(3) Training remedy (V-STAR): a paradigm that augments outcome supervision with fine-grained internal attention guidance.
- HVAR (Hierarchical Visual Attention Reward): integrated into a GRPO-style RL framework, it rewards visual attention specifically in anchoring-relevant intermediate layers and specifically at high-entropy pivot points, enforcing evidence querying when it matters most.
- FRM (Forced Reflection Mechanism): constructs “Generate–Reflect–Regenerate” trajectories during RL exploration, inserting explicit reflection triggers to force re-checking the image and to internalize anti-hallucination behavior beyond external decoding tricks.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full-text excerpt, the confirmed evidence is primarily mechanistic/interpretability-based:
- Fig.1: CoT reasoning attends less to visual evidence than non-reasoning generation across layers.
- Fig.2: around transition tokens (high-entropy pivots), text-to-image attention drops, and hallucinated spans often follow.
- Fig.3: intermediate layers show a widening cross-modal coupling gap; grounded tokens have stronger/more focused visual attention while hallucinatory tokens are weaker/more diffuse.
- Fig.4: head-level visual attention is more consistent and stronger for truthful generations in intermediate layers, but weaker and sporadic for hallucinations.
(Note: the excerpt truncates before the full V-STAR training/evaluation section; thus dataset names, metrics, gains, and ablations cannot be faithfully summarized without the remaining pages.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep read):
- Start with the RVTD setup and Fig.1 to internalize the central, counterintuitive claim: CoT can reduce visual grounding.
- Study the cognitive pivot analysis and Fig.2: how pivot tokens are identified, how entropy/uncertainty is measured, and the “high uncertainty + low visual attention” mismatch.
- Carefully read the layer-wise localization (Finding 2 / Sec.3.4) with Fig.3 and Fig.4: this is the core technical evidence for intermediate-layer anchoring failure.
- For V-STAR, focus on why HVAR is hierarchical (layer- and position-aware) and why it targets intermediate layers at high-entropy pivots; then understand how FRM differs from simple re-sampling/self-consistency by intervening in RL trajectories.
skim (quick read):
- Read the introduction + contributions to get the RVTD → pivots → intermediate-layer anchoring failure → V-STAR storyline.
- Skim only Figs.1–4 with captions to capture the main findings.
- For methods, retain the two takeaways: reward internal visual attention (not only final correctness) and enforce reflection trajectories to re-anchor on visual evidence.
