summary_en.authors_note: The authors argue for a shift from external decoding-time interventions and purely outcome-level supervision to microscopic, internal guidance: explicitly reinforce visual semantic anchoring—especially at high-entropy cognitive pivots—and internalize debiasing via reflection-based RL trajectories.

recommendation.zh: 值得看其“转折点不看图”的诊断：长CoT越跑越脱离视觉证据；可据此在训练里加锚点监督/注意力约束。
recommendation.en: Good for the “pivot points stop looking at the image” diagnosis: longer CoT drifts off visual evidence; suggests anchoring supervision or attention constraints in training.

paper.title: Back to the Barn with LLAMAs: Evolving Pretrained LLM Backbones in Finetuning Vision Language Models

summary.core_problem: 当VLM以预训练LLM作为语言/推理骨干时，如何在不改变其它因素的前提下评估“更强的新LLM骨干”是否必然带来更强的VLM，以及影响路径是什么。
summary.importance: 分析与评测贡献：提供受控实验，揭示“升级LLM骨干并不总能提升VLM”的反直觉现象；对VLM研发中的backbone替换、对齐与训练配方迁移具有直接工程启发。
summary.technical_approach: 固定视觉编码器、训练数据与后训练算法，仅替换LLM骨干（LLaMA-1/2/3）构建一组VLM进行对比，系统分析不同骨干对多模态推理、对齐与下游任务表现的影响与不一致性。
summary.experiments: 受控对比LLaMA-1/2/3骨干的VLM；摘要未给出具体任务集合、指标与提升幅度，仅说明“新骨干不总更好”。

summary_en.core_problem: Whether swapping in newer, stronger pretrained LLM backbones necessarily improves vision-language models (VLMs) when other components and training recipes are held constant, and what factors drive mismatches.
summary_en.importance: Offers controlled evidence that backbone upgrades can fail to translate into VLM gains, providing practical guidance for backbone replacement, alignment, and recipe transfer in VLM engineering.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs comparable VLMs by fixing the vision encoder, data, and post-training algorithm while only varying the LLM backbone (LLaMA-1/2/3), then analyzes impacts on multimodal reasoning, alignment behavior, and downstream performance.
summary_en.experiments: Runs controlled comparisons across VLM variants using LLaMA-1/2/3 backbones; the abstract reports the key qualitative finding (newer backbones are not always better) without detailing task suites or metrics.

recommendation.zh: 改变“换更强LLM骨干=更强VLM”的默认信念：受控替换实验很有工程指向；只看骨干对照与失败案例分析。
recommendation.en: Updates the default prior that “a stronger LLM backbone guarantees a stronger VLM”: the controlled swap experiments are actionable; read the backbone comparisons and the failure analysis.

paper.title: Do Vision Language Models Need to Process Image Tokens?

summary.core_problem: VLM 在解码器深层持续处理大量 image tokens 代价高，但“是否真的需要在深层持续处理图像 token、视觉表征是否在深层仍显著演化”并不清楚。本文从表征结构演化角度回答：视觉 token 在解码器中何时变得稳定/冗余、能否被截断/替换、这种冗余是否任务相关，以及截断后能否通过微调或推理链补偿。
summary.importance: 该问题直接关系到 VLM 的计算效率与架构设计：如果视觉 token 在较浅层已进入低复杂度稳定区间，则深层对 dense image tokens 的持续计算可能主要是冗余开销。论文用可量化的表征指标给出“何时冗余、冗余到什么程度、哪些任务仍需要深层视觉交互”的证据，为 token 剪枝/早停/分层融合等高效 VLM 设计提供原则。
summary.technical_approach: 以“表征轨迹分析”替代单纯任务指标：在 VLM 解码器各层分别对图像 token 与文本 token 的嵌入矩阵 Z_l 做结构度量。(1) 矩阵熵/有效秩：对 Gram 矩阵归一化后计算 Von Neumann entropy S1 与 r_eff=exp(S1)，刻画谱能量是否集中（压缩/冗余）或分散（多样性）。(2) 内在维度（ID）：估计局部流形维数，衡量表示自由度与复杂度。(3) 轨迹曲率（TC）：用相邻层更新向量的平均角偏差衡量表示“转向/重构”强度。核心发现是：图像 token 的熵、ID、曲率在较早层迅速收敛到“有界复杂度”稳定形态，而文本 token 在更深层仍持续演化；据此进一步研究深层图像 token 的功能可替代性、任务依赖性，以及截断后通过微调/推理链的可恢复性与效率收益。
summary.experiments: 覆盖三类主流 VLM 家族与多尺度（LLaVA-1.5、Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct、InternVL，3B–72B），在 BLINK 数据集上进行表征分析；并用相同图像在 captioning 与 VQA 风格提示下对比，尽量隔离输入差异对表征指标的影响。实验围绕 RQ1–RQ5：先用熵/ID/曲率展示跨层动态差异（视觉早稳、文本深变），再检验“早稳是否意味着深层冗余/可互换”、比较单 token 预测与多 token 生成任务对视觉深度的依赖差异，并评估截断视觉 token 后微调能否逐步重分配视觉信息、在不同截断强度下恢复程度与计算效率权衡，以及结构化推理链是否能在减少视觉处理深度时补偿性能。
summary.reading_guide: must_read（精读）：(1) Introduction：明确五个 RQ 与三类表征指标为何能对应“冗余/复杂度/演化”。(2) RQ1 方法段：矩阵熵/有效秩、ID、TC 的定义与解释（尤其是“谱集中=压缩”“曲率=层间重构强度”如何支撑结论）。(3) RQ1 结果图/表：重点看图像 token 指标在前几层快速平台化、文本 token 继续变化的对照曲线（这是全文论证支点）。(4) Interchangeability/Task dependence 相关实验：关注 captioning vs VQA（单 token vs 多 token）下截断/替换的性能差异，用来理解“冗余是任务条件性的”。(5) Adaptation/Reasoning：看微调恢复曲线与效率收益（截断强度越大恢复越慢/越有限）以及推理链补偿的边界。skim（泛读）：先读 Introduction + RQ1 指标与主结论；再跳到任务依赖与截断微调的关键实验小节与结论段，快速获得“视觉早稳→可做深度削减，但生成任务更敏感、微调可部分恢复”的整体图景。
summary.authors_note: 作者主张用可解释的表征结构指标为“是否需要深层处理 image tokens”提供证据链：视觉表示在解码器中很早进入稳定、低复杂度区间，深层视觉 token 可能部分冗余；但冗余程度受任务形态影响，且截断后可通过微调在一定程度上重分配信息、通过推理链在部分场景补偿，从而为高效 VLM 设计提供可操作的分析框架。

summary_en.core_problem: VLM decoders spend heavy compute processing dense image tokens through many transformer layers, yet it is unclear whether deep, sustained image-token processing is actually necessary and whether visual representations meaningfully evolve in later layers. The paper asks when image tokens become representationally stable/redundant, whether deeper image-token computation is functionally interchangeable, how this depends on task type (single-token prediction vs multi-token generation), and whether fine-tuning or structured reasoning can recover performance after truncating image-token processing.
summary_en.importance: Answering this determines whether a large fraction of VLM compute is avoidable. If visual tokens enter an early bounded-complexity regime, then deep image-token processing may be largely redundant, enabling principled token truncation/early-exit/hierarchical fusion designs. The work contributes a representation-driven diagnostic toolkit (entropy/ID/curvature) that links internal dynamics to efficiency decisions rather than relying only on end-task accuracy.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper performs layer-wise representation-trajectory analysis inside the LLM decoder, separately for image vs text tokens. For token embedding matrices Z_l: (1) Matrix-based (Von Neumann) entropy via the normalized Gram matrix spectrum, and effective rank r_eff=exp(S1), to quantify spectral concentration/compression vs diversity. (2) Intrinsic dimensionality (ID) to estimate local manifold degrees of freedom (representation complexity beyond ambient dimension). (3) Trajectory curvature (TC), computed from angular deviations between successive layer update vectors, to measure how strongly representations are reconfigured across depth. Key claim: image-token representations rapidly converge—entropy stabilizes, ID compresses, and curvature approaches a near-constant profile—while text-token representations continue to evolve substantially in deeper layers. The paper then uses this to test interchangeability/redundancy, task dependence, fine-tuning-based recovery after truncation, and whether reasoning chains can compensate for reduced visual-token depth.
summary_en.experiments: Across three VLM families (LLaVA-1.5, Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct, InternVL) spanning 3B–72B, experiments are run on BLINK. For controlled comparisons, the same images are used across captioning and VQA-style prompts to isolate representational effects. The study is organized around RQ1–RQ5: demonstrate modality-specific layer dynamics (early visual stabilization vs continued textual evolution), evaluate whether stabilized visual tokens are functionally redundant/interchangeable in deeper layers, quantify task-dependent reliance on deep visual processing (single-token vs multi-token generation), test fine-tuning’s ability to redistribute visual information after truncation (recovery vs truncation severity and efficiency gains), and assess whether structured reasoning chains can offset reduced visual-token processing depth.
summary_en.reading_guide: must_read (deep): (1) Introduction for the five RQs and why representation metrics are the right lens. (2) RQ1 methodology for precise definitions/interpretations of entropy/effective-rank, ID, and curvature. (3) RQ1 main result figures/tables showing early plateaus for image tokens vs continued changes for text tokens—this is the core evidence. (4) Interchangeability + task-dependence sections: focus on captioning vs VQA comparisons to understand when “redundant” visual depth still matters. (5) Adaptation + reasoning sections: inspect fine-tuning recovery curves and efficiency trade-offs, and the limits of reasoning-chain compensation. skim (fast): read Introduction + RQ1 headline results; then jump to the task-dependence and truncation/fine-tuning takeaway experiments and the conclusion to get the main message: early visual stabilization enables depth reduction, but generation tasks are more sensitive and recovery is partial/gradual under aggressive truncation.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors argue for a representation-grounded account of image-token dynamics: visual tokens quickly enter a bounded-complexity regime in the decoder, implying partial redundancy of deep image-token computation; however, utility is task-dependent, and while fine-tuning can partially reallocate visual information after truncation (with efficiency gains), recovery is limited when truncation is too aggressive. The proposed metrics provide a practical framework for designing more efficient VLMs.

recommendation.zh: 会改变我对“深层必须全量图像token”的prior：按文中表征稳定性指标立刻做自家模型层间ablation，指导早停/剪枝/分层融合。
recommendation.en: This should update your prior that deep layers must keep dense image tokens: replicate their representation-stability probes on your stack to justify early-exit/pruning/hierarchical fusion.

paper.title: UIPress: Bringing Optical Token Compression to UI-to-Code Generation

summary.core_problem: UI-to-Code生成中视觉token极长导致prefill延迟高，现有压缩要么不真正缩短序列、要么与UI信息密度不匹配，难以在保持生成质量的同时显著降token与延迟。
summary.importance: 贡献类型为高效多模态架构模块：将“光学/编码器侧可学习压缩”从OCR迁移到UI-to-Code，提供可插拔轻量压缩模块，在冻结视觉编码器与LLM解码器的前提下大幅压缩视觉token预算，直接面向推理效率痛点。
summary.technical_approach: UIPress插入在冻结ViT encoder与LLM decoder之间：用深度可分离卷积进行局部聚合、用元素引导的空间重加权适配UI非均匀信息密度、再用Transformer refinement整合；将约6700视觉token压到固定256预算；并对解码侧做LoRA以适配压缩后的表征。
summary.experiments: 基于Qwen3-VL-8B做UI-to-Code；关键设置为视觉token从~6700压缩到256，目标是降低prefill latency并保持HTML/CSS生成质量。摘要未给出具体数据集、指标（如Exact match/DOM tree similarity）与提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Reduce prefill latency in UI-to-code generation caused by extremely long visual token sequences, achieving true sequence-length reduction while preserving UI information needed for high-quality code generation.
summary_en.importance: Presents a plug-in efficiency module that brings learnable optical/token compression ideas to UI-to-code, enabling large reductions in visual token budget without retraining the full vision encoder or LLM decoder—directly targeting inference-time bottlenecks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces UIPress between a frozen ViT encoder and a frozen LLM decoder: depthwise separable convolutions perform local aggregation, element-guided spatial reweighting adapts to non-uniform UI information density, and a transformer refinement stage integrates features; compresses ~6700 visual tokens to a fixed 256, with LoRA applied on the decoding side to adapt to the compressed representation.
summary_en.experiments: Built on Qwen3-VL-8B for UI-to-code; the headline setting compresses visual tokens from ~6700 to 256 to reduce prefill latency while maintaining HTML/CSS generation quality, but the abstract does not provide datasets, metrics, or quantitative quality/latency numbers.

recommendation.zh: 只看压缩模块接口与延迟/质量曲线：若真能在冻结编码器+LLM下显著降prefill，这是可立刻复现的推理侧动作；其余叙述可略。
recommendation.en: Skim the module interface and the latency–quality curves: if it truly cuts prefill while freezing encoder+LLM, it’s an immediately reproducible inference-side win; ignore the rest.

paper.title: Visually-Guided Policy Optimization for Multimodal Reasoning

summary.core_problem: RLVR/GRPO 等后训练虽提升了 VLM 的链式推理与可验证正确率，但模型推理过程仍呈“文本主导”：对图像 token 的注意力激活稀疏，且随推理步数增加出现 temporal visual forgetting（视觉证据在后续步骤被逐步遗忘），导致依赖语言先验、视觉不忠实与幻觉/推理错误。
summary.importance: 该问题直接影响“多步推理是否真正基于视觉证据”。在 RLVR 强化推理长度与逻辑一致性后，视觉遗忘会被进一步放大：推理越长越不看图，最终正确性与可解释性都受损。相比引入额外 token/外部模型/多次前向的方案，若能在不增加系统复杂度的情况下提升视觉对齐，将更利于规模化训练与部署。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 VGPO（Visually-Guided Policy Optimization），核心由两点洞察与一个训练框架组成：
(1) Visual Focus Score：利用“生成 token 的隐藏状态”与“图像 token 隐藏状态”的相似度，作为无需额外监督的视觉聚焦分数，用于自发定位哪些生成位置/哪些图像区域与当前推理最相关。
(2) Visual Attention Compensation：基于 focus score 对视觉相关 token 进行重加权与放大；并在推理后期逐步提高视觉期望（progressive incentives），对抗随时间衰减的视觉注意力。
(3) Dual-Grained Advantage Re-Weighting 融入 GRPO/RLVR：
- Intra-trajectory（轨迹内）：对 token-level advantage 动态重权，强化与视觉证据强相关的生成片段；同时对后期步骤施加更强的视觉补偿以缓解遗忘。
- Inter-trajectory（轨迹间）：在候选响应组内，整体优先“视觉累积更好/更持续 grounding”的轨迹，使策略更新倾向于长期保持视觉对齐的解答路径。
整体特点：不引入额外训练 token、无需辅助大模型验证、避免额外图像扰动的双前向对比，主要依赖模型自身隐藏状态信号完成定位与强化。
summary.experiments:
论文报告在“数学 + 视觉依赖的多模态推理任务”上进行广泛实验，结论集中在两类指标：
(1) 视觉激活/视觉遗忘：VGPO 能显著提升图像 token 的注意力激活密度，并减缓随推理步数增长的注意力衰减（temporal visual forgetting）。
(2) 任务性能：在需要视觉证据支撑的推理基准上取得 SOTA 或显著优于基线的表现，同时保持 RLVR 带来的推理能力收益。
（精读时建议对照文中 Figure 1/2 的注意力与遗忘分析，以及与 Look-Back/VAPO/PAPO/VPPO 等方法的对比设置与消融。）
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（详细技术分析 + 精读建议）
- 重点问题证据：Introduction 中关于“文本主导注意力”与“temporal visual forgetting”的实证分析；尤其 Figure 1/2（注意力分布、随步数衰减曲线/可视化）。
- 关键创新点 1：Visual Focus Score 的定义与验证——隐藏状态相似度为何能定位视觉 grounding（看其度量方式、相似度计算粒度、与注意力/梯度信号的关系）。
- 关键创新点 2：Visual Attention Compensation 的具体形式——如何把 focus score 转成重权；progressive incentives 如何随 step 调度；其对 token-level advantage 的作用路径。
- 关键创新点 3：Dual-Grained Advantage Re-Weighting——轨迹内/轨迹间两层重权如何与 GRPO 的 group advantage 结合；是否改变采样、归一化或 surrogate objective。
- 消融与诊断：分别去掉 focus score、去掉 progressive、只做 intra 或 inter 的效果；以及对“推理长度增加时”的稳健性。

skim（方法概述 + 泛读建议）
- 先读 Introduction 的问题定义与两点洞察（隐藏状态相似度可定位视觉 token；遗忘随步数加剧）。
- 再读 Preliminary（GRPO）把握其 advantage 计算与更新框架。
- 最后快速扫方法段落中 VGPO 的两层重权思路（intra/inter）与实验主表/主图（视觉激活与任务分数）。
summary.authors_note: 作者主张：视觉不忠实的关键不只是“视觉激活弱”，更在于“推理过程中逐步遗忘视觉证据”。因此应在 RLVR 的策略优化阶段显式引入“视觉定位 + 视觉补偿 + 后期更强约束”，并尽量避免额外模型/额外前向带来的训练复杂度。

summary_en.core_problem: RLVR/GRPO post-training improves step-by-step reasoning in VLMs, but inference remains text-dominant: attention to image tokens is sparse and decays over reasoning steps (temporal visual forgetting). As chains get longer, the model increasingly relies on textual priors rather than visual evidence, causing unfaithful grounding, hallucinations, and reasoning errors.
summary_en.importance: This directly challenges whether multi-step multimodal reasoning is truly evidence-based. RLVR tends to lengthen and structure reasoning; without fixing visual forgetting, longer reasoning can paradoxically reduce visual faithfulness. A solution that strengthens visual grounding without extra tokens, auxiliary verifiers, or extra forward passes is attractive for scalable training and deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper proposes VGPO (Visually-Guided Policy Optimization) built on two observations and a GRPO-compatible optimization scheme:
(1) Visual Focus Score: use similarity between hidden states of generated tokens and image tokens to localize visually grounded cues without external supervision.
(2) Visual Attention Compensation: re-weight/amplify visually relevant cues based on the focus score, and progressively raise visual expectations in later reasoning steps to counter temporal decay.
(3) Dual-Grained Advantage Re-Weighting integrated into policy optimization:
- Intra-trajectory: dynamically re-weight token-level advantages to emphasize visually grounded parts, with stronger late-step incentives to compensate forgetting.
- Inter-trajectory: prioritize trajectories with better global visual accumulation/consistent grounding within the sampled group, correcting holistic visual negligence.
Overall, VGPO relies on self-generated hidden-state signals rather than adding special tokens, external models, or extra image perturbation forward passes.
summary_en.experiments:
Experiments span math and vision-dependent multimodal reasoning tasks, evaluating both:
(1) Visual activation/forgetting: VGPO increases image-token activation and reduces attention decay across reasoning steps.
(2) Task performance: it achieves state-of-the-art or clear gains on visually grounded reasoning benchmarks while retaining RLVR reasoning benefits.
(For careful reading, align these claims with Figure 1/2 diagnostics and comparisons to Look-Back/VAPO/PAPO/VPPO, plus ablations.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep technical + close-reading guide)
- Evidence of the problem: Introduction’s empirical analysis of text-dominant attention and temporal visual forgetting; especially Figure 1/2.
- Key novelty #1: Visual Focus Score—how hidden-state similarity is computed/validated as a grounding locator.
- Key novelty #2: Visual Attention Compensation—how focus scores become weights; how progressive incentives are scheduled over steps; how this modifies token-level advantages.
- Key novelty #3: Dual-Grained Advantage Re-Weighting—exactly how intra-/inter-trajectory reweighting plugs into GRPO’s group-based advantage and surrogate objective.
- Ablations/diagnostics: remove focus score, remove progressive incentives, intra-only vs inter-only, and robustness vs longer reasoning.

skim (high-level overview + fast-reading guide)
- Read the Introduction for the problem framing and the two core insights.
- Skim the GRPO preliminary to recall advantage computation.
- Skim the VGPO method for intra/inter reweighting, then jump to main results and the visual-forgetting plots.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors argue that visual unfaithfulness is not only weak visual activation but also step-wise visual forgetting during long reasoning. They advocate injecting visual localization and progressive late-step compensation directly into RLVR policy optimization, while keeping the training pipeline lightweight (no extra tokens/models/forward passes).

recommendation.zh: 看可视化注意力与“视觉遗忘”诊断那部分就够：若现象扎实，它改变我对RLVR后训练的prior——必须加视觉约束/奖励，否则越推理越不看图。
recommendation.en: Only read the attention/visual-forgetting diagnostics: if the effect is real, it changes my RLVR prior—without explicit visual constraints/rewards, longer reasoning just drifts away from the image.

paper.title: VisionFoundry: Teaching VLMs Visual Perception with Synthetic Images

summary.core_problem: 解决VLM在空间理解、视角识别等基础视觉感知技能上的短板，探索“仅给任务关键词”能否自动生成有针对性的合成监督来补齐能力。
summary.importance: 数据/流程贡献：提出任务感知的合成数据闭环（LLM生成题目与T2I提示词→T2I合成图→VLM一致性验证），在无需人工标注与参考图像的情况下构造可训练的感知型VQA数据；对多模态数据工程与能力补课具有通用启发。
summary.technical_approach: VisionFoundry流水线：输入任务名（如Depth Order），用LLM生成问题-答案与T2I prompts；用T2I模型合成图像；再用一个专有VLM做一致性校验过滤，形成高一致性的(image, question, answer)三元组；发布VisionFoundry-10K覆盖10个任务的合成VQA数据，并用其对VLM进行训练/微调以提升对应感知能力。
summary.experiments: 构建VisionFoundry-10K（10k三元组，10个任务）；摘要未给出使用的具体T2I模型/专有VLM、训练的VLM基座、参数量、评测基准与提升幅度（仅说明“训练后提升”）。

summary_en.core_problem: VLMs exhibit weaknesses in basic visual perception skills such as spatial understanding and viewpoint recognition, and it is unclear whether targeted supervision can be generated automatically from only a task keyword.
summary_en.importance: The paper contributes a general synthetic-data closed loop for perception skill “remediation” without manual annotation or reference images, providing a reusable recipe for multimodal data engineering and capability improvement.
summary_en.technical_approach: VisionFoundry takes a task name (e.g., depth order), uses an LLM to generate question–answer pairs and text-to-image prompts, synthesizes images with a T2I model, and filters samples via consistency checking with a proprietary VLM to produce high-consistency (image, question, answer) triples; it releases VisionFoundry-10K spanning 10 tasks and uses it to train/fine-tune VLMs for improved perception.
summary_en.experiments: The work constructs VisionFoundry-10K (10,000 triples across 10 tasks) and reports that training on it improves the corresponding perception abilities; the abstract omits the specific T2I/VLM components, base models, evaluation benchmarks, and quantitative improvements.

recommendation.zh: 当数据工程配方读：合成闭环是否真能自动筛掉坏图/坏题决定可信度；若你缺“基础感知补课”数据，可直接照其流程搭一条内部生成管线。
recommendation.en: Read it as a data-engineering recipe: credibility hinges on whether the loop reliably filters bad prompts/images; if you lack “perception bootcamp” data, you can copy the pipeline internally.

paper.title: How Should Video LLMs Output Time? An Analysis of Efficient Temporal Grounding Paradigms

summary.core_problem: 视频时序定位（VTG）中，Video LLM/MLLM 需要输出时间边界，但现有方法的“时间输出范式”与骨干网络、数据、训练协议强耦合，导致无法判断性能差异究竟来自输出设计还是其他因素；同时面向边缘/端侧部署时，不同输出范式在参数开销、训练稳定性、推理确定性与算力成本上的系统级权衡缺乏受控分析。
summary.importance: VTG 是 moment retrieval、dense captioning、highlight detection、grounded video QA 等任务的核心能力。随着模型走向小型化与端侧部署，“如何输出时间”会放大为工程与算法的共同瓶颈：同等骨干下，输出范式可能显著影响收敛、延迟、可复现性与最终精度。该论文的价值在于做受控对比，把输出范式从“系统整体差异”中剥离出来，给出可操作的选型依据。
summary.technical_approach:
论文在统一框架下对三类主流 VTG 输出范式做 controlled study，保证除输出设计外其余变量一致（同一紧凑 VLM 骨干、相同数据源三元组、相同优化器/epoch/LoRA 微调协议等），从而隔离“输出范式”这一自变量。
三类范式：
1) Text Numeral Generation（文本数字生成）：直接在语言输出中生成起止时间的数字字符串（chat 式输出）。优点是实现简单、无额外词表/头；风险是数字生成误差、格式不稳定、对解码敏感。
2) Temporal Token Generation（时间 token 生成）：引入专门的时间/事件结构 token，把时间边界作为结构化序列的一部分自回归生成（文中以 TRACE 风格的 causal event modeling 实例化，事件可包含 (t, saliency, caption) 等字段）。优点是结构显式、可扩展元数据；代价是序列更长、解码更复杂。
3) Continuous Temporal Decoding（连续时间解码）：从隐藏状态映射到连续时间目标；文中重点比较分布式/概率化解码（如 DisTime 风格：对时间 bin 输出分布以表达边界不确定性），并说明纯回归头可视为其退化情形。
评估维度不仅是定位精度，还包括：参数额外开销、训练稳定性/收敛、推理确定性（determinism）、计算成本等面向部署的指标。
summary.experiments:
受控实验设置：在多种紧凑骨干上实现三范式并统一微调配置（SmolVLM2 0.5B/2.2B、FastVLM 1.5B、Molmo2 4B/8B），使用一致的数据与训练协议，仅改变输出格式与对应目标函数。
对比报告覆盖：
- 精度：不同范式在相同骨干下的 VTG 定位效果差异；
- 规模效应：从 0.5B 到 8B 时范式差异是否缩小/放大；
- 工程属性：参数/词表/头的额外开销，训练是否更易发散，推理输出是否更确定（尤其生成式/数字式对解码策略敏感），以及计算成本。
（注：你提供的全文片段未包含结果表数值；精读时应以 Table 1、Figure 1 及实验章节的主表/效率分析表为准。）
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读建议：详细技术分析 + 重点章节/图表/创新点）
- 精读 Introduction：明确论文要解决的是“输出范式的因果影响隔离”与“端侧效率权衡”。
- 必看 Figure 1 + Table 1：Figure 1 总结三范式差异；Table 1 说明以往工作为何不可比（骨干/数据/协议不一致），也是本文受控设计的动机证据。
- 精读 Paradigm Formulation：把三范式统一到同一数学符号体系（h→t*），理解每种范式的训练目标与解码路径；尤其关注 TRACE 风格结构化事件生成与 DisTime 风格分布解码的具体实现细节（tokenization/binning/损失）。
- 精读实验的“效率维度”小节：关注参数开销、训练稳定性、推理确定性与计算成本的度量方式（例如是否固定解码策略、是否统计方差/失败率）。
- 精读跨骨干对比：看 0.5B/1.5B/2.2B/4B/8B 下结论是否一致，从而指导真实部署选型。
skim（泛读建议：方法概述 + 推荐看哪些部分）
- 只看 Introduction + Figure 1：快速建立三范式概念。
- 快速扫 Paradigm Formulation 每个范式的“输出长什么样”。
- 直接跳到实验主表与效率分析结论段：获取“哪种范式在小模型上更划算”的经验结论。
summary.authors_note: 作者强调“输出空间设计”本身就是 VTG-MLLM 的关键变量：它影响学习难度、解码稳定性与系统成本。论文通过严格控制骨干/数据/训练协议，把讨论从‘某某系统更强’转为‘在同等条件下哪种时间输出更优’，并把端侧部署关心的效率指标纳入同等重要的评价维度。

summary_en.core_problem: In Video Temporal Grounding (VTG), Video LLMs must output temporal boundaries, but existing approaches entangle the temporal output paradigm with different backbones, datasets, and training protocols—making it impossible to attribute performance differences to the output design itself. As VTG moves toward compact, edge-deployable models, the system-level trade-offs (parameter overhead, training stability, inference determinism, compute cost) across output paradigms need a controlled, apples-to-apples analysis.
summary_en.importance: VTG underpins moment retrieval, dense video captioning, highlight detection, and grounded video QA. For compact/edge deployment, the temporal output formulation can materially affect convergence, latency, reproducibility, and accuracy. This paper’s value is a controlled comparison that isolates output design as the sole variable and provides practical guidance on accuracy–efficiency trade-offs.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper implements and compares three dominant VTG output paradigms under a unified fine-tuning framework, holding constant the compact VLM backbone, data triples, optimizer, epochs, and LoRA protocol—so the only changing factor is the output formulation and its objective.
Paradigms:
1) Text Numeral Generation: generate start/end timestamps as plain-text numerals in the language output. Simple but prone to formatting/numeral errors and decoding sensitivity.
2) Temporal Token Generation: introduce dedicated temporal/event tokens and autoregressively decode structured event sequences (TRACE-style causal event modeling), where an event may include (time, saliency, caption) fields. More structured/extendable but longer sequences and more complex decoding.
3) Continuous Temporal Decoding: map hidden states to continuous temporal targets; the study focuses on distribution-based decoding (DisTime-style) that outputs a probability distribution over time bins to model boundary ambiguity (with pure regression viewed as a degenerate case).
Evaluation goes beyond localization accuracy to include parameter overhead, training stability, inference determinism, and computational cost.
summary_en.experiments:
Controlled experiments are run across multiple compact backbones (SmolVLM2 0.5B/2.2B, FastVLM 1.5B, Molmo2 4B/8B) with identical fine-tuning settings and the same underlying data, varying only the output paradigm.
Reported analyses cover: accuracy differences under identical backbones, scaling effects from 0.5B to 8B, and deployment-relevant properties such as extra parameters/vocabulary/heads, convergence stability, inference determinism (especially for generative/numeral outputs), and compute cost.
(Note: the provided excerpt does not include numeric result tables; consult Figure 1, Table 1, and the main/efficiency tables in the experiments section for exact findings.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep technical + how to read)
- Introduction: focus on the causal isolation goal and the edge-efficiency motivation.
- Figure 1 + Table 1: Figure 1 summarizes the three paradigms; Table 1 motivates why prior comparisons are confounded.
- Paradigm Formulation: understand the unified notation (h→t*) and the concrete instantiations (TRACE-style structured generation; DisTime-style distributional decoding), including tokenization/binning and losses.
- Efficiency analysis section: pay attention to how overhead, stability, determinism, and compute are measured (fixed decoding settings, variance/failure rates, etc.).
- Cross-backbone results: verify whether conclusions hold consistently from 0.5B to 8B for real deployment decisions.
skim (high-level + what to look at)
- Read Introduction + Figure 1 to grasp the three output options.
- Skim each paradigm’s “what the output looks like”.
- Jump to the main results and efficiency takeaways to learn which paradigm offers the best accuracy–efficiency trade-off for compact models.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors argue that the temporal output space is a first-class design choice for VTG-MLLMs, affecting learnability, decoding stability, and system cost. By strictly controlling backbone/data/training, they shift the discussion from ‘which system is better’ to ‘which output paradigm is better under identical conditions’, and elevate deployment-centric efficiency metrics to equal footing with accuracy.

recommendation.zh: 受控对比把“时间输出头”从骨干/数据里剥离，能直接指导端侧VTG选型；只看成本-稳定性-确定性权衡表和关键消融即可。
recommendation.en: Cleanly isolates the “time-output head” from backbone/data effects, giving actionable edge-deployment tradeoffs; just read the cost/stability/determinism table and the core ablations.

paper.title: MAG-3D: Multi-Agent Grounded Reasoning for 3D Understanding

summary.core_problem: 在复杂3D场景中实现面向开放式问题的“先精确grounding再推理”的零样本/免训练3D grounded reasoning。
summary.importance: 方法创新：将off-the-shelf VLM以多智能体方式组织成训练无关（training-free）的3D grounded reasoning框架，强调可组合的规划/执行以提升泛化；对VLM落地到3D理解与具身/空间推理有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出MAG-3D多智能体框架：用planning agent进行任务分解与策略规划，动态协调“专家agent”完成对象/区域定位与空间几何关系推理；避免手工固定pipeline与in-domain tuning，主打zero-shot与灵活组合。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供具体评测基准、指标、对比方法与提升幅度；核心卖点是training-free、基于现成VLM的3D grounded reasoning效果与泛化能力验证（需看正文确认数据集与结果）。

summary_en.core_problem: Achieving open-ended 3D question answering that first performs accurate grounding and then reasoning in complex 3D scenes, ideally in a zero-shot, training-free manner.
summary_en.importance: The paper proposes a training-free multi-agent organization of off-the-shelf VLMs for 3D grounded reasoning, emphasizing composable planning/execution to improve generalization and practicality for 3D understanding and embodied/spatial reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: MAG-3D uses a planning agent to decompose tasks and coordinate specialized expert agents that handle object/region grounding and spatial-geometry reasoning, avoiding fixed hand-crafted pipelines and in-domain fine-tuning while targeting flexible zero-shot composition.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract highlights training-free evaluation and generalization claims for 3D grounded reasoning but does not specify benchmarks, metrics, baselines, or numerical improvements.

recommendation.zh: 当作3D落地的prompt编排案例扫一眼：重点看多agent分工与失败模式，training-free结果受工具链影响大，信号偏弱。
recommendation.en: Glance as a prompt-orchestration case study for 3D: focus on agent roles + failure modes; training-free gains are heavily toolchain-dependent, so treat as weak evidence.

paper.title: Hidden in Plain Sight: Visual-to-Symbolic Analytical Solution Inference from Field Visualizations

summary.core_problem: 从物理场的可视化图像(及一阶导数等元信息)中恢复可执行的解析符号解(SymPy表达式)，实现“视觉到符号”的科学推理。
summary.importance: 贡献类型为Benchmark+方法：提出ViSA任务与VLM可用的合成基准ViSA-Bench，并给出自验证的解题流水线；对多模态推理、符号回归式评测与可验证CoT流程有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出ViSA-R2与“solution-centric、自验证”的链式流程：结构/模式识别→解族(ansatz)假设→参数推导→一致性验证；输出为单个可执行SymPy表达式且常数需完全实例化；评测同时考虑数值精度、表达式结构相似度与字符级准确率。
summary.experiments: 发布ViSA-Bench：覆盖30类二维线性稳态场景、带可验证符号标注；在8B级开源权重模型上评测（摘要未给出具体模型名、训练/微调细节与相对提升幅度）。

summary_en.core_problem: Inferring executable symbolic analytical solutions (e.g., SymPy expressions) directly from visualizations of physical fields (with auxiliary metadata such as first derivatives), enabling visual-to-symbolic scientific reasoning.
summary_en.importance: Contributes a new task and benchmark (ViSA / ViSA-Bench) plus a verification-centric solving pipeline, offering a testbed for multimodal reasoning with objectively checkable symbolic outputs and evaluation beyond free-form text.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces a solution-centric, self-verifying chain (ViSA-R2): recognize structure/patterns in the field visualization, hypothesize an ansatz family, derive parameters, and verify consistency; requires output as a single fully instantiated SymPy expression and evaluates via numerical accuracy, structural similarity, and character-level correctness.
summary_en.experiments: Releases ViSA-Bench covering 30 classes of 2D linear steady-state scenarios with verifiable symbolic labels; evaluates 8B-scale open-weight models (specific models and training details not provided in the abstract).

recommendation.zh: 值得知道有“视觉到符号解”这个可验证评测：只看数据合成与自验证流程，模型部分更像baseline堆叠，适合做鲁棒性回归测试。
recommendation.en: Good to know as a verifiable ‘vision-to-symbolic-solution’ eval: skim the data synthesis + self-check loop; modeling is mostly baseline stacking, useful for robustness regression.

paper.title: VL-Calibration: Decoupled Confidence Calibration for Large Vision-Language Models Reasoning

summary.core_problem: 论文解决LVLM（大视觉语言模型）在多模态推理中“答错但很自信”的校准问题，尤其是幻觉（hallucination）导致的高置信错误。作者指出：沿用文本LLM的“单一整体置信度+答案对错二值监督”的口径不适配LVLM，因为错误可能来自两类不同源头——视觉感知失败（没看对图/没grounding）或在感知正确前提下的推理错误；单一置信度会混淆两者，并且视觉不确定性常被语言先验掩盖。
summary.importance: 在医疗、法律等高风险场景，模型不仅要“尽量对”，还要“知道自己何时不确定”。LVLM的错误往往是视觉幻觉或语言先验主导下的臆断，导致置信度严重失真。本文提出将置信度显式解耦为“视觉感知置信度”和“推理置信度”，并给出在缺乏视觉置信度真值标签时可训练的RL奖励构造与token级训练技巧，在降低ECE的同时还能提升准确率，具有直接工程价值。
summary.technical_approach:
1) 置信度解耦框架（两阶段/两类token）：模型输出不仅包含推理链z与答案y，还显式生成与“视觉依据（visual rationale）”相关的置信度token，以及与“逻辑推理链（reasoning chain）”相关的置信度token，从而把不确定性来源拆开。
2) RL训练范式：在RLVR（可验证奖励RL）基础上，除二值正确性奖励R_acc外，引入校准目标。对比既有方法（如用Brier Score对整体置信度c做L2校准），本文强调LVLM需要针对视觉与推理分别校准。
3) 视觉置信度无真值的奖励估计：提出Visual Certainty Reward，将两类信号结合：
  - Visual Grounding：比较“原图”与“扰动图”条件下模型输出分布的KL散度；KL越大表示输出对视觉内容更敏感、更grounded。
  - Internal Certainty：对视觉描述相关token计算熵（entropy）；熵越低表示内部更确定。
  - 融合方式：用log-scale形式整合，既奖励“既grounded又自信”的视觉表述，又通过对数压缩动态范围提升RL稳定性。
4) Token-level Advantage Reweighting：指出二值结果奖励对所有token一视同仁会放大幻觉。作者用上述视觉不确定性估计对优势函数做token级重加权：对高视觉不确定且带来负优势的token加大惩罚，从而抑制不grounded的幻觉，同时尽量保留有效的视觉感知内容。
summary.experiments:
在13个基准上系统评测（以Qwen3-VL系列为主）：
- 校准指标：ECE显著下降（文中报告从0.421降至0.098）。
- 准确率：在最强基线之上平均提升约2.3%–3.0%，表明校准训练未以牺牲能力为代价，反而改善推理/回答质量。
- 泛化与鲁棒性：跨模型尺度、不同架构、以及OOD基准均观察到一致收益，支持“解耦校准+视觉确定性奖励+token级重加权”的通用性。
summary.reading_guide:
【skim（泛读）】
- 读Introduction：抓住动机（LVLM错误来源解耦）与三项贡献（解耦置信度、视觉确定性奖励、token级优势重加权）。
- 读Methodology中对比段：理解与SaySelf/RLCR等“整体置信度+Brier”的差异。
- 快看实验总表：ECE与Accuracy的同时提升是本文最重要的结果。

【must_read（精读）】
- 精读“Visual Certainty Reward”构造：
  1) 原图vs扰动图KL作为grounding度量的合理性与实现细节；
  2) 视觉描述token熵作为internal certainty的定义；
  3) log-scale融合为何能稳定训练。
- 精读“Token-level Advantage Reweighting”：这是把“视觉不确定性估计”真正注入RL优化的关键机制，决定是否能抑制幻觉而不伤害有效感知。
- 精读消融实验：分别去掉grounding项/entropy项/log-scale/重加权，观察ECE与准确率如何变化，以确认每个组件的必要性。
- 重点图表建议：
  1) 框架示意图（两阶段解耦输出）；
  2) ECE下降与可靠性图（reliability diagram，如有）；
  3) OOD与跨尺度结果表（验证泛化）。
summary.authors_note: 作者的关键洞察是：LVLM的“自信错误”往往不是单一原因，必须把视觉感知与逻辑推理的不确定性拆开表达与优化；否则语言先验会主导整体置信度。由于视觉置信度缺乏标注，论文用“对图像扰动的敏感性（grounding）+内部熵（certainty）”构造可学习的视觉确定性奖励，并进一步用token级优势重加权把该信号精细注入训练，从而同时改善校准与准确率。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles confidence miscalibration in large vision-language models (LVLMs), where models often produce incorrect or hallucinated answers with high certainty. It argues that text-LLM-style calibration—optimizing a single holistic confidence score using binary answer correctness—mismatches LVLMs because errors can stem from (i) visual perception/grounding failures or (ii) reasoning failures given correct perception; a single confidence conflates these sources and visual uncertainty is often overwhelmed by language priors.
summary_en.importance: In high-stakes applications, models must be both accurate and reliably uncertain when they are likely wrong. LVLM hallucinations and language-prior dominance make confidence particularly unreliable. By explicitly decoupling perception vs reasoning confidence and providing an RL-trainable visual-certainty signal without ground-truth confidence labels, the work offers a practical path to safer LVLM deployment, achieving large ECE reductions while improving accuracy.
summary_en.technical_approach:
1) Decoupled confidence: the model is prompted/trained to output separate confidence tokens for the visual rationale (perception/grounding) and for the reasoning chain, rather than a single global confidence.
2) RL training: built on RL with verifiable rewards (RLVR) using binary correctness R_acc, extending prior holistic-confidence methods (e.g., Brier-score calibration) to a decoupled setting suitable for LVLMs.
3) Visual Certainty Reward without labels: combines
  - Visual Grounding: KL divergence between output distributions conditioned on the original image vs a perturbed image; higher KL implies stronger dependence on visual content (better grounding).
  - Internal Certainty: token entropy over the visual description; lower entropy indicates higher internal confidence.
  - Log-scale fusion: integrates the two signals while compressing dynamic range for more stable RL optimization.
4) Token-level Advantage Reweighting: addresses the weakness of trajectory-level binary rewards by reweighting token-level advantages using the estimated visual uncertainty—penalizing high-uncertainty tokens with negative advantage to suppress ungrounded hallucinations while preserving valid perception content.
summary_en.experiments:
Evaluated on 13 benchmarks (notably on Qwen3-VL models):
- Calibration: ECE drops substantially (reported from 0.421 to 0.098).
- Accuracy: improves by ~2.3%–3.0% over the strongest baselines, indicating calibration training also enhances answer quality.
- Generalization: consistent gains across model scales, architectures, and out-of-distribution benchmarks, supporting the robustness of the decoupled calibration paradigm and the proposed rewards/training tricks.
summary_en.reading_guide:
【skim】
- Read the Introduction for motivation (perception vs reasoning error sources) and the three main contributions (decoupling, visual-certainty reward, token-level reweighting).
- Skim the Methodology comparison to SaySelf/RLCR-style holistic confidence + Brier score.
- Check the main results tables: simultaneous ECE reduction and accuracy gain is the headline.

【must_read】
- Study the Visual Certainty Reward in detail: KL(original vs perturbed) as grounding, entropy as internal certainty, and why log-scale fusion stabilizes RL.
- Study Token-level Advantage Reweighting: the key mechanism that injects visual-uncertainty signals into optimization to curb hallucinations.
- Read ablations: remove grounding/entropy/log-scale/reweighting to verify each component’s contribution.
- Focus figures/tables: framework diagram (two-phase decoupling), calibration/reliability plots (if provided), and OOD + cross-scale results.
summary_en.authors_note: The main insight is that LVLM overconfidence is multi-causal; calibration must separate visual perception uncertainty from reasoning uncertainty. Lacking ground-truth visual-confidence labels, the paper constructs a learnable visual-certainty reward from image-perturbation sensitivity (grounding) and token entropy (internal certainty), and further applies token-level advantage reweighting to directly suppress ungrounded hallucination tokens—yielding better calibration and higher accuracy.

recommendation.zh: 把 LVLM 置信度拆成“视觉感知 vs 推理”两头，工程上能直接降高置信幻觉；重点看解耦训练目标与无视觉真值时的奖励构造，别纠结花哨指标。
recommendation.en: Decouples LVLM confidence into perception vs reasoning—practically useful for reducing high-confidence hallucinations; focus on the training objective and reward design without visual ground-truth, ignore the metric garnish.

paper.title: Arbitration Failure, Not Perceptual Blindness: How Vision-Language Models Resolve Visual-Linguistic Conflicts

summary.core_problem: 解释VLM在视觉-语言冲突（例如图像是蓝香蕉但回答“黄”）时失败的根因：是“看不见”(perceptual blindness)还是“仲裁失败”(arbitration failure)。
summary.importance: 机制分析/诊断贡献：提出“Encoding–Grounding Dissociation”——失败样本中模型仍能编码视觉证据，但在后层/输出阶段被语言先验压制；为理解与缓解VLM幻觉/先验支配提供可检验的层级证据与分析工具。
summary.technical_approach: 在10个VLM上做Multimodal Arbitration Crossover (MAC)分析，结合layer-by-layer Logit Lens probing跟踪各层视觉信号与先验信号的竞争；用线性可解码性评估早层视觉属性编码强度，并比较成功/失败样本在编码强度与最终logit差距上的关联，指出决定因素更接近“最终层仲裁/融合”而非“早期感知编码”。
summary.experiments: 覆盖10个不同规模VLM；报告视觉属性在早层可线性解码（AUC > 0.86），且成功/失败样本的编码强度近似；最终层logit差距更能预测grounding结果（摘要中相关系数数值未完整给出）。未提供具体模型名称、数据集与完整指标细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Identify whether vision-language model failures under visual–linguistic conflict arise from inability to perceive visual evidence (perceptual blindness) or from later-stage arbitration that overweights language priors (arbitration failure).
summary_en.importance: Proposes and supports an Encoding–Grounding Dissociation: models can encode the relevant visual attributes yet still answer incorrectly due to downstream fusion/decision dynamics, offering a testable, layer-resolved account of VLM hallucinations and prior dominance.
summary_en.technical_approach: Applies Multimodal Arbitration Crossover (MAC) analysis across models, using layer-by-layer logit-lens probing to track competition between visual evidence and linguistic priors; measures early-layer visual attribute encoding via linear decodability and relates success/failure primarily to final-layer logit arbitration rather than encoding strength.
summary_en.experiments: Across 10 VLMs, early-layer visual attributes are linearly decodable with high performance (AUC > 0.86) and are similar for success vs failure cases, while final-layer logit differences better predict grounding outcomes; the abstract omits specific model names, datasets, and full metric reporting.

recommendation.zh: 值得知道“看见了但输出被语言先验压住”的诊断视角；但对训练改法指向不强，读核心分析与层级证据图即可。
recommendation.en: Useful to internalize the ‘it encodes vision but language prior wins’ diagnosis; not very prescriptive for training—read the core analysis and layer-wise evidence figures.

paper.title: CORA: Conformal Risk-Controlled Agents for Safeguarded Mobile GUI Automation

summary.core_problem: 移动端GUI自动化代理（VLM/LLM驱动）从“建议”走向“代操作”后，动作空间巨大且不可逆高风险（转账、授权、隐私外发等）。现有防护（提示词自检、启发式规则、VLM-critic）缺乏形式化保证、难以在分布漂移下校准，且无法提供用户可调的风险-自主性权衡。
summary.importance: 移动端场景比桌面更脆弱：屏幕小导致误触更频繁；权限/支付/社交与真实身份资产强绑定；通知/弹窗/覆盖层带来持续的注入面；个性化与版本碎片化导致强分布漂移。若没有“可验证的执行风险控制”，代理一旦误执行会造成不可逆损失，因此需要可部署、可校准、可调参的安全控制层。
summary.technical_approach:
CORA提出“选择性动作执行”（带拒绝/弃权的预测）范式：基础策略每步提出动作a^t，安全控制器决定Execute或Abstain。

核心由三部分耦合：
1) Guardian风险模型Rψ：学习“动作条件风险”——在当前GUI状态与历史下，执行该特定候选动作会导致伤害的概率/风险（不是泛化的‘是否危险’评分，而是对‘执行这个动作’的条件化评估）。
2) Conformal Calibration（CRC）：不直接阈值化原始风险分数，而用Conformal Risk Control把执行/拒绝边界校准到满足用户指定风险预算α（对“已执行动作中的伤害率”给出统计保证）。同时面向部署的分布漂移，扩展为加权校准（covariate shift下的weighted conformal）与更保守的序列化处理以应对时序相关。
3) Diagnostician干预模型：对被拒绝的动作进行多模态反思与最小化干预建议，将拒绝细分为Confirm/Reflect/Abort，目标是在降低伤害的同时控制打扰成本。

额外机制：Goal-Lock（目标锁定）冻结用户目标g，将屏幕文本视为不可信证据以缓解间接注入/目标劫持。

评估与报告方式：强调风险-覆盖率（coverage=执行比例）与安全-有用性-打扰的前沿曲线，而非单一分数，直接对应部署中的“少打扰 vs 少出事”的可调权衡。
summary.experiments: 提出Phone-Harm移动端安全基准：Harm-150（150个人工撰写高风险任务，含逐步伤害标注）+ Normal-150（150个同协议构造的纯良性任务），用于对抗式安全评估与混合流量（更贴近部署）分析。Harm-150将OS-Harm威胁框架迁移到移动端，强调不可逆与隐私敏感动作（授权、支付、外发）。数据由人工撰写与人工标注，并与训练分布保持隔离以降低泄漏风险。论文主张用CORA在该基准上展示：在给定α下对“执行伤害率”实现校准控制，并通过Diagnostician在拒绝时减少不必要中断。
summary.reading_guide:
【skim（泛读）】
- 读Introduction：把握移动端GUI风险来源、为何现有prompt/heuristic/critic不够。
- 重点看“Selective action execution”定义与风险-覆盖率/前沿报告协议（理解论文评价口径）。
- 快速扫Phone-Harm构建与Harm-150/Normal-150设定（理解任务与标注粒度）。

【must_read（精读）】
- 精读方法部分三件套：Guardian（动作条件风险建模目标与输入输出）、CRC校准（α含义、保证对象是‘executed-harm rate’而非总体风险、以及加权校准处理shift）、Diagnostician（Confirm/Reflect/Abort的触发逻辑与如何降低打扰）。
- 精读Goal-Lock：其威胁模型假设（屏幕文本不可信）与对注入的覆盖边界。
- 精读实验：风险-覆盖率曲线、混合流量设置、以及在shift/序列依赖下保证是否仍成立（看是否采用保守扩展/加权）。
- 建议对照：CORA是post-policy、pre-action控制层——与“训练时对齐/奖励惩罚”不同，关注其可插拔性与部署校准流程。
summary.authors_note: 作者核心主张是把GUI安全从“让模型更乖”转为“对已执行动作的伤害率做可校准、可验证的统计控制”，并提供用户可调α来显式管理风险-自主性权衡；同时用Phone-Harm把移动端不可逆高风险动作系统化为可评测基准。

summary_en.core_problem: Mobile GUI agents powered by VLMs/LLMs are moving from assistance to autonomous execution, where a single mis-click can trigger irreversible harm (payments, permissions, privacy disclosures). Existing safeguards (prompting, heuristics, VLM-as-critic) are brittle, poorly calibrated under distribution shift, and provide no formal, user-tunable guarantees.
summary_en.importance: Mobile environments amplify risk: small screens increase grounding/mis-tap errors; permissions/payments/social actions are tightly coupled to real identity and assets; notifications/pop-ups create a constant injection surface; personalization and app/version churn induce strong distribution shift. Deployment therefore needs a calibrated execution controller with explicit statistical guarantees, not ad-hoc filters.
summary_en.technical_approach:
CORA frames safety as selective action execution (prediction with abstention). At each step, a base policy proposes an action a^t; a safety controller decides Execute vs Abstain.

CORA couples three components:
1) An action-conditional Guardian model Rψ that estimates the risk of executing the specific proposed action in the current GUI state/history.
2) A Conformal Calibration module using Conformal Risk Control (CRC) to calibrate the execute/abstain boundary to satisfy a user-specified risk budget α on the executed-harm rate (rather than thresholding raw scores). For deployment realism, it incorporates weighted calibration under covariate shift and conservative extensions for sequential dependence.
3) A trainable Diagnostician that handles rejected actions with minimal interventions—Confirm, Reflect, or Abort—to reduce harm while controlling user interruption.

Additionally, CORA uses Goal-Lock: it freezes the user goal and treats on-screen text as untrusted evidence to mitigate indirect prompt injection/goal hijacking.

Evaluation is reported as risk–coverage and safety–helpfulness–interruption frontiers, matching the real deployment trade-off between autonomy and safety.
summary_en.experiments: Introduces Phone-Harm, a mobile benchmark with Harm-150 (150 human-authored harmful tasks with step-level harm labels) and a matched Normal-150 (150 benign tasks) for both adversarial safety testing and mixed-traffic analysis. Harm-150 adapts OS-Harm threat framing (misuse, injection, misbehavior) to mobile, emphasizing irreversible/privacy-sensitive actions (permissions, payments, external disclosures). The benchmark is human-authored/annotated and kept disjoint from pipeline-generated training data to reduce leakage. Experiments are positioned to show CRC-calibrated control of executed-harm rate at target α and reduced unnecessary interruptions via the Diagnostician.
summary_en.reading_guide:
【skim】
- Introduction: why mobile GUI safety is harder; limitations of prompt/heuristic/critic safeguards.
- The “selective execution” formulation and the risk–coverage / frontier-based reporting.
- Phone-Harm setup (Harm-150 vs Normal-150) to understand the evaluation target.

【must_read】
- Method details: (i) Guardian’s action-conditional risk objective, (ii) CRC calibration and what guarantee is provided (executed-harm rate), plus weighted conformal for shift and conservative sequential handling, (iii) Diagnostician’s Confirm/Reflect/Abort design and interruption minimization.
- Goal-Lock: threat model assumptions and what injection channels it covers.
- Experimental plots: risk–coverage curves, mixed-traffic evaluation, and robustness under shift/sequential dependence.
- Conceptual positioning: CORA is post-policy, pre-action (plug-in controller), distinct from training-time alignment.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper’s key thesis is to move from “make the agent behave” to “statistically control the harm rate of executed actions” with a user-tunable α, enabled by conformal risk control, and to ground mobile-specific evaluation via the Phone-Harm benchmark.

recommendation.zh: 把“可调风险预算+校准保证”引入GUI代操作，比提示词自检靠谱；建议细读风险控制形式化与校准实验，便于落地成安全层。
recommendation.en: Brings tunable risk budgets + calibration-style guarantees to GUI actuation, more actionable than prompt self-checks; read the formal risk control and calibration experiments for deployment.
